It features Cuisinart’s exclusive PURELYCERAMIC™ Nonstick Advanced Release System, which is free of PFAS, PFOS, PFOA, and petroleum, ensuring easy food release and allowing for cooking with less oil and butter.

The stainless steel handles, made from 70% recycled material, stay cool on the stovetop. Designed for professional results, the cookware is perfect for simmering, sautéing, and searing, and its fast, energy-efficient heating makes it suitable for all stovetops, including induction. *Reduces the amount of fossil fuel-based plastic used in these products

ADZ-112.name: 11-qt Dual Basket Air Fryer Pro
ADZ-112.description: Cook two delicious foods at the same time with the Cuisinart® Dual Basket Air Fryer. Whether making a family meal, or dinner for one, this dual air fryer allows you to cook two different foods at once, with different times and temperatures on each side, thanks to a Sync Finish feature that ensures both are ready to enjoy at the same time. It boasts 11-quart capacity (two 5.5-qt baskets), has 6 convenient cooking functions — air fry, roast, bake, broil, dehydrate, and keep warm, while a toss reminder, auto-pause, and auto-warm make cooking a breeze. Each basket can cook: 1.5 lb fries, 2 lb wings, 4 chicken cutlets, 4 lb whole chicken, 4 salmon fillets; fits a standard 9"x5" loaf pan. Sync Settings Technology effortlessly replicates cooking settings for batch cooking one food type in both baskets, while Sync Finish Technology ensures your meals are perfectly timed. Includes must-have presets: Wings, Fries, Frozen Snacks, Vegetables, and Nuggets presets. The ceramic nonstick baskets and crisper plates makes cleanup easy, and the viewing window includes an interior light. This double air fryer makes mealtime effortless.

54C-11R.name: 11 Piece Set Ceramica XT Nonstick Cookware
54C-11R.description: Perform all cooking tasks, large or small, with this Cuisinart® Non-Stick Cookware set. Now you can simmer, sauté, fry, boil or braise to your heart’s content! Our exclusive Ceramica® XT non-stick interior is titanium reinforced for enhanced food release and durability. The powerful non-stick will not stain or discolor.

MW89-11.description: This premium 11 piece set includes all of the cookware essentials for classic cooking techniques like slow simmers, delicate browning and reduction of liquids and is also oven safe. This cookware is dishwasher safe so cleanup is conveniently hassle free. A beautiful white matte exterior brightens up your kitchen and complements any kitchen décor.

MBK89-11.name: 11pc Matte Black Elegance Set
MBK89-11.description: This 11-Piece cookware set an elegant matte black finish and professional stainless steel construction with a matte black exterior. Additionally, the magnetic stainless steel bodies are compatible with all stovetops, including induction, and the cookware is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Set includes: 2 Qt. saucepan with cover, 3 Qt. saucepan with cover, 3.5 Qt. saute pan with helper handle and cover, 6 Qt. stockpot with cover, 8" ceramic nonstick skillet, 10" stainless steel skillet, 20cm universal steamer.

CPB-11WB.name: 11" White Board with Black

CPP-612P.name: 12" Aluminum Pizza Peel
CPP-612P.description: The Cuisinart® 12" Aluminum Pizza Peel is the perfect tool for making perfect pizzas right at home! The peel features an aluminum surface that is lightweight and easy to handle. Prep your uncooked pizzas right on the peel and easily transfer them to and from your grill or oven. The wooden handle on the peel offers a stylish touch and folds down for compact storage.

DCC-1120NAS.name: 12 Cup Classic Programmable Coffee Maker
DCC-1120NAS.description: The Cuisinart® Classic Coffeemaker brings fresh coffee brewing to your kitchen with classic styling that's beautiful, functional, and easy to program. Make 1-4 cups—or as many as 12—in the large-capacity carafe that features an ergonomic handle, knuckle guard, and drip-free spout for safe and fuss-free serving. Program brewing up to 24 hours in advance, set it to turn off automatically, or sneak a quick cup in the middle of a brew cycle with the Brew Pause™ feature. The most delicious hot coffee is fast and fresh when filtered through both an easy-clean, permanent gold tone filter and a charcoal water filter. Make your most delicious cup of the day right at home with Cuisinart.

CWA-0041.name: 12" Carbon Steel Hammered Wok (Round)
CWA-0041.description: Master the art of stir-fry and more with the Cuisinart 12-inch Carbon Steel Hammered Wok. The professional-grade design with a classic round bottom, this wok locks in flavors and juices, delivering that signature wok hei taste you crave. Perfect for stir-frying, sautéing, steaming, noodles, and even deep-frying, its versatile design caters to a variety of cooking styles. The durable hand-hammered carbon steel construction is unseasoned, allowing you to create a natural non-stick surface through seasoning. Equipped with a sturdy wood handle and a front helper handle, it offers excellent control and comfort during use. Elevate your culinary game with this 1-pan solution; a must-have wok for breakfast, lunch, and dinner!

CTG-00-12FSTN.name: 12"  Squared Head Silicone Tongs
CTG-00-12FSTN.description: The versatile 12" Squared Head Silicone Tongs are perfect for tossing salads, flipping cutlets, and safely retrieving items from boiling water! These tongs feature a comfortable soft-grip handle and a convenient locking pull tab for easy storage. Crafted from heavy-gauge stainless steel, they boast a squared edge silicone tong head that effortlessly slides under food while cooking and serving. The tong heads have silicone teeth that grip food securely while in use and are heat resistant up to 450°F.  These Cuisinart® 12"  Squared Head Silicone Tongs keep hands away from the heat and are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.

CPC-900NAS.name: 12-in-1 Multicooker 6 Quart
CPC-900NAS.description: Cuisinart® picks up the pressure with this powerful new 12-in-1 Multicooker. Cooking under pressure can finish a meal 70% faster, and with its max 15psi, this multicooker can do it even faster! But versatility is the big story. This is a top-of-line multicooker, with 12 pre-programmed settings for everything from meat to risotto to sautéed veggies. It’s truly an appliance that does it all. And it makes doing it all so easy, with intuitive digital controls and a large, easy-to-read LCD. Uniquely shaped and finished, it’s destined to take center stage in any kitchen.

The luxurious, rounded full-body design enhances any kitchen, while the triple-ply stainless steel construction ensures durability and timeless appeal. Experience precise and even heat distribution with Heat Surround™ technology, where an aluminum core extends from the pan’s base up the sidewalls for flawless cooking results. Stay in control with cast stainless steel Cool Grip™ handles that remain cool to the touch, offering comfort and security. The tempered glass lids, framed with sleek stainless steel and wide handles, lock in moisture and flavor. The sealed, dripless rims ensure effortless, mess-free pouring and make cleanup a breeze in the dishwasher. Compatible with all stovetops, including induction, and oven-safe up to 500°F (450°F for lids), this cookware is as versatile as it is timeless—ready to elevate every meal you make. Stockpot with Cover, 8" Skillet with Cover, 10" Skillet, Universal Steamer Insert.

CGS-1312.name: 12 Piece Griddle Tool Set
CGS-1312.description: The Cuisinart 12 Piece Griddle Set provides you with everything you need to master the griddle! The griddle spatulas include one solid and one perforated spatula for handling anything you throw on the griddle. The perforated design allows for excess grease to drip through for healthier cooking. The 4 silicone eggs rings will help you create perfectly shaped eggs for bacon and eggs or egg sandwiches and the non-stick material easily slides off, keeping your eggs in tact. CGWM-083.name: 12.25" Melting Dome with Bonus Wire Rack

CPM-700NAS.name: 16 Cup Popcorn Maker
CPM-700NAS.description: The Cuisinart®16 Cup Popcorn Maker makes it easier than ever to pop crunchy homemade popcorn. The Cuisinart® 16 Cup Popcorn Maker pops up to 16 cups and has special vents in the popping bowl to let moisture escape. Popcorn lovers can select the desired amount of oil and salt to make popcorn just the way they like it. When popping is complete, they can serve right from the popping bowl. The Cuisinart® 16 Cup Popcorn Maker operates with the simple flip of a switch. Cleanup is easy too: All removable are parts are dishwasher safe. Easy! Fast! Fun!

C77SSH-15P.name: 15pc Stainless Steel Cutlery Block Set
C77SSH-15P.description:
Cuisinart premium cutlery is created for cooks in every kitchen. The Classic Collection features high-quality stainless steel knives. Crafted with sleek, modern lines, precision blades, durable bolsters, and elegant textured handles, this superior cutlery has all the versatility you need to handle food preparation like a pro.


15pc Set Includes: 
8" Chef Knife
8" Slicing Knife
7" Santoku Knife
5.5" Serrated Utility Knife
4.5" Steak Knives (6)
3.5" Paring Knife
2.75" Bird's Peak Paring Knife
8" Sharpening Steel
All-Purpose Household Shears
Wood Block

CCG-216A.name: 16" Portable Charcoal Grill
CCG-216A.description: The Cuisinart® 16" Portable Charcoal Grill offers the perfect solution for easy grilling when camping, tailgating, or at home! This compact grill is lightweight and easy to transport, featuring locking latches that keep the lid secured to the body. The 4-legged design is ideal for stability while grilling, ensuring your grill wont rock or tip during use. Controlling temperature is so important when cooking with charcoal, so that is why the Cuisinart® 16" Portable Charcoal Grill features a dual vent system with an air inlet vent on the bottom of the fire bowl and an air exhaust vent on the lid. The ash catcher below the fire bowl protects the surface beneath your grill from any hot bits of charcoal that may fall through while cooking.

CWB-16B.name: 16.5" Bamboo Cutting Board
CWB-16B.description: Protect countertops and knife edges with Cuisinart® cutting boards. These sturdy wood boards are perfect for prepping, serving, cutting and carving. Offering a variety of shapes and sizes for every cutting task, backed by a lifetime warranty. Reversible design lets you use both sides and can be easily hand washed for best results. 16” x 12” Bamboo Wood Cutting Board with Stainless Steel Handle.

COS-116.name: 16" Vertical Charcoal Smoker
COS-116.description: The Cuisinart® Vertical 16” Charcoal Smoker was built to last. The three year warranty adds confidence to the durable framework and porcelain enamel water bowl. With two 16” solid steel cooking grates, this smoker can accommodate just about any food you’re looking to smoke at the house. Working a charcoal smoker is as simple as lighting the charcoal, filling up the water bowl, and then casually adjusting the air vents to control the temperature. This vertical barrel design makes it easy to keep a consistent temperature with minimal adjustments and accessing the water bowl and charcoal grate doesn’t get much easier with this vertically hinged door. When all you need to setup the Cuisinart® Vertical 16” Charcoal smoker is 15 minutes and a screwdriver, you’ll be smoking your favorite foods in no time!

AMB-17BS.name: 17" Baking Sheet
AMB-17BS.description: Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Non-Stick Bakeware is ideal for today's cooks. The full line is constructed of heavy gauge aluminized steel to provide even heat distribution and consistent baking results. The nonstick interior and exterior ensure easy food release and cleanup, and extra-thick rolled edges prevent warping. The entire line is dishwasher safe. Cuisinart® quality promises you a lifetime of great performance, whatever the baking task!

AMB-17CS.name: 17" Cookie Sheet
AMB-17CS.description: Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Non-Stick Bakeware is ideal for today's cooks. The full line is constructed of heavy gauge aluminized steel to provide even heat distribution and consistent baking results. The nonstick interior and exterior ensure easy food release and cleanup, and extra-thick rolled edges prevent warping. The entire line is dishwasher safe. Cuisinart® quality promises you a lifetime of great performance, whatever the baking task!

C77SS-15PGA.name: 15pc Elite Series Stainless Steel Block Set with Acacia Block
C77SS-15PGA.description: Durably designed to make every cutting task quick and easy, this premium cutlery set features German steel blades for ultra-sharp precision and ergonomic hollow handles for superior balance and comfort. Premium hollow-handle steak knives are weighted for smooth cutting performance, and the full set is beautifully displayed in an Acacia wood storage block.

CMHB-17BS.name: Easy Grip®  Nonstick Metal 17" Baking Sheet
CMHB-17BS.description: The Easy-Grip™ Non-Stick Metal Bakeware line is constructed of heavy gauge steel. Comfortable handles allow easy lifting and rolled edges prevent warping. All items in this line have a premium non-stick interior and exterior for easy food release and are dishwasher safe.

CWB-17EGA.name: 17" Reversible End Grain Acacia Cutting Board
CWB-17EGA.description:
EXCEPTIONAL CRAFTSMANSHIP
High-quality, distinctively designed end grain Acacia wood combines beauty and durability 
PERFECTLY PROPORTIONED 
The ideal size for prepping fruits, vegetables, meats, and more. 
MAXIMUM VERSITILITY 
Smooth, flat cutting surface on one side, deep grooved well on the other for catching juices during food prep. EMBEDDED HANDLES
Easy to lift for moving, serving, and storing.

CGG-9236.name: 17" Tabletop Gas Griddle with Hood
CGG-9236.description: Looking for easy, versatile cooking at home or on-the-go? The Cuisinart 17" Tabletop Gas Griddle is the perfect solution. Whether you're cooking for a small crowd or packing it up for outdoor adventures, this compact griddle delivers. With enough space to cook 12 burgers or 6 NY strip steaks at once, it’s ideal for camping, tailgating, picnics, or any outdoor event. The built-in hood protects the griddle when not in use and doubles as a way to melt cheese on burgers. Setup is quick and easy—just attach the legs, hood, and grease cup brackets, and you'll be ready to cook in 15 minutes.

CWB-17EGB.name: 17" Reversible End Grain Bamboo Cutting Board
CWB-17EGB.description:
EXCEPTIONAL CRAFTSMANSHIP
High-quality, distinctively designed end grain Bamboo wood combines beauty and durability 
PERFECTLY PROPORTIONED

MAXIMUM VERSITILITY

Easy to lift for moving, serving, and storing.

SMB-17BS.name: Easy Grip® Silicone Grip Nonstick 17" Baking Sheet
SMB-17BS.description: Boasting thick rolled edges to prevent warping, the Cuisinart® Easy Grip® Nonstick Bakeware 17” Baking Sheet will provide perfect results, year after year. The sleekly styled 12” Baking Sheet is made of heavy-gauge steel with a dishwasher safe premium nonstick interior to make releasing cookies and other baked goods painless. The pan also features silicone grips on two sides for easy removal from the oven when hot.

CBP-518.name: 18” Butcher Paper Cutter Dispenser
CBP-518.description: The Cuisinart 18” Butcher Paper Holder will take your smoking game to the next level! Growing in popularity among the BBQ community, butcher paper is an FDA-approved paper that helps keep your meat moist by sealing in the juices and keeping the meat tender. Butcher paper is breathable, compared to foil, so it allows additional smoke flavor in while preventing it from losing moisture towards the end of the smoke. This holder features a non-slip grip on the base, keeping it in place while tearing sheets. Roll changing is easy with the dowel holder and arms that lock into the open position. Arm lifts to keep the roll in place, the serrated edge allows straight, clean cuts every time, making wrapping meat quick and easy. The holder has a compact fold for easy storage when not in use. The Cuisinart 18” Butcher Paper Holder helps you pull butcher paper with confidence, making wrapping your meat easier than ever!

CWB-18B.name: 18.75" Bamboo Cutting Board
CWB-18B.description: Protect countertops and knife edges with Cuisinart® cutting boards. These sturdy wood boards are perfect for prepping, serving, cutting and carving. Offering a variety of shapes and sizes for every cutting task, backed by a lifetime warranty. Reversible design lets you use both sides and can be easily hand washed for best results. 18.5” x 7” Bamboo Cutting Board.

CTG-00-FG.name: 2-in-1 Detachable Grater
CTG-00-FG.description: Dual coarse and medium grating surfaces and a soft-grip, nonslip handle and base make the 2-in-1 Detachable Grater perfect for grating over a cutting board or directly over food. Detachable for convenient use and folds flat for compact storage.

CEG-1149.name: 2-in-1 Indoor/Outdoor Electric Griddle
CEG-1149.description: The Cuisinart 2-in-1 Indoor/Outdoor Electric Griddle is the perfect cooking solution for any setting—whether you're whipping up breakfast in the kitchen or cooking dinner on the balcony. Designed for versatility and convenience, this compact electric griddle assembles in under 10 minutes, getting you ready to cook with ease. The powerful 120V heating element heats the non-stick griddle surface to over 550°F, providing the high temperatures needed for searing and perfectly cooked meals. With 240 sq. in. of cooking space, you can prepare anything from pancakes and bacon to stir-fry and grilled sandwiches. The griddle offers two setup options: use it on the stand for a traditional outdoor cooking experience, or easily remove it for tabletop cooking indoors. Whether you're making breakfast in your kitchen or hosting a cookout, this electric griddle makes it easy to enjoy griddled foods anywhere. The 5 adjustable heat settings allow you to fine-tune the temperature for various dishes. The grease management system keeps your cooking area clean by directing drippings into the collection cup below. The 6-foot power cord provides ample reach for both indoor and outdoor use.

CCB-2HCB.name: 18" Acacia Carving Board with Handles
CCB-2HCB.description: 18" Acacia Wood Cutting Board with Stainless Steel Handles. Great for Carving & Serving for everything from weeknight dinners to your special holiday meals.

COH-1900.name: 19.5” Cleanburn Smokeless Fire Pit
COH-1900.description: Stay Cozy, Stay Outdoors! Warmth without the smoke with the Cuisinart 19.5” Cleanburn Smokeless Fire Pit. With open wood fire pits, there is always someone who gets in the way of a cloud of smoke every so often, not anymore! Everyone can gather around and enjoy the warmth from this smokeless style fire pit! Fueled best by kiln dried / seasoned hardwood logs or wood chunks, this 19.5” Cleanburn smokeless design increases the airflow and burning process, so you can have the smokeless function with high heat performance. The bottom vents pull cooler oxygen in, feeding the flames from below while traveling between our innovative curved shaped double walls, causing the air to heat up, while igniting a fire faster. The hot air then travels through holes at the top of the unit, burning off any ash debris or smoke that the flames create, making this a smokeless fire pit. Clean up takes just 2 steps with our patent-pending base ash tray design. Simply remove the cooled fire bowl and lift the base to empty the ashes. The Cleanburn is crafted with stainless-steel interior bowl, and high-heat black enameled steel outer bowl construction that will last for many great fires in the years to come. Weighing only 19.6 lbs. makes it easy to adjust its current location when cooled by lifting up the sides of the bowl when connected to the stainless-steel ashtray base. the Cleanburn system makes you warmer, quicker! Experience the Cleanburn Advantage, Smokeless Flames, Limitless Memories!. Gather your friends around the Cuisinart 19.5" Cleanburn Smokeless Fire Pit and Ignite your Nights! . (Dimensions are: 19.5" Wide x 14.75” Height = Assembled.)

CTG-00-MIS.name: 2-in-1 Oil Mister and Pourer
CTG-00-MIS.description: Add flavor and prevent sticking with this handy kitchen essential. The Cuisinart® 2-in-1 Oil Mister & Pourer sprays an even mist to flavor salads, sauté, roast, air fry, grill and more! The pour spout provides an even flow for cooking and measuring by simply moving the lock switch to open the pour spout. This 2-in-1 oil mister & pourer lets you have more flavor with less fuss in the kitchen.

CEG-115.name: 2-in-1 Indoor/Outdoor Electric Grill
CEG-115.description: The Cuisinart 2-in-1 Indoor/Outdoor Electric Grill is the perfect grilling solution for any setting—whether you're cooking in the kitchen or on the balcony. Designed for convenience and versatility, this compact electric grill assembles in under 10 minutes, getting you ready to grill with ease. The powerful 120V heating element heats the non-stick cooking surface to over 550°F, giving you the searing power needed for delicious results. With 240 sq. in. of cooking space, you can grill up to 12 burgers at a time. The grill offers two setup options: use it with the stand for a traditional outdoor grilling experience or lift it off to place on any tabletop surface for indoor use. Whether you're grilling in your kitchen, hosting a cookout or BBQ, this electric grill makes it easy to enjoy grilled foods wherever you prefer. The 5 adjustable heat settings make it easy to achieve the perfect temperature for a variety of foods. A grease drainage channel ensures mess-free grilling by directing drippings into the collection cup below. The 6-foot power cord provides ample reach for both indoor and outdoor cooking.

CTG-00-LLP.name: 2-in-1 Lemon and Lime Press
CTG-00-LLP.description: Easily enhance recipes and elevate drinks with fresh citrus juice with the Cuisinart 2-in-1 Lemon and Lime Press.  Suitable for one-handed use, the lemon and lime press extracts juice fast and simply, perfect for adding fresh flavor to your favorite foods and cocktails.

WAF-RP10NAS.name: 2-in-1 Waffle Maker with Removable Plates
WAF-RP10NAS.description: Bake two styles of waffles, either Classic or Belgian waffles just the way you like them—all with one innovative kitchen essential. Removable nonstick plates switch easily and seamlessly from Belgian to Classic waffles. Choose the exact browning level to suit your taste. The Audible Alert and Indicator Light will let you know when your waffles are done to perfection. Enjoy TWO styles of waffles with ONE easy-to-use, easy-to-clean, easy-to-store waffle maker.

COM-209.name: 2-in-1 Oil Sprayer
COM-209.description: The 2-in-1 Oil Sprayer bottle is a fast and easy way to get a nice, misted coating of your choice of oil on your grill or on foods. Perfect for coating griddles, pans, salads, and more. The speed at which you spray the mister will allow you to get a direct spray or an even mist. Push the tab and it opens up to allow for pouring oil when more is needed. Not only is the mister great for adding flavor to food, but it also allows you to prevent the sticking of food to your cooking surface. The 2-in-1 Oil Sprayer & Dispenser has a clear glass bottom allowing you to easily see the oil level inside and is also easy to clean and dishwasher safe. Wide mouth design helps when adding oil or herbs into the vessel, a siphon screen keeps those bits from clogging the pickup tube for making your own flavors!. One less thing to worry about when you've finished your meal

MBK8922-810.name: 2-Pack Matte Black Elegance Skillet Set (8” & 10”)
MBK8922-810.description: This 2-pack skillet set features an elegant matte black finish and professional stainless steel construction with a matte black exterior. Its PowerBond™ high-impact bonded base ensures even heat distribution, allowing you to fry, sear, and sauté with professional results, while the riveted stainless steel blush bronze stick handles stay cool on the stovetop. Additionally, the magnetic stainless steel bodies are compatible with all stovetops, including induction, and the cookware is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Set includes: 8" Skillet and 10" Skillet.

CIT-2123.name: 2 Piece BBQ Tong Set
CIT-2123.description: The Cuisinart 2 Piece BBQ Tong Set includes a 15" tong and a 12" tong to help enhance your grilling experience. Both tongs feature stainless steel construction with slip-resistant silicone hand grips. Use the 15" tong to handle your meat or main dish and use the 12" tong to cook your side dish, preventing cross contamination. The 12" tong can also be utilized as a serving tool after using the 15" tong to cook your meal. The simple locking mechanism allows the tongs to be easily stored away in a kitchen drawer when not in use.

CCM-2PW.name: 2 piece Cutting Mat Set
CCM-2PW.description: 2pc Cutting Mat Set with printed wood design

AMB-CR2.name: 2 Piece 16" Cooling Racks
AMB-CR2.description: This premium 2-pk cooling rack set is perfect for cookies, biscuits, muffins, breads and plenty of other baked goods. The racks conveniently fit in 17” baking sheets to cook meats and crisp foods like bacon. The racks are designed with closely spaced bars, to easily support all foods and prevent food breakage, and feet to elevate the rack to maintain optimal airflow.

CTK-SS25CRW.name: 2 Qt. Cream Stainless Steel Tea Kettle
CTK-SS25CRW.description: Make two quarts of boiling hot water in style with the Cream 2 Qt. Tea Kettle from Cuisinart. The classic tea kettle will bring a splash of color to your kitchen, boasting sleek metallic finishes for looks that impress. Also features a traditional whistle that lets you know when the water is at boiling point.

6422-911.name: 2-PK Skillet Set 9" & 11" Skillets
6422-911.description:
EXCEPTIONAL DESIGN 
Anodized aluminum offers unsurpassed durability and cooking performance. COMFORTABLE HANDLING  
Cast stainless steel stick handles are contoured for a secure grip and designed to stay cool on the stovetop.  
CONVENIENTLY NONSTICK 
For healthier cooking and easy cleanup.

CTK-SS25MW.name: 2 Qt. Matte White Stainless Steel Tea Kettle
CTK-SS25MW.description: Make two quarts of boiling hot water in style with the Matte White 2 Qt. Tea Kettle from Cuisinart. The classic tea kettle will bring a splash of color to your kitchen, boasting sleek metallic finishes for looks that impress. Also features a traditional whistle that lets you know when the water is at boiling point.

619-18P.name: Discontinued 2 Quart Pour Saucepan
619-18P.description: No other piece of cookware performs with the versatility of the Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ 2  Qt. Nonstick Hard Anodized Saucepan. Whether you're preparing a delicate hollandaise sauce, steaming savory wild rice or simmering a hearty soup, no other pan offers more reliable results. Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Nonstick Hard Anodized Cookware features durable hard anodized construction for fast and even heating. We guarantee it with a lifetime warranty.

719-18P.name: 2 Quart Pour Saucepan
719-18P.description: A time and space saver, the 2 Quart Pour Saucepan is a necessity for today’s kitchens. With added measurement markings and an induction-ready base, classic cooking is stylish and simple. The spout and draining lid also ensure drip-free pouring – two different sized draining holes provide superior control.

CPT-122.name: 2 Slice Compact Plastic Toaster
CPT-122.description: Take control of your toast with the Cuisinart 2-Slice Compact Plastic Toaster, which boasts seven shades of toasting. This compact toaster saves space, whether placed sideways or facing forward to fit any kitchen counter or even dorm room. Whether you want a thick toasted bagel to snack on, toaster pastries, or thin sliced bread for a healthy twist on croutons, the wide slots and high-lift carriage make it easy to toast every time.

CPT-520.name: 2 Slice Motorized Toaster
CPT-520.description: Cuisinart® masters the art of toast making with the 2 Slice Automatic Toaster. With 4 programmable memory settings and automated lever less lift, all it takes to toast your favorite breads, bagels, English muffins, pastries, and waffles to the ideal shade is the touch of a button. Elevate your experience with advanced functions to make toasting quick and easy!

CPT-720.name: 2 Slice Digital Toaster with MemorySet Feature
CPT-720.description: Make mornings better with Cuisinart. Customize your toasting preferences with shade settings from light to dark and bread options from whole grains to gluten free. Large digital display clearly shows your selections and the countdown timer. Store your family's favorites with the MemorySet feature. Easy to save and even easier to select – now everyone can have their toast the way they like it at the touch of a button.

CPT-T20.name: Discontinued 2 Slice Touchscreen Toaster
CPT-T20.description: Cuisinart’s new T-Series line features trendsetting toasters with sleek touchscreen button controls for premium styling and effortless toasting. New features make these units stand out – QuickView™ function lets users check toast without interrupting the toasting cycle, and a +30-Second control adds a little extra time as needed. The T-Series sleek black touchpad changes the dynamic of today’s kitchen. Invisible in standby mode, it wakes up when the power icon is touched, illuminating options for Bagel, Defrost and Single Slice, as well as a choice of six shade settings. Style meets technology in the T-Series touchscreen toasters from Cuisinart!

CCF-27.name: 2.7 Cu. Ft. Compact Fridge
CCF-27.description: Utilize your space with this sleek 2.7 cubic foot compact refrigerator that provides ample storage for food and beverages. The adjustable thermostat makes it easy to regulate the temperature to preserve full flavor and freshness. The interior accommodates a wide variety of perishables, with clear-view vegetable and fruit crisper, removable and adjustable shelves, and built-in door storage for items you want to grab quickly. A freezer compartment stores ice cream, frozen vegetables and more. The door is reversible for easy left or right-side opening access!

AIR-80.name: 2.6-qt Basket Air Fryer
AIR-80.description: This 2.6-qt air fryer is a versatile, compact culinary companion—ideal for cooking complete meals for 1-2 people and whipping up delicious side dishes and snacks. Our Air Advantage™ technology ensures crispy perfection with air fry, bake, and roast functions plus 3 air fry presets. The viewing window with light, toss reminder and automatic warm makes air frying more convenient than ever. Plus, its space-saving design optimizes countertop space or allows for easy storage.

AMB-21BS.name: 21" Baking Sheet
AMB-21BS.description: Perfect for family size meals, such as sheet-pan dinners with chicken or fish, and a variety of roasted vegetables. A baker's dream for baking extra-large batches of cookies, granola, and more!

MCP116-20N.name: 20cm Universal Steamer
MCP116-20N.description: The most versatile steamer around allows you to serve up portions for one or a whole family. This beautifully designed, stainless steel universal steamer fits 2, 3, and 4 quart saucepans, making it easy to steam nutritious vegetables. Equipping your kitchen with this valuable addition to the line will help you steam vegetables perfectly, to your exact eating preference. This Cuisinart®MultiClad Pro Stainless Cookware piece is composed of stainless steel for unsurpassed durability and performance. We guarantee it with a lifetime warranty.

C77-2PSHR8B7R.name: 2 Piece Shears Set
C77-2PSHR8B7R.description: Cuisinart® earned a reputation for making ultra-sharp, precision cutting blades with its trademark food processors. Now that expertise is available in a line of top-quality kitchen shears that can cut anything from food to flowers, string and cardboard. Shears are lightweight and balanced for comfortable hold, and come in different colors and sizes for individual kitchen and cooking styles.

CGG-9242.name: 22" Tabletop Gas Griddle with Hood
CGG-9242.description: Looking for easy, versatile cooking at home or on-the-go? The Cuisinart 22" Tabletop Gas Griddle is the perfect solution. Whether you're cooking for a small crowd or packing it up for outdoor adventures, this compact griddle delivers. With enough space to cook 15 burgers or 8 NY strip steaks at once, it’s ideal for camping, tailgating, picnics, or any outdoor event. The built-in hood protects the griddle when not in use and doubles as a way to melt cheese on burgers. Setup is quick and easy—just attach the legs, hood, and grease cup brackets, and you'll be ready to cook in 10 minutes.

COH-800.name: 24" Cleanburn Fire Pit
COH-800.description: Enjoy the warmth of a roaring fire without the smoke with the patented Cuisinart 24” Cleanburn Smokeless Fire Pit. Say goodbye to shuffling seats to avoid smoke blowing in your face! Designed for enhanced airflow, this fire pit minimizes smoke and maximizes heat, creating a cozy centerpiece for your outdoor space. Our innovative curved double-wall design pulls cool air through bottom vents, feeding the fire and heating the air as it rises. This hot air escapes through top vents, burning off ash and smoke for a faster, cleaner, and smokeless fire experience. The durable stainless steel interior bowl ensures long-lasting performance, while the lightweight design and integrated handle make it easy to move. With quick assembly and a ash cleanup system, it’s the perfect choice for patios, backyards, and outdoor gatherings. Its sleek design, portability, and low-maintenance features make it a must-have for cozy evenings and lively gatherings alike.

CCB-4114.name: 24" Pizza Stone Brush
CCB-4114.description: Easily reach and clean all areas of your pizza oven with the Cuisinart 24" Pizza Stone Cleaning Brush. The brush features a 90-degree rotating head that allows you to swipe from front to back or from side to side - whatever the mess calls for! The lightweight aluminum design makes the brush easy to maneuver while cleaning inside your pizza oven. The brass cleaning bristles won't scratch or scuff your pizza stone, while the flat scraper helps remove any caked-on, stubborn spots.

CGG-9748.name: 28" Outdoor Griddle with Hood
CGG-9748.description: The Cuisinart 28" Outdoor Griddle brings greater cooking versatility to your backyard. The 504 sq. in. carbon-steel flat top cooking surface fits up to 24 burgers at a time, along with every other meal in between. The combined 30,000 BTUs between two stainless steel burners gives you cooking temps up to 600 F for high-heat searing. The side shelves feature integrated condiment caddies to store all of your sauces and spices while cooking. The griddle includes a hood to protect the griddle surface between uses.

CGG-9020.name: 28" Outdoor Griddler - 2-in-1 Griddle & Broiler
CGG-9020.description: Elevate your outdoor cooking game with the 28" Outdoor Griddler, your new go-to for backyard meals. This 2-in-1 Griddle & Broiler combo gives you the best of both worlds—flat-top griddle cooking, plus high-heat, open-flame searing from the broiler for that perfect char. The griddle offers a spacious 504 sq. in. surface, fitting up to 24 burgers at once, so you’re always ready for the family or a crowd. Beneath the griddle, the broiler cabinet features a 3-level adjustable cooking rack and a viewing window, allowing you to sear, roast, toast, or melt with ease—bringing that signature flame-kissed taste to every dish. The Broiler Baffles system (patent-pending) directs heat downwards when closed, providing high-heat searing for steaks, roasting, melting cheese, and more. Open the Baffles to release heat for toasting, warming, or melting. Both the griddle and broiler share the same fuel source, maximizing efficiency with no extra fuel. Designed for ultimate convenience, the Griddler includes integrated condiment caddies on the side shelves for easy access to sauces and spices, along with a paper towel holder and trash bag holder to streamline prep and cleanup.

AMB-24MMP.name: 24 Cup Mini Muffin Pan
AMB-24MMP.description: Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Non-Stick Bakeware is ideal for today's cooks. The full line is constructed of heavy gauge aluminized steel to provide even heat distribution and consistent baking results. The nonstick interior and exterior ensure easy food release and cleanup, and extra-thick rolled edges prevent warping. The entire line is dishwasher safe. Cuisinart® quality promises you a lifetime of great performance, whatever the baking task!

CTG-00-2BM.name: 2pc Baking Mat Set
CTG-00-2BM.description: Put away the parchment paper and step up your baking game with even-heating, non-stick, reusable Silicone Baking Mats by Cuisinart®. The half-sheet and toaster oven mats have slick, nonstick surfaces that repel fats, eliminating the need for adding oils, sprays, and butter to prevent sticking. Baked goods, fish, and roasted vegetables are made healthier, less greasy, brown evenly all over, and lift right off the tray. The lightly weighted mats lay flat on the baking tray, so delicate cookies and cakes maintain a smooth, flat surface and release with ease after cooling. Take the mats from freezer to microwave for total versatility, then run them through the dishwasher to thoroughly clean away odors and residue. Easy to use, clean, and reuse, these game-changing silicone mats offer everything the home cook hoped for to create the ideal home baking experience.

CTG-00-2DP.name: 2pc Dough Press Set
CTG-00-2DP.description: Mouthwatering sweet and savory dumplings, empanadas, meat patties, sandwiches, pierogis, mini pies, and pizzas are fun to prepare and more fun to eat with the 2 piece Cuisinart® Dumpling Press Set. With the small- and medium-size presses that nest together for compact, convenient storage, you can create custom bites for little and large hands like. Each one has a built-in cutter that prepares a circle of dough that fits perfectly in the press. Spoon a dollop of your own healthy, homemade filling in the center of the dough, fold the press over, crimp and seal the edges with a tight squeeze, and your creation is ready to cook and eat! Enjoy endless possibilities for crafting cooked fold-over foods that make the perfect meal, snack, and appetizer.

CGG-0028.name: Discontinued 28" Two Burner Gas Griddle
CGG-0028.description:
Unlock the versatility of griddle cooking with the Cuisinart® 28" Griddle! This versatile griddle allows you to prepare breakfast, lunch or dinner. It has 644 sq in. of cooking space and two heat zones for even and consistent cooking. The griddle features a dual grease management system with two removable drip cups in the front, making it easy to manage and remove grease from the cooking area. The two wheels allow the griddle to be easily moved to where you need it and the leveling feet allow the griddle to be used on any type of uneven surface. Take your barbecue, tailgate or camping trip to the next level with the Cuisinart® 28" Griddle!
Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CTG-00-2SMPM.name: 2pc Single Serve Microwave Popcorn Makers
CTG-00-2SMPM.description: Snack smarter with the Cuisinart 2-Piece Single Serve Microwave Popcorn Makers. No oil or butter is needed with the durable silicone, so you pop perfect, healthier 3 ¾ -cup servings. This 2 piece set is also great for family movie nights, dorm rooms and even portion control!

CTG-00-2TNG.name: 2pc Tong Set: 7" and 9" Stainless Steel Tongs
CTG-00-2TNG.description: Grip, flip, and serve with the Cuisinart® 2-piece heavy-gauge stainless steel Tong Set in 9” and 7”. Soft-grip, nonslip handles are comfortable to hold, and locking pull tabs and a hanging hook make the tongs easy to store. The 7" tongs are great for small jobs like serving appetizers and cooking in a small pan. While the 9" tongs are perfect for turning foods in the air fryer, removing steaks off a grill, and even tossing salads!

C77SS-2PUTPK.name: 2pc Stainless Steel Knife Set
C77SS-2PUTPK.description:
2pc Utility Paring Set Includes:
5.5" Serrated Utility Knife
3.5" Paring Knife

Stainless Steel Collection

CTG-00-2WT.name: 2Pc Wok Tool Set
CTG-00-2WT.description: Stir fry and sauté delicious hot meals using this tool set made specially for wok cooking. The stainless steel turner and skimmer have handles topped with smooth acacia wood for a solid hold, so mixing meals is quick, safe, and controlled with ease. Contoured tool heads are made to move food around the curved walls of the wok, while the extra-long handles keep handles and arms at a safe distance from hot splatter. The sleek wood and metal design complements the modern kitchen. Crafted with a hole at the end of each handle for easy hanging, these premium tools are perfect for displaying between uses.

CCH-3.name: 3-Cup Mini Chopper
CCH-3.description: For small batch chopping and grinding, this multipurpose mini chopper is the perfect combination of compact convenience and fuss-free versatility. This 3-cup chopper features an auto-reversing SmartPower® blade with a sharp edge for chopping, puréeing, and emulsifying, and a blunt edge for grinding through spices and harder foods. Button controls switch between Chop and Grind to power through food prep tasks with total ease and precision.

CTG-00-SCS.name: 2pc Sandwich Cutter and Sealer Set
CTG-00-SCS.description: The Cuisinart® 2pc Sandwich Cutter & Sealer Set includes a circular and a square sandwich cutter and sealer. Each shape is set apart by a different color, making it easy to prevent cross-contamination. The stainless steel cutters efficiently trim crusts off sandwiches without excessive waste, while the colorful handles ensure comfortable use. Whether you're catering to allergies, dietary needs, or just personal preference, these sandwich cutters and sealers allow you to create customized sandwiches. Ideal for busy lunches or quick snacks on the go!

CCB-1015.name: 3-in-1 Chainmail Grill Cleaner
CCB-1015.description: Ditch the bristles and clean your grill without worries with the Cuisinart 3-in-1 Chainmail Grill Cleaner. Designed for durability and convenience, its dense, tightly knit chainmail mesh effortlessly scrubs away grease and grime, without breaking like larger chainmail designs. Safe for all types of grill grates and griddles (excluding ceramic), this versatile brush is built to make your post-cook cleanup a breeze. Featuring a high-heat resistant sponge core, the grill brush can be used wet for steam-cleaning power that cuts through tough, stuck-on residue—so you can skip the elbow grease and enjoy a spotless grill. The detachable head with a secure locking feature lets you clean with or without the ergonomic handle, perfect for reaching tight spaces or cast-iron cookware or woks. Plus, the handle doubles as a scraper tool, giving you even more cleaning options.

CTG-00-SSCLD.name: 2qt Swing Basket Colander
CTG-00-SSCLD.description: Simplify your life with the Cuisinart® 1.5qt Swing Basket Colander Set. This 2-in-1 tool makes it easy to wash, soak, and drain fruits, vegetables, and salads in one quick swivel. Simply tilt the bowl to drain water in the sink without removing the colander, then use the bowl for convenient serving. The removable colander makes draining pasta a breeze and storage convenient. Dishwasher safe and backed by a lifetime warranty, this durable set is sure to be a go-to kitchen essential for years to come.

AMW-90.name: 3-in-1 Microwave Air Fryer Plus
AMW-90.description: Versatility and variety made easy! The Cuisinart 3-in-1 Microwave Air Fryer Plus is the ultimate kitchen convenience that can Air Fry, convection cook, and microwave for an endless array of family favorites. Air Fry 3 lbs of wings, bake a 9” pan of brownies, microwave a full plate of food, and so much more. Adjust time and temp to 450°F or choose from precision presets for customized Air Fry and convection cooking. Microwave to your exact preference with 11 power levels and easy presets. Get your food, your way with one multifunctional must-have for today’s home chef.

CTG-00-AVO.name: 3-in-1 Avocado Tool
CTG-00-AVO.description: Quickly and easily cut, pit and slice avocado's with the Cuisinart® 3-in-1 Avocado Tool! A retractable blade easily slices through avocado skin, durable stainless steel teeth easily remove the pit, and the fanned blades give you perfect slices of avocado! The retractable blade stores inside the soft-grip, non-slip handle and features a built-in herb stripper!

CSBP-100.name: 3-in-1 Stuffed Burger Press
CSBP-100.description: The Cuisinart® stuffed burger press is the ultimate 3-in-1 tool for burger making.  Start by making amazing burgers stuffed with your favorite flavors in 3 easy steps.  Just press, stuff press and you're ready to cook.  Or use the convenient slider insert to shape perfect sliders any time for a great snack.  This press also works great to make regular burger patties up to 3/4 lb!  So no matter what burger you are in the mood for the Cuisinart® Stuffed Burger Press has you covered

CTG-00-MFFS.name: 3-in-1 Precision Fruit Slicer
CTG-00-MFFS.description: The 3-in-1 Precision Fruit Slicer makes fast work of fruit and vegetable slicing! Accurately and quickly slice mangos, apple, pears, citrus fruits, tomatoes, and even potatoes!

CCB-3PCROS.name: 3 Piece Cutting Board Rooster Set
CCB-3PCROS.description: Bring the country kitchen home with the 3 Piece Cutting Board Rooster Set from Cuisinart. Each board features a rustic image of a rooster and a built in handle to hang or hold. Conveniently, the boards also have a lip, preventing your chopped ingredients sliding off as you transport them to your pot or pan for cooking.

CPC-120.name: 3 Piece Pellet Grill Ash Cleaning Kit
CPC-120.description: Deep cleaning tools for your pellet grill or smoker. Don't leave excess dust, ash, and debris in the body of your grill, the Cuisinart® Pellet Grill Ash Cleaning Kit has all the tools you need to get it clean. The brush bristles are gentle and won't scratch, but are sturdy enough to lift away small particles of dust. The scraper will scrape stuck on debris so you can scoop it up and remove it. The side of the dustpan features a comb-like design allowing you to remove any large debris from the brush. No need to lug an ash vacuum around, this tool is compact and lightweight, making cleaning up a breeze.

SSL-100RED.name: 3 MM Thin Shred Spg Cone Red

CTG-00-3MC.name: 3 Piece Nesting Liquid Measuring Cup Set
CTG-00-3MC.description: Great for any sized job in the kitchen, Cuisinart's set of measuring cups have pour spouts that provide an even and smooth flow, never leaving drips on the counter.

CPS-700.name: 3 Piece Pizza Grilling Pack
CPS-700.description: The Cuisinart 3 Piece Pizza Grilling Pack is the ultimate kit to help you create mouth watering pizza right at home. The set includes a 13" cordierite pizza stone, 12" folding stainless steel pizza peel, and pizza wheel cutter. Place the pizza stone directly on your grill surface, preheat it for 15 minutes and you're ready to start making grill-fired pizzas. The pizza peel makes it easy to add and remove pizzas from your grill or oven and even folds flat for compact storage. When the pizzas are ready, quickly slice them up for serving with the pizza wheel cutter. Turn your grill in to a pizza making machine with the Cuisinart 3 Piece Pizza Grilling Pack!

CWA-865.name: 3-Piece Wok Tool Set
CWA-865.description: Don’t cook it…Wok it! The three most important Cuisinart Outdoors wok tools in one set – Spatula, Ladle, and Slotted Skimmer – everything needed for stir frying, deep frying, sauté, steaming, and boiling; the 17” tools have premium wood handles, nylon straps for hanging, and designed to navigate the curved walls of the wok; Where performance and sophistication intersect.

89193-20.name: 3 Quart Saucepan
89193-20.description: These professional quality saucepans are made from premium stainless steel. Perfect for single servings of soups, vegetables, sauces and delicious side dishes. Tempered glass lids offer a clear view of what’s cooking.

6193-20P.name: 3 Quart Pour Saucepan
6193-20P.description: No other piece of cookware performs with the versatility of the Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Nonstick Hard Anodized 3 Qt. Pour Saucepan. Whether you're preparing a delicate hollandaise sauce, steaming savory wild rice or simmering a hearty soup, no other pan offers more reliable results. Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Nonstick Hard Anodized Cookware features durable hard anodized construction for fast and even heating.

C77SSCS-3P.name: 3-Piece Rose Gold Carving Set
C77SSCS-3P.description: This 3 piece Rose Gold Carving Set makes a beautiful addition to any table. Carve at the table with sleek, sophisticated rose gold knife and fork on the sustainably sourced acacia wood carving board. The board is also rimmed with rose gold for an elegant touch.

C77SHP-3S.name: 3-Slot Foldable Knife Sharpener
C77SHP-3S.description: Keep your knife blades as sharp as the day they arrived with the 3-Slot Foldable Knife Sharpener! The handle folds down, making storage a cinch.

CGR-725.name: Discontinued 3-Tier Pellet Grill Rack System
CGR-725.description: Maximize your cooking area with the Cuisinart 3-Tier Smoker Rack System! This multipurpose rack is great for smoking jerky, chicken wings, ribs, shrimp, and other delicate foods that need the extra wiring to prevent them from falling through the grates. Each rack has grids with bars going both ways so you can place your meat however you see fit, no need for it all to be going in the same direction. The bottom and middle shelves slide out for easy access during the smoke, making flipping or rotating pieces a breeze. When done, simply place in the dishwasher; the rack collapses for compact storage.

CCF-31.name: 3.1 Cu. Ft. Compact Fridge
CCF-31.description: Utilize your space with this sleek 3.1 cubic foot compact refrigerator that provides ample storage for food and beverages. The adjustable thermostat makes it easy to regulate the temperature to preserve full flavor and freshness. The interior accommodates a wide variety of perishables, with clear-view vegetable and fruit crisper, removable and adjustable shelves, and built-in door storage, including a can holder, for items you want to grab quickly. A large separate freezer compartment with its own door stores ice cream, frozen vegetables, meats and more. Freezer and refrigerator doors are reversible for easy left or right-side opening access.

C77TR-3PR.name: 3.5" Paring Knife
C77TR-3PR.description: This triple rivet 3.5" Paring knife is ideal for a variety of small cutting tasks. Designed with a superior stainless steel blade for precision and accuracy, and a forged, extra-wide safety bolster for perfect stability and control. Complete with a sleek triple rivet handle for durability and strength.

PSC-350.name: 3.5 Quart Programmable Slow Cooker
PSC-350.description: Turn slow cooking into a delicious art form with the Cuisinart® 3.5 Quart Programmable Slow Cooker. Let the delicious scents of slow cooked dishes greet you after your commute home by using the 24-hour LCD countdown timer and four cooking modes that automatically change to Warm when the cook time ends. Classic pulled pork is easy to make, or try out new gourmet creations in the ceramic cooking pot housed in stylish stainless steel.

COS-330.name: 30" Electric Smoker
COS-330.description: Experience authentic smoked flavors without the hassle of charcoal! The Cuisinart 30” Electric Smoker makes smoking easy for both beginners and seasoned BBQ lovers. Set your exact temperature, and this electric smoker handles the rest. With 548 sq. inches of cooking space on three chrome racks, you’ll have ample room to smoke meat for gatherings. Perfect for brisket, smoked salmon, jerky, and more. The removable water pan and wood chip tray make starting up and cleaning effortless. Enjoy smoky BBQ flavor right at home, whether you’re smoking meats, fish, or veggies.

CGG-999.name: 360 XL Griddle Outdoor Cooking Station
CGG-999.description:
Experience 360° of Griddle Cooking Versatility! Whether you are cooking for a small crowd or a large party, the Cuisinart® 360° XL Griddle Outdoor Cooking Station will amaze any audience. Breakfast, lunch and dinner, the 30-inch diameter cooking center can handle it all! It features a 360° grease pan and rear grease cup, making for easy access and clean-up. The cooking center comes with a quick access paper towel holder, and two folding side tables. It also includes a stainless steel lid with an integrated vent, enhancing the features of a normal griddle! This lid creates versatility to steam, roast, smoke or warm! From eggs and pancakes to burgers or stir-fry, the Cuisinart® 360° XL Griddle Outdoor Cooking Station gives you the ability to explore your culinary creativity. The prestigious Cuisinart® brand is not limited to their famous food processors - plugged or unplugged, nobody covers the modern chef like Cuisinart®. Cuisinart® is a full-service culinary resource with a wide array of products, preferred by chefs and favored by consumers. And now you can take the world-famous Cuisinart® brand to your patio, lawn, tailgate, or campsite with their comprehensive line of Cuisinart® outdoor grilling products available now at Walmart.
Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CGS-8036Z.name: 36 Piece Backyard BBQ Tool Set
CGS-8036Z.description:
You could be the proud owner of one of them most comprehensive BBQ tools sets available.  We really enjoyed working on bringing this project to life.  It was fun and refreshing to step back and think about all of the possible tools you would want when getting started on your grilling hobby or trying to revamp a collection or give the best grilling gift. We also had the chance to take some new twists on classic items as well.  For example, the steel grill scraper included in this set is a one of a kind way to scrape down all of the grill grime and never risk leaving any bristles behind.  The steel burger flags are also a very cool way to serve and mark your burger temperatures for those big family barbecues. We hope you enjoy using this tool set as much as we did developing it. Happy grilling!

Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CGG-0036.name: Discontinued 36" Four Burner Gas Griddle
CGG-0036.description:
Expand your outdoor cooking versatility with the Cuisinart® 36" 4 Burner Gas Griddle! This versatile griddle allows you to prepare breakfast, lunch, or dinner all on the same appliance. The cold-rolled steel cooking surface provides 760 square inches of cooking space, allowing you to easily cook for up to 10 people at a time. The 4 independently controlled burners provide 15,000 BTUs each, allowing you to control hot and cool zones on the griddle surface while cooking. The griddle features a dual grease management system with two removable drip cups in the front, making it easy to manage and remove grease from the cooking area. With two wheels the griddle can easily be moved around your backyard and the leveling feet allow for use on uneven surfaces. When finished cooking, the griddle easily collapses down for storage or travel!
Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

C77SS-3P.name: 3pc Stainless Steel Knife Set - Graphix Collection
C77SS-3P.description: The Graphix Collection 3 Piece Set of Knives is the perfect starter kit to upgrade your kitchen knives. These three knives can be used for any kitchen prep work, whether slicing, dicing, mincing, or peeling.

CGG-7400.name: 4-Burner Gas Grill
CGG-7400.description: The Cuisinart 4-Burner Gas Grill is exactly what you need for your home. Cuisinart’s first full-size grill is one that was built to last and built to impress. With its 4 individually controllable burners, you’ll get 44,000 BTUs of cooking heat spread evenly across the 443 square inches of cooking surface. And if you’re looking for additional space, there’s a built-in warming rack that provides 167 additional square inches. With an easy twist to start ignition and removable cast iron cooking grates, this grill was made with the customer in mind. And no full-size grill is complete without side tables. The Cuisinart 4-Burner Gas Grill has two 18-inch x 13-inch side tables that provide plenty of extra space during a cookout.

CRBW-33B.name: 33" Bar Wall Rack
CRBW-33B.description: Turn your kitchen into a showstopper with the Cuisinart® Bar Wall Rack! The stunning brushed stainless steel is the perfect statement piece to hang above a kitchen island, bringing your Cuisinart® Cookware within arms reach as you cook for minimal fuss during the creative process. With ample space to hang your pans, the Bar Wall Rack is a practical and beautiful way to organize your kitchen.

CCB-4125.name: 4-in-1 Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-4125.description: The Cuisinart 4-in-1 Grill Cleaning Brush is the all-in-one tool to clean any type of mess on your grill surface. This 4-in-1 brush combines hot. cold, and detail cleaning using 4 different cleaning applications. First, the main side of the brush features stainless-steel wire bristles for cleaning your grill while it is warm, and second, the scour pad on the reverse side cleans your grill while it is cool. Third, on each of the shorter sides there are densely-packed stainless-steel wire bristles for detail cleaning between grill grates and other tight areas of your grill. Lastly, the stainless-steel scraper on the end of the brush head helps remove any burnt-on pieces that may get left behind. The brush handle measure 13" in length allowing you to easily reach all areas of your grill.

CTG-00-PT.name: Discontinued 4 in 1 Pasta Tool
CTG-00-PT.description: The Cuisinart® 4 in 1 Pasta Tool is all you need to prepare, cook and serve pasta! Features include a salt measurer, pasta measurer, nylon head for cooking and serving, and a durable stainless steel cheese grater with protective cover.

CBB-410A.name: 4-in-1 BBQ Basket
CBB-410A.description: The Cuisinart® 4-in-1 BBQ Basket allows you to satisfy most of your meat cooking needs with one accessory. You’ll no longer have to take out several different products in order to cook one meal for the family. Grill or smoke just about any meat in this multipurpose basket. The rib rack fits up to 6 full racks of ribs. And if you flip the rib rack over, you’ll see that there’s a 14.5” x 9.5” basket built for roasts, briskets, and other large cuts of meat. The detachable can holder fits in the middle of the basket and it is perfect for beer can chicken. And last but certainly not least, the two chicken wing racks that hook onto the sides of the basket can fit up to 12 drum sticks at a time!

AST-4T.name: 4-Pc Stainless Taco Tray Set
AST-4T.description: Perfect for crisping and baking soft tortillas or hard taco shells for the whole family! Durable stainless steel allows for safe and sturdy handling. Taco trays are designed to hold food with a solid grip and secure ingredients when bringing from kitchen to table. Use the taco tray for a variety of dishes including soft tacos, hard tacos, fajitas, burriots, sandwiches, hot dogs and more.

CMBM-4SP.name: 4" Mini Spring Form Pan Set
CMBM-4SP.description: This full line of nonstick bakeware offers all of the performance and convenience today's cooks look for. Constructed of heavy-gauge steel, each bakeware piece provides even heat distribution and consistent results. Bake delicious double chocolate brownies, carrot cake and sugar cookies. Then place the bakeware in the dishwasher for easy cleaning. Bake delicious muffins, tarts, pies or mini pizzas in fun shapes and adorable sizes with these new Mini Bakeware specialty pieces. Everybody loves a tiny treat.

CGS-1100.name: 4 Piece Ash Wood Grill Tool Set
CGS-1100.description: The Cuisinart® 4 Piece Ashwood Grill Tool Set is a stylish update from your old and dated grill tools. The ash wood handles are sealed to prevent grease and oil from penetrating the wood and damaging the handles. The set includes a spatula, tongs, fork, and basting brush. The spatula features a serrated edge for quick cutting of food while on the grill surface. The tongs are lightweight and easy to handle and lock for compact storage. The fork is great for handling a variety on the grill surface. The basting brush features a removeable silicone head for easy cleaning. The Cuisinart® 4 Piece Ash Wood Grill Tool Set makes the perfect gift for any grill enthusiast!

CSBP-200.name: 4-in-1 Stuffed Burger Press
CSBP-200.description: Impress your guests with the Cuisinart® 4-in-1 Burger Press! Make them Restaurant Style Sliders, Juicy 1/4 Pound Burgers, 1/2 - 3/4 Pound Burgers and even Stuffed 1/2 Pound Burgers for those who are up for the challenge. Start making amazing burgers stuffed with your favorite flavors in 3 easy steps. Just press, stuff press and you're ready to cook. Or use the convenient slider insert to shape perfect sliders any time for a great snack. So no matter what burger you are in the mood for the Cuisinart® 4-in-1 Stuffed Burger Press has you covered.

CGS-1000A.name: 4 Piece Folding Grill Tool Set
CGS-1000A.description: The Cuisinart® 4 Piece Folding Grill Tool Set is the perfect set for camping, tailgating, or at home! This compact set includes a spatula, tongs, fork and carrying case. The tools feature an easy to use push pin design that makes folding and opening the tools effortless. The push pin design also ensures that the tools will stay firmly locked in place when in use. Other grill tools can be long and clunky and take up too much drawer space. The Cuisinart® 4 Piece Folding Grill Tool Set includes a stylish carrying case that is compact and easy to store.

CMBM-4PMK.name: 4 piece Mini Pumpkin Set
CMBM-4PMK.description: Holiday baking made fun for the family with this Mini Pumpkin set. Part of the Seasonal Mini Bakeware line from Cuisinart, these pumpkin pans are made of steel for even heat distribution, ensuring your breads and cakes are evenly baked throughout. The professional non-stick interior allows for easy release after baking and is dishwasher safe, making cleanup fast.

CCM-4PC.name: 4 Piece Cutting Mat Set
CCM-4PC.description: You can easily avoid cross-contamination with the 4 Piece Cutting Mat Set. Each of the color-coded mats also features a helpful graphic on the tab, making it simple to pick out each mat for cutting fish, vegetables, beef, and chicken.

CMBM-4SD.name: 4 piece Mini Star of David Set
CMBM-4SD.description: Holiday baking made fun for the family with this Mini Star of David set. The professional nonstick interior allows for easy release after baking and is dishwasher safe, making cleanup fast.

CMBM-4SFK.name: 4 piece Mini Snowflake Set
CMBM-4SFK.description: Holiday baking is made fun for the family with this Mini Snowflake set. Part of the Seasonal Mini Bakeware line from Cuisinart, these snowflake pans are made of steel for even heat distribution, ensuring your breads and cakes are evenly baked throughout. The professional nonstick interior allows for easy release after baking and is dishwasher, making cleanup fast.

AMB-4.name: 4 Piece Set
AMB-4.description: Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Non-Stick Bakeware is ideal for today's cooks. The full line is constructed of heavy gauge aluminized steel to provide even heat distribution and consistent baking results. The nonstick interior and exterior ensure easy food release and cleanup, and extra-thick rolled edges prevent warping. The entire line is dishwasher safe. Cuisinart® quality promises you a lifetime of great performance, whatever the baking task!

CWA-346.name: 4-Piece Wok Deep Fry Tool Set
CWA-346.description: Fry, sift, and stir with ease with the 4-Piece Wok Deep Fry Tool Set from Cuisinart Outdoors; The Wok Fry Strainer has 17-inch premium stainless steel construction and a 6-inch fine mesh strainer; Perfect for lifting food when deep frying and separating small food particles from oil during clean-up; 8-inch Deep Fry Thermometer, complete with a double-scale temperature range of 50-550ºF / 10-290°C, has a custom wok pan adapter designed to fit inside round bottom woks without touching the sides; Oversized Chopsticks measuring 16.5 inches with a flexible "helper" designed to hold the chopstick ends properly when stirring or lifting foods. Deep-frying has never been easier, Wok this way!

C55CNS-4PUT.name: 4 Piece Nonstick Color Knife Set
C55CNS-4PUT.description: Cuisinart® Advantage™ professional-quality stainless steel knives have a cutting-edge, nonstick coating that makes slicing easier - and allows coding during food prep to avoid cross-contamination. In style-conscious hues for today's design-smart consumer, these premium knives come with matching blade guards and ergonomic handles.

CMBM-4MPL.name: 4 piece Mini Maple Leaf Set
CMBM-4MPL.description: Holiday baking made fun for the family with this Mini Maple Leaf set. Part of the Seasonal Mini Bakeware line from Cuisinart, these maple leaf pans are made of steel for even heat distribution, ensuring your breads and cakes are evenly baked throughout. The professional nonstick interior allows for easy release after baking and is dishwasher safe, making cleanup fast.

AMB-TOB4.name: 4-Piece Toaster Oven Set
AMB-TOB4.description: This Toaster Oven Baking Set is constructed of heavy gauge steel for even heating and fits all standard toaster ovens. Cook or heat up some of your favorite foods and desserts like French fries, pizza slices, chocolate chip cookies and more, right in the toaster oven. This 4-pc dishwasher safe set includes a broiler pan with rack, baking pan and 11″ Pizza Pan.

CCF-44.name: 4.4 Cu. Ft. Compact Fridge
CCF-44.description: Utilize your space with this sleek 4.4 cubic foot compact refrigerator that provides ample storage for food and beverages. The adjustable thermostat makes it easy to regulate the temperature to preserve full flavor and freshness. The interior accommodates a wide variety of perishables, with clear-view vegetable and fruit crisper, removable and adjustable shelves, and built-in door storage for items you want to grab quickly. A freezer compartment stores ice cream, frozen vegetables, and more. The door is reversible for easy left or right-side opening access.

WAF-150NAS.name: 4 Slice Belgian Waffle Maker - Square
WAF-150NAS.description: Take waffles beyond breakfast with the Cuisinart® 4 Slice Belgian Waffle Maker. This high-performance waffle iron has an elegant stainless steel top and makes deep-pocket waffles to hold more toppings for more delicious options! Five-setting controls for browning create customized results to meet your family’s tastes. The green light signals when the unit is ready to bake and when baking is done, eliminating cooking guesswork!

MSC-400.name: Discontinued 4 Quart 3-in-1 Cook Central Multicooker
MSC-400.description: The Cuisinart® 4-Quart 3-in-1 Cook Central® is a compact and convenient way to make family dinners every day. Brown your ingredients right in the pot before slow cooking for delicious dishes with the flavors turned up. Take control of your meals with preset functions to brown/sauté, slow cook, and steam foods for endless variety of dishes. The Cook Central® makes family favorites easy, including chili, pulled pork, macaroni and cheese, and even oatmeal for healthy breakfasts. The 24-hour timer and automatic Keep Warm function ensures your delicious meal will be waiting for your family to come home.

CGMT-140.name: 48" x 30" Premium Deck & Patio Grill Mat
CGMT-140.description: Protect your deck and patio from grease, spills and stains with the Cuisinart 48” X 30” Premium Grill and Smoker Mat. This non-slip grill mat measures 48" x 30" fitting most grills, smokers and griddles. The weight of the mat keeps it in place on your deck and the weather resistant material allows you to keep it outdoors all season long! When messes happen on the mat, you can simply take your garden hose and rinse it off, making it ready to use again. Unlike other mats, the Cuisinart 48” X 30” Premium Grill and Smoker Mat heavy-duty grill mat is made from 100% durable PVC material and will out last the competition.

AIR-160NAS.name: 4.5-qt Basket Air Fryer
AIR-160NAS.description: Prepare a variety of dishes, from quick snacks to hearty meals, effortlessly with the versatile Cuisinart® 4.5-qt Basket Air Fryer. Air Advantage™ technology ensures healthier, crispy, and flavorful results every time. Featuring a large 8”x8” cooking surface area for more even cooking plus four cooking functions, a toss reminder, and a convenient viewing window, it simplifies air frying, roasting and baking. Four easy-to-use air fry presets takes the guesswork out of air frying your favorites.

CPT-540.name: 4 Slice Motorized Toaster
CPT-540.description: Cuisinart® masters the art of toast-making with the 4-Slice Automatic Toaster. With 8 programmable memory settings and automated lever-less lift, all it takes to toast your favorite breads, bagels, English muffins, pastries, and waffles to the ideal shade is the touch of a button. Elevate your experience with advanced functions to make toasting quick and easy!

CCB-1080.name: 5 Piece Grill & Griddle Scrubber Set

CGG-240.name: All Foods Roll-Away Gas Grill
CGG-240.description:
Combining exceptional performance with convenient portability, the Cuisinart® All Foods Roll-Away gas grill makes the perfect choice for the serious backyard griller and the Chef on-the-go.  Designed for ultimate versatility, the grill’s ample grilling space, full-size height and convenient hide-away side shelves make it ideal for everyday family grilling and backyard get-togethers.  At the same time, the convenient roll-away folding cart makes it easy to pack up and transport to any campground, tailgate or beach – so you don’t have to compromise on the quality of your grill when you are away from home.   The grill features a 15,000 BTU stainless steel loop burner, 240 square inch porcelain enamel coated cast iron grill surface, and a reliable Twist Start electric ignition.  The precision temperature gauge clearly displays the internal temperature of the grill, and the heat distribution panel ensures even temperatures across the entire grilling surface and reduces flare-ups.
Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

DGB-450.name: Discontinued Automatic Grind & Brew 10 Cup Coffee Maker

Use the Brew Pause™ feature to enjoy a cup without interrupting the brew cycle. Have pre-ground coffee? Use the grind-off option to brew it to perfection. TOA-FD70.description:
French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven replaces multiple devices with a combo of 7 cooking functions—air fry, toast, bake, broil, roast, pizza, and warm—making it easy to prepare everything from breakfast and snacks to family dinners. 
HeatSeal Technology locks in heat where the French doors meet for more efficient cooking, crispier results, and consistent performance. SoftHold French doors feature DualSync one-hand operation, opening simultaneously and staying in place so you can safely load and unload food without juggling a hot door. When you crave a crunch, the powerful top-mounted fan and heating assembly drives high-velocity hot air directly over your food for faster, crispier air fry results and superior browning compared to standard convection ovens. 
You will not have to compromise on portion sizes with this airfryer; the spacious 0.6 cubic ft capacity easily fits 6 slices of toast, a 12" pizza, 3 lbs. of wings, or a 4.5-lb. chicken, perfect for family-size meals without turning on your full-size oven. Built to perform and built to last, the stainless-steel housing and interior provides long-lasting durability and easy-to-clean convenience. The Artisan French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven delivers effortless cooking with results you can count on every day.

CGSS-780.name: Bourbon Molasses Seasoning 11.5 OZ

Welcome to a unique blend of classic and contemporary designed to delight and inspire today’s home chefs, from two names associated with great food and good times: Cuisinart and Caskata.

CGPR-221.name: Cast Iron Grill Press with Wood Handle

CBP-300.name: Cast Iron Basting Pot and Brush

With 20,000 BTUs of grilling power and 275 sq. in. of cooking space, you can sear meats and cook delicious meals for family and friends. The two independently controlled burners let you create separate heat zones for perfectly grilling a variety of foods at once. The built-in thermometer allows you to monitor the grill's temperature with precision, while the sleek stainless steel finish adds a touch of style. Perfect for camping adventures, beach outings, and weekend cookouts, the Cuisinart Chef’s Style Tabletop Grill ensures you can grill like a pro wherever you go.

CAP-500.name: Discontinued Countertop HEPA Air Purifier
CAP-500.description:
The CAP-500 Air Purifier comes complete with dual filtration using two H13 high-grade HEPA filters, active carbon filters and removable, reusable metal pre-filters. Our three-stage filter system captures up to 99.9% of airborne particles 0.1 Micron or larger including bacteria and various contaminants as well as dust, pollen and odors from cooking, smoke, pets and VOC’s. The air purifier cycles air within 500 sq. ft. room 2x every hour and 250 sq. ft. 4x every hour. Relax and breathe easy with this peace-of-mind essential for today's home.

 

3-STAGE DUAL AIR INTAKE H13 HIGH GRADE HEPA FILTRATION SYSTEM

 

HEPA H13 – H13 high-grade HEPA filters capture up to 99.9% of airborne particles 0.1 Micron or larger including bacteria and various contaminants
ACTIVE CARBON FILTERS – Captures up to 99.9% of various unwanted cooking odors, smoke and VOCs to 0.1 Micron or larger
REMOVABLE, REUSABLE METAL PRE-FILTERS – Captures larger airborne particles such as dust, pet dander and cooking oils
 

CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE

 

Your air purifier will automatically tell you when it’s time to replace the dual action HEPA H13 and active carbon filters on the unit. The filter replacement light will illuminate in red after 2,500 hours of continuous use. When needed, replacement filters can be purchased directly from Cuisinart.

 

The H13 high-grade HEPA filters should be vacuumed once a month for the air purifier to perform at its best. If the air purifier contains dust or pet dander, it’s best to clean the removable metal pre-filters more often than once a month to maintain 2,500 hours of filter life.

 

The metal pre-filters are to be hand-washed only. If the filters are fairly clean, wash each filter with soapy, warm water. If the pre-filters are very dirty, you may need use a soft brush to gently clean them.

TOA-112.name: Cuisinart® 15-in-1 Extra-Large Digital Air Fryer Oven
TOA-112.description: Enjoy extra-large cooking convenience with the Cuisinart® Extra-Large Digital Air Fryer Oven. With 10 cooking functions including air fry, toast, bake, broil, roast, warm, pizza, low, dehydrate, and grill, this air fryer offers versatile cooking options for individuals and families alike. This Cuisinart® air fryer oven boasts an extra-large 0.90-cubic-foot stainless steel oven interior and can air fry 4 lbs of wings, cook a 13 lb turkey, 5+ lb chicken, toast 9 slices of bread, and bake a 13" pizza. The countertop oven also contains 5 pre-programmed presets to cook fries, wings, vegetables, snacks, and nuggets, making it perfect for quick and easy snacking or side dishes. The uniquely modern door with integrated control panel and extra-large viewing window gives this digital air fryer oven a contemporary look that complements any kitchen space. The IntelliTemp Temperature Probe with precision sensors reads precise temps and cooks perfect proteins every time. This air fryer oven comes with a versatile 9"x13" baking pan with divider to separate food for dietary preferences. It also includes an oven rack, air fry basket, and removable crumb tray. It also includes a ceramic non-stick reversible grill/griddle for year-round indoor grilling. This extra-large air fryer oven makes large meal cooking easy.

CTG-01-PC.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Curve Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip nonslip handle. Pizza cutter wheel is made from stainless steel. Dishwasher Safe.

CGSS-120.name: Dark Coffee Roast Seasoning
CGSS-120.description: Cuisinart’s Dark Coffee Roast Seasoning creates the ultimate bark on barbecue or crust on your grilled chicken. Our coffee seasoning is roasted for dark aromatic flavors with caramel, garlic, and bourbon bursts. Our blend wakes up everyday steaks, ribs, wings, burgers, and sauces. Perfect as a rub on meats or poultry or as a seasoning on your sauces, soups, and dressings. Use as a dry rub for grilling by rubbing or sprinkling 1-3 teaspoons of seasoning per pound of meat; adjust to taste. Use as a paste by adding 1 Tablespoon of olive oil for every 1 teaspoon of seasoning and brush on just before cooking. Use as a topical seasoning by shaking on top of your grilled meats, poultry and pork. The prestigious Cuisinart brand is not limited to their famous food processors - plugged or unplugged, nobody covers the modern chef like Cuisinart. Cuisinart is a full-service culinary resource with a wide array of products, preferred by chefs and favored by consumers. And now you can take the world-famous Cuisinart brand to your patio, lawn, tailgate, or campsite with a comprehensive line of Cuisinart outdoor grilling products.

CGS-5014Z.name: Deluxe Stainless-Steel Grill Set (14 Piece)
CGS-5014Z.description: The Cuisinart® Deluxe 14 Piece Grilling Tool Set includes all the necessary tools to make your grilling experience easy and convenient.  This durable set of stainless steel tools includes a Chef's Spatula, Grill Tongs, Silicone Basting Brush, Cleaning Brush, Extra Cleaning Brush Head and 4 Pairs of Corn Holders.  Each tool is designed with elongated handles and a hanging ring for convenient placement during grilling time. C77-SHRDP.name: Deluxe Poultry Shears
C77-SHRDP.description: New blade surfaces and unique textured handles, these Deluxe Poultry Shears will fit your kitchen décor as well as your personal cooking styles.

CCO-55.name: Deluxe Can Opener
CCO-55.description: The chrome Deluxe Can Opener gleams on any kitchen countertop, bringing style to the humble can opener.
