The magnetic lid holder is attached to the removable arm to make clean up easy. The sturdy base prevents tipping or sliding during use.

TOB-135NNAS.name: Discontinued Deluxe Convection Toaster Oven Broiler
TOB-135NNAS.description: From evenly toasting bread to cooking a roast with mouthwatering results, Cuisinart®’s toaster oven offers today’s home cooks superior performance and versatility. Equipped with 1800 watts of power, this kitchen essential is large enough to accommodate 6 slices of toast, and Always Even™ technology ensures consistent results every time! A dedicated pizza function bakes an 11" pizza to perfection in minutes. The cool-touch handle and slide-out rack add exceptional convenience. With its elegant stainless steel front, this toaster oven is trademark Cuisinart®.

CGS-5020Z.name: Deluxe Grill Set (20 Piece)
CGS-5020Z.description: Elevate your grilling game with the Cuisinart 20-Piece Deluxe Grill Tool Set, a complete collection of BBQ essentials in one convenient kit. Crafted from stainless steel, this set offers professional-grade tools, including everything from a chef’s spatula and grill tongs to a high-performance grill cleaner brush and a digital temperature fork with LED light and alarm settings. Perfect for home barbecues, camping cookouts, or tailgates, the tools come packed in a sleek, durable aluminum carrying case, ensuring you have top-tier grill accessories wherever you go. Whether you're a seasoned chef or a weekend griller, this set equips you with all you need for flavorful, perfectly grilled food.

SCO-60.name: Deluxe Stainless Steel Can Opener
SCO-60.description: With one touch, the Cuisinart<sup>®</sup> Deluxe Stainless Steel Can Opener makes short work of any standard size can. The precision Power Cut™ blade effortlessly slices through cans, held in place by the handy magnetic lid holder. Cuisinart<sup>®</sup> designed the arm to be removable, making cleanup effortless. The freestanding can opener has an extra-wide base to prevent tipping, while the clean lines of the brushed stainless steel complement any other premium countertop appliances for luxury chef’s kitchen.

CPS-515Z.name: Deluxe Pizza Grilling Pack
CPS-515Z.description:
The Cuisinart® Deluxe Pizza Grilling Pack equips you with everything you need to help create perfect pizzas right at home on your grill! The set includes a 15" pizza stone, a 14" aluminum pizza peel, and a quick-cut pizza cutter. The 15" pizza stone is made from durable cordierite material and is 0.5" thick. This gives the stone a heavy-duty feel and helps promote maximum heat retention for producing a perfectly cooked crust . The 14" aluminum pizza peel is lightweight and easy to handle and makes transferring pizzas to and from your grill a breeze. The peel can also be used to turn your pizzas while they are cooking so you get a evenly cooked pie every time. The quick-cut pizza cutter measures 15" wide and will easy slice through pizzas in one quick motion for fast serving. The Cuisinart® Deluxe Pizza Grilling Pack will help you transform your ordinary gas grill into a pizza making machine!
Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

TOA-65.name: Digital Air Fryer Toaster Oven
TOA-65.description: Cuisinart® makes air frying easier than ever, with presets to perfectly fry favorites like wings, fries, chicken nuggets, snacks and veggies. Frying with air instead of oil is delicious and guilt-free, and this large capacity oven fries up to 3 lb. at once. It also offers all the great features of a full-size toaster oven. And that’s not all! Unique to the Cuisinart® Digital Air Fryer Toaster Oven is a range of low temperatures that lets users proof dough, dehydrate foods and more, taking multi-functionality to a whole new level. With the large digital display and intuitive programming options, selecting presets, temperature, time, and function have never been easier.

CCB30-26B.name: Discontinued 10" Ceramic Pan
CCB30-26B.description: Cuisinart® presents bakeware elegant enough to take to the table. CBB-1200.name: Discontinued 1.75 Horsepower Blender

635-16OP.name: Discontinued 1 Quart Pour Saucepan

Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ Nonstick Hard Anodized Cookware features durable hard anodized construction for fast and even heating. We guarantee it with a lifetime warranty.

GK-1.name: Digital Gooseneck Kettle
GK-1.description: Experience the full, flawless flavor of pour-over tea or coffee with the Cuisinart® Digital Gooseneck Kettle. Custom-designed to perfect the craft of pour-over brewing, this ingenious kettle features a precision pour spout that ensures a slow, steady pour for optimal flavor extraction. The touchpad base features a center plate for quick heat-up and a front panel with digital temperature display and controls. Adjustable temperature control lets you select from 140°F to 212°F. 1.0 liter capacity holds enough water for four cups of authentic pour-over coffee or tea.

DCC-1150.name: Discontinued 10 Cup Programmable Thermal Coffee Maker
DCC-1150.description: The sleek double-walled thermal carafe and stainless accents blend seamlessly, combining classic good looks with modern conveniences in the 10 Cup Programmable Thermal Coffeemaker. With easy 24-hour programmability, 1-4 cup setting to maintain the delicious coffee taste when making a smaller pot, this Cuisinart coffeemaker is a smart addition to your countertop. And fresh, great tasting coffee is guaranteed from the very first cup, thanks to our Brew Pause™ feature, gold-tone coffee filter, and charcoal water filter.

DGB-300.name: Discontinued 10 Cup Automatic Grind & Brew™ Coffee Maker
DGB-300.description: There is nothing more enjoyable than waking up to freshly brewed coffee! The Automatic Grind & Brew®  Coffeemaker grinds whole beans, and brews the freshest, most flavorful coffee possible. It's so smart that it knows exactly how much water to use to extract all of the flavor and none of the bitterness. Available in Black and White.

DCC-1170BK.name: Discontinued 10 Cup Thermal Classic Coffee Maker

The insulated carafe features an ergonomic handle, knuckle guard, and drip-free spout for safe, fuss-free serving. Dual gold-tone and charcoal filters purify the water to brew the most delicious cup of the day, made right at home with Cuisinart®.

SBC-1000.name: Discontinued Blend and Cook Soup Maker

CTG-00-2LP.name: Discontinued Bottle Pourers (Set of Two)

WAF-B50.name: Discontinued Breakfast Express® Belgian Waffle & Omelet Maker

DCC-2600.name: Discontinued Brew Central® 14 Cup Coffee Maker

CFE-20PBR.name: Discontinued Bridget Collection

DCC-2200.name: Discontinued Brew Central® 14 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker

BRK-300.name: Discontinued Brick Oven Toaster Oven

CRHC-22ORB.name: Discontinued Bronze Half Circle Wall Rack

CWP-250.name: Discontinued Burger paper
CWP-250.description: Stacking burgers has never been easier...less sticky! These 6" x 6" square wax coated sheets are non-stick and easy to use. EM-300.name: Discontinued Buona Tazza™ Single Serve Espresso Machine

CG-01-S4BU.name: Discontinued Burgundy Glasses (Set of 4)

CDST1-S4BB.name: Discontinued Camila Collection

EM-400.name: Discontinued Buona Tazza® Single Serve Espresso and Coffee Machine

CTK-EOS12R.name: Discontinued Cache™ 2 Quart Enamel Teakettle
CTK-EOS12R.description: Enamel on steel kettles offer a unique sense of style and color to compliment today's home kitchens. Features a convenient whistle to signal that water is boiling.

CGWM-043.name: Discontinued Bluetooth® Easy Connect Thermometer

CGS-6010.name: Discontinued Carousel Stainless Steel Grill Tool Set (10 Piece)

CF-01-C20.name: Discontinued Carbay 20 Piece Set

CABP-320.name: Discontinued Cast Aluminum Double Burger Press

CFS-219.name: Discontinued Cast Iron Fajita Skillet Set

C59CE-3PR.name: Discontinued Ceramic 3.5" Paring Knife

C59CE-2P.name: Discontinued Ceramic 2 Piece Set (5" Santoku Knife & 3.5" Paring Knife)

C59CE-7BD.name: Discontinued Ceramic 7" Bread Knife

C59CE-8CF.name: Discontinued Ceramic 8" Chef's Knife
C59CE-8CF.description: Chopping, dicing, and mincing is fast and accurate with the Cuisinart® Elements® Ceramic 8” Chef’s Knife. The handle is ergonomically designed, remaining comfortable from beginning to end of your prep work.

C59CE-6CF.name: Discontinued Ceramic 6" Chef's Knife
C59CE-6CF.description: Prepping a lot of ingredients for dinner? CDP01-S4WC.name: Discontinued Chailles Collection

C59CE-5UT.name: Discontinued Ceramic 5" Utility Knife

CNW-528.name: Discontinued Ceramic Nonstick 12" x 12" Grill Wok
CNW-528.description: The Cuisinart®  Ceramic Nonstick Grill toppers were created to provide you with more eco conscious options that look as good as they perform. CCC-100.name: Discontinued Charcoal Chimney
CCC-100.description: If you don’t use a charcoal chimney to light charcoal, it’s time to start. Charcoal chimneys allow you to safely and conveniently light charcoal for a grill or smoker. Just crumple up some old newspaper and stick it in the space below the metal divider in the charcoal chimney and place the chimney on a charcoal grate on a grill or smoker. Then, load the area above the metal divider with your desired amount of charcoal. Use a lighter to light the newspaper through the large vent holes. Wait 10-20 minutes (depending on the amount of charcoal) until most of the briquettes are partially covered in white ash and then your charcoal is ready to go!

DGB-900BC.name: Discontinued Burr Grind & Brew Thermal™ 12 Cup Automatic Coffee Maker

CGWM-080.name: Discontinued Clermont Pellet Grill & Smoker
CGWM-080.description: Get ready for the ultimate culinary experience with 8-in-1 cooking capabilities; smoke, bbq, grill, roast, sear, braise, bake, and char-grill! The Cuisinart® Clermont Pellet Grill and Smoker is designed with professional kitchen details to take your smoking game to the next level. With 1400 square inches of cooking capacity and an integrated Sear Zone, you’ll have fun exploring all the possibilities this smoker has to offer. Featuring two large French style doors with viewing windows, an interior rack customization system, interior lights, a large work station, and a digital display. The double doors are both lined with a commercial grade gasket seal that locks in the smoke. Inside are 2 solid stainless steel racks with a 5 Position Oven Style Rack System, allowing you to customize your cook! Move the racks around to fit beer can chicken, a large roast, even a huge Thanksgiving turkey. To help monitor the meat temperature, dual temperature probes are stored in the hopper lid and can be plugged into an internal jack, hiding the wires from view. Two 10-watt halogen bulbs will brighten up the interior so you can easily see your delicious meat smoking on the top and the bottom rack. The wrap-around work surface has extra-large front and side shelves great for prepping and serving. The work surface includes a paper towel holder and 3 tool hooks for your convenience. With a 40 pound hopper, you can get a long smoke in without having to add more pellets. The hopper features an interior light and a low pellet sensor so you are notified when more pellets need to be added. A 3-Step Ash Clean Out System makes cleaning a breeze! Simply lift up on the lever lock, pull the lever out and remove the ashes from the ashtray. This smoker has an extra-large LCD controller with cooking readouts and offers Wi-Fi mobile remote monitoring; monitor and change temperature with the Cuisinart® mobile app. The Clermont has the look of a high-end commercial kitchen appliance, with the durability and cooking capacity of a large smoker. CCB-134.name: Discontinued Comfort Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-134.description: The Cuisinart® Comfort Cleaning Brush is a great looking and comfortable way to clean your grill.  This brush is designed at an angle to reach over grill and clean the grate while the handle is curved and molded for better grip.

DCC-2000.name: Discontinued Coffee on Demand™ 12 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker
DCC-2000.description: Cuisinart® introduces coffee without the carafe! The Coffee on Demand®  coffeemaker has a simple press to serve lever that delivers up to 12 cups of hot coffee, cup by cup, from a double-wall reservoir. Our exclusive Coffee Gauge®  on the front of the unit counts down the cups remaining. With 24 hour programmability, auto shutoff, professional brushed metal housing, and clean, contemporary styling, this is one of the easiest and most elegant coffeemakers on the market.

CPT-140.name: Discontinued Compact 4 Slice Toaster
CPT-140.description: The Cuisinart® Compact Toaster is not just smaller than standard 4 slice toasters, it's better! Streamlined and specially designed to sit sideways or facing forward on kitchen counters, the LED touchpad controls and a 9-setting LED backlit browning dial are within easy reach either way. That's a nice position to be in!

TOA-28.name: Discontinued Compact Air Fryer Toaster Oven
TOA-28.description: The Cuisinart® AirFryer Toaster Oven is now available in a new, space-saving design! Cuisinart’s Compact AirFryer Toaster Oven is big enough to air fry up to 2.5 lb. of food, toast 4 slices of bread or bagel halves, and bake up to a 3 lb. chicken. With all the features of our full-size models, including 6 functions and temperatures up to 450°F, this is an oven that offers multiple menu options and great performance without crowding the countertop!

SS-300.name: Discontinued Compact Single Serve
SS-300.description: Introducing a personal brewer! The Cuisinart® Compact Single Serve offers consumers fresh gourmet coffee, tea, hot cocoa and more in under two minutes. Innovative one-touch technology and a hot water feature makes it easier than ever to enjoy a wide array of hot beverages.

CDF-100.name: Discontinued Compact Deep Fryer
CDF-100.description: Cuisinart® presents a deep fryer that takes up less counter space. Designed to fry batches up to ¾ of a pound in just 1.1 liter of oil, this is a great deep fryer even for spur-of-the-moment snacks and meals. The compact design allows creative cooks to prepare fried calamari to top a salad, and moms to fry up mozzarella sticks for kids. Temperatures up to 375°F and a die-cast frying bowl maintain selected oil temperatures for restaurant-quality results. Easy to use, easy to clean, and simple to store, it could make deep frying an everyday event!

ICE-25.name: Discontinued Classic™ Frozen Yogurt-Ice Cream & Sorbet Maker
ICE-25.description: The traditional styling of the Cuisinart®  Classic™  Frozen Yogurt-Ice Cream & Sorbet Maker will put a smile on every ice cream lover's face. Fully automatic, this frozen dessert maker requires only the addition of fresh ingredients and the flip of a switch to make 1 1/2 quarts of ice cream, frozen yogurt, sorbet, or those fabulous frozen drinks -- icy smooth and ready to enjoy in as little as 20 minutes!

TOB-80N.name: Discontinued Compact Toaster Oven Broiler
TOB-80N.description: You can Bake, Broil, Keep Warm, and Toast with ease thanks to the Cuisinart® Compact Toaster Oven Broiler’s four preset functions. The easy-clean nonstick interior holds up to four slices of bread or a 9" pizza. The practical design includes baking and drip pan, broiling rack, front removable crumb tray, an oven rack that slides out when the door opens, and a clutter-busting cord wrap. Use the convenient shade control dial to make toast just the way you like it. The perfect oven for any sized kitchen.

AFR-25.name: Discontinued Compact Air Fryer
AFR-25.description: Now anyone can enjoy crispy, flavorful fried foods without the guilt! Engineered to ensure golden brown results, this high-efficiency unit airfries 2.5 lb. of wings and cooks a wide variety of foods with minimal noise and maximum ease. Simple to use– just turn one knob to regulate the temperature, and the other to set the timer. Designed with a spacious, nonstick interior and stylish stainless steel, the Cuisinart® Compact Air Fryer is easy to clean and complements any kitchen décor.

CB300GF.name: Discontinued Compact To Go Blender
CB300GF.description: Indulge in smoothies wherever you go with the Goodful by Cuisinart® Compact To-Go blender in a sleek set that packs a 300-watt base, blending and frothing blades and two 20-oz. travel cups.

CCB-231.name: Discontinued Complete Grill Brush System
CCB-231.description: Cleaning your grill is a necessity of every grill owner. It is also the least enjoyable part of the grilling process. The Complete Grill Brush System offers a new take on traditional grill brushes. The unique design of this grill brush creates better grip and allows extra pressure to be applied to a dirty grate without any extra effort. You will be able to clean off more grease and food residue with each motion while easily being able to get to those hard to reach places. Unlike the average grill brush, this brush comes with a smaller, removable brush that will help clean those hard to reach areas. This extra brush will help keep the grill cleaner, longer. Take a more advanced approach to cleaning your grill and enjoy the results.

CFS-QR-20.name: Discontinued Container 20oz
CFS-QR-20.description: Monitoring food-freshness is easy with this integrated Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ system! The innovative container features an air and water-tight secure seal, ideal for storing anything from soups, sauces to meats and vegetables. The state-of-the-art Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ and QR code system allows users to easily log their food and receive alerts when freshness is about to expire. Just store and scan; Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ does the rest.

CFS-QR-40.name: Discontinued Container 40oz
CFS-QR-40.description: Monitoring food-freshness is easy with this integrated Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ system! CPB-300.name: Discontinued Compact Portable Blending/Chopping System
CPB-300.description: The Compact Portable Blending/Chopping System powerhouse does it all! Use the streamlined blender jar to make smoothies in a flash, mince herbs, or grind up flax in the chopping cup, and whip up custom drinks right in the four Tritan™ travel cups! Designed to fit anywhere, the Compact Portable Blending/ Chopping System delivers big performance with a 350-watt motor and user-friendly electronic touchpad. The blender jar, chopping cup, and travel cups are all shatter resistant, BPA-free, and dishwasher safe.

CPT-120R.description: The Cuisinart® Compact Toaster is not just smaller than standard 2 slice toasters, it's better! Streamlined and specially designed to sit sideways or facing forward on kitchen counters, the LED touchpad controls and a 9-setting LED backlit browning dial are within easy reach either way. That's a nice position to be in!

CFS-QR-7.description: Monitoring food-freshness is easy with this integrated Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ system! CFS-QR-52.description: Monitoring food-freshness is easy with this integrated Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ system! Just store and scan; Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ does the rest.

TOB-100.name: Discontinued Compact Digital Toaster Oven Broiler
TOB-100.description: When cooks are short on space, every inch counts. That’s why Cuisinart’s Compact Digital Toaster Oven Broiler is packed with 7 handy functions – Toast, Bake, Broil, Keep Warm, and special settings for sandwiches, bagels, and leftovers. With Always Even™ Toast Shade technology and both preset and adjustable temperature and cook times, the unit is programmed to put power where it’s needed most. Small but mighty, the unit holds four slices of bread or a 9" pizza!

TOB-165.name: Discontinued Convection Toaster Oven Broiler with Exact Heat™ Sensor
TOB-165.description: Cuisinart® brings a new standard of convenience and consistency to baking, broiling and toasting. The Convection Baking fan surrounds the food surface with evenly heated airflow, to cook foods up to 30% faster than conventional ovens. The state-of-the-art Exact Heat™ Sensor and Your Choice™ Browning Memory ensure that everything is cooked to perfection. The Convection Oven-Toaster-Broiler will be a welcome addition to any kitchen!

CRORBH-6.name: Discontinued Cookware Rack Hooks
CRORBH-6.description: Short on storage? Hang up your pots and turn your kitchen into a showpiece with these 6 Cookware Rack Hooks. Available in Oil Brushed bronze, polished copper, and matte black, the Cuisinart® hooks are the perfect accessory for any style of kitchen.

CTG-00-CTOR.name: Discontinued Cooking Torch
CTG-00-CTOR.description: Our stainless steel Cooking Torch is perfect for creating professional quality desserts right in your home. This essential tool will help complete the classic crème brûlée and perform a variety of other tasks in your kitchen. Great for melting cheese, browning meringue, browning potatoes and roasting the tops of tomatoes.

ICE-70.name: Discontinued Cool Creations™ Ice Cream Maker
ICE-70.description: At the touch of one button, you can create two quarts of delicious frozen treats with the Cool Creations™ Ice Cream Maker in just 20 minutes. Making homemade ice cream, gelato, frozen yogurt, and sorbet of any type in any flavor couldn’t be easier with one-button operation for ice cream, gelato, and sorbet, convenient digital LCD time programming, and auto shutoff. The unique paddle makes fast work of processing. The sleek brushed metal housing makes it look as good as the treats it creates for your family and friends.

TOB-195.name: Discontinued Convection Toaster Oven
TOB-195.description: Today's busy lifestyles have made the multifunctional countertop oven more popular than ever. This Cuisinart®; Toaster Oven Broiler features state-of-the-art electronic touchpad controls and a stainless steel bar handle and side grips to give it a popular commercial look. Four versatile cooking options and an extra-large capacity are great for everyday cooking, and make it a convenient second oven for side dishes and desserts. From dinner for two to a dinner party, Cuisinart® is ready to serve!

CTG-00-CP.name: Discontinued Cookie Press (Set of 25)
CTG-00-CP.description: The Cuisinart® Cookie Press lets you make cookies, décorate cakes, cupcakes and more! Includes 18 traditional and holiday cookie discs, and 6 décorating tips. Dishwasher Safe.

CSO-300.name: Discontinued Convection Steam Oven
CSO-300.description: Cuisinart® has managed to incorporate all the functions of a professional steam oven in a countertop footprint for a unique oven that can cut cooking time by as much as 40%! The Convection Steam Oven delivers full steaming capability along with traditional countertop oven features. With 9 single and combination functions, you can steam or poach vegetables, fish, poultry, and rice, or use steam in combination with both Broil or Bake functions to create beautifully crisp roasts that are moist and juicy inside. You can also proof breads, rolls, pretzels, and even donuts to get bakery results faster, with the ingredients your family trusts. Also has a Steam Clean feature, making clean up easy!

CJK-17BC.name: Discontinued Cordless Electric Jug Kettle
CJK-17BC.description: The Cuisinart® Cordless Electric Jug Kettle features the latest in technology to make boiling water quicker and easier than ever. The elegant brushed stainless steel finish makes it the perfect addition to any table. Great for making tea, hot chocolate, oatmeal, instant soups, and noodles, it will quickly become part of your daily routine. In just minutes, this contemporary cordless kettle brings up to 1-3/4 quarts of water to the boiling point and then turns itself off. You'll wonder how you lived without it!

PTC22-20.name: Discontinued Copper Tri-Ply Skillet
PTC22-20.description: Cuisinart® Copper Tri-Ply bonds the finest materials to meet your culinary demands. Whether preparing a simple saut? of veal marsala, a delicate roux for gumbo, or simmering chili all day to blend its flavors, Cuisinart's Copper Tri-Ply Cookware makes cooking a pleasure. Perfect heat, perfect results. Every time.

CSB-44N.name: Discontinued Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender
CSB-44N.description: We packed a lot of power into the Cuisinart® Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender. So, when you're all charged up to blend your favorite food or drink, the Cuisinart® Hand Blender will be too!

CTPP-8.name: Discontinued Copper Collection Tri-Ply Cookware 8 Piece Tri-Ply Cookware Set
CTPP-8.description: Our Copper Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware is an investment that will prove its worth every time you use it. Exclusively designed triple-ply material provides superior heat conductivity and even heat distribution to meet the demands of gourmet chefs everywhere. When properly cared for, your Cuisinart® Copper Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware will give you countless years of service and pleasure.

KUA-17.name: Discontinued Cordless Automatic Electric Kettle
KUA-17.description: The Cordless Electric Kettle is a classic stainless steel beauty that boils 1 3/4 quarts water in minutes. The heating element is concealed, making cleaning fast and easy.

CEK-50.name: Discontinued Cordless Electric Knife Set
CEK-50.description: Cordless and rechargeable for maximum convenience, the Cuisinart® Electric Knife features a powerful motor and two dishwasher-safe stainless steel blades to make short work of any slicing task. The serrated blade perfectly slices meat and bread with speed and precision, while the straight-edge blade is specially designed for fruit, vegetables and filleting fish. Powered by two 7.8-volt lithium batteries, the unit delivers optimal cutting performance for up to 20 minutes on a single charge and includes a safety lock/unlock feature to prevent accidents. The heavy-duty case with easy-grip handles makes storing and transporting the knife and accessories especially easy

DK-17.name: Discontinued Cordless Electric Kettle
DK-17.description: With classic stainless steel styling and a graceful stay-cool handle, the Cuisinart Cordless Electric Kettle looks sleek on any kitchen countertop. The convenient extra large window, with water level marks, lets you see when the water is boiling or kettle needs reﬁlling. With a concealed heating element and easy one-touch operation, the Cordless Electric Kettle makes hot drinks fast and easy.

CEK-120.name: Discontinued Cordless Lithium Electric Knife
CEK-120.description: The Cuisinart® Cordless Lithium Electric Knife makes quick work of all culinary cutting tasks from slicing bread to carving roasts! The slicing guide ensures a consistent cut, and the ergonomic handle minimizes fatigue.

CMG-20.name: Discontinued Cordless Rechargeable Multi-Grater
CMG-20.description: Grate, shred or slice all your favorites with simply, the touch of a button. The Cuisinart® Multi-Grater has all your kitchen needs covered, from grating Parmesan to peppercorns, shredding chocolate or softer cheeses and slicing vegetables, proving the CMG-20 is a lot more than your everyday cheese grater.

CCM-10.name: Discontinued Cotton Candy Maker
CCM-10.description: The Cuisinart® Cotton Candy Maker brings the carnival home! The halogen heater system provides fast and delicious results, and the hub detaches for easy cleaning.

CPT-190.name: Discontinued Countdown Metal 4-Slice Toaster
CPT-190.description: Our Countdown metal Toaster Series delivers innovative looks and spectacular performance. The Countdown Metal 4-Slice Toaster offers two control panels, each toasting two items at a time, to any shade you want. That means you can toast thick-sliced bread at the same time you're doing bagels! Features two 6-shade setting dials and bagel, reheat and defrost controls with two custom LCD countdown timers and LED indicators for each function.

CTK-SS11.name: Discontinued Crown™ 2 Quart Teakettle
CTK-SS11.description: Combining form and function, sleek Crown™ 2 Quart Teakettle quickly brings water to a boil. There is no need to watch this pot boil, as the cheerful whistle lets you know when the water has reached temperature.

CB-30.name: Discontinued Countertop Single Burner
CB-30.description: The Cuisinart® Countertop Single Burner always comes in handy when you’re cooking for a crowd. The flat surface is easy to clean and the brushed stainless housing looks great on the counter.

CTG-00-CST.name: Discontinued Corn Stripper
CTG-00-CST.description: Stripping corn from fresh cob is easy with the Corn Stripper from Cuisinart. The comfortable finger grips makes it easy to use the durable stainless steel blade to free delicious kernels of corn right from the cob for all your favorite recipes.

CCB-395.name: Discontinued Cross Action Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-395.description: The Cuisinart® Cross Action Grill Brush is the latest innovation in grill cleaning.  The brush head has been designed with bristles that are in a criss cross pattern to attack grill grime from every angle.  The brush head is 3.5" x 3.5" to cover a wide swath of grill surface with every pass, and the ergonomically shaped handle also features a rubberized grip so you can clean with ease and comfort.

CB-60.name: Discontinued Countertop Double Burner
CB-60.description: Perfect for parties and holidays, the Cuisinart® Countertop Double Burner provides extra countertop cooking options. The large plate features 1300 watts of power, and the small plate has 500 watts for quick heat-up.

CPT-170.name: Discontinued Countdown Metal 2-Slice Toaster
CPT-170.description: Our Countdown metal Toaster Series delivers innovative looks and spectacular performance. The Countdown Metal 2-Slice Toaster is constructed of brushed stainless steel, with polished and brushed accented controls. Features one 6-shade setting dial and bagel, reheat and defrost controls with one custom LCD countdown timer and LED indicators for each function.

CTG-00-CCC.name: Discontinued Cu pieceake Carrier
CTG-00-CCC.description: Our Stackable Cupcake Carrier makes it easy to carry your freshly baked goodies from your kitchen to a cookout, picnic, or venue! Each Cupcake Carrier holds up to 24 cupcakes - 12 on each layer in three rows of four.

SCC-1000.name: Discontinued Crystal 14 Cup Glass Programmable Coffee Maker
SCC-1000.description: The Cuisinart®  Perfec Temp® 14 Cup Glass Programmable Coffeemaker features state of the art coffeemaking technology that turns up the temperature to deliver hotter coffee, while retaining coffee's full flavor and quality throughout the brewing process – because temperature is as important as taste! Ideal for coffee lovers who prefer hotter coffee. The oversized digital display illuminates the full range of programmable options, including regular and bold flavor settings. The styling is sleek, with elegant angles and a new high tech look with an extremely user-friendly control panel.

CGL-060.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CGL-060 Grilluminate Universal LED Grill Light
CGL-060.description: The Grilluminate Universal LED Grill Light is a fully customizable light to brighten your grill in the dark of night. This unique dual mounting system uses a C-Clamp to mount the grill to most full sized grill handles, while the base allows you to firmly stand the light on any magnetic surface. We also designed the light to slide and rotate, directing light exactly where you need it, and the 6 bright LEDs have a high/low setting to give you complete control. Now you can grill longer into the night!

CNSG-120.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CNSG-120 All Foods Grill Griddle
CNSG-120.description: Bring breakfast and other great griddle foods to your grill with the Cuisinart® All Foods Griddle.  Cook bacon, eggs and pancakes in the morning on the same grill you cook burgers on at night.  Griddle bacon right next to burgers you are grilling.  Make hash browns, grilled cheese, veggies and more any time.  This stainless steel griddle is a needed addition to any grill.

CTG-00-CCSP.name: Discontinued Cu pieceake-Shaped Carrier
CTG-00-CCSP.description: Make events even more special with our whimsical Cupcake Shaped Carrier and bring up to 24 cupcakes with you in style!

CSG-515.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CSG-515 Digital Universal Grill Thermometer
CSG-515.description: The Cuisinart® Digital Universal Grill Thermometer is a simple and effective way to check in on the readiness of your grilled meats. This thermometer has a digital LCD display that reads internal meat temperatures in 10 seconds or fewer. The 5" probe is long enough to fit in any sized meat cut and the head flexes around for easiest viewing.  It also features a small magnet in the thermometer head to store quickly and conveniently at your grill. This thermometer comes with a battery and a probe cover so you are ready to go right away.

CCG-400.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  Charcoal Grill-on-the-Go
CCG-400.description: The Cuisinart® Grill-On-The-Go is the ideal all-in-one tailgating package that includes a portable charcoal grill, 12-pack cooler and convenient storage bag.  The grill offers 165 square inches of grilling surface - plenty for up to 8 large burgers, steaks or chicken breasts - and easily fold up to only 2" wide for convenient storage in the side pocket of the bag.  The bag is designed with ample space for your dry foods, as well as a detached insulated cooler bag which fits neatly inside the bag.   It has several storage areas and pockets which can easily accommodate your grill tools, condiments, and other articles for your party, as well as a comfortable shoulder strap for easy transport.

CRR-158.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CRR-158 Folding Rib Rack
CRR-158.description: Barbecue ribs slow and low for delicious dinners with the stainless steel Cuisinart®  Folding Rib Rack. This rack holds 4 large racks of ribs above your grill surface, providing even cooking and no charring even when ribs cook for a long period of time. The upright method allows for easy basting without having to move or turn the ribs. The rack includes two handles for easy transportation from the grill right to your table. The rack also folds flat, for easy kitchen drawer storage.

CSR-130.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CSR-130 Grill Sauce Rack
CSR-130.description: The Cuisinart® Grill Sauce Rack is the perfect addition to any BBQ for everyone who loves to dip, dunk and slather on delicious sauces.  The rack holds 3 8oz cups and sits safely on the grill warming up whatever sauces you like.  Fill up with Queso, BBQ, Buffalo or any sauce, drop the rack on the grill and wait until they reach a bubbly deliciousness.  Use grill mitts to carry the rack to the table and serve your guests a tasty new twist on toppings.

CVP-149C.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CVP-149C Stainless Steel Grilling Platter
CVP-149C.description: Grilling is no longer reserved for steaks and burgers alone.  The master chef is expanding his menu to include other items which require a more versatile grilling surface.  The Cuisinart® 13" x 8" Stainless Steel Grilling Platter is the perfect piece of grill ware to help ensure all your fish filets, seafood and vegetables are cooked to perfection - without sticking to the grill or falling through the grates.

CGM-100.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  Grill Mitt
CGM-100.description: Get a firm grip on the situation with the Cuisinart®  Grill Mitt, an exceptionally comfortable way to make grilling safer and easier. The heat-resistant thick cotton suede material protects your hand from the high temperatures while grilling and is also perfect for removing hot grill racks.

CGG-440.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  Portable Gas Grill with Rolling Cart
CGG-440.description: Combining exceptional performance with convenient portability, the Cuisinart® Portable Gas Grill with Rolling Cart makes the perfect choice for the serious backyard griller and the Chef on-the-go.  Designed for ultimate versatility, the grill’s ample grilling space and full-size height make it ideal for everyday family grilling and backyard get-togethers.  At the same time, the convenient roll-away folding cart makes it easy to pack up and transport to any campground, tailgate or beach – so you don’t have to compromise on the quality of your grill when you are away from home.   The grill features a 15,000 BTU stainless steel loop burner, 330 square inch porcelain coated grill surface,  a reliable Twist Start electric ignition and convenient tool hooks.

7117-14RR.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 14" Lasagna Pan with Stainless Roasting Rack
7117-14RR.description: The newest addition to the Cuisinart® Chef's Classic™ line is an elegant mirror-polished stainless steel lasagna pan with roasting rack.  Just the right size for favorite multi-layered lasagnas, it has riveted comfort-grip stainless side handles that make placing lasagnas into the oven and lifting them out, safe and easy. The stainless steel interior does not react with food, so flavors stay true and tasty, and the brilliant stainless exterior makes this pan a perfect serving piece for dinner or buffet tables.

CQM-195.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  Quesadillas maker
CQM-195.description: Bring the fiesta home and grill up delicious cheesy bites with the Cuisinart®  Quesadilla Basket! Our handy basket allows you to assemble and grill quesadillas fast. Simply open the basket, assemble ingredients, fold, lock, and grill! The basket locks makes for foolproof flipping, for even grilling without the mess. The silicone heat resistant handle allows you to grip and flip from a safe distance.

C77TRR-15P.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 15pc Triple Rivet Rotating Block Set
C77TRR-15P.description: Cuisinart® Nitrogen Triple Rivet Cutlery possesses superior nitrogen-infused stainless steel blades for ultimate sharpness and corrosion resistance. Constructed for perfect stability and control, these knives are designed with an extra-wide safety bolster and stainless steel rivets that secure the blade to the comfortable handle. This 15 piece set is complete with a rotating block for easy access to any knife, and comes with ledges on the back to secure any cookbook or tablet for an easy look at any recipe!

CPT-160BKS.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 2 Slice Metal Classic Toaster
CPT-160BKS.description: With six shade settings, the Cuisinart® 2-Slice Metal Classic Toaster makes breakfast just the way you like it. The smooth brushed stainless steel housing with polished chrome and black accents looks sleek in any kitchen and toasts anything the way you love. Use the custom controls to defrost and toast bagels, bread, and pastries to perfection!

CSGS-100.name: Discontinued Cuisinart®  CSGS-100 Grill Stand
CSGS-100.description: Elevate your grilling with Cuisinart's grill stand.  The rugged and sturdy tubular metal construction keeps your grill rock solid while cooking.  The embroidered 600 denier black nylon front vanity curtain looks great and hides your gas tank from view.  Two handy tool hooks let you keep your grill tools organized and clean.  The stand has a mid-level shelf designed to securely hold a 20 lb. LP tank.  Quick and easy assembly.

CBC-7200PC.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 14-Cup Brew Central Programmable Coffee Maker
CBC-7200PC.description: The Cuisinart Brew Central® 14-Cup Programmable Coffeemaker is engineered to produce the perfect brew.  Cup after cup, this coffeemaker combines extra-large capacity with fully programmable convenience. Designed with an array of custom settings, from 24-hour Brew Start to adjustable Auto-Off, it brews up to 14 cups into a dripless glass carafe. Choose regular or bold flavor and high, medium or low carafe plate temperature.  Using our cutting-edge coffee technology, the 14 Cup Programmable Coffeemaker can give you hotter coffee without sacrificing taste.  The backlit LCD is easy-to-read, a ready tone can be turned on or off, and an indicator light signals when it’s time to decalcify.  Enjoy the freshest, most satisfying coffee, with a charcoal filter that eliminates water impurities, and a gold-tone filter for superior flavor.

WAF-200.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 4 Slice Belgian Waffle Maker - Round
WAF-200.description: The Cuisinart® 4 Slice Belgian Waffle Maker cooks golden waffles that are crispy on the outside and mouthwateringly tender on the inside. With a stylish brushed stainless steel cover, the waffle iron offers an adjustable temperature control with six browning settings for ultimate control. The result? Precise perfection.

CPC-400.name: Discontinued Cuisinart® 4-Quart Pressure Cooker
CPC-400.description: It’s easy to make compact-size meals or side dishes fast with the 4-Quart Pressure Cooker! Just toss ingredients into the pot, close the lid, and let the pressure cooker do the work. Brown, simmer or sauté food right in the pot before cooking, and keep it warm when done! Food retains more vitamins and minerals than with traditional cooking methods, it stays moist and flavors stay true.

AMW-60.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 3-in-1 Microwave Air Fryer Oven
AMW-60.description: The Cuisinart® 3-in-1 Microwave AirFryer Oven brings versatility and variety to your kitchen combining three appliances to microwave, airfry and bake all in one. With a custom-engineered heater and fan designed for precision cooking, the air fryer uses significantly less oil to bring optimal nutrition and superior flavor to your favorite foods. With easy presets there's no more guesswork for your fried favorites - French fries, chicken wings and frozen snacks. The microwave is programmable with 11 power levels, Auto Cook, and defrosts food using time or weight. 0.6-cubic-foot interior provides enough capacity to airfry 2 lbs of wings or bake up to a 4-lb. chicken. From microwaving popcorn to air frying chicken wings to reheating leftovers, this is the kitchen essential that does it all.

CPT-T40.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 4-Slice Touchscreen Toaster
CPT-T40.description: Cuisinart’s new T-Series line features trendsetting toasters with sleek touch button controls for premium styling and effortless toasting. New features make these units stand out – QuickView™ function lets users check toast without interrupting the toasting cycle, and a +30-Second control adds a little extra time as needed. The T-Series sleek black touchpad changes the dynamic of today’s kitchen. Invisible in standby mode, it wakes up when the power icon is touched, illuminating options for Bagel, Defrost and Single Slice, as well as a choice of six shade settings. Style meets technology in the T-Series toasters from Cuisinart!

WAF-150.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 4 Slice Belgian Waffle Maker - Square
WAF-150.description: Take waffles beyond breakfast with the Cuisinart® 4 Slice Belgian Waffle Maker. This high-performance waffle iron has an elegant stainless steel top and makes deep-pocket waffles to hold more toppings for more delicious options! Five-setting controls for browning create customized results to meet your family’s tastes. The green light signals when the unit is ready to bake and when baking is done, eliminating cooking guesswork!

DCC-1500.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 12-Cup Coffee Maker
DCC-1500.description: Savor delicious brewed coffee in style with the new 12 Cup Programmable Coffeemaker. With its modern curved design, this kitchen essential brings "fresh" to your cup and to your counter. Enjoy the convenience of preprogramming with 24-hour advance presets that accommodate any schedule, so a full carafe is ready to pour without any wait time. Make up to 12 cups in the ergonomic, easy-to-hold carafe that sits on a warming plate that keeps coffee hot for 2 hours, with an automatic shutoff setting. Set the clock, brew, run the cleaning process or sneak a quick cup in the middle of a brew cycle with the Brew Pause™ feature. The most delicious hot coffee is fast and fresh when filtered through both an easy-clean, permanent nylon coffee filter and a charcoal water filter. Freshen up your kitchen with the new 12 Cup Coffeemaker from Cuisinart.

CTG-00-PM.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 5-Piece Pasta Maker
CTG-00-PM.description: Make homemade pasta in three different styles with 9 different thicknesses, with the 5 piece Pasta Maker! And once you've mastered lasagna, spaghetti, and fettucini, you can also try the additional angel hair cutting attachment and linguini cutting attachment.

C55-6PCSC.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 6pc Printed Cactus Chef Set
C55-6PCSC.description:
6pc Chef Set Includes: 
8" Chef Knife
5" Serrated Utility Knife
3.5" Paring Knife 
All Knives include matching blade guards for safe storage

CPC-600N1.name: Discontinued Cuisinart® 6-Quart Pressure Cooker
CPC-600N1.description: It’s easy to make entire meals or side dishes fast with the 6-Quart Pressure Cooker! Just toss ingredients into the pot, close the lid, and let the pressure cooker do the work. Brown, simmer or sauté food right in the pot before cooking, and keep it warm when done! Food retains more vitamins and minerals than with traditional cooking methods, it stays moist and flavors stay true.

CPC-800.name: Discontinued Cuisinart® 8-Quart Pressure Cooker
CPC-800.description: Prepare family-sized meals fast with the 8-Quart Pressure Cooker! Just toss ingredients into the pot, close the lid, and let the pressure cooker do the work – presets for meats, stews, soups and beans eliminate the guess-work! It’s easy to brown, simmer or sauté food right in the pot before cooking, plus keep it warm when done! Pressure-cooked food retains more vitamins and minerals than traditional cooking methods, stays moist and flavors stay true.

CBK-200.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 2lb Convection Bread Maker
CBK-200.description: Bring the bakery home with our beautiful expertly engineered brushed stainless Convection Bread Maker! Fresh bread doesn’t get any easier, thanks to the responsive air circulation, speed, and timing to ensure a beautiful bake each and every time. Taking care of your family’s health is easy with gluten free and low carb settings among 16 preset options at the touch of a button. Entertaining is easy with 3 crust colors, 3 loaf size options, and over 100 bread, dough, cake, and jam combinations with minimum fuss.

C55-6PCSM.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Advantage 6pc Printed Chef Set - Grey Marble
C55-6PCSM.description:
6pc Set Includes: 
8" Chef Knife 
5.5" Serrated Utility Knife 
3.5" Parer 

All knives include matching blade guards for safe and easy storage

CTK-SS17.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Aura 2 Quart Teakettle
CTK-SS17.description: Make two quarts of boiling hot water in style with the Aura 2 Quart Tea Kettle from Cuisinart. The classic tea kettle will bring a splash of color to your kitchen, boasting sleek metallic finishes for looks that impress. Also features a traditional whistle that lets you know when the water is at boiling point.

TOA-60.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Air Fryer Toaster Oven
TOA-60.description: This unique kitchen workhorse is actually a premium full size toaster oven with a built-in air fryer. That means it not only bakes, broils, and toasts, it also lets you air fry right inside the oven. Air frying, which uses powerful ultra-hot air, is a healthier way to prepare delicious fried favorites, from wings to fritters to fries to shrimp. And since toaster ovens stay on the countertop, this fryer doesn’t have to move back and forth, from cupboard to counter. Enjoy the crunch without the calories and messy cleanup, with the AirFryer Toaster Oven!

CPM-28.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Classic-Style Popcorn Maker
CPM-28.description: Bring out the smiles with our Classic-Style Popcorn Maker! In just a few minutes you and your family and friends can be enjoying fresh popped corn, made just how you like it.

CBJ-450.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Compact Blender Juice Extractor Combo
CBJ-450.description: Introducing the innovative kitchen essential that makes it easy for health-conscious consumers to enjoy a wide variety of fresh juice-based beverages—at home or on the go. The sturdy nonslip base houses a powerful 450-watt peak motor and features a control dial with low, high, and pulse options. Blend delicious smoothies directly into a 16-oz. travel cup or attach the juice extractor to extract nutrient-rich juice from bananas, carrots, apples, and more. The travel cup comes with an attachable lid so you can enjoy your drink on the go!

6117-14.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Chef's Classic™ Nonstick Hard Anodized 14" Lasagna Pan
6117-14.description: This 14" Nonstick Lasagna Pan is the perfect size with side walls deep enough for a crowd-pleasing lasagna, roasted chicken and other baked casseroles! The open design maximizes the cooking surface and makes it easy to layer your ingredients for a delicious dinner.

CJE-500.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Compact Juice Extractor
CJE-500.description: People are not only eating healthier, they’re drinking healthier too! Let Cuisinart® help your family do it without sacrificing counter space thanks to our BPA-free Compact Juice Extractor. Turn your favorite fruits and vegetables into 16oz of tasty and nutritious juices in seconds and replace the pitcher for uninterrupted juicing, all at the touch of one button! The quietly powerful Compact Juice Extractor also has a mesh filter that separates out up to 40oz of pulp before requiring emptying.

CMW-200.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Convection Microwave Oven and Grill
CMW-200.description: Cuisinart® presents a countertop oven that’s the ultimate combination of size, style and smarts. The big, 1.2 cubic foot Microwave Convection Oven and Grill looks like it belongs in a high-end commercial kitchen. Brushed stainless steel and black frame a sleek control panel that offers single and combination settings for an unlimited number of cooking options. A multi-stage cooking feature that automatically shifts from one function to another makes perfect results easier than ever. This is a new generation of microwave – and it’s from Cuisinart®, of course!

DFP-14BKSY.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Custom 14 Cup Food Processor
DFP-14BKSY.description: Cuisinart® makes cooking for crowds easy and fast with the Custom 14™ 14 Cup Food Processor. Made from brushed stainless steel, this sleek kitchen workhorse is a breeze to use and will whir through prep and cooking with ease. Whether you are making a weeknight meal or a weekend celebration, the large capacity work bowl will hold everything as the 720 watt motor makes quick work chopping whole fruits and vegetables, shredding cheese, or kneading dough.

FPC-100.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Complete Chef Cooking Food Processor
FPC-100.description: Cuisinart® adds a new twist to its classic food processor that everyone loves. The CompleteChef® preps and cooks right in the ease and convenience of prepping and cooking all your ingredients right in one big work bowl, with a temperature range that rivals a stovetop! The CompleteChef® expertly guides you through a delicious culinary experience — with 200 integrated recipes, intuitive controls, an interactive full color digital display, and technology to prep and cook. Multifunctional and versatile – from chopping, kneading and slicing, to sautéing, simmering and steaming, and so much more…The CompleteChef® does it all!

CPM-100.name: Discontinued Cuisinart® Easypop® Hot Air Popcorn Maker
CPM-100.description: Pop healthier popcorn with just hot air! The Cuisinart® Easypop® Hot Air Popcorn Maker is exceptionally easy to use. Just pour kernels into the popping chamber without oil and hot air will send up to 15 cups of popcorn out of the chute right into a waiting bowl in under 3 minutes! Also features a butter-warming tray for a richer treat. All removable parts are dishwasher safe.

P55-22BK.name: Discontinued Cuisinart® Complete Chef Nonstick Cookware 22 Piece Set
P55-22BK.description: Aluminum-core construction for quick and even heat distribution. Durable nonstick cookware ensures professional performance.

GR-6S.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Contact Griddler with Smoke-less Mode
GR-6S.description: Introducing the first Contact Griddler® with Smoke-less Mode, an innovative kitchen essential that makes it easy to cook delicious grilled meals indoors—without all the smoke. Specially designed plates reduce grease while precision temperature control maintains just the right heat for grilling beef, poultry, fish, and pork to perfection, with maximum flavor and minimal smoke. Engineered especially for smoke-less indoor cooking of grilled favorites all year round, this one-of-a-kind appliance also includes all the Griddler® features home chefs love. And because there's a removable drip tray and the plates are nonstick and dishwasher safe, cleanups are a breeze.

CPT-180BKS.name: Discontinued Cuisinart 4 Slice Metal Classic Toaster
CPT-180BKS.description: The Cuisinart® 4-Slice Metal Classic Toaster boasts beautiful brushed stainless steel housing with polished chrome and black accents. Not only does this toaster look sleek, but the results are as good as it looks, with custom controls to defrost and toast bread, pastries, and bagels four at a time for you and a friend. The dual control panels mean you can both enjoy your food just how you like it, toasted to the shade you love.

FP-14DCN.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Elite Collection 2.0 14 Cup Food Processor
FP-14DCN.description: The Cuisinart Elite Collection® 14 Cup Food Processor boasts a 1300 watt peak power motor to power through your favorite recipes with ease. With innovative design solutions including a 4½ cup work bowl nested inside the 14 cup bowl, adjustable slicing disc, and a reversible shredding disc, Cuisinart gives you multiple food processors in one! The SealTight™ Advantage System including BladeLock maximizes the capacity of your work bowl by containing ingredients in the sealed bowl - and the blade locks in place sealing the bowl from the bottom and won't fall out when removing your prepped ingredients whether mixing, processing, or pouring. Plus clean up is a breeze as the removable parts are all dishwasher safe.

CFO-3SS.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Electric Fondue Pot
CFO-3SS.description: Cuisinart® Electric Fondue Set Now fondue is easier than ever. The stick-free Cuisinart® Electric Fondue Set has a heating element built into the base of the pot and a thermostat that adjusts to a wide range of temperature settings. Consumers can prepare chocolate, cheese, broth or oil fondues in this elegant 3-quart brushed stainless pot. As always, Cuisinart® makes cleanup easy. The nonstick pot offers superb food release, and the entire unit is dishwasher safe.

FP-8SV.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Elemental 8 Cup Food Processor
FP-8SV.description: The Cuisinart Elemental 8 Cup Food Processor is designed to perform any food prep task your recipe calls for. Big enough to chop ingredients for a party-sized portion of salsa, the Elemental 8 is also powerful enough to turn a full work bowl of vegetables into healthy puréed soups in seconds. The wipe-clean rubberized touch pad controls and reversible shredding and slicing discs make this food processor a firm favorite of cooks!

DGB-2G.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Grind & Brew Single-Serve Coffee Maker
DGB-2G.description: Make the perfect cup for one with the Grind & Brew Single-Serve Brewer by Cuisinart®. Designed to brew the most flavorful coffee with ease and convenience, this compact coffeemaker grinds whole beans to the ideal consistency for optimal flavor using a conical burr grinder, then feeds them into the HomeBarista reusable filter cup to be brewed. The HomeBarista can also be filled with pre-ground coffee or you can use your favorite single-use coffee pod. With three ways to brew and three size options, crafting the perfect cup is easy, fast, and extra enjoyable!

GR-11.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Griddler Grill & Panini Press
GR-11.description: For succulent steaks, juicy burgers, and crispy grilled sandwiches, get the Cuisinart® Griddler® Grill & Panini Press. The two grill plates can be used for pressing panini and other sandwiches but also open flat to double the cooking surface for a convenient tabletop grill. The preset temperature is optimized for grilling, removing the guesswork from cooking so you can focus on the rest of the meal. And when your dish is ready, cleanup is super easy because the removable grill plates are dishwasher safe! With Power On and Ready to Cook indicator lights, operation is simple!

WMR-CA.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Round Classic Waffle Maker
WMR-CA.description: Make delicious waffles fast and easy with the gleaming stainless steel Cuisinart® Round Classic Waffle Maker. Take control of your breakfast with five browning settings and red and green indicator lights to let you know when it’s ready to bake, and ready to eat for wonderful waffles every time.

CFP-800.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Kitchen Central 3-in-1 Food Processor
CFP-800.description: Now home chefs can save time and counter space with the all-in-one versatility of the Cuisinart® Kitchen Central. Equipped with 3 attachments, this innovative multipurpose kitchen essential easily and seamlessly converts from an 8 cup food processor to a 40-oz. blender to a powerful juice extractor. Prep, blend, and juice to perfection with a simple turn of the dial. The 500-watt motor ensures high-performance and plenty of power for whipping up a wide variety of delicious dishes, desserts, and beverages.

FP-13DGM.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Elemental 13 Cup Food Processor with Dicing
FP-13DGM.description: Take on any food prep task with the Cuisinart® Elemental 13 Cup Food Processor. Big enough to chop ingredients for a party-sized portion of salsa, the Elemental 13 can also dice ingredients in the same bowl!

RHB-100.name: Discontinued Cuisinart EvolutionX Cordless Hand Blender
RHB-100.description: Introducing blending taken to a new level of professional performance and cordless convenience. Powered by 7.4 volts of lithium ion efficiency and easily rechargeable with a USB cord, the EvolutionX Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender does it all, from blending smoothies to whipping cream, mixing sauces and more. Includes 30 oz. beaker and chef's whisk.

SM-50G.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Precision Master 5.5-Quart Stand Mixer
SM-50G.description: Delivering power, precision and performance, our stand mixer features a 500-watt motor, die-cast metal construction, and 12 speeds that allow for nuance and excellence in performing a variety of preparation tasks. The unit's tilt-back head allows for easy access to its 5.5-quart mixing bowl, while the included splash guard prevents messy countertops. Also included are a chef's whisk, dough hook, and flat mixing paddle. The mixing bowl and all accessories are dishwasher safe. Additionally, you can purchase a variety of attachments for the unit: a pasta roller and cutter, pasta extruder, meat grinder, frozen dessert maker, and spiralizer.

CCJ-500.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Pulp Control Citrus Juicer
CCJ-500.description: From the smallest lime to the largest grapefruit, our sleek brushed stainless steel Pulp Control Citrus Juicer gets out more juice more efficiently. The adjustable auto-reversing reamer features custom pulp control settings for your family’s preference, and the unique Final-Spin feature maximizes the amount of juice from each piece of fruit. Dishwasher-safe parts make cleanup a breeze.

CSB-179.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Smart Stick Variable Speed Hand Blender
CSB-179.description: Versatile and durable, this kitchen essential provides the high performance today's home chefs demand. Equipped with a 300-watt DC motor that delivers maximum power with minimum noise, the Smart Stick® Variable Speed Hand Blender switches from low to high speed at the turn of a dial. The long stainless steel shaft reaches deep to blend in bowls, pots and pitchers, while the mixing/measuring cup, chopper/grinder and chef's whisk make short work of a wide variety of food prep tasks. From puréeing soup to emulsifying mayonnaise to whipping meringues, this hand blender consistently delivers chef-caliber results.

DCC-5.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Soho™ 5-Cup Coffee Maker
DCC-5.description: Jump start mornings, energize afternoons, and warm up every evening with small batch coffee brewed hot or over ice with the Cuisinart SoHo™ 5-Cup Coffee Maker. This compact coffee maker is designed with modern appeal and a slender footprint. It’s mindful of its bold aesthetic as well as the limited amount of area it occupies while serving rich, satisfying coffee with total ease. A single On/Off button makes the task virtually effortless. Use the integrated coffee scoop, mounted securely in the no-lift cover, to measure grounds into the easy, brew basket, add water to the tank, and 5 cups of fresh coffee is on the way! Morning rituals should be simple and minimal—nothing more, nothing less. That's Cuisinart Soho.

SPB-650.name: Discontinued Cuisinart VELOCITY Ultra 7.5 1 HP Blender
SPB-650.description: This sleek and powerful blender features Ice Crush and Smoothie controls, Low and High blending speeds, and a convenient Pulse function. Its generous 56-ounce durable BPA-free plastic jar features a tight-seal lid, soft-touch handle, and a 2-oz. measuring cap for precise measuring. The blender’s electronic touchpad provides easy selection for all your blending needs.

BFP-650.name: Discontinued Cuisinart VELOCITY Ultra Trio 1 HP Blender/Food Processor with Travel Cups
BFP-650.description: The dynamic VELOCITY Ultra Trio Blender/Food Processor with Travel Cups lets you do it all! The blender’s smart power and sophisticated electronics minces delicate herbs, whips up smoothies, and even chops ice to a fine powder. Blend your smoothies right in the two travel cups, put on the lids, and enjoy healthy breakfast on the go. Use the food processor work bowl to slice, shred, chop, or mix a dip in no time at all. With its sturdy base, this 3-in-1 workhorse can handle anything you toss at it – or into it!

DBM-8.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Supreme Grind Automatic Burr Mill
DBM-8.description: Discover the difference that freshly ground beans make to your coffee, with the Supreme Grind™ Automatic Burr Mill! The elegant brushed stainless steel Cuisinart® burr mill boasts 18 levels to grind your coffee beans, from ultra-fine to extra-coarse. With an automatic stop, your beans are guaranteed to be consistently ground to the right grade, maximizing the oils, aromas, and flavors for a better cup of coffee. Grind enough coffee to make 4-18 cups, and store any remaining grounds in the chamber.

P87-10.name: Discontinued Cuisinart® Stainless Steel 10 Piece Set
P87-10.description: Stainless steel surface for professional results every time you cook. Aluminum encapsulated base heats up quickly and distributes heat uniformly. Handles are designed to provide a secure and comfortable grip. Riveted stick handles stay cool on the stovetop. Glass lids fit tight to lock in flavor, moisture and nutrients. Covers are made from tempered glass for superior durability. Rims of cookware are tapered for convenient, drip-free pouring. Cookware is oven safe to 350°F and freezer safe for easy storage. Kitchen tools feature ergonomic handles and are dishwasher safe.

SFP-13.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Stainless Steel 13-Cup Food Processor
SFP-13.description: Home chefs and serious foodies can double up on food prep with the Cuisinart® Stainless Steel 13 Cup Food Processor. A 13 cup work bowl for big jobs and a 4.5 cup nesting work bowl for smaller jobs eliminates the need to clean a bowl between tasks – that saves time! And with two stainless steel blades and two discs, it offers an almost unlimited variety of food prep options. Purée soup, chop herbs and nuts, slice fruits and vegetables, shred cheese and more. There’s not much it can’t do with food!

WAF-V100.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Vertical Waffle Maker
WAF-V100.description: The brushed stainless steel on the Cuisinart® Vertical Waffle Maker takes up less room on the counter while making foolproof perfect Belgian waffles. Just add your favorite batter through the spout up to the fill line for consistent waffle thickness, top to bottom and side to side, that won’t spill over the edges. Indicator lights and an audible alert, plus five browning levels, guarantee crowd-pleasing waffles are perfectly baked for all your family and friends.

DBM-T10.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Touchscreen Burr Grinder
DBM-T10.description: The new Cuisinart® T Series line combines style and innovation, perfect for today’s modern kitchen. Intuitive touchscreen controls on the Burr Coffee Grinder let coffee lovers tap icons to choose from 18 grind consistencies and select the number of cups they want to brew – the unit will grind the right amount for the number of cups. This premium burr grinder includes a manual grind control and a chamber large enough to hold ground coffee for up to 32 cups. When not in use, the grinder’s LCD screen goes to sleep, creating an ultra-sleek profile on the kitchen counter. A touch of the power icon wakes up the screen and you’re ready to grind. It’s a great way to ensure the coffee you brew is always fresh, and a brand new look kitchens are going to love!

DCC-T20.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Touchscreen 14-Cup Programmable Coffeemaker
DCC-T20.description: Cuisinart® launches its new T Series line with a coffeemaker that is going to change the dynamic of today’s kitchen. Intuitive touchscreen controls let coffee lovers tap icons to choose start time, shutoff time, number of cups, and strength settings. When the coffeemaker is not in use, the LCD screen goes to sleep – creating an ultra-sleek look in your kitchen. Simply touch the power icon to wake up the screen when you are ready to brew! With PerfecTemp® Technology, this premium coffeemaker even brews hotter, and has two filters that protect the rich coffee flavor. Its superb coffee and a brand new look kitchens are going to love!

GR-M3.name: Discontinued Cuisinart STACK5
GR-M3.description: Never has there been a multipurpose grill this versatile that is also this compact! Cuisinart® introduces the ultimate in cooking variety in an all-in-one grill. This unique counter-top unit cooks 6 different ways, replacing the need for multiple cooking appliances. The grill plate sears meats and vegetables or, when swapped for a stainless steel rack, easily steams foods. A 5-quart deep, non stick pan can be used for slow cooking, baking, griddling, and browning or sautéing. Temperature presets adjust at the turn of a dial. Plus, the removable plate and pan are durable for long-lasting use and dishwasher safe for easy cleanups.

CTG-00-4WS.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Wine Set (4 Pieces)
CTG-00-4WS.description: Begin upgrading your barware today with the Cuisinart® Wine Set (4 Pieces). The elegant black and stainless steel design gives a timeless feel to these classic barware tools.

GK-17.name: Discontinued Cuisinart ViewPro Cordless Electric Kettle
GK-17.description: Powered by 1500 watts, the ViewPro Cordless Electric Tea Kettle brings water to a boil in minutes. Whether heating water to steep the perfect cup of tea, make a cup of hot cocoa, or fill a French Press Coffeemaker, the 1.7-liter capacity holds enough water to please every member of the family at once! The glass jug lets you see at a glance when your water is ready-just pour, enjoy, and repeat. More Enjoying, Less Waiting!

SS-1.name: Discontinued Cup-O-Matic™ Single Serve Coffee Maker
SS-1.description: Regular or bold, large or small – your ideal cup should never be compromised. Now with the Cuisinart® Cup-O-Matic™ Coffeemaker, it's easy to brew your cup the way you want it. Use the flavor selector to control coffee intensity and choose a 4- to 12-ounce cup size depending on your coffee need. The water reservoir – complete with water filter – has a 60-ounce capacity so a quick cup is never far away.

DFP-14BCN.name: Discontinued Custom 14™ Cup Food Processor
DFP-14BCN.description: Cuisinart® makes cooking for crowds easy and fast with the Custom 14™ 14 Cup Food Processor. Made from brushed stainless steel, this sleek kitchen workhorse is a breeze to use and will whir through prep and cooking with ease. Whether you are making a weeknight meal or a weekend celebration, the large capacity work bowl will hold everything as the 720 watt motor makes quick work chopping whole fruits and vegetables, shredding cheese, or kneading dough.

CTG-01-TT.name: Discontinued Curve Handle Line Nylon Turner Tongs
CTG-01-TT.description: The Nylon Turner Tong makes flipping your food so much easier. With an innovative stainless steel wire, the dishwasher safe, nylon turner tong is an essential tool for any kitchen.

DFP-14CPY.name: Discontinued Custom 14™ 14 Cup Food Processor
DFP-14CPY.description: Cuisinart® makes cooking for crowds easy and fast with the Custom 14™ 14 Cup Food Processor. Made from brushed stainless steel, this sleek kitchen workhorse is a breeze to use and will whir through prep and cooking with ease. Whether you are making a weeknight meal or a weekend celebration, the large capacity work bowl will hold everything as the 720 watt motor makes quick work chopping whole fruits and vegetables, shredding cheese, or kneading dough.

CTG-00-CB16.name: Discontinued Cutlery & Tool 16 Piece Block Set
CTG-00-CB16.description: Now home chefs can enjoy the ease and convenience of having all their essential knives and tools in one block set. From carving a roast and slicing bread to paring fruits and filleting fish, the wide range of stainless steel knives makes quick work of any cutting task and includes a sharpening steel to maintain their extra-fine edges. The heat-resistant nylon tools feature slotted or solid heads to simplify preparing and serving food. Housed in a handsome rubberwood block, this all-in-one set puts chef-caliber cutlery and tools at the fingertips of today’s busy home chefs.

CPT-60.name: Discontinued Custom Control™ Total Touch® Electronic Toaster
CPT-60.description: Two slices of perfect toast require the right touch. The Cuisinart® Custom Control™ Total Touch® 2-Slice Electronic Toaster lets you toast everything from bagels to muffins thoroughly and evenly because it is not only wide enough, but it is also smart enough!

CTG-00-CBC.name: Discontinued Cutting Board with Colander
CTG-00-CBC.description: Designed with nonslip silicone edges for easy handling, this chef-caliber, 20" cutting board measures up to just about any cutting task and fits over the sink to conserve counter space. Equipped with a 2.5-quart removable, collapsible colander, the polyboard is easy to clean and dishwasher safe. It is perfect for cutting meats, fish, vegetables, and fruits, with a built-in colander that lets you rinse and drain items right over the sink as they’re cut up or trimmed. Available in two options: white with black trim or semi-transparent with red trim.

CGWM-090.name: Discontinued Deluxe Outdoor Prep Table
CGWM-090.description: Take your BBQ game to a whole other level with the Cuisinart® Deluxe Outdoor BBQ Prep Table. This outdoor prep table equips you with everything you need to bring the kitchen outside. The stainless steel work surface measures 36" x 22", giving you plenty of space to prep meats, cut vegetables, or filet fish. The two storage shelves allow you to keep all of your grilling essentials handy while outside, cutting down on time back and forth to the kitchen. Washing your hands and keeping food clean is so important when handling raw meats by the grill. That's why the Cuisinart® Deluxe Outdoor BBQ Prep Table comes equipped with a faucet and seamless stainless steel sink. The faucet connects directly to any standard garden hose and is fit with a drain pipe for sink run-off. The 4 swiveling casters make moving the table effortless, allowing you to easily situate it in the perfect spot in your yard. Barbecue can be a messy game, and you need to be able to clean as you go. With a paper towel holder and trash bag holder, you'll be able to make clean up a breeze. The Cuisinart® Deluxe Outdoor BBQ Prep Table will make you re-think what is possible when cooking outdoors!

GAS9456AS.name: Discontinued Deluxe Four Burner Gas Grill
GAS9456AS.description: Bring the high-end appliance look and performance you desire outdoors, while preparing a gourmet grilled meal for friends and family. Enjoy an exceptional, worry free cooking experience with an appliance grade viewing window that allows you to monitor food quickly and easily without losing heat. Experience effortless entertaining with the Cuisinart® Deluxe Four-Burner Gas Grill.

CBM-20.name: Discontinued Deluxe Grind Conical Burr Mill
CBM-20.description: Elevate your coffee experience with our barista-quality Deluxe Grind Conical Burr Mill. Boasting Cuisinart® design, the Burr Mill produces superior results, preserving the natural flavors and oils of your coffee during all 18 grind settings from ultra fine for espresso to extra coarse for French Press. Our advanced engineering ensures a cooler, quiet, low static grind of up to 14 cups of coffee beans into the container or directly into a permanent, paper, or portafilter for ultimate convenience. The removable 1lb bean hopper remains tightly sealed to maintain freshness. The Deluxe Grind Conical Burr Mill meets the high standards set by the Specialty Coffee Association of America (SCAA) and the European Coffee Brewing Centre (ECBC).

KFS-1W.name: Discontinued DigiPad™ Round Scale
KFS-1W.description: Cuisinart® digital kitchen scales deliver accurate measurements in imperial and metric weights fast, and the DigiPad™ Round Scale can help you master all your favorite recipes. Designed to meet all your household measuring needs, each smart design combines modern versatility with easy cleaning. With this one kitchen product, you can ensure your baking results will be consistent every time, conveniently weighing multiple ingredients for reliable and precise results.

CPG-6000.name: Discontinued Deluxe Wood Pellet Grill and Smoker
CPG-6000.description: Get that smoky barbecue flavor right in your backyard! With the Cuisinart® Deluxe Wood Pellet Grill and Smoker, enjoy a convenient way to smoke your favorite meats! Featuring an extra-large cooking capacity totaling 700 square inches, 513 sq. inches main rack & 187 sq. inches warming rack. With the large 20 pound hopper, you’ll be smoking for hours without needing to refill. Increasing in popularity, Pellet Grills are an easy and fun way to smoke meat and start barbecuing. The Deluxe Wood Pellet BBQ Grill & Smoker is super versatile, giving you the ability to grill, smoke, roast, braise, barbecue and even bake with it. Add pellets to the hopper and set your desired temperature; that’s it. Pellets come in a variety of flavors and can be mixed to create your own personal smoky-flavor.

FP-DC.name: Discontinued Dicing Accessory Kit
FP-DC.description: Imagine dicing favorite fresh vegetables and fruits into perfect little 10mm squares in seconds! Dice a cupful or bowlful of nutritious broccoli, zucchini, carrots and onions to add color, flavor and texture to soups and sauces. Or you can dice firm, fresh fruits like apples and pears to garnish a salad. Easy to use, with a cleaning tool that instantly clears the grid to make cleanup quick. Everything goes into the storage case when done, and the lid of the case is a flat work bowl cover. Custom designed to fit perfectly in work bowl for seamless operation.

TOB-60N1.name: Discontinued Cuisinart Toaster Oven Broiler with Convection
TOB-60N1.description: Cuisinart® brings a classic approach to modern cooking with the Toaster Oven Broiler with Convection. The industrial stainless steel styling, and the 0.6 cu ft. capacity – large enough to fit a 12" pizza or 6 slices of toast – make this countertop oven a valuable addition to any kitchen. This multi-functional oven can bake, broil, toast, warm, convection bake and convection broil to perfection with a glass window allowing you to monitor the cooking progress without opening the door. Clean up is easy thanks to the interior non-stick coating and the removable crumb tray.

CSG-466.name: Discontinued Digital Folding Probe Thermometer
CSG-466.description: The Cuisinart® Digital Folding Probe Thermometer is a simple and effective way to check in on the readiness of your grilled meats.  This thermometer has a digital LCD display that reads internal meat temperatures instantly.  The probe is long enough to fit in any sized meat cut and folds into base for convenient storage. Built-in LED light allows for grilling at night. Comfortable grip and the folding probe provide perfect angles and comfort when reading temperatures in hard to reach places.

CTG-00-TM.name: Discontinued Digital Timer with Battery
CTG-00-TM.description: Our Digital Timer with Battery boasts an easy to read digital display and magnetic back to attach to metal stovetops and grills. Simply rotate the rim to adjust the time and count down till your dish is done!

CSG-800.name: Discontinued Digital Grilling Thermometer and Timer
CSG-800.description: One of the greatest challenges a grill master faces is perfecting the cook of the meat to every guest’s request.  The Cuisinart® Digital Thermometer & Timer is the new tool in the battle for grilled perfection.  Featuring a programmable, digital thermometer and timer, it gives you all of the information you’ll need on your grilled meats.

CTG-607C.name: Discontinued Digital Temperature Gauge With Color Changing Display
CTG-607C.description: Grill it to perfection with the Cuisinart® Programmable Magnetic Temperature Gauge and serve up perfectly cooked meats, poultry and chops every time you grill. This accurate digital temperature gauge displays the Set and Actual temperature of your food and alerts you when the food has reached its ideal temperature with a color changing display and audible alarm. The stainless steel probe comes with a 3-foot long stainless steel cable that can reach all corners of your grill. The integrated magnetic base allows for easy convenient placement on most gas grills.

CDF-300.name: Discontinued Deep Fryer
CDF-300.description: Make restaurant-quality deep-fried food – crispy chicken, light tempuras, golden onion rings, and calamari with crunch – right at home! The Cuisinart™ Deep Fryer has an extra-wide 9" x 9" fry basket that holds items with minimal stacking, so food cooks crispier all around. A heating element, permanently affixed to the underside of the quality die-cast frying bowl, keeps oil at peak frying temperature. The bowl lifts out to empty and clean. Our Deep Fryer fries more food in less oil than most other fryers, too, and temperature adjusts to 375°F for perfect results, no matter what’s cooking!

DSA22-30H.name: Discontinued Dishwasher Safe Anodized Cookware 12" Open Skillet with Helper Handle
DSA22-30H.description: Our exclusive ArmourGuard technology offers a rich hard-anodized exterior with the convenience of dishwasher cleanup.

CTG-00-DTM.name: Discontinued Digital Meat Thermometer
CTG-00-DTM.description: Our stainless steel Digital Meat Thermometer is perfect for roasting meats or poultry, with an easy-to-read digital display that displays targeted temperature and is oven safe up to 450°F.

9111-18.name: Discontinued Double Boiler Insert (fits 18cm Saucepan)
9111-18.description: The original standard for professional quality stainless steel cookware. Designed for professional performance, top-rated for home use

MCP45-25NS.name: Discontinued Double Burner Griddle
MCP45-25NS.description: Perfect for big family breakfasts or entertaining friends, the space-saving double burner griddle is perfect for preparing anything from stacks of pancakes to sautéed vegetables to fish filets.

WAF-F20.name: Discontinued Double Belgian Waffle Maker - Round
