WAF-F20.description: The professional quality Cuisinart® Round Double Belgian Waffle Maker cooks two thick, delicious Belgian waffles at the same time. With its extra-deep 1-inch waffle pockets, non-stick coated waffle grids, and adjustable browning controls, you'll have light and fluffy waffles in no time!

CDM-100G.name: Discontinued Drink Maker
CDM-100G.description: The Cuisinart® Drink Mixer is best known for mixing up rich and creamy soda-fountain-style milkshakes, but easily handles pancake batter and more. In Retro Green.

ICT-60.name: Discontinued Double Induction Cooktop
ICT-60.description: This Cuisinart® Induction Cooktop features two burners with induction technology for fastest heat-up, while using up to 70% less energy than conventional cooktops. Perfect for entertaining or anytime you need extra burners!

CG-S4DOFBG.name: Discontinued Double Old Fashioned Glasses (Set of 4)
CG-S4DOFBG.description: Cheers to the new Cuisinart® Essentials Glassware Collection! Elegant and affordable, these glasses will bring style and grace to any home. Sip and savor favorite wines with quality glassware designed for daily use, and special enough for the fanciest celebration.

CSK-1248.name: Discontinued Dual Dutch Grilling Oven
CSK-1248.description: This will certainly be one of the best grill top cookware pieces you ever purchase.  The Cuisinart® Dual Dutch Oven brings a wide world of versatility to your grilling experience.  Our unique shape is designed to fit the contours of round kettle and similar grills to use space that is typically wasted.  The cast iron construction absorbs and retains heat extremely well baking foods to perfection.  Try some mac and cheese, a casserole, or even an apple cobbler,  The 1.5 quart capacity is enough for a delicious side dish or small meal.  The lid also foubles as a griddle surface or a trivet for serving.  With the Dual Dutch oven your grilling variety can be limitless.

CGG-522.name: Discontinued Dual Blaze Two Burner Gas Grill
CGG-522.description: The Cuisinart® Dual Blaze Two Burner Gas Grill takes portable outdoor grills to the next level. With 20,000 BTUs of power, this grill will never be lacking in temperature. The two independent burners are easily controlled by the knobs on the front of the grill. Built specifically for 20lb propane tanks, the Dual Blaze grill does not require any additional accessories to connect to a 20lb tank. To aid in the grilling experience, the cast iron cooking grate provides high quality and durability. And you’ll always know the temperature with the precision, integrated grilling thermometer. When not in use, the grill’s legs can be folded to lock the grill and the handle can be used to easily carry the grill from home to tailgate. Impress your family and friends with the perfect combination of power and portability using the Cuisinart® Dual Blaze Two Burner Gas Grill.

CGWM-024.name: Discontinued Dual Grip Grill Brush
CGWM-024.description: Delicious grilled food starts with a clean grill! The Cuisinart® Dual Grip Grill Brush features a front handle grip which allows you to apply additional pressure to the grill grates. Use the scraper located at the end of the grill brush to loosen debris. The Dual Grip Grill Brush will help you clean your grill so you can get grilling!

KML-9.name: Discontinued DualPro™ Digital Kitchen Scale
KML-9.description: The Cuisinart® DualPro™ Digital Kitchen Scale quickly and conveniently weighs multiple ingredients precisely, with imperial or metric measurements to handle any recipe. With a removable dishwasher safe weighing platform, the DualPro™ is as easy to clean as it is to use. The signature black and stainless styling blends seamlessly with any contemporary kitchen.

CWC-1200DZ.name: Discontinued Dual Zone Wine Cellar
CWC-1200DZ.description: Store up to 12 bottles of wine at the temperatures that preserve their integrity, with the new Dual Zone Wine Cellar from Cuisinart®. With a temperature range of 39° – 68°F, you can easily use the touchpad to set two temperatures in this dual compartment cellar to keep your wines at sommelier-recommended temperatures. Whether reaching for the perfect wine pairing with dinner or savoring an end-of-day indulgence, Cuisinart® delivers the ultimate wine experience, every time. Capable of storing whites in one side and reds in the other, everyone is happy.

CEC-7.name: Discontinued Egg Cooker
CEC-7.description: Cooking eggs has never been easier! The Cuisinart® Egg Cooker cooks up to 7 eggs in shells - hard, medium or soft - or perfectly poaches up to 3 eggs at once. The amount of water added precisely controls cooking time, and indicator lights, an audible signal, and auto-shutoff prevent overcooking. Cuisinart® signature stainless looks great, and the results are always just what you ordered!

CTG-00-ACG.name: Discontinued Dual Edge Cheese Grater
CTG-00-ACG.description: Our Dual Edge Cheese Grater boasts two grating surfaces, fine and medium, angled for easy grating. The non-slip bottom makes it perfect for prep and its convenient size is ideal for serving at the table. Also included are two protective covers for safe storage.

CPM-900.name: Discontinued EasyPop® Popcorn Maker
CPM-900.description: The Cuisinart EasyPop Popcorn Maker puts the crunch back into homemade popcorn! Special vents in the popping bowl let moisture escape to keep popcorn crisp. Pops up to 10 cups in under 5 minutes, and keeps it healthier by letting you decide the type and amount of oil and salt you want. Operation is simple and cleanup is dishwasher easy, so enjoy popcorn- plain, buttered, tangy cheese or caramel - any time you want it, with Cuisinart

CPM-950.name: Discontinued EasyPop Plus™ Flavored Popcorn Maker
CPM-950.description: Gourmet popcorn lovers are in for a treat! Cuisinart’s EasyPop Plus™ Flavored Popcorn Maker pops up to 10 cups of popcorn in under 5 minutes and then mixes in toppings and flavorings with the flip of a switch. Recipes are included for favorites like caramel and cheese popcorn and, best of all, corn pops and mixes right in a flip-to-serve bowl!

CSJ-300.name: Discontinued Easy Clean Slow Juicer
CSJ-300.description: Crafting a wide range of fresh, healthy, homemade juice beverages is easy with the Cuisinart® Easy Clean Slow Juicer. Engineered to powerfully press and crush fruits and vegetables for maximum juice extraction, this kitchen essential is a must for wellness-minded home chefs. The masticating auger produces less heat to retain the full flavor and nutrients of food. The auger ensures every bit of juice is extracted, while pulp is ejected into its own pitcher. Add variety and quickly yet thoroughly extract the essence of nuts, wheat grasses, sprouts, and more. This ultra-versatile unit lets you create an endless array of nutritious and delicious beverage options, from pressed juices to alternative milks to refreshing tonics and spritzers. The mesh-free filter is easily cleaned under the tap, and the powerful motor operates with quiet efficiency.

CCP-10.name: Discontinued Electric Cookie Press
CCP-10.description: Make more cookies in less time with the Electric Cookie Press from Cuisinart. This easy-to-use press turns out professional-looking cookies in minutes! There are 12 cookie discs to choose from, including special seasonal patterns, as well as 8 designer pastry tips for decorating cookies and desserts or filling pasta shells, deviled eggs or pastries. Automatic one-touch operation and an ergonomic handle make this press easy and comfortable to work with.

CTG-00-ES.name: Discontinued Egg Slicer
CTG-00-ES.description: The Cuisinart® Egg Slicer slices hard cooked eggs easily in two different styles - thin sliced and wedges.

CEK-40.name: Discontinued Electric Knife
CEK-40.description: Cuisinart® continues its commitment to superior quality and innovation with our state-of-the-art electric stainless steel knife. The Cuisinart®<sup>®</sup> Electric Knife delivers high performance with two stainless steel blades to tackle any task. The bread blade makes short work of crusty baguettes, and the carving blade produces clean restaurant-quality cuts. Ideal for slicing meats, loaves, and vegetables, the ergonomic handle accommodates both right- and left-handed people. The elegant solid wood butcher-block storage tray with safety lock system for storage looks stylish on any counter top or tucks away safely into a drawer.

JK-17.name: Discontinued Electric Cordless Tea Kettle
JK-17.description: Whether heating water for perfect afternoon tea, making hot cocoa before bed, or filling a French Press for your morning coffee, the Electric Cordless Tea Kettle is always ready. Boasting 1500 watts of power, the Tea Kettle brings up to 1.7 liters of water to the boil fast at the push of a button. Convenience is built into the kettle, with an Open button to lift the lid for filling, while the base features a 360’ connector for easy cordless power.

WOK-730.name: Discontinued Electric Wok
WOK-730.description: Introducing an easier way to cook a wide variety of today's favorite meals.  The 7.3 quart Cuisinart® Electric Wok does stir-fry and big one-pot meals, simmers soups or sauces, and steams large orders of shrimp, chicken and vegetables--right on the countertop, no burner required!  1800 watts guarantees quick heatups, and a removable temperature control probe adjusts from warm to 450 F for more cooking options.  With the probe removed, the wok can be lifted off the base and placed in the dishwasher for quick and easy cleanup.  A domed lid, two accessory racks and wooden spatulas make the Cuisinart® Electric Wok an easy way to cook for family and friends.

CPM-100W.name: Discontinued EasyPop™ Hot Air Popcorn Maker
CPM-100W.description: Pop healthier popcorn with just hot air! The Cuisinart® Easypop® Hot Air Popcorn Maker is exceptionally easy to use. Just pour kernels into the popping chamber without oil and hot air will send up to 15 cups of popcorn out of the chute right into a waiting bowl in under 3 minutes! Also features a butter-warming tray for a richer treat. All removable parts are dishwasher safe.

CS-7.name: Discontinued Electric Steam Sterilizer and Dryer
CS-7.description: Offering peace of mind the natural way, the Electric Steam Sterilizer and Dryer lets parents sterilize everything for baby with steam. It’s a perfect solution for bottles, pacifi ers, small toys, and breast-feeding accessories. The sterilizer is compact yet big enough to hold up to fi ve glass or plastic bottles, including most commercially available sizes.

CSK-150.name: Discontinued Electric Skillet
CSK-150.description: The brushed stainless steel Cuisinart® Electric Skillet is one of the most versatile countertop cooking appliances on the market and a valuable addition to any kitchen. A temperature probe adjusts from Warm to 450°F and can be removed to make the Skillet dishwasher safe. The nonstick cooking surface is ideal for low-fat or no-fat cooking and is big enough for family orders of pancakes, or a fajita with friends.

ECH-4MB.name: Discontinued Elemental 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder
ECH-4MB.description: More convenient than ever, the Cuisinart® Elemental CollectionTM 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder effortlessly handles a variety of food preparation tasks such as chopping, grinding, and puréeing. The SmartPower® blade has a patented auto-reversing ability with a sharp edge for delicate chopping and pureeing soft foods, while the blunt edge grinds through spices and harder foods. Additionally, the revolutionary BladeLock System keeps the blade secure during processing and pouring. It’s cutting-edge food prep from Cuisinart!

FP-8.name: Discontinued Elemental 8 Cup Food Processor
FP-8.description: The Cuisinart Elemental 8 Cup Food Processor is designed to perform any food prep task your recipe calls for. Big enough to chop ingredients for a party-sized portion of salsa, the Elemental 8 is also powerful enough to turn a full work bowl of vegetables into healthy puréed soups in seconds. The wipe-clean rubberized touch pad controls and reversible shredding and slicing discs make this food processor a firm favorite of cooks!

FP-11.name: Discontinued Elemental 11 Cup Food Processor
FP-11.description: The Cuisinart® Elemental 11 Cup Food Processor lets you quickly and easily prepare large portions of ingredients for meals with minimum effort. The generous 11 cup work bowl, 1 stainless steel blade and reversible slicing and shredding discs make this food processor the ultimate timesaver for your favorite dishes, making quick work of everything from chopping nuts and puréeing soup to slicing tomatoes and shredding cheese. Another time saver - the rubberized touchpad with Pulse control is wipe-clean and the removable parts are dishwasher safe!

CYM-100.name: Discontinued Electronic Yogurt Maker with Automatic Cooling
CYM-100.description: Today’s health-conscious consumers want to eat right. The Cuisinart® Electronic Yogurt Maker with Automatic Cooling turns milk and soymilk into nutritious yogurt – automatically! Yogurt lovers can create an endless variety of flavors and the 1.5 liter batch makes enough for days of delicious meals and snacks. Operation is simple. Once processing time has elapsed, the unit switches itself to a cooling mode. It’s easy to eat healthy, with Cuisinart®!

FP-12.name: Discontinued Elite Collection™ 12 Cup Food Processor
FP-12.description: Combining the Cuisinart® tradition of culinary excellence with groundbreaking innovation, the Cuisinart® Elite Collection 12 Cup Food Processor sets the bar for the next generation of kitchen appliances. With a 4 cup work bowl nested inside the big bowl, plus the adjustable 6-position slicing disc and reversible shredding disc, it provides home chefs with multiple food processors in one! The exclusive SealTight Advantage System is designed to deliver maximum bowl capacity and clean processing and pouring. It is truly the finest food prep appliance available for today's modern kitchen.

5922-20R.name: Discontinued Elements Nonstick Skillets
5922-20R.description: Delivering eco-friendly cooking for today’s health-conscious cooks, the 10" Covered Skillet is ideal for creating everything from omelets to sautéed vegetables and so much more!

FP-14.name: Discontinued Elite Collection™ 14 Cup Food Processor
FP-14.description: The Cuisinart® Elite Collection®  14 Cup Food Processor delivers the next big innovation for the modern kitchen. With 11 and 4 1/2 cup work bowls nested inside the 14 cup bowl, plus the adjustable 6-position slicing disc and reversible shredding disc, it provides home chefs with multiple food processors in one! The exclusive SealTight®  Advantage System is designed to deliver maximum bowl capacity and clean processing and pouring. No other processor does it better!

EM-1000.name: Discontinued Espresso Defined™ Fully Automatic Espresso Machine
EM-1000.description: The state-of-the-art Cuisinart® Espresso Machine makes so much more than espresso! With its intuitive touchscreen controls, brewing barista-quality espresso, cappuccino, latte, or coffee - even steaming milk - is effortless. Grinds eans, brews, tops off beverages with velvety foam and lets users customize each cup with grind size, milk volume, brew temperature, and flavor strength settings that are saved for up to 4 users. The Cuisinart® Espresso Defined™ combines minimalist design and maximum elegance , and is absolutely brilliant, inside and out.

CH-4.name: Discontinued Elite Collection™ 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder
CH-4.description: The Cuisinart® Elite Collection™ 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder handles food preparation such as chopping, grinding, and puréeing effortlessly, making your kitchen tasks easier. The unique SmartPower™ blade has a patented auto-reversing ability with a sharp edge so you can chop delicate ingredients and purée soft foods, while the blunt edge can grind through your favorite spices and harder foods. The superior BladeLock™ System feature keeps you safe by securing the blade in place during processing and pouring.

EM-100.name: Discontinued Espresso Machine
EM-100.description: Imagine the aroma of a fresh cup of your favorite espresso beverage– hot, rich, bold, and flavorful. Now, make your imagination reality with the stainless steel Cuisinart® Espresso Maker. Press an espresso and then use the stainless steam nozzle and frothing cup to transform it into a latte or cappuccino. You can even heat cups on the warming plate above to keep your beverage steaming hot.

EM-15.name: Discontinued Espresso Defined™ Espresso Machine
EM-15.description: The styling of the Espresso Defined™ professional-quality espresso machine will make it the centerpiece of any kitchen. With 19 bars of pressure, this unit produces intense flavor and a rich, velvety smooth crema. Presets and menu options let users adjust flavor strength and brew temperature, to customize each cup. Easy start to finish, with used capsules ejected right into an internal waste bin. Compatible with Nespresso® OriginalLine capsules, this is Cuisinart® at its best!

CGS-1006Q.name: Discontinued Essential 4 Piece Grilling Tool Set
CGS-1006Q.description: The Cuisinart®  Essential 4 piece Grilling Tool Set Set features the Chef's Spatula, the Professional Grill Tongs, the Oversized Grill Knife and the Master Cleaning Brush. This deluxe set covers the entire grill - with all the tools necessary to turn, grab, serve and cut any delicious foods you put on the grill.

CGS-1001.name: Discontinued Essential Grill Set
CGS-1001.description: The Cuisinart®  Essential Grill Set features the Chef's Spatula, the Professional Grill Tongs and the Chef's Fork. These durable stainless steel tools are all you need to master your grill - whether you're grilling steaks, vegetables or fish filets. When your grilling is complete, store your prized Cuisinart®  Grilling Tools in the deluxe storage bag.

CGS-1007.name: Discontinued Essential Starter Set
CGS-1007.description: The Cuisinart®  Essential Starter Set features two of the most important grilling tools any chef needs - a set of Professional Grill Tongs and a Chef's Spatula. These durable stainless steel tools can handle anything you put on your grill - from steaks to fish to vegetables. The attractive designs and innovative features make the Essential Starter Set a necessity for your grilling area.

922-20.name: Discontinued Everyday Stainless 8-Inch Skillet
922-20.description: The original standard for professional quality stainless steel cookware. Designed for professional performance, top-rated for home use

CGG-220.name: Discontinued Everyday Portable Gas Grill
CGG-220.description: Get great grilling performance every time you grill with the Cuisinart® Everyday Portable Gas Grill. This 15,000 BTU grill with stainless steel loop burner is designed to accommodate all your grilling and entertaining needs whether you are camping, tailgating, hosting friends or simply cooking dinner for your family after a typical day at work. No need for an excessively large full-sized grill taking up your valuable patio space. No need to purchase a second "disposable" grill to take on the road. The Cuisinart® Everyday Gas Grill is smartly designed to handle it all -- with the performance expected from a Cuisinart® product. The 240 square inch porcelain enamel cast iron grill grate can accommodate lots of food and distributes heat evenly and efficiently. An integrated precision temperature gauge clearly displays internal temperatures and allows you to accurately manage your cooking. Two removable side tables offer valuable countertop prep space for tools, food and beverages. The Twist Start electric ignition and removable drip tray add to the convenience and ease of use. Weighing less than 40 pounds, it is easy to pack up and carry to any social venue where fine grilled food is on the menu. Innovative culinary tools are the Cuisinart® signature. The prestigious Cuisinart® brand is not limited to their famous food processors - plugged or unplugged, nobody covers the modern chef like Cuisinart®. Cuisinart® is a full-service culinary resource with a wide array of products, preferred by chefs and favored by consumers. And now you can take the world famous Cuisinart® brand to your patio, lawn, tailgate, or campsite with their comprehensive line of Cuisinart® outdoor grilling products available at retailers.

CCB-909.name: Discontinued Extra Large 9" Griddle Scraper
CCB-909.description: Easily remove burnt, caked-on residue from your griddle! The Cuisinart® Extra Large 9" Griddle Scraper is a must-have tool for cleaning your griddle cooking station. The ergonomic handle has two grips that are positioned to help you apply more leverage, for quick and easy cleaning without hand fatigue. Includes a removable metal splash guard above the scraper head that's designed to keep burned food and cooking oils away from the handle and your hands.

CFE-01-E20.name: Discontinued Evires 20 Piece Set
CFE-01-E20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. Made to the renowned quality standards of Cuisinart®, these solid yet comfortable continental size pieces are hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel and finished with the utmost care. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

CHA-860.name: Discontinued Fire Pit Poker
CHA-860.description: The Cuisinart Cleanburn Fire Pit Poker accessory provides an added layer of protection for your Cuisinart Cleanburn Fire Pit. The fire pit poker keeps your hands a safe distance from the fire, while controlling the flames.

CTG-02-FLG.name: Discontinued Fine Cut Long Grater
CTG-02-FLG.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Twist Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip handle. The fine cut long grater features a stainless steel cutting surface, perfect for hard or soft cheeses and vegetables. Dishwasher Safe.

CFT-104.name: Discontinued Fish and Vegetable Turner
CFT-104.description: Nothing beats a healthy filet of fish grilled to perfection on an open flame. Add your favorite fresh vegetables and your menu is complete. The Cuisinart®  Fish and Vegetable Turner is the perfect grilling tool to keep those delicate filets together when turning and serving. The large surface helps the chef serve complete filets and large portions of vegetables to guests.

DCC-2650.name: Discontinued Extreme Brew® 12 Cup Programmable Coffee Maker
DCC-2650.description: Get your first cup of hot fresh coffee up to 25% faster with our Extreme Brew®12 Cup Programmable Coffeemaker! Cuisinart® has re-engineered each step of the brewing process to deliver hot coffee faster without sacrificing that fresh taste at the boldness you love using our Brew Strength Control. As well as the 24-hour programmability and famous Brew Pause™ feature, the 12 cup carafe features a drip-free pour spout for ultimate convenience for your first cup of hot fresh coffee.

CFW-122.name: Discontinued FireWire Flexible Grilling Skewers (2 Pack)
CFW-122.description: Looking for a new twist on kebabs? Try Cuisinart®  FireWire. These innovative flexible skewers make preparing, grilling, and serving kebabs easy. The flexible and dishwasher safe stainless steel cable design lets you marinate your skewered food in a bowl or zip-lock bag and then throw right onto the grill for ultimate convenience. The flexible FireWire also means you can maximize the space on your grill, arranging the skewer anyway you want while the ends stay cool, for easy rotating and removing without tools.

DCC-2750.name: Discontinued Extreme Brew™ 10 Cup Thermal Programmable Coffee Maker
DCC-2750.description: Really need that first cup of hot fresh coffee fast? Now you can get it up to 25% faster with the Extreme Brew 10 Cup Thermal Programmable Coffeemaker! Packed with all your favorite Cuisinart®; features, including brew strength controls and auto shutoff, this is truly the ultimate coffee-lovers machine. And of course, our famous Brew Pause feature means you can get that first cup while the rest of the double-walled thermal carafe gets filled.

CTG-02-W1.name: Discontinued Flat Whisk
CTG-02-W1.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Twist Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip handle. The flat whisk features a stainless steel head. Dishwasher Safe.

DCC-755.name: Discontinued FlavorBrew® 10 Cup Thermal Coffeemaker
DCC-755.description: Designed to preserve counter space as well as the fresh flavor of your coffee, this sleek, 10 cup thermal programmable coffeemaker enhances any countertop in both form and function. With a thermal carafe that keeps coffee hot and fresh for hours and great features like 24-hour programmability, a 1-4 cup setting, and the always convenient Brew Pause™  feature, it's easier than ever to brew, pour and enjoy a great cup of coffee.

GAS2556AS.name: Discontinued Five Burner Dual Fuel Gas Grill
GAS2556AS.description: The Cuisinart Five-Burner Gas Grill offers a range of cooking versatility by allowing you to grill and griddle meals all on the same unit. Experience the cooking versatility that is the Cuisinart Five-Burner Gas Grill. Easily adjust the Cuisinart Five Burner Gas Grill to fit your needs with dual fuel valves for propane or natural gas (Model#ACC1056AF Cuisinart Natural Gas Conversion Kit sold separately).

DCC-755BK.name: Discontinued FlavorBrew® 10 Cup Thermal Coffee Maker
DCC-755BK.description: Designed to preserve counter space as well as the fresh flavor of your coffee, this sleek, 10 cup thermal programmable coffeemaker enhances any countertop in both form and function. With a thermal carafe that keeps coffee hot and fresh for hours and great features like 24-hour programmability, a 1-4 cup setting, and the always convenient Brew Pause™  feature, it's easier than ever to brew, pour and enjoy a great cup of coffee.

CDF-500.name: Discontinued Extra-Large Rotisserie Fryer and Steamer
CDF-500.description: The Cuisinart® Extra-Large Rotisserie Fryer and Steamer is a multitasking marvel that not only fries a whole turkey in an hour using less oil than a traditional fryer, it also fries up big portions of delicious appetizers, entrées, side dishes, breakfast treats and more! Use it without oil to steam all your favorites, like vegetables, dumplings, etc. – you can even cook up an entire clambake right at home. From appetizers to entrées to desserts, the options are unlimited!

DCC-750.name: Discontinued FlavorBrew® 12 Cup Coffee Maker
DCC-750.description: With a compact design that saves precious counter space, this sleek, modern, 12 cup programmable coffeemaker enhances any countertop in both form and function. With great features like 24-hour programmability, a 1-4 cup setting, and the always convenient Brew Pause™ , it's easier than ever to brew, pour and enjoy a great cup of coffee.

DCC-750BK.name: Discontinued FlavorBrew® 12 Cup Coffeemaker
DCC-750BK.description: With a compact design that saves precious counter space, this sleek, modern, 12 cup programmable coffeemaker enhances any countertop in both form and function. With great features like 24-hour programmability, a 1-4 cup setting, and the always convenient Brew Pause™ , it's easier than ever to brew, pour and enjoy a great cup of coffee.

CTG-00-SSP.name: Discontinued Flex & Flip™ Silicone Spatula
CTG-00-SSP.description: The Cuisinart® Flex & Flip™ Silicone Spatula is a breakfast workhorse. The tapered edge and flexible head are perfect for sliding under and lifting omelets, pancakes, crepes, and more with ease. The silicone head is heat resistant to 450°F and safe for nonstick cookware. With a soft-grip nonslip ergonomic handle, this spatula is also dishwasher safe for easy clean-up.

CDP01-S4FL1.name: Discontinued Fleurie Collection
CDP01-S4FL1.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers a variety of beautiful patterns, each dish designed and crafted of the ?nest quality porcelain. From colorful geometrics to bold black on white to delicate pastels, Cuisinart® porcelain dinnerware can be classically elegant, totally trendy, and everything in between. Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CFE-20PFL.name: Discontinued Florence Collection
CFE-20PFL.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience. Set includes: 4 Dinner Forks, 4 Dinner Knives, 4 Dinner Spoons, 4 Salad Forks, and 4 Teaspoons.

CTG-19-FT.name: Discontinued Flex Turner
CTG-19-FT.description: Cuisinart's New Collection of Flexible turners are great for any home chef. These flexible Stainless steel, silicone wrapped turners are perfect for flipping omelets, burgers, cookies and more! The tapered edge helps move easily underneath delicate foods without tears or a mess. These are a great addition to any kitchen!

CIT-202.name: Discontinued Folding Cleaning Brush
CIT-202.description: Long grill tools are great for safer grilling over hot flames, but can be tough to store and transport due to their size. That is why we created the 16” Cuisinart® Folding Grill Brush that folds to half its size. Ideal for drawer storage and portable enough to make camping and tailgating grilling easy, our Folding Grilling Tools line also includes the Cuisinart® Folding Spatula and Cuisinart® Folding Tongs.

CTG-00-FC.name: Discontinued Foil Cutter
CTG-00-FC.description: The Cuisinart® Foil Cutter easily removes foil on wine bottles. Hand Wash Only.

CIT-701.name: Discontinued Flexible Slotted BBQ Spatula
CIT-701.description: The all-purpose Cuisinart® Flexible Slotted BBQ Spatula is perfect for lifting, turning, flipping, frying, grilling, baking, and more! The beveled edge helps slide beneath foods, while the slots in the head allow grease, oils, or sauces to drip through. This multipurpose firm-flex spatula is flexible enough to lift delicate food and strong enough to lift a heavy burger patty.

CFGS-150.name: Discontinued Folding Grill Stand
CFGS-150.description: Elevate your grilling with Cuisinart®'s folding grill stand.  Great for use full-time on your patio or deck or for taking to the big game or the beach.  Keeps your Cuisinart® grill at the perfect height for cooking.  Rugged and sturdy all-metal construction.  Folds flat quickly and easily for transport.  The stand has tool hooks, and a mid-level shelf that has a hole to securely hold a 20 lb. LP tank.

CIT-200.name: Discontinued Folding Spatula
CIT-200.description: Storing and transporting long handled grilling tools can be difficult, but not with the Cuisinart® Folding Spatula! 16” of grill tool simply fold to take up half the space. Now keeping a safe distance from grill flames is easy while tailgating, camping, or throwing a beach party. The Cuisinart® folding grill tool line also includes the Cuisinart® Folding Tongs and Cuisinart® Folding Brush as well.

CNFB-433.name: Discontinued Fish Basket With Removable Handle
CNFB-433.description: Grilling large, delicate fish filets is easy with the Cuisinart®  Non-Stick Fish Basket! No longer will you have to deal with soft filets that fall apart and through the grill grate. Season or sauté your favorite filet and place in the basket. Close the top, secure the lock, and start grilling! The handle even disconnects for easy grilling with the lid down. When your fish is cooked, the professional grade non-stick wires ensure your filet won't stick to the basket, making serving and clean up a breeze.

CIT-201.name: Discontinued Folding Tongs
CIT-201.description: Safety comes first with grilling, and keeping a safe distance from open flames is why long handled tools are so popular. However, those long handles can make transporting and storing grilling tools difficult, which is why we created the 15” Cuisinart® Folding Tongs. With a simple fold, the tongs take up half the space – making any camping trip or tailgating a whole lot safer. Check out the Cuisinart® Folding Spatula and Cuisinart® Folding Brush for comfort and safety in half the space.

CMM-232.name: Discontinued Flavor Injector
CMM-232.description: It's time you made the change from plain and ordinary meats to juicy and succulent meats! The Cuisinart® Flavor Injector will allow you to inject delicious flavors into any type of meat. Turkey, steaks, smoked meats, no problem! With both a large and small syringe tip, the flavor injector will allow you to make adjustments from meat to meat. And the visible liquid chamber allows you to see the exact amount of juice that you are injecting into every piece of delicious meat.

DHR-20.name: Discontinued Food Dehydrator
DHR-20.description: The Cuisinart® Food Dehydrator dries your favorite meats and fruits for healthier and delicious snacks. Or dry herbs and flowers for a fragrant potpourri.

CTG-00-FM.name: Discontinued Food Mill
CTG-00-FM.description: The new Cuisinart® Food Mill is equipped with fine, medium and coarse cutting discs for preparing a wide variety of foods. The fine disc can be used to purée peas, carrots, squash, and more for baby food, while the medium disc is ideal for homemade gnocchi, and the coarse disc makes quick work of chunky mashed potatoes and applesauce. The food mill is ergonomically designed for smooth turning, is equipped with a soft-grip turn knob and handles, and is completely dishwasher safe.

CAP-1000.name: Discontinued Freestanding HEPA Air Purifier
CAP-1000.description:
The PuRXium Freestanding Air Purifier offers 4-stage, 4-sided intake at 360 degrees to give a large room clean and odor free air. It comes complete with 4 metal pre-filters, 4 H13 high-grade HEPA filters, 4 active carbon filters and UV-C light that work together to capture up to 99.9% of various airborne particles 0.1 Micron or larger, including bacteria and various contaminants to provide fresher, cleaner air. The air purifier cycles air within a room up to 1000* sq. ft. 2x every hour and 500 sq. ft. 4x every hour. Relax and breathe easy with this peace-of-mind essential for today's home. NOTE: *Approximately 1,000-square-foot area.

 

4-STAGE 360 DEGREE AIR INTAKE H13 HIGH-GRADE HEPA FILTRATION SYSTEM

 

HIGH-GRADE HEPA FILTERS (4) – H13 high-grade HEPA filters capture up to 99.9% of airborne particles 0.1 Micron or larger including bacteria and various contaminants as well as dust, pollen and odors from cooking, smoke, pets and VOC’s
ACTIVE CARBON FILTERS (4) – Captures up to 99.9% of unwanted particles including cooking odors, smoke and VOCs 0.1 Micron or larger
REMOVABLE, REUSABLE METAL PRE-FILTERS (4) – Captures larger airborne particles such as dust and pet dander
 

CLEANING AND MAINTENANCE

 

To get the most out of your Purxium™ Air Purifier, it’s best to clean the washable pre-filters once a month or more often, depending on where the air purifier is placed and if you have pets. The HEPA H13 filters should be cleaned once a month using the brush attachment from a vacuum.

 

Your air purifier will automatically tell you when it’s time to change your filter when 2,500 hours of purification has been reached. The filter replacement light will illuminate in red when it is time to replace the HEPA H13 and active carbon filters on the unit. When needed, replacement filters can be purchased directly from Cuisinart.

ICE-31.name: Discontinued Fruit Scoop™
ICE-31.description: Make scrumptious, healthy frozen desserts from just 100% fresh fruit with the Cuisinart® Fruit Scoop™ Frozen Dessert Maker! The unique paddle crushes and freezes chunks of fresh, ripe fruit to create one and a half quarts of delicious frozen fruit treats – from chunky textured to creamy smooth. A second paddle easily turns the unit into a genuine Cuisinart® Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt maker. Add your favorite fruit, ice cream, yogurt mixtures, and flavorings using the large spout on top to create endless varieties of frozen desserts and drinks in 18 to 25 minutes. Healthy, nondairy, fresh and fruity to totally rich, creamy, and decadent, this dessert maker does it all and you get to control the ingredients.

95-11.name: Discontinued Forever Stainless Collection™ 11 Piece Set
95-11.description: Inspired by the iconic 6-point diamond, the Cuisinart® Forever Stainless Collection™ is built to last a lifetime.  This timeless, exceptionally crafted 11 piece set features mirror-polished stainless steel and elegant riveted stainless steel handles. The Forever Stainless collection provides versatile performance and is safe to use in the oven, broiler, and freezer.

CTG-14-LDR.name: Discontinued FusionPro Ladle
CTG-14-LDR.description: Serve your favorite soup with Cuisinart® sleek FusionPro Ladle! The durable Ladle features a stainless steel handle, is dishwasher safe, and is heat resistant up to 400°F.

GG1500GF.name: Discontinued Full Grill & Griddle
GG1500GF.description: Cook two different ways at the same time with this 2-sided, full-sized grill and griddle-in-one from Goodful by Cuisinart. The sleek bamboo base looks great on your counter while the aluminum grill plate's nonstick surface makes clean-up quick and easy.

CTG-14-PSR.name: Discontinued FusionPro Pasta Server
CTG-14-PSR.description: Easily serve any pasta meal to guests with Cuisinart® FusionPro Pasta Server. The convenient kitchen tool features sleek, stainless steel handles with a nylon tool head that is heat resistant up to  400°F.

CTG-00-FELI.name: Discontinued Fresh Edge Lime
CTG-00-FELI.description: Keep food fresher longer with these handy food holders! The airtight design keeps cut vegetables fresher and helps contains odors. The fun designs make them easy to spot in the refrigerator and they are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup!

CTG-14-LSR.name: Discontinued FusionPro Slotted Spoon
CTG-14-LSR.description: FusionPro Slotted Spoon features sleek, stainless steel handles. Perfect for stirring a large pot of pasta, while the slots handily drain remaining water.

CGG-501.name: Discontinued Gourmet Two Burner Gas Griddle
CGG-501.description: If you're looking for easy and versatile cooking at home, look no further! From the basics to breakfast and beyond, you can cook just about anything on a griddle. Flat top cooking can be found in just about every cultural cuisine from Japan to Spain to the U.S. The Cuisinart® Gourmet Two Burner Gas Griddle is designed to look great on your patio while still offering the portability to take it to the tailgate, camp site, or anywhere your culinary creativity is needed. If you need an all-in-one outdoor cooking appliance or something to expand your culinary creativity at home or away, then this product is for you! Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CTG-14-LTR.name: Discontinued FusionPro Slotted Turner
CTG-14-LTR.description: Cook eggs and burgers in style with Cuisinart® FusionPro Slotted Turner! The durable Turner features a stainless steel handle, is dishwasher safe, and is heat resistant up to 400°F.

CCG-100.name: Discontinued GrateLifter Portable Charcoal Grill
CCG-100.description: Superior outdoor cooking with the flavor of charcoal and the quality and convenience of Cuisinart®.  The Cuisinart® GrateLifter Charcoal Grill features a novel cooking grate lifting system giving access to the charcoal bed without having to touch the dirty cooking grate.  With the lift engaged, the grate raises effortlessly out of the way when you open the lid - you can also choose to open the lid without lifting the grate.  This lets you start the coals, add coals for extended cooking, or brush the coal ash in to the ample collection bin without ever touching the grate!  Other features include a large, family-sized cooking surface, precision air flow system for accurate temperature control, lid mounted temperature gauge, a robust table stand, and an attractive and durable porcelain enamel coated lid.

CTG-14-SKR.name: Discontinued FusionPro Skimmer
CTG-14-SKR.description: The FusionPro Skimmer features a sleek, stainless steel handle and red accent ring. The nylon tool head is also heat resistant up to  400°F and is dishwasher safe.

CTG-02-GP.name: Discontinued Garlic Press
CTG-02-GP.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Twist Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip handle. The garlic press features a removable chamber for easy cleaning and stainless steel head. Dishwasher Safe.

GG-10.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized 10 Piece GreenGourmet® Set
GG-10.description: Cuisinart® is leading the way in eco-friendly branded cookware with our new GreenGourmet™ line. Exclusive Cuisinart® Ceramica™ nonstick technology is ceramic based instead of petroleum based, helping to conserve existing oil supplies and the coating is applied at a temperature one half that of conventional nonsticks. And it’s completely free of PTFE and PFOA. The cookware’s hard anodized construction provides high heat conductivity, which requires less energy to reach desired cooking temperatures. Riveted stainless handles stay cool on the stovetop and are made from 70% recycled stainless steel. Today, more and more home cooks are going green… and so is Cuisinart® cookware!

CSK-250.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Electric 14" Skillet
CSK-250.description: Cuisinart®  presents a stylish polished stainless steel skillet that's good for you and a little easier on the environment! The interior of our GreenGourmet® Electric Skillet is premium Cuisinart®  Ceramica® nonstick, a petroleum-free ceramic-based cooking surface that contains no PTFE or PFOA. With temperature control from Warm to 450⁰F our 14-inch smart nonstick lets you sear, fry, griddle, simmer, or braise with little or no oil or butter for healthier family dinners, and cleans up in record time!

GG22-24.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized 10" Skillet
GG22-24.description: Cuisinart® is leading the way in eco-friendly branded cookware with our new GreenGourmet™ line. Exclusive Cuisinart® Ceramica™ nonstick technology is ceramic based instead of petroleum based, helping to conserve existing oil supplies and the coating is applied at a temperature one half that of conventional nonsticks. And it’s completely free of PTFE and PFOA. The cookware’s hard anodized construction provides high heat conductivity, which requires less energy to reach desired cooking temperatures. Riveted stainless handles stay cool on the stovetop and are made from 70% recycled stainless steel. Today, more and more home cooks are going green… and so is Cuisinart® cookware!

GG45-25.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized Nonstick Eco-Friendly Double Burner Griddle
GG45-25.description: Perfect for big family breakfasts or entertaining friends, the space-saving Double Burner Griddle is ideal for preparing anything from stacks of pancakes to sautéed vegetables to fish filets.

GG44-22.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized 4 Quart Dutch Oven
GG44-22.description: The versatile 4 Quart Dutch oven is generously sized and ideal for simmering, boiling and stewing, keeping food moist and full of flavor. Cuisinart® Ceramica® technology creates an environmentally safe coating without the use of petroleum.

GGT-10.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Tri-ply Stainless Steel 10 Piece Set

CGWM-008.name: Discontinued Griddle Spatula
CGWM-008.description: The Cuisinart® Griddle Spatula is perfect for flipping burgers, pancakes, veggies, eggs, and other grill or griddle foods. Use the beveled edges to chop food while cooking. Great tool for hibachi cooking, griddle breakfasts, teppanyaki grilling, and more!

CGWM-027.name: Discontinued Griddle Scraper
CGWM-027.description: Easily remove burnt, caked-on residue from your griddle with the Cuisinart® Heavy Duty Griddle Scraper! The ergonomic design has an easy grip handle allowing you to place more pressure on the stainless steel blade for a better clean.

GC-15.name: Discontinued Griddler® Compact Grill Centro
GC-15.description: Presenting a grill that can do it all – all at once! The Griddler® Compact Grill Centro features a top tier that easily converts from grill to griddle and a bottom tier that automatically rotates kebabs and hot dog rollers to produce evenly cooked results. It is built to last with solid stainless steel and die-cast construction, yet is easy to clean with removable, dishwasher-safe kebab drawer, drip cup and grill/griddle plate. So get grilling!

GG30-20.name: Discontinued GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized 11" Grill Pan
GG30-20.description: The 11" Grill Pan boasts a ceramic-based non-stick cooking surface that is petroleum free, helping to-conserve natural resources. Heat is distributed quickly producing perfect grill marks on chicken, shrimp, or panini.

GR-55.name: Discontinued Griddler® Combo
GR-55.description: The Griddler®  Combo cooking surface uses two removable and reversible nonstick grill and griddle plates to provide multiple cooking options. Use half grill/half griddle, full griddle or full grill to prepare any meal. It's easy to make a steak-and egg breakfast or fry the peppers and onions on the griddle while grilling the chicken for fajitas - all right on the countertop with one easy Griddler® !

GR-35.name: Discontinued Griddler® Compact
GR-35.description: It's the hardest working kitchen appliance you've ever seen! The multipurpose Cuisinart®  Griddler® Compact transforms with just a flip of the reversible plates. Start with bacon and eggs for breakfast, then a deliciously overstuffed panini for lunch, and finally chicken or burgers on the grill for dinner - this little powerhouse handles it all!

GR-2.name: Discontinued Griddler Express™ Contact Grill
GR-2.description: Cuisinart® lets customers grill all their favorites -- steaks, burgers, chicken, veggies, potatoes, etc. -- rain or shine. The Griddler Express™ Contact Grill sits right on the kitchen counter, with extra-large top and bottom grilling surgaces and a cup to catch excess fat. A professional-style floating hinge precisely positions the top plate to ensure both sides of foods, including popular panini sandwiches, are always evenly grilled. Nonstick plates are easy to clean and require little or no oil. Bigger, easier and healthier... what more could you ask for!

GR-300WS.name: Discontinued Griddler® Elite
GR-300WS.description: The Griddler<sup>®</sup> Elite boasts six impressive cooking functions in sleek brushed stainless steel that gleams on any kitchen countertop. This stylish electric grill can tackle any task, with the ability to grill, griddle, half grill, half griddle, panini press, and top melt sandwiches, meats, and appetizers. The electronic display lets you set a timer and dual zone temperature control, meaning you can griddle an egg on one plate while grilling bacon on the other across a generous 240 square inches of cooking surface. With reversible plates, our superior SearBlast™ feature locking flavor into steaks at 500˚F, and a top cover that is fully adjustable, cooking is perfectly customized and precise every time. The dishwasher safe nonstick grill plates are also conveniently removable for easy clean up after even the gooiest, cheesiest sandwich or sticky barbecue sauce.

GR-SM.name: Discontinued Griddler® Overstuffed Sandwich Maker
GR-SM.description: Fit more between the bread! The Griddler®  Overstuffed Sandwich Maker has extra-large plates with extra-deep pockets to make room to make room for larger, thicker gourmet sandwiches. So pile in the pastrami or bring on the brie: it satisfies both refined and hearty appetites, and the variable temperature control achieves the perfect texture.

GR-3.name: Discontinued Griddler® Jr
GR-3.description: The Griddler® Jr. maintains the best of the Griddler®  family traits and has a more compact build to fit comfortably on any countertop. It can be used three different ways to prepare a variety of favorites – steaks on the open grill, crisp-grilled sandwiches with the panini press, or burgers cooked to perfection, both sides at once, with the contact grill. Make big plans with a small package!

GR-5B.name: Discontinued Griddler® FIVE
GR-5B.description: We’ve redesigned the iconic Griddler<span class="s2">® with sleek, contemporary styling while keeping the widely-praised performance unchanged. In addition to the well-known and loved functions, including its 5-in-1 cooking options, the GR-5 has an LCD display, user-friendly digital controls, a sear function and more. The floating cover and reversible plates are easily removable, transforming the Griddler<span class="s2">® FIVE from grill to griddle, making it an indispensable partner in the kitchen!<span class="Apple-converted-space">

CGG-080.name: Discontinued Griddl'n Grill Portable Gas Grill
CGG-080.description: The Cuisinart®  Griddl'n Grill is more than a portable gas grill, it is the ultimate go anywhere, cook anything grill that allows tailgaters and campers to grill and griddle breakfast, lunch, and dinner wherever they are. This versatile propane 192 square inch grill comes with a non-stick griddle integrated into the lid for eggs or warming buns. For breakfast, try grilling bacon and sausage while the pancakes and eggs cook on the griddle above. Try loading up the grill with burgers, dogs, and chicken, and using the griddle to sauté onions and peppers or cook potatoes, asparagus, and other veg. Large heat resistant side handles let you move the grill lid during cooking while the sturdy fold-down legs can also fold up to provide a comfortable locking handle for easy transport.

CGM-111.name: Discontinued Grill Gauntlet
CGM-111.description: The Aramid Fiber of these gloves is most well-known for its aerospace and military applications. They can withstand up to 475 degrees and are perfect for removing hot platters and foods from the grill or outdoor oven. Whether you are a lefty or a righty, this ambidextrous glove will be the perfect fit. And the silicone overlay will provide the perfect grip for handle items going on and off the grill.

GR-150.name: Discontinued Griddler® Deluxe
GR-150.description: With six sizzling cooking options, the Griddler® Deluxe raises your grilling game in stylish brushed stainless steel. The dual-zone temperature control gives home chefs complete control over the reversible grill and griddle plates for ultimate breakfasts, panini lunches, and burgers or fajitas for dinner. The 240 square inch grilling surface is ideal for entertaining friends or fun family meals and our SearBlast™ feature locks in the flavor of juicy steaks at 500˚F. With dishwasher safe accessories and 1800 watts of power, deluxe grilling is as enjoyable as it is easy with Cuisinart®!

GG-2.name: Discontinued Grill & Griddle
GG-2.description: Everyone knows Cuisinart™ products save time and now they save space, as well.  The Cuisinart™ Grill & Griddle has a large reversible, nonstick plate to make it two appliances in one.  An embedded heating element lets you evenly grill poultry, meats, fish and vegetables. Not in the mood to grill?  Flip the cooking plate and set the electric thermostat to perfectly cook pancakes, eggs, crab cakes or fajitas!

CCB-9101.name: Discontinued Griddle Scraper with LED Light
CCB-9101.description: Light up your griddle surface and leave no mess behind with the Cuisinart Griddle Scraper with LED Light! Featuring a super bright LED light, this griddle scraper allows you to thoroughly clean your griddle surface even after the sun goes down. The 6" stainless steel blade effortlessly removes caked-on food and grease from your cooktop leaving with you a clean surface. The ergonomic handle design offers maximum comfort, while the knob grip allows for added cleaning pressure when needed for tough messes.

CCK-210.name: Discontinued Grill Cleaning Stone Kit
CCK-210.description: The Cuisinart® Grill Cleaning Stone is the ideal cleaning tool for tough messes on your grill. The grill stone comes with a cleaning handle and a replacement cleaning stone. The cleaning handle firmly grips the stone and allows you to safely reach all areas of your grill while cleaning. The stone measures 4.75" x 3.0" and covers a wide area of your grill surface while cleaning. The gritty material of the stone easily breaks up burned-on food and grease with ease. As you use the stone, it will begin to form to your specific grilling surface, giving you a custom cleaning experience. The stones make for a safe alternative to traditional wire bristles brushes that can come loose and get stuck in your food.

CNT-202.name: Discontinued Grill Tapas - Square
CNT-202.description: Taking the tapas trend to the grill! Tapas provide a fun and diverse way of tasting numerous foods while interacting with friends and family. Using the Grill-Top Tapas Square bowl, enjoy tapas straight from the grill top to the table. Share family style or dish out everyone's favorite. Every time you are having tapas, you are being given the opportunity to try something new or stick with a classic. Cuisinart's Grill-Top Tapas bowl is a uniquely designed bowl that is great for the grill and even better for serving. Not only does the non-stick coating allow for no mess serving, they also making cleaning up a breeze. It is important to use oven mitts or gloves when removing tapas bowls from the grill. And when it comes to tapas, variety is key so don't forget to get creative.

CK-107.name: Discontinued Grill Knife
CK-107.description: Slicing meats and checking doneness are important parts of the grilling process. A small steak knife from your table just doesn't have what it takes to comfortably maneuver around a hot grilling surface. The Cuisinart® Grill Knife is designed to help slice, portion and check meats directly on the grill. The extra long handle keeps hands away from the heat and its durable blade allows for easy cutting from any angle.

GR-4.name: Discontinued Griddler®
GR-4.description: With five separate cooking options, the Cuisinart® Griddler® can handle everything from pancakes and sausages to grilled cheese to steaks, hamburgers, and panini. A floating cover and one set of reversible plates turn the Griddler® into a contact grill, panini press, full grill, full griddle, or half grill/half griddle. Dual temperature controls ensure everything is perfectly cooked every time on the removable dishwasher safe nonstick cooking plates for easy meals and clean up.

CT-109.name: Discontinued Grill Tongs
CT-109.description: Every master chef knows that a good set of tongs is the most important tool in his collection. The ability to easily grab any piece of food - from steak tips to shrimp to vegetables - makes grilling both effortless and enjoyable. The Cuisinart®  Grill Tongs are designed with long handles and fine pointed surfaces to easily grasp foods while keeping hands away from the heat.

CGWM-011.name: Discontinued Grill Locking Tongs
CGWM-011.description: These are the ideal tongs to use while grilling. The long tongs will allow you to safely and comfortably turn, lift, and remove food from the grill. The stainless steel tongs make it easy to grab even the most difficult of grilled foods and the scalloped ends will grip food firmly without tearing it. The locking mechanism keeps the tongs closed for convenient storage. These tongs are the perfect complement to any other barbecue tools you'll need when out by your grill.

DGB-475.name: Discontinued Grind & Brew™ 10 Cup Automatic Coffee Maker
DGB-475.description: The Grind & Brew®  Coffeemaker from Cuisinart® automatically grinds the beans to produce a fresh and flavorful pot of coffee. Fully programmable with a sleek, European design, this 10 cup coffeemaker will be right at home in any modern kitchen!

CNTS-288.name: Discontinued Grill-Top Tapas
CNTS-288.description: Tapas provide a fun and diverse way of tasting numerous foods while interacting with friends and family. Using these bowls, enjoy tapas straight from the grill top to the table. Share family style or dish out everyone’s favorite. Every time you are having tapas, you are being given the opportunity to try something new or stick with a classic. Cuisinart’s Grill-Top Tapas are uniquely designed bowls that are great for the grill and even better for serving. Not only does the non-stick coating allow for no mess serving, they also making cleaning up a breeze. It is important to use oven mitts or gloves when removing tapas bowls from the grill. And when it comes to tapas, variety is key so don’t forget to get creative!

CGL-310.name: Discontinued Grilluminate Torch Light

CCB-2717.name: Discontinued Grill Renew Steam Cleaning System
CCB-2717.description: The Cuisinart Grill Renew Steam Cleaning System is the ultimate deep cleaning tool for all of your outdoor cooking equipment. The cleaning system features a 1.5 cup capacity steamer unit that heats up in under 5 minutes with a continuous run time of 10-12 minutes. Also included is a long spray hose, a spray nozzle, and 5 different cleaning attachments designed specifically to help you clean all areas of your grill or smoker. The Grill Renew cleaning head is a non-bristle cleaning alternative for your grill grates, featuring a flexible high-temperature plastic wrapped in a super durable aramid fiber cloth that helps to easily steam away grease and grime. The circular steel wire bristle cleaning head is a traditional grill cleaning solution that is ideal for cast iron grill grates, and interior parts of the grill like heat tents and grease trays. The circular nylon bristle cleaning head is a soft, non-abrasive attachment perfect for cleaning exterior surfaces of your grill that can scratch. The scour pad cleaning attachment is best suited for stainless steel grates and other smooth surfaces. The scour pad also helps remove heat discoloration from stainless steel surfaces. Lastly, the flat-edge scraper is ideal for grills or smokers with glass viewing windows, or for removing cake on food and grease from surfaces inside your grill.

CHDR-225.name: Discontinued Hot Dog Roller

CDST1-S4HG.name: Discontinued Loire Collection

Celebrate meals in style, with Cuisinart®!

LPP.name: Discontinued Little Pro Plus™ Compact 3 Cup Food Processor/Juicer
LPP.description: The Cuisinart® Little Pro Plus™ Compact 3 Cup Food Processor/Juicer is powerful, easy to use, easy to clean, and exceptionally quiet. The "Plus" is a citrus juicer attachment with three juicing cones that squeeze citrus fruits quickly and efficiently.

CTG-17-PC.name: Discontinued Luminous Pizza Cutter
CTG-17-PC.description: The Luminous Collection of kitchen tools features a sleek, ergonomic handle design capped with a touch of gold. The pizza cutter features a durable stainless steel blade to easily slice your favorite pizza.

CTG-17-GP.name: Discontinued Luminous Garlic Press
CTG-17-GP.description: The Luminous Collection of kitchen tools features a sleek, ergonomic handle design capped with a touch of gold. The garlic press is made of durable stainless steel and features a swing basket for easy cleaning.

A28808.name: Discontinued Lunch Tote Cooler
A28808.description: The all-new, lightweight insulated coolers come with many features to ensure your contents stay not only dry, but cold or warm too! Each cooler is thermal insulated and made of a durable shell. Keeping your contents dry is also easy with its water-resistant zipper and waterproof, wipeable liner.

CCH-325.name: Discontinued Magnetic Drink Holder
CCH-325.description: You can now keep your favorite beverage at hand when grilling with the Cuisinart Magnetic Drink Holder. There are no tools required, simply secure to any flat metal surface and it is ready to use. The cup holder measures 3.3 inches in diameter and 3 inches in height and will fit most cans, bottles, and cups. This accessory is not only great for grills, smokers, and griddles, but also riding lawnmowers, metal tables, and more. With the Cuisinart Magnetic Drink Holder, your focus will be on what’s cooking on the grill, and not wonder where you placed your beer!

CF-01-LE45.name: Discontinued Le Havre 45 Piece Set
CF-01-LE45.description: With the introduction of Cuisinart®; Flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. Finishes are artfully blended. Styles range from clean and modern to elaborate and refined. European in flavor yet universal in appeal, the new flatware adds grace and panache to any meal.

CMR-444.name: Discontinued Magnetic Grill Tool Rack
CMR-444.description: Keep your grilling tools close by and out of the way with the Cuisinart® Magnetic Grill Tool Rack. The strong magnetic base fixes to most metals and will hold your grilling tools. This tool rack has four 1.25 inch hooks that are evenly spaced 3 inches apart. Easily place on your grill or smoker without having to drill into the body or have any messy assembly to do. Also great for garage or indoor use! You’ll be happy to have your tools off the side table and yet close by with the Cuisinart® Magnetic Grill Tool Rack.

CDST1-S4Q2.name: Discontinued Madeleine Collection
CDST1-S4Q2.description: Food matters, and so does what it's served on. Introducing Cuisinart® Stoneware Dinnerware, the perfect choice for breakfast, lunch or dinner! Available in a variety of irresistible styles, shapes and colors, Cuisinart® Stoneware is a perfect complement to any meal. Celebrate meals in style, with Cuisinart®!

CGL-2004.name: Discontinued Magnetic LED Smoker and Grill Light
CGL-2004.description: Make nighttime smoking easier and even more fun with the help of the Cuisinart® Magnetic LED Smoker & Grill Light. Be able to see what you are smoking with its super bright LED light that provides hours of light. The bright LED light sits on an extendable arm that will reach every nook and cranny of your smoker, making it easy to check the water level and wood chips. The Magnetic Base and Adjustable Neck allows you to easily move it around on your smoker and makes it easy to store when not in use. Make nighttime smoking easier and even more fun with the help of the Cuisinart® Magnetic LED Smoker & Grill Light.

CMP-300.name: Discontinued Magnetic Paper Towel and Foil Holder
CMP-300.description: Quickly and easily wrap your smoked meats in foil with the Cuisinart Magnetic Paper Towel and Foil Holder! This 2-in-1 designed product features an aluminum foil dispenser with a cutter and a paper towel holder. The strong magnetic back will hold to most metals and stays in place while you tear sheets of foil or paper from it. It features a serrated blade that makes quick and crisp cuts to the aluminum foil, giving you the perfect amount each time. For safety, an integrated blade guard covers the serrated blade when not in use. The compact foil cutter and paper towel holder will mount to the side or front of a smoker or grill, keeping the side tables free for other uses. Having paper towels handy is always a plus when grilling or smoking, a quick and easy way to quickly clean up messes. Great for indoor and outdoor use, the Cuisinart Magnetic Paper Towel and Foil Holder will surely become a favorite accessory for any griller or smoker.

CDP01-S4FL3.name: Discontinued Loiret Collection
CDP01-S4FL3.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers a variety of beautiful patterns, each dish designed and crafted of the ?nest quality porcelain. From colorful geometrics to bold black on white to delicate pastels, Cuisinart® porcelain dinnerware can be classically elegant, totally trendy, and everything in between. Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CFE-01-M20.name: Discontinued Majorie 20 Piece Set
CFE-01-M20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. Made to the renowned quality standards of Cuisinart®, these solid yet comfortable continental size pieces are hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel and finished with the utmost care. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

CSS-33.name: Discontinued Magnetic Grilling Spice Set
CSS-33.description: The Cuisinart® Magnetic Grilling Spice Set is the essential spice set for every barbecue. With a spice grinder, a BBQ seasoning shaker, and a salt & pepper shaker, you’ll have everything you need for the perfect barbecue. Fill each of these containers with your favorite spices and rubs and attach them to any flat metal surface with the magnetic backing on each container. And with the clear chambers, you will be able to see each of your spices and monitor the fullness levels. These containers are large enough for any spices and they close shut to block out moisture. And of course the stainless steel accented containers will look fantastic with any grill.

CTG-00-GLV.name: Discontinued Mandoline Cut Resistant Glove
CTG-00-GLV.description: The Cuisinart® Cut Resistant Glove is a comfortable and easy way to help prevent injuries when cutting or slicing. One Size Fits All. Machine Washable.

CTG-00-WMP.name: Discontinued Marble Mortar and Pestle
CTG-00-WMP.description: Our heavy duty marble mortar and pestle is great for a variety of jobs, From crushing nuts and herbs for rubs to making guacamole, pesto's, and chili paste effortlessly. Our mortar and pestle makes crushing and grinding ingredients easy!

CDP01-S4WL.name: Discontinued Marne Collection
CDP01-S4WL.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers beautiful simplicity, each dish designed and crafted of the finest quality porcelain. Classically elegant and totally trendy, whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CFE-01-MA20.name: Discontinued Maree 20 Piece Set
CFE-01-MA20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

CTG-00-MANG.name: Discontinued Mandoline with Glove
CTG-00-MANG.description: The Cuisinart® Mandoline has 5 cutting options featuring Cuisinart’s Exclusive food processor blade technology. Includes a Fine Julienne, Thick Julienne, Shredding and Straight/Crinkle Cut Blades. Includes food holder with built-in food pusher. Safety cover and built-in blade storage. Includes Cut Resistant Safety Glove.

CWPL-207.name: Discontinued Master Blend BBQ Smoking Pellets
CWPL-207.description: The Master Blend Pellets give your meat an aromatic smoky flavor inspired by the essence of genuine aged liquor barrels and natural wood. The pellets are crafted from aged Brandy barrels, Maple, Cherry, and Hickory wood for a well-balanced sweet and smoky flavor that your guest will love. The Master Blend Pellets will enhance the savory flavors of your meat. Not just for pellet grills, these pellets can also be used with smoker tubes or smoker boxes on gas or charcoal grills. 20 pounds of premium quality wood pellets. Pairs well with all types of protein and vegetables. Make sure to check out Cuisinart's line of seasonings; great to pair with the Cuisinart Pellets. Cuisinart BBQ’s unique pellets are derived from reclaimed oak liquor and wine barrels combined with our premium wood selections. Each blend is a purposeful mixture of flavored barrels matched with the finest quality of harvested woods. Our exceptionally slow-burning blends create distinctive smoky output that permeates your favorite barbeque.

CMC-262.name: Discontinued Meat Pulling/Shredding Claws
CMC-262.description: Every BBQ Master eventually faces the challenge of pulling pork and shredding chicken.  If you've ever done it with forks you know it can be a difficult and time consuming task.  These expertly designed claws make short work of your meat shredding chores.

CMFP-170.name: Discontinued Meat Flipper
CMFP-170.description: The nifty Cuisinart®  Meat Flipper is the ultimate tool that can handle almost every piece of food on your grill. This versatile grilling tool is designed with a comfortable wooden grip and precision sharpened tip that delicately pierces your food for easy turning. Constructed of durable stainless steel, the slim shaft is strong enough to handle heavy foods such as ribs, steaks, and chicken, but delicate enough to turn fish filets and vegetables. Plus, the 18 inch reach allows for full coverage on your grill.

CGS-1004.name: Discontinued Master Grill Set
CGS-1004.description: The Cuisinart®  Master Grill Set features the Chef's Spatula, the Professional Grill Tongs, the Chef's Fork, the Grill Knife, the Silicone Basting Brush and the Master Cleaning Brush. This deluxe set covers the entire grill like no other - with six essential stainless steel tools and a durable storage case providing the perfect place to store your tools after use.

CTG-07-MH.name: Discontinued Masher
CTG-07-MH.description: Prepare smooth mashed potatoes and more with the Cuisinart® Elements Collection Masher! The stainless steel tool features nonslip grips for a firm and comfortable hold, making any food prep task easy.

CFE-20PLUC.name: Discontinued Lucca Collection
CFE-20PLUC.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience. Set includes: 4 Dinner Forks, 4 Dinner Knives, 4 Dinner Spoons, 4 Salad Forks, and 4 Teaspoons.

CTG-00-MAN01.name: Discontinued Mandoline
CTG-00-MAN01.description: Cuisinart® mandolines feature ultra-sharp stainless steel blades made with the same precision technology used to forge our legendary food processor blades. Offering up to 4 different cutting options, precision thickness adjusters, accessory tools that safely store right in the unit, and easy dishwasher cleanup, these mandolines are the go-to food prep tool.

CNMB-444.name: Discontinued Meatball Grilling Basket
CNMB-444.description: The Cuisinart®  Meatball Grilling Basket is a fun accessory that allows you to grill up delicious barbecued meatballs and other tasty treats right on your grill. This clever non-stick basket is easy to use and allows your imagination to run wild with new appetizer ideas for your grill. Try cherry tomatoes, stuffed mushrooms, crab cakes, bacon wrapped scallops, or delicious meatballs basted with tangy barbecue sauce. Just open the basket lid, load up 20 finger foods, slide down the loop lock and start grilling! Turn the basket at any time thanks to the heat resistant rubberized handle for even grilling. Meatballs come out juicy and delicious.

CTG-00-MEZ.name: Discontinued Mezzaluna
CTG-00-MEZ.description: Chopping herbs or slicing through pizza is easy with our Mezzaluna! The comfortable grip gives you control over the curved blade made from stainless steel.

MSS-8.name: Discontinued Mica-Shine Stainless Steel 8 Piece Set
MSS-8.description: This complete premium cookware set is perfect for classic cooking techniques like slow simmers, rolling boils, and reduction of liquids. With a high-shine stainless steel exterior and aluminum encapsulated base for fast and even heating, this set is both stylish and functional. Complete with measurement markings in cups and liters to easily follow any recipe, this cookware is compatible with all stovetops, including induction, and is dishwasher safe for ultimate convenience. Illuminate your kitchen with this brilliant, 8 piece set.

CTG-04-MB.name: Discontinued Melon Baller
CTG-04-MB.description: The Barrel Handle Collection of kitchen tools and gadgets has a professional look and feel. Solid black soft-grip handles with stainless steel are rounded for universal comfort. From stirring a pot to ladling soup to grating cheese or coring an apple, this line of kitchen tools does everything the home chef needs – and more!

7MS2-32.name: Discontinued Mini Dutch Oven Servers (Set of 2)
7MS2-32.description: Cuisinart® introduces stainless steel Dutch Ovens that are perfect for entertaining. These Dutch Ovens can be used as fill and serve dishes. Simply prepare creamy puddings, spiced nuts, fresh salsa and serve them to your guests. Whip up homestyle mac 'n cheese, delicious souffles, savory au gratin potatoes and more!

CMW-55.name: Discontinued Microwave
CMW-55.description:
Cuisinart® makes a microwave for every kitchen. This compact 0.7 cubic foot oven takes up minimal
counter space and offers all the features that make a microwave a must have. Preprogrammed one-touch
controls ensure everything from reheating coffee to defrosting cutlets will be done just right.  Prepare a
meal from scratch, and cook a little healthier – Cuisinart® makes it easy.

DLC-2AM.name: Discontinued Mini-Prep® Plus 24 Ounce Processor
DLC-2AM.description: The Mini-Prep® Plus 24 Ounce Processor is the perfect little helper for small food preparation, from chopping herbs to finely grinding hard cheese. Its versatility lies in the special Auto Reversing Smart Blade™ making the Mini-Prep® versatile, and it is easier to process both soft and hard foods in the 24 ounce work bowl. Designed in Italy, the Mini-Prep® Plus is easy to clean as it is to look at, with a wipe-clean touch pad and dishwasher-safe removable parts.

CMBM-4HRT.name: Discontinued Mini Heart Pans (Set of 4)
CMBM-4HRT.description: Cuisinart® 4pc Mini Metal Heart Pan Set is ideal for today's cooks and makes baking fun for the whole family. The full line is constructed of heavy gauge steel to provide even heat distribution and consistent baking results. The nonstick interior and exterior ensure easy food release and cleanup. The entire line is dishwasher safe. Cuisinart quality promises you a lifetime of great performance, whatever the baking task.

MM-2M.name: Discontinued Mini-Mate Plus® 9 Ounce Chopper/Grinder
MM-2M.description: Our tiny but mighty Mini-Mate Plus® 9 Ounce Chopper/Grinder is a handy timesaver for kitchen prep jobs that don't require a full-sized food processor. The 9 ounce bowl and reversible blade are dishwasher safe, making cleanup easy after you've chopped or ground your ingredients.

DLC-4BCH.name: Discontinued Mini-Prep® Plus 4 Cup Food Processor
DLC-4BCH.description: Finished with elegant brushed metal, the Mini-Prep<sup>®</sup> Plus 4 Cup Food Processor is a fashionable fit for any kitchen. Use the automatic reversing blade to chop or grind your way through any recipe’s prep work for easier homemade meals any day of the week. Handy for everyday food prep tasks.

DLC-1R.name: Discontinued Mini-Prep® 2.6 Cup Food Processor
DLC-1R.description: The Cuisinart® Mini-Prep® Processor is the ideal kitchen assistant for your small food preparation tasks. The compact size fills minimum counter space but still boasts more power than other choppers, chopping and grinding up to 21 ounces at once using 2-speed operation to tackle a range of ingredients.

MP300TY.name: Discontinued Mini Processor
MP300TY.description: Sometimes size doesn’t matter. This mini chopper makes quick work of everyday chopping and grinding jobs. Just add your ingredients! Time to open up the very Tasty™ recipe booklet and send out the invites. Tell everybody to come hungry!

CTG-02-MDG.name: Discontinued Medium Cut Grater
CTG-02-MDG.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Twist Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip handle. The medium cut hand grater features a stainless steel cutting surface, perfect for hard or soft cheeses and vegetables. Dishwasher Safe.

5730M-14TQ.name: Discontinued Mini Square Fry Pan
5730M-14TQ.description: Cuisinart® Mini Non-Stick 14cm Mini Square Fry Pan

CMBM-4TRT.name: Discontinued Mini Tart Pans (Set of 4)
CMBM-4TRT.description: Delight your friends and family with personal sweet or savory personal sized tarts made in the 4” Mini Tart Pans. CGAV-600.name: Discontinued Multi-Head Ash Vacuum

The additional attachments allow for cleaning of multiple surfaces and tight spots. Complete the job before needing to empty! The large canister stores up to 4.8 gallons worth of cold ash, when full the visual HEPA Filter-Fill Indicator will turn red notifying you when the canister needs to be emptied.

CTG-00-MUD.name: Discontinued Muddler
CTG-00-MUD.description: This beautiful stainless steel Muddler from Cuisinart® is the perfect home bartender's assistant, bringing out flavors from herbs and fruits to liven up your cocktails.

CIT-453.name: Discontinued Multi-Purpose BBQ Shears
CIT-453.description: The Cuisinart® Multi-Purpose BBQ Shears are made for multi-purpose use. Featuring a squeeze to open, spring loaded handle. An easy to engage locking mechanism keeps shears closed when in storage.

CSG-499.name: Discontinued Multi-Tool Instant Read Thermometer
CSG-499.description: The Cuisinart® Multi-Tool Instant Read Thermometer is easy to use and offers more than just a meat probe! The quick, easy-to-read thermometer makes grilling your dish to the perfect temp easy and convenient. It features an easy to read display and stainless steel probe that delivers instant readings.

CCB-999.name: Discontinued Multi-Purpose Stainless Steel Griddle Scraper
CCB-999.description: Scrape, Chop, and Serve with the Cuisinart® Multi-Purpose Stainless Steel Griddle Scraper. Use as a second spatula to scoop up food from the griddle surface onto a serving tray. ICE-48.name: Discontinued Mix It In™ Soft Serve Ice Cream Maker by Cuisinart®

MCU19-18N.name: Discontinued MultiClad Unlimited™ 2 Quart Saucepan

ACC1056AF.name: Discontinued Natural Gas Conversion Kit

Grill your way with Cuisinart® Gas Grills! Compatible with Cuisinart® grill models GAS1456AS, GAS9456AF, GAS9556AF.

CNCH-430.name: Discontinued Non-stick corn holder

CDP01-S4FL2.name: Discontinued Noelia Collection

CNP-177.name: Discontinued Non-Stick Nacho Grilling Platter
