62I22-24.description: Cuisinart's Chef's Classic Nonstick Hard Anodized 10" Skillet is ready to take on any cooking challenge!  Heating quickly, the skillet eliminates hot spots and cooks food evenly.

CTG-04-FK.name: Discontinued Nylon Fork
CTG-04-FK.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Barrel Handle Line, this kitchen tool features a sophisticated design with a professional look and feel. The black soft-grip handle with stainless steel is rounded for universal comfort. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 425°F, and are safe on non-stick cookware. Dishwasher Safe.

CTG-04-LDS.name: Discontinued Nylon Straining Ladle
CTG-04-LDS.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Barrel Handle Line, this kitchen tool features a sophisticated design with a professional look and feel. The black soft-grip handle with stainless steel is rounded for universal comfort. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 425°F, and are safe on non-stick cookware. Dishwasher Safe.

MONOARABICABRAZIL.name: Discontinued MONOARABICA™ iperEspresso Brazil
MONOARABICABRAZIL.description: Intense of aroma, yet velvety in feel, rich with the chocolate and all it conjures. A sensory revolution.

CRC-29B.name: Discontinued Octagonal Hanging Rack
CRC-29B.description: Turn your kitchen into a showstopper with the Cuisinart® Octagonal Hanging Rack! The stunning brushed stainless steel is the perfect statement piece to hang above a kitchen island, bringing your Cuisinart® Cookware within arms reach as you cook for minimal fuss during the creative process. With ample space to hang your pans, the Bar Wall Rack is a practical and beautiful way to organize your kitchen.

CTG-22-LST.name: Discontinued Oceanware Slotted Spoon
CTG-22-LST.description: The Oceanware Collection is making waves as the new eco-friendly kitchen tool line. Crafted from recycled fishnets pulled from the ocean, the handles capture the essence of the seashore with deep blue and aqua tones. These durable, eco-friendly tools have nylon heads that resist heat up to 420 ̊F.  Safe to use on non-stick cookware, they go in the dishwasher for easy cleaning.

CTK-EOS1R.name: Discontinued Omni™ 2 Quart Enamel Teakettle
CTK-EOS1R.description: The Omni™ 2 Quart Enamel Teakettle adds a touch of whimsy to your kitchen, bringing joy to the simple task of boiling water. Made of enameled stainless steel for superior heat retention, this kettle from Cuisinart also features a whistle lets you know when the water has reached boiling point.

CTG-04-WT.name: Discontinued Nylon Wide Turner
CTG-04-WT.description: The Barrel Handle Collection of kitchen tools and gadgets has a professional look and feel. Solid black soft-grip handles with stainless steel are rounded for universal comfort. From stirring a pot to ladling soup to grating cheese or coring an apple, this line of kitchen tools does everything the home chef needs – and more!

COP-141.name: Discontinued OmniPanel Versatile Grilling Surface
COP-141.description: Spice up your barbecue with the Cuisinart®  OmniPanel Versatile Grilling Surface, designed to handle anything you want to grill. This versatile set includes a large divided stainless steel platter for grilling seafood, large fish filets, and vegetables. But don't stop there! Feel like bruschetta or pizza? Use the OmniPanel's pizza stone right on the grill and impress friends and family with crispy grilled pizza. Or, add a smoky twist to a salmon filet by using the cedar grilling plank to infuse your fish with complex flavor. With the Cuisinart®  OmniPanel, your grilling possibilities are endless.

OT1500GF.name: Discontinued One Top Induction & Sous Vide Cooker
OT1500GF.description: The One Top was engineered to be the most versatile appliance in your kitchen

CEG-980.name: Discontinued Outdoor Electric Grill with VersaStand
CEG-980.description: Cuisinart's Outdoor VersaStand Portable Electric Grill integrated adjustable telescoping base provides authentic grilling performance and flavor. It's small format fits easily on balconies and small patios - great for places that propane or charcoal grills aren't allowed. And although the grill is compact, its ample cooking grate is large enough to cook most family meals - 8 steaks, 8 hamburgers, 6 - 10 chicken breasts, or over 4 lbs. of fish! The grill heats up very quickly, and reaches temperatures high enough to sear a steak to perfection. Storage is quick and easy as well with the novel telescoping base that quickly transforms from storage to tabletop  to floor standing use. It folds up in seconds, and is integrated into the grill for added convenience. The grill plugs into a standard household electrical receptacle, and is UL approved for outdoor use.

SMK2036AS.name: Discontinued Oakmont Pellet Grill
SMK2036AS.description: The NEW Cuisinart Oakmont Pellet Grill provides the very best cooking versatility. Grill, Smoke, BBQ, Roast, Sear, Bake, Broil and Braise all on The Cuisinart Oakmont Pellet Grill. Make your cooking experience easy with the Bluetooth readouts on the LCD controller and the Cuisinart Easy Connect BBQ app. Lock in the flavor you dream of on the pellet grill with the insulated lid designed with a gasket seal that prevents smoke from escaping. We took the hassle out of cleaning with the express clean-out system that removes ash as easy as one-two-three. Whether you are smoking a brisket, grilling up some burgers, or griddling your favorite recipes the Oakmont Pellet Grill does it all.

CEG-980T.name: Discontinued Outdoor Electric Tabletop Grill
CEG-980T.description: The Cuisinart® Outdoor Tabletop Portable Electric Grill provides authentic grilling performance and flavor.  Its small format fits easily on balconies and small patios - great for places that propane or charcoal grills aren't allowed.  And although the grill is compact, its ample cooking grate is large enough to cook most family meals - 8 steaks, 8 hamburgers, 6 - 10 chicken breasts, or over 4 lbs. of fish!  The grill heats up very quickly, and reaches temperatures high enough to sear a steak to perfection.   Storage is a snap -  with its folding legs it stows almost anywhere.  The grill plugs into a standard household electrical receptacle, and is UL approved for outdoor use.

ASR-1713HPS.name: Discontinued Ovenware Nonstick Roasting (Set of 8)
ASR-1713HPS.description: The Cuisinart® 8 piece Ovenware Nonstick Roasting Set is ideal for turkey dinners or large roasts, providing the perfect solution for everyday family meals, parties and holiday celebrations. The set has wide-grip handles for safe and easy lifting, which bodes well for transporting food from the kitchen to the table. It includes a 17" x 13" roaster with rack; a carving knife and fork; whisk; silicone basting brush; meat thermometer; and a 13½" cutting board – everything consumers need to easily prepare a flavorful, generously sized roast.

DFP-7BC.name: Discontinued Original 7 Cup Food Processor
DFP-7BC.description: The Cuisinart® Original 7 Cup Food Processor in Brushed Metal is a classic! Its 7 cup capacity and versatile assortment of blades and discs make food prep tasks a snap. The Extra Large Feed Tube and Pusher and Sleeve Assembly handle whole fruits and vegetables with ease.

C77PW-8PB.name: Discontinued Pakka Wood 8 Piece Cutlery Block Set
C77PW-8PB.description: Made of beautiful Pakka Wood, the Cuisinart® 8 Piece Cutlery Set with Block is an elegant solution to your prep work. Cuisinart® adds innovative lines, looks, and textures to its expanding collection ofcutlery block sets. New blade surfaces, unique textured handles, and a selectionof both knife styles and block styles let consumers choose superior cuttingtools that fit their kitchen décor as well as their personal cooking styles.

CSG-603.name: Discontinued Outdoor Grilling Steak Thermometers (Set of 4)
CSG-603.description: Grill your steaks to perfection with Cuisinart® Outdoor Steak Thermometers.  These simple gauges help you cook your steaks with gourmet-like precision - always to the desired cooking level and never undercooked.  Simply insert the reusable stainless steel thermometer into your steak to get a fast, accurate read of the current cooking level - Rare, Medium or Well Done.  When finished grilling, simply drop the gauges in your dishwasher for safe and convenient cleaning and sterilizing.  Set includes 4 thermometers.

CBO-1000.name: Discontinued Oven Central™
CBO-1000.description: Now you can cook and bake in one compact countertop appliance! The Cuisinart®  Oven Central®  lets you roast meats, sauté vegetables, griddle pancakes and toast bagels. Other functions allow you to steam, stir-fry, bake cupcakes or a favorite pasta dish. With faster heat-up, and temperatures from Warm to 450°, this all-in-one oven is a mini powerhouse!

GR-1.name: Discontinued Panini & Sandwich Press
GR-1.description: The Cuisinart® Griddler™ Panini & Sandwich Press makes everything from popular panini to great grilled cheese. Designed like professional units, our floating hinge adjusts to sandwich thickness to perfectly grill thin or thick panini and sandwiches. A preset temperature ensures restaurant-quality results -- always crisp and golden brown.

CDP01-S4OP.name: Discontinued Pannes Collection
CDP01-S4OP.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers a variety of beautiful patterns, each dish designed and crafted of the ?nest quality porcelain. From colorful geometrics to bold black on white to delicate pastels, Cuisinart® porcelain dinnerware can be classically elegant, totally trendy, and everything in between. Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CTG-06-PS.name: Discontinued Pasta Server
CTG-06-PS.description: Add a modern touch to the kitchen with Cuisinart’s bold new, super-functional tools and gadgets. The handle has bright color accents to match the head, and the practicality is hard to beat. Happy cooking!

CFE-01-PF20.name: Discontinued Parisian Feast 20 Piece Set
CFE-01-PF20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. Made to the renowned quality standards of Cuisinart®, these solid yet comfortable continental size pieces are hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel and finished with the utmost care. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

CTG-02-OK.name: Discontinued Oyster Knife
CTG-02-OK.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Twist Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip handle. The oyster knife features a stainless steel blade. Dishwasher Safe.

CPM-800.name: Discontinued PartyPop™ Popcorn Maker
CPM-800.description: Cuisinart® makes fresh, crunchy, homemade popcorn fast, easy...and healthy! The Cuisinart®®  PartyPop®  Popcorn Maker pops up to 10 cups of popcorn in under 5 minutes, and lets popcorn lovers decide just how much, and what kind, of popcorn, oil and flavorings to use. Popcorn pops right into a clear plastic bowl that flips to serve, and both bowl and popping plate go into the dishwasher. America's favorite snack has never been easier!

CDST-16MCPF.name: Discontinued Parisian Feast Collection
CDST-16MCPF.description: Food matters, and so does what it’s served on. The Parisian Feast Collection is a 16 piece set, combining classic creamy plates and bowls with complementary salad plates and mugs in traditional Parisian colors.

COH-100.name: Discontinued Patio Fire Pit Table
COH-100.description: Gather your friends and family around the Cuisinart Fire Pit Table, this stylish fire pit will create an intimate atmosphere in your outdoor living space. This fire pit uses propane gas to support clean burning with a smokeless experience. The 20lb propane tank, not included, stores conveniently inside the table, hiding it from plain sight. The heat output is 40,000 BTU's providing ample warmth for those chilly nights. The body of the fire pit is made with very modern woodgrain metal panels that give the look of actual wood, while providing a durable heat resistant base to the table. While not in use, an integrated cover slides over the fire pit and transforms it into a multi-use coffee table. Relax while watching the flames on the Cuisinart Fire Pit Table dance in the dark, creating an escape from your own backyard.

DCC-2900.name: Discontinued PerfecTemp® 12 Cup Thermal Coffee Maker
DCC-2900.description: The stylish Cuisinart PerfecTemp® 12 Cup Thermal Coffeemaker boasts advanced coffee-making technology that delivers hotter coffee without sacrificing rich flavor and quality during the brewing process. Ideal for coffee lovers who prefer hotter java, the PerfecTemp® 12 Cup Thermal Coffeemaker has a streamlined control panel, brew strength control, and oversized digital display for easy use. The styling is sleek, with elegant angles and a new high-tech look for serious coffee lovers.

CTK-SS2.name: Discontinued Peak™ 2 Quart Teakettle
CTK-SS2.description: The Peak™ 2 Quart Teakettle from Cuisinart combines classic stainless steel style with superior heat retention for faster boiling. Use the teakettle to make up to two quarts of hot water for beverages or cooking, listening out for the whistle which lets you know when the water is boiling.

DCC-2850.name: Discontinued Perfect Brew 12 Cup Coffee Maker Black

CCB-212.name: Discontinued Perfect Pressure Grill Brush
CCB-212.description: Cleaning your grill is a necessity of every grill owner. It is also the least enjoyable part of the grilling process. The Perfect Pressure Grill Brush offers a new take on traditional grill brushes. The unique design of this grill brush creates better grip and allows extra pressure to be applied to a dirty grate without any extra effort. You will be able to clean off more grease and food residue with each motion while easily being able to get to those hard to reach places. Unlike the average grill brush, this brush comes with a replacement brush head. This will extend the life of your brush and keep the grill cleaner longer. Take a more advanced approach to cleaning your grill and enjoy the results.

CTG-04-S3P.name: Discontinued Peelers (Set of 3)
CTG-04-S3P.description: The Cuisinart® Barrel Handle Collection of kitchen tools and gadgets has a professional look and feel. Solid black, soft-grip handles with stainless steel are rounded for universal comfort. From stirring a pot to ladling soup to grating cheese or coring an apple, this line of kitchen tools does everything the home chef needs -- and more!

DCC-2800.name: Discontinued PerfecTemp® 14 Cup Coffee Maker
DCC-2800.description: The Cuisinart PerfecTemp® 14 Cup Glass Coffeemaker provides hotter coffee without sacrificing flavor thanks to our unique brewing technology. Use the strength options to brew your favorite coffee just how you like it, every time. Scheduling the brew cycle to start at any time using the 24-hour programmability is easy thanks to the extra large LCD display and user-friendly control panel. The sleek PerfecTemp® 14 Cup Glass Coffeemaker also features our Brew Pause™ technology, letting you enjoy that first cup while the rest finishes brewing.

KML-10.name: Discontinued PerfectWeight™ Digital Kitchen Scale
KML-10.description: The efficient PerfectWeight™ Digital Kitchen Scale makes measuring ingredients easy and accurate, with a digital screen for quick simple reading. Accurate ingredients means baking with greater consistency, making your recipes impress every time. The tempered glass and sleek design of the PerfectWeight™ looks chic on any countertop.

PTK-330R.name: Discontinued PerfecTemp® Teakettle
PTK-330R.description: Enjoy your favorite teas like never before with the PerfecTemp® Teakettle from Cuisinart! Tea is at its best when brewed at the right temperature for its type, which is why our PerfecTemp® has a precise temperature gauge to provide up to three quarts of the exact water temperature for your tea variety. The premium porcelain enamel boasts an iron core to heat up quickly and retain heat to brew your perfect cup of tea with optimum flavor and healthful benefits! Packed with vitamins, antioxidants, and minerals, the cup of tea you love is good for you!

TEA-100.name: Discontinued PerfecTemp® Programmable Tea Steeper & Kettle
TEA-100.description: Treat yourself to precision brewed teas with the Cuisinart® PerfectTemp® Programmable Tea Steeper & Kettle. Featuring six preset water temperatures, this teakettle quickly heats the water to the right temperature for your tea and then boasts a countdown time so that your tealeaves will steep for the perfect length of time. The stainless steel tea infuser can also be removed to quickly heat up to 1.2 liters of water in the kettle. Steeps both loose and bagged tea in beautiful glass so that you can see the flavors develop.

CFE-20PPR.name: Discontinued Piper Collection
CFE-20PPR.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience. Set includes: 4 Dinner Forks, 4 Dinner Knives, 4 Dinner Spoons, 4 Salad Forks, and 4 Teaspoons.

CTG-00-PS.name: Discontinued Pineapple Slicer
CTG-00-PS.description: With superior Cuisinart® cutting technology, the Cuisinart® Pineapple Slicer turns a pineapple into a stack of juicy rings in seconds. A simple twisting motion is all it takes to core and slice. The fruit comes out clean, with no eyes or bits of peel attached, and leaves the core and empty shell behind. Made of heavy-duty stainless steel, with a nonslip grip handle, the Cuisinart® Pineapple Slicer turns the chore of slicing pineapple into a simple pleasure.

CFE-20PPIS.name: Discontinued Pisa Collection
CFE-20PPIS.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience. Set includes: 4 Dinner Forks, 4 Dinner Knives, 4 Dinner Spoons, 4 Salad Forks, and 4 Teaspoons.

CTG-02-PI.name: Discontinued Pie/Cake Server
CTG-02-PI.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Twist Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip handle. The pie server features a stainless steel head. Dishwasher Safe.

CPS-006.name: Discontinued Pizza Wheel Cutter
CPS-006.description: Replace your old pizza cutter with the sharp and stylish Cuisinart Pizza Cutter Wheel! The 4” cutting blade easily slices through pizzas, while the soft, textured rubber grip fits comfortably in the palm of your hand. The cutter features a rotating blade guard that keeps the blade contained when put away for storage and protects the blade from scratches. For easy clean up, the handle, blade and blade guard all come apart and are top-rack dishwasher safe, making sure no food bits are stuck and left behind.

CTG-06-PC.name: Discontinued Pizza Cutter
CTG-06-PC.description: Add a modern touch to the kitchen with Cuisinart’s bold new, super-functional tools and gadgets. The handle has bright color accents to match the head, and the practicality is hard to beat. Happy cooking!

CNPS-417.name: Discontinued Pizza Grilling Pan
CNPS-417.description: Now you can create delicious pizzas on your grill with the Cuisinart® Pizza Grilling Pan. This unique piece of non-stick outdoor cookware is designed with perforations that help to infuse your pizza with the natural flavors of your barbecue.  The 12" diameter is perfect for a family or kids and conveniently fits most grills.  The heat resistant folding handle is also removable - so storage is easy and your grill lid can fully close when cooking.

CCB-399.name: Discontinued Pizza Stone Cleaning Brush
CCB-399.description: Clean debris from your pizza stone safely and effectively with the Cuisinart® Pizza Stone Cleaning Brush. Once you're done making pizzas, simply brush the pizza stone gently with your brush and you will be good to go. The palm stalk fibers of the cleaning brush work perfectly for the surface of the cordierite pizza stone. The edge also features a steel scraper to help break up baked on mess.  This is the best tool for safely and effectively cleaning your pizza stone and getting it ready for future use.

CTG-04-PIE.name: Discontinued Pie Server
CTG-04-PIE.description: The Barrel Handle Collection of kitchen tools and gadgets has a professional look and feel. Solid black soft-grip handles with stainless steel are rounded for universal comfort. From stirring a pot to ladling soup to grating cheese or coring an apple, this line of kitchen tools does everything the home chef needs – and more!

WM-PZ2.name: Discontinued Pizzelle Press
WM-PZ2.description: Cuisinart® engineering has simplified the art of baking the perfect pizzelle, crafting two thin, crisp 4-inch cookies at once with the Cuisinart® Pizzelle Press! Dual indicator lights take the guesswork out of timing and can bake to 5 browning levels. Nonstick plates let you easily remove warm pizzelle without breaking, so they can be rolled into delicious Italian cannoli or cones. Simply wipe the plates clean with a damp cloth and store upright after use.

CCB3001SER.name: Discontinued Poly with Santoprene Cutting Board
CCB3001SER.description: 11x14inch Poly w/Santoprene Cutting Board Non-absorbent Santropene step handles for added protection and comfort Will not dull knives Dishwasher safe

CGG-200.name: Discontinued Portable Outdoor Tabletop Propane Gas Grill
CGG-200.description: The Cuisinart® All Foods Gas Grill is a versatile cooking system that expertly grills fine foods. Solid grilling performance provided from a 12,000 BTU stainless steel loop burner, a heat distributing panel, and a pre-seasoned cast iron cooking grate. The grill is compact in size, making it ideal for smaller yards and patios.  Despite its small size, it is more than large enough to regularly cook meals for your whole family.  And for grilling on the go, features such as folding stainless steel side shelves and two large carry handles, it is convenient to carry to the game or beach. Features include a precision temperature gauge, the Cuisinart® Twist Ignition system, and a removable drip tray.  Comes equipped to use 16oz. or 14.1oz portable LP gas bottles.

HM-50M.name: Discontinued Power Advantage® 5 Speed Hand Mixer
HM-50M.description: The Cuisinart® Power Advantage® 5 Speed Hand Mixer easily mixes even the heaviest ingredients with ease. Switch from dense cookie dough to whipped cream with just one touch thanks to the slide control. This powerful motor with automatic feedback can perform any mixing task your recipes require.

HM-6.name: Discontinued Power Advantage® 6-Speed Hand Mixer
HM-6.description: Cuisinart® picks up the power with this 6-speed hand mixer. 250 watts easily powers through batters and dough, and six speeds win it high marks for versatility. Users can slowly fold dry ingredients into wet without splatters, then turn up the speed to whip up meringues and cream. When the job is done, the extra-long beaters get ejected with the push of a lever and go right into the dishwasher for easy cleanup. With its soft handle and unique center cord, this mixer is a pleasure to work with, start to finish!

HM-70MR.name: Discontinued Power Advantage® 7 Speed Hand Mixer
HM-70MR.description: Flawlessly mix even the densest ingredients with the Cuisinart® Power Advantage® 7 Speed Hand Mixer. Make fast work of any cookie dough or meringue with its powerful motor featuring automatic feedback delivering just the right amount of power for your cooking task. Boasting a precision touchpad with digital display, you can shifts speeds with just one touch to tackle whipping cream perfectly!

CPR-154.name: Discontinued Potato Grilling Rack
CPR-154.description: Enjoy up to four large delicious baked potatoes right on the grill with the Cuisinart®  Potato Grilling Rack. Simply load up your potatoes on the stainless steel spike, season, and close your grill. The spikes hold the potatoes in place and help from the inside. By the time your steaks are done, you will have tasty potatoes infused with the smoky flavor of the grill.

HSM-70.name: Discontinued Power Advantage™ Hand/Stand Mixer
HSM-70.description: Mixing power and versatility, the Cuisinart® Power Advantage™ Hand/Stand Mixer features a mountable 7-speed hand mixer and 3.5-qt. stainless bowl. The hand mixer is easy to control and operate and dramatically improves any kitchen’s capabilities when mounted on the sturdy mixing stand. The beaters make the bowl spin to ensure all ingredients are evenly incorporated. By hand or on the stand, it’s the perfect mix!

BFP-10CH.name: Discontinued PowerBlend Duet™ Blender/Food Processor
BFP-10CH.description: Cuisinart's powerful new 7-speed blender also has a genuine Cuisinart®  food processor. A heavy-duty 600-watt motor pulses, stirs, mixes, purées, chops and even crushes ice in record time. In food processor mode, users can slice, shred or process ingredients right into a 3 cup work bowl. It's big, it's powerful, and it's easy -- removable parts are dishwasher-safe!

CPK-17.name: Discontinued PerfecTemp® Cordless Electric Kettle
CPK-17.description: Protect your tea from over brewing with the PerfecTemp® Cordless Electric Kettle and its six preset temperatures optimized for every variety of tea. The 1500-watt cordless kettle quickly brings water to the exact heat and keep it at temperature for 30 minutes, so you don’t have to wait for your second cup! And for those who enjoy coffee, this Cuisinart teakettle also features a French Press preset to bring out the full flavors of your coffee grinds every time.

DLC-2014.name: Discontinued PowerPrep Plus® 14 Cup Food Processor
DLC-2014.description:
Throughout the years, the food processor has become the most popular cooking appliance among gourmets everywhere. Cuisinart® is synonymous with superior quality and innovation that gourmets have come to expect from their favorite kitchen tool.
With the 14 Cup PowerPrep Plus® 14 Cup Food Processor, Cuisinart® introduces a revolutionary new model. It boasts a new motor with an alternate speed for perfect dough mixing, and a rounded housing for easy cleaning and handling, along with new safety features built in to its bowl and cover.

CBT-700.name: Discontinued PowerEdge™ 700 Blender
CBT-700.description: Make your own smoothies and great drinks or create gourmet soups and sauces with the Cuisinart®  PowerEdge®  700 Blender! The ideal combination of power and performance, it features our new Power6 Turbo-Edge blade design to crush ice, puree, and mix with maximum efficiency. A great smoothie is just 30 seconds away with the pre-programmed Smoothie function or use the built-in Count-Up®  Timer. The easy-pour 56-oz. blender jar and lid are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.

CHM-5.name: Discontinued PowerSelect™ 5 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
CHM-5.description: The Cuisinart®  PowerSelect®  5 Speed Hand Mixer offers 220 watts of power and enough speed settings to mix just about anything that needs mixing. An easy one-touch slide switch smoothly changes speeds for precision control, and Automatic Feedback kicks in more power whenever it's needed. A swivel cord, comfortable handle and beaters that eject at the touch of a button make this Cuisinart®  Mixer a pleasure to use.

CHM-7.name: Discontinued PowerSelect™ 7 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
CHM-7.description: Cuisinart® combines power, speed, and convenience in this versatile 220-watt hand mixer. One-touch convenience delivers 7 speed options, digitally displayed right on the handle where they're easy to see. A SmoothStart® feature, with 3 extra-low speed settings, eliminates splattering and keeps mixer and countertops clean. With Automatic Feedback to kick in more power when needed, this is a mixer that won't let you down!

CBT-1000.name: Discontinued PowerEdge™ 1000 Watt Blender
CBT-1000.description: The Cuisinart®  PowerEdge®  1000-Watt Blender is constructed with a heavy die-cast metal base and a lightweight, 64-ounce Bisphenol A (BPA) free Tritan®  copolyester blender jar from Eastman. Ideal for today's gourmet kitchen, it is the perfect combination of high style and high tech! We have added pre-programmed Smoothie, Ice Crush and Pulse functions to blend smoothies, frozen drinks or crush ice flawlessly.

SM-35R.name: Discontinued Precision Master™ 3.5-Quart Stand Mixer
SM-35R.description: Cuisinart® continues to change the way the world mixes! Just the right size for most mixing tasks, with 12 speeds for superior control, all the accessories needed for virtually any mixing task, and optional attachments for purchase to do even more!

DLC-XP.name: Discontinued Plus™ 20 Cup Food Processor
DLC-XP.description: Designed for professional chefs, the Cuisinart® Plus™ 20 Cup Food Processor provides unmatched performance and durability. The extra large 20 cup work bowl is perfect for catering and restaurant use. The powerful motor can knead dough with ease, shred cheese, and chop without burning out over tough whole root vegetables. UL listed for household and commercial use, the Plus™ 20 Cup unites the ease of home cooking with professional power for the ultimate food processor.

SA-110A.name: Discontinued Precision Electronic Scale
SA-110A.description: The Cuisinart®  Precision Electronic Scale is an attractive and functional kitchen tool -- compact, lightweight and easy to use.

SA-100MWH.name: Discontinued Precision Gourmet Scale
SA-100MWH.description: The Cuisinart®  Precision Gourmet Scale adds a look of elegance to an indispensable kitchen tool.

SA-105.name: Discontinued Precision Portion Scale
SA-105.description: Small size, light weight, high accuracy, easy readability -- this scale is a time saver, as well as the best way of ensuring delicious results every time.

CHM-3.name: Discontinued PowerSelect® 3 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
CHM-3.description: The Cuisinart® PowerSelect® 3 Speed Hand Mixer offers enough speed settings to mix anything you need with a one-touch slide switch to smoothly change speeds for precision control. Automatic feedback kicks in more power whenever it's needed. A swivel cord for right or left handed use, comfort grip handle, and beaters that eject at the touch of a button make this Cuisinart® Mixer a pleasure.

SM-50CRM.name: Discontinued Precision Master 5.5-Quart Stand Mixer
SM-50CRM.description: Delivering power, precision and performance, our stand mixer features a 500-watt motor, die-cast metal construction, and 12 speeds that allow for nuance and excellence in performing a variety of preparation tasks. The unit's tilt-back head allows for easy access to its 5.5-quart mixing bowl, while the included splash guard prevents messy countertops. Also included are a chef's whisk, dough hook, and flat mixing paddle. The mixing bowl and all accessories are dishwasher safe. Additionally, you can purchase a variety of attachments for the unit: a pasta roller and cutter, pasta extruder, meat grinder, frozen dessert maker, and spiralizer.

SPB-10.name: Discontinued PowerBlend 600™ Blender
SPB-10.description: Cuisinart® boosts both power and capacity to take blending to the next level. Our new line of high-performance blenders includes this 7-speed deluxe model that can handle any task that comes along. A powerful 600-watt motor mixes up 56 ounces of spectacular fruit smoothies in record time. Preprogrammed speed controls are lined up alongside an oversized on/off switch to let users Pulse, Stir, Mix, Purée, Chop, Liquefy or Crush Ice with the touch of a button. Customers love this big blender because when the job is done, the jar and lid go right into the dishwasher!

SMD-50CRM.name: Discontinued Precision Pro 5.5-Quart Digital Stand Mixer
SMD-50CRM.description: Introducing the digital stand mixer with the perfect blend of power, precision, and speed! Equipped with a high-performance 500-watt motor, the Cuisinart® Precision Pro Digital Stand Mixer powers through even the heaviest mixing jobs in a 5.5-quart large capacity bowl. A turn of the digital LED dial is all it takes to select from 12 speed options, including 3 preprogrammed food prep settings and 7 recipe tasks to be performed in each food prep setting. Premium attachments include chef's whisk, flat mixing paddle, dough hook, and splash guard with pour spout for maximum versatility with minimal mess. Die-cast housing provides superior durability, and commercial mixing for today's kitchen ensures precise, thorough mixing. Leave it to Cuisinart® to combine digital convenience with powerful performance in the must-have stand mixer for today's home chef.

CTG-00-PMAN.name: Discontinued PrecisionSlice™ Upright Mandoline
CTG-00-PMAN.description: The Cuisinart PrecisionSlice™ Upright Mandoline combines ease and versatility with an upright design that ensures hands are kept away from the blades. Equipped with Cuisinart’s exclusive food processor blade technology, this innovative kitchen essential transforms fruits and vegetables into perfectly uniform slices, dices and thin and thick julienne strips. Adjust the sliders to change between cutting options and simply turn the control knob for 40 adjustable thickness options, from 1 mm to 8 mm. The extra-wide feed tube easily accommodates larger cuts of food to minimize trimming, and the slanted, gravity-fed design ensures smooth, effortless slicing. Compact and foldable, with a custom attachable collection container and cleaning brush, this mandoline set is constructed for convenient self-storage.

DLC-2011.name: Discontinued Prep 11 Plus™ 11 Cup Food Processor
DLC-2011.description: The Cuisinart® Prep 11 Plus™ 11 Cup Food Processor boasts a revolutionary motor with alternate speeds for perfect mixing, and features Cuisinart®'s patent-pending Dough Control technology, which adjusts the speed to automatically ensure proper dough consistency. The Prep 11 Plus™ includes a rounded housing for easier cleaning and handling, new safety features, and the Supreme™ Wide Mouth Feed Tube. Plus, it's backed by a ten-year warranty, the longest in the industry!

CTG-00-RD.name: Discontinued Prep Express® Plus
CTG-00-RD.description: Create healthy rice alternatives with this handy all-in-one prep tool.  Featuring Cuisinart's exclusive food processor blade technology and 7 1/2 cup work bowl, the PrepExpress® Plus is perfect for chopping cauliflower, broccoli, beets, potatoes and more!

DLC-2009CH.name: Discontinued Prep 9™ 9 Cup Food Processor
DLC-2009CH.description: Food preparation is fast and easy with the Prep 9™ 9 Cup Food Processor. The compact build fits any countertop while the large work bowl makes it easy to create an entire meal for your family and friends from scratch - shredding, slicing, and chopping ingredients with the push of a button. The Cuisinart® 9 Cup Food Processor is the ideal prep tool for any task and the beautiful brushed stainless steel finish compliments any kitchen. All removable parts are dishwasher safe, making cleanup a breeze!

HFP-300.name: Discontinued PrepExpress™ Handheld Food Processor
HFP-300.description: Cuisinart® adds to its signature food processor line the Handheld Food Processor. A comfortable handle allows users to pick it up to grate, slice or shred ingredients directly into a bowl or pan. Stainless steel accents make it an elegant addition to Cuisinart®'s food prep collection.

SS-10.name: Discontinued Premium Single Serve Brewer
SS-10.description: The 72 oz. capacity Cuisinart® Premium Single-Serve Brewer is a fully programmable and versatile home-brewing unit that is ideal for both personal use and entertaining, making it perfect for any household. Compatible with any brand of single cup pod including Keurig K-Cup pods and equipped with the HomeBarista™ Reusable Filter Cup, this coffeemaker makes it easier than ever for consumers to enjoy a wide array of hot beverages. The unit has five different cup-size settings (ranging from 4 ounces to 12 ounces), and an adjustable brewing temperature to ensure desired temperatures are reached. In addition to coffee, a hot water button can be used to prepare soup, tea, hot cocoa, and more, and the unit is equipped with a rinse function for easy cleaning.

BA-1115.name: Discontinued Prep Board™ Cutting Surfaces (Set of 3)
BA-1115.description: Ideal for preparing ingredients or serving snacks, this set of three Cuisinart® Prep Board™ Cutting Surfaces is a practical and stylish addition to any kitchen. Made from hygienic polypropylene, the each Prep Board™ will not absorb odor or bacteria, dull knives, or chip, peel, or crack. Each dishwasher safe Prep Board™ is oven safe up to 180°F and a convenient microwavable tray.

CTG-00-FFC.name: Discontinued PrepExpress French Fry Cutter
CTG-00-FFC.description: Cutting-edge fries! Make slicing potatoes, carrots, zucchini, eggplant and more, fast, fun, and easy. Two durable, stainless steel grid blades cut both regular and steak fries. The handy food pusher keeps fingers safe as you press food down. No part of the vegetable goes to waste! With setup and clean up so fast and simple, prepping the perfect fries has never been easier!

DLC-2007.name: Discontinued Prep 7® 7 Cup Food Processor
DLC-2007.description: The right choice for everyday food prep. Big enough to process plenty of ingredients, and sized for exceptionally easy handling. With trademark features like the wide, one piece feed tube and accessories for virtually any processing task, this Cuisinart® mid-size food processor is ready for everyday in every kitchen.

CGP-202.name: Discontinued Preseasoned Cast Iron Grilling Platter Set
CGP-202.description: Bring out that flame-grilled flavor everyone loves with the Cuisinart®  Preseasoned Cast Iron Grilling Platter. Not only do the innovative flavor slots remove excess fats and grease for healthier meals, they also enhance the natural taste of your foods as they grill over open flame. The cast iron platter is preseasoned for a natural nonstick surface that is easy to clean and also creates incredible heat dispersion to cook everything evenly. The platter nestles into the wooden serving tray so that you can impress your guests and serve your sizzling hot food right to the table.

CGP-201.name: Discontinued Preseasoned Cast Iron Grilling Platter
CGP-201.description: Enhance the mouth-watering flame-grilled flavor of your food with the Cuisinart®  Preseasoned Cast Iron Grilling Platter. The unique flavor slots maximize the grilled flavor while making meals healthier by draining away excess fat and grease. The large grilling surface is ideal for delicate fish, vegetables, and seafood. Heat is evenly dispersed throughout the preseasoned cast iron platter, which is naturally nonstick for optimized grilling and easy cleaning. The wooden tray holds the platter fresh from the fire for impressive tabletop serving.

CGPR-222.name: Discontinued Press and Stuff Cast Iron Burger Press
CGPR-222.description: Get ready to experience burgers like you never have before with the Cuisinart® Press and Stuff Cast Iron Burger Press! This uniquely shaped press helps bring out the natural flavors of your burgers and allows you to create 1/2 lb. stuffed burgers or low-carb burger bowls. Use the press to form an indent in the center of your burger patty. This allows the juices from the patty to stay in the meat longer during the cooking process giving you a juicy and more flavorful burger. Typical burgers puff up and lose juices as they cook, resulting in a dryer burger. Once you've made the indent, fill up your burger with your favorite toppings and get to cooking. As more and more people shift toward healthier eating options, this burger press is perfect for creating burger bowls that don't require a bun, giving you a low-carb and guilt free option. Rethink the way you do burgers with the Cuisinart® Press and Stuff Cast Iron Burger Press!

CCB-450.name: Discontinued Professional Brisk Grill Brush
CCB-450.description: The Cuisinart® Brisk Brush Prodessional cleans grills cold and cleans grills fast.  It features nylon bristles designed to use once your grill has cooled.  They will go to task cleaning up grill grime and are safe to use on all types of grill grates.  The bristles are firmly rooted in the brush, but sometimes during normal grilling bristles can dislodge.  In the event that occurs, our red bristles are easy to spot for added safety.

DLC-10C.name: Discontinued Pro Classic™ 7 Cup Food Processor
DLC-10C.description: The Cuisinart® Pro Classic™ 7 Cup Food Processor makes all your favorites, from stir-fries and main course salads, to peanut butter and home-made bread or pizza. The Pro Classic™ boasts an extra-large feed tube to handle whole fruits and vegetables, a slicing disc, a shredding disc, and a chopping/mixing blade to tackle all your prep work with ease.

CWC-1800DZTS.name: Discontinued Private Reserve® Dual Zone Wine Cellar
CWC-1800DZTS.description: Keep your wine tasting its best with 2-zone temperature control that ensures both reds and whites are stored under optimal conditions. Engineered with compression-free technology, the Cuisinart Private Reserve® Dual Zone Wine Cellar maintains ideal temperatures with less noise and energy consumption. Touchscreen controls right on the door make it easy to select preferred temperatures from 39°F to 68°F. The slim line design fits in narrow spaces while storing up to 18 bottles of wine and champagne. Crafted with stainless steel exterior trim and sturdy racks with natural wood and chrome accents, this sleek, modern wine cellar is worthy of the finest vintages.

CSG-601.name: Discontinued Professional Meat Thermometer
CSG-601.description: The Cuisinart® Professional Grilled Meat Thermometer is the easy way to check on the doneness of anything you're grilling.  Simply insert the probe into your meal and it will quickly read how hot the internal temperature is.  Use the handy printed guide for a quick reference for different meats as well.  The thermometer also includes a probe cover for clean storage.

DLC-8SBCY.name: Discontinued Pro Custom 11™ 11 Cup Food Processor
DLC-8SBCY.description: From the Cuisinart Pro Custom 11 Cup Food Processor's cover with large feed tube and unique compact chopping/kneading cover, to its industrial quality motor, this kitchen powerhouse is built to deliver professional results year after year. With two different slicing discs, a shredding disc, a chopping/mixing blade, and two sizes of pushers, you can make fast work of any recipe prep without breaking a sweat.

CWC-600.name: Discontinued Private Reserve™ Wine Cellar
CWC-600.description: Protect the integrity of your favorite wines with the Cuisinart™ Private Reserve™ Wine Cellar. This elegant countertop cellar chills wines using thermoelectric cooling technology, which eliminates noise and vibration. Eight temperature presets for a variety of reds and whites keep up to 6 bottles of wine at the perfect serving temperature. Designed in the style of full-size cellars, with a stainless steel door and interior light, the Cuisinart™ Private Reserve™ is a beautiful way to display wines and champagnes.

89-11.name: Discontinued Professional Series™ Cookware 11 Piece Set
89-11.description: Cook like a pro with this professional stainless steel cookware from Cuisinart®. The exclusive PowerBond™ high impact bonded base heats fast, distributes heat evenly, and is induction cook-top ready. Riveted stainless handles provide strength and durability for ultimate control. Tempered glass FlavorLock® lids seal in moisture and nutrients. Cookware is oven and broiler-safe up to 500°F for superior versatility. Glass lids oven safe up to 350°F.

C99PW-10P.name: Discontinued Professional Series Pakka Wood 10 Piece Cutlery Block Set

DTC-850.name: Discontinued Programmable Automatic Brew & Serve™ Coffee Maker

CTF-605.name: Discontinued Programmable Outdoor Digital Temperature Fork
CTF-605.description: Grill It To Perfection with the Cuisinart®  Programmable Digital Temperature Fork. Cook all your favorite meats, poultry and seafood with gourmet-like precision and never serve undercooked food again. Set the desired temperature or cooking level and take the guesswork out of your grilling. Use the 99 minute countdown timer to remind you when to turn or baste your food. The audible and flashing alarm alerts you when your food is done. When finished grilling, simply remove the fork tines for convenient dishwasher-safe cleaning and sterilizing.

EM-200.name: Discontinued Programmable Espresso Machine
EM-200.description: Want a single or double espresso? The choice is yours with the Cuisinart® Programmable Espresso Maker! Program a single or double espresso and savor the rich flavors that Cuisinart® brings out with 15 bars of pressure, or add hot water for an Americano, or add frothed milk for a creamy cappuccino or luscious latte. The stainless stem nozzle and frothing cup makes barista beverages easy. The Programmable Espresso Maker also features a cup-warming plate, removable drip tray, and cover for convenience.

CCJ-500CH.name: Discontinued Pulp Control Citrus Juicer
CCJ-500CH.description: From the smallest lime to the largest grapefruit, our sleek brushed stainless steel Pulp Control Citrus Juicer gets out more juice more efficiently. The adjustable auto-reversing reamer features custom pulp control settings for your family’s preference, and the unique Final-Spin feature maximizes the amount of juice from each piece of fruit. Dishwasher-safe parts make cleanup a breeze.

FCC-2.name: Discontinued Programmable 5 Cup Percolator & Electric Kettle
FCC-2.description: Introducing the ultimate multi-beverage brewing experience. The Cuisinart® Programmable 5 Cup Percolator & Electric Kettle uses innovative technology to brew up to 5 perfect cups of coffee or heat water for tea in one compact unit. A magnetic drive system circulates water from the bottom up to the filter, extracting optimal flavor from grounds. Hot drinks are easy to customize with adjustable time, temperature, and brew strength. Water remains at a steady temperature for robust flavor and the 1-liter glass carafe doubles as an electric kettle that boils water for tea, soups and hot cereals. Complete with 30-minute Keep Warm plate, stainless steel reusable filter, and ergonomic handle, the Programmable 5 Cup Percolator & Electric Kettle brings all the beverage variety of a professional barista home to you.

CGG-608.name: Discontinued Professional Portable Gas Grill
CGG-608.description: The Cuisinart® Professional Portable Gas Grill delivers the performance of a full sized grill with the convenience of portability.  This grill fires up with 10,000 BTUs of meat searing heat across 176 square inches of cooking space.  With all of that power comes a lot of control as well.  The one easily controllable burner allows you to sear meats at high temperatures and then lower the temperature to allow food to cook through. And the built in thermometer monitors the grill temp for you.  The stainless finish will look as good at your home as it will on the road. And with an inner/protective liner in the lid, the beautiful steel look will look better and last longer.

ICE-30BC.name: Discontinued Pure Indulgence™ 2 Quart Frozen Yogurt-Sorbet & Ice Cream Maker
ICE-30BC.description: What's better than one quart of luscious homemade ice cream, sorbet, or frozen yogurt? Two quarts! The fully automatic Cuisinart® Pure Indulgence™ makes 2 quarts of your favorite frozen desserts or drinks in as little as 25 minutes. It's easy - an integrated motor, double-insulated freezer bowl and automatic mixing paddle do all the work. Results are consistently smooth, cleanup is easy, and the brushed metal styling is simply sensational.

KML-8.name: Discontinued ProVantage™ Digital Kitchen Scale
KML-8.description: Get perfect results every time with the Cuisinart® Digital Kitchen Scale and accurately measure the ingredients for your favorite baking treats. Use the ProVantage™ Digital Kitchen Scale and switch between imperial and metric weights with the easy clean touchpad buttons, displayed on the large LCD for accurate measurements while you bake. Designed to meet all your household measuring needs, the smart design combines modern versatility with easy cleaning.

CSB-33.name: Discontinued Quick Prep® Hand Blender
CSB-33.description: Great for the whole family, the Quick Prep® Hand Blender whips, blends, mixes, purées, and more! The powerful motor has two speed settings to reduce splash back and tackle dense ingredients. Comes with a 16-oz. beaker for blending right in the measuring container.

CK-5R.name: Discontinued QuicKettle
CK-5R.description: This compact kettle is the perfect choice when brewing for one or two. The QuicKettle heats water up fast and turns itself off when it reaches boiling temperature. Designed for user convenience, this cordless kettle features an easy-to-view water level window, a lid that pops open with the touch of a button, and overheat and boil-dry protection.

CCB-2919.name: Discontinued Quick Swap Grill Brush
CCB-2919.description: The Cuisinart Quick Swap Grill Brush is a versatile, dual-use cleaning brush that allows you to clean your grill either with the included brush handle, or on your power drill for deep cleaning purposes. The brush head features durable, crimped nylon bristles. The crimped bristle design is commonly used for tough cleaning jobs such as car detailing and kitchen/bathroom grout cleaning. Use the brush head on the included handle for quick cleaning before or after a meal. For tougher cleaning jobs, such as beginning and end-of-season cleanings, attach the brush head on to your power drill and easily scrub away caked-on food and grease. The universal drill bit design allows the brush head to fit on any style of power drill. Easily swap between cleaning modes by pulling the release knob on the brush handle and then secure on to your drill.

CPO-800.name: Discontinued PurePrecision™ 8 Cup Pour-Over Coffee Brewer
CPO-800.description: Kick your premium coffee making up a notch with a coffee-bar quality brewer that delivers gourmet, coffee-bar quality flavor! This precision brewing technique provides superior flavor extraction. Fully electric operation pre-wets grounds before brewing to let the flavor “bloom.” Now your friends and family can enjoy the superior coffee taste produced by manual brewers – without the work! Temperature and strength lets you customize every coffee, and a unique laser-etched stainless steel filter helps to maximize this exceptional coffee experience. Available with Glass Carafe.

CTG-04-RRS.name: Discontinued Ravioli Stamp (Round)
CTG-04-RRS.description: The Cuisinart® Barrel Handle Collection of kitchen tools and gadgets has a professional look and feel. Solid black, soft-grip handles with stainless steel are rounded for universal comfort. From stirring a pot to ladling soup to grating cheese or coring an apple, this line of kitchen tools does everything the home chef needs -- and more!

CTC-201.name: Discontinued Propane Tank Adapter
CTC-201.description: It’s time to stop worrying about running out of propane while grilling. This propane tank gauge constantly monitors the propane level in a standard 20lb tank. Attach one end to a 20lb propane tank and the other end to the hose of a full-size grill (or portable grill that has a built-in hose). And for the sake of convenience, this tank gauge can be left outside, attached to the propane tank.

SP-2.name: Discontinued Rechargeable Salt & Pepper Mills
SP-2.description: Cuisinart® presents an easy and elegant way to serve freshly ground salt and pepper. Our stainless Rechargeable Salt & Pepper Mills sit in a sleek power base to ensure mills are always fully charged and ready to grind. Adjust for fine to coarse grinds, and light up food as it’s being seasoned for perfect results. Bon appétit!

CR-8.name: Discontinued Raclette
CR-8.description: Raclette grilling has been a popular European entertaining experience for generations. Now you can try it right at home! Slow down, relax and enjoy tabletop grilling of your favorite meats and vegetables, or making crêpes on the reversible cast metal grill /griddle plate. The 8 nonstick trays under the grill are perfect for cheeses and other accompaniments to enhance your meal. With a nonstick cooking surface, adjustable temperature probe and 8 raclette dishes, the possibilities are endless!

CFE-01-R20.name: Discontinued Rannee 20 Piece Set
CFE-01-R20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. Made to the renowned quality standards of Cuisinart®, these solid yet comfortable continental size pieces are hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel and finished with the utmost care. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

CFS-TC-REC64G.name: Discontinued Rectangular 64oz
CFS-TC-REC64G.description: For decades, Cuisinart® has been helping you prepare delicious homemade meals. Now Cuisinart®'s superior storage containers let you vacuum seal food, locking out air and moisture, for longer freshness.

CFS-QR-34R.name: Discontinued Rectangular 34oz
CFS-QR-34R.description: Monitoring food-freshness is easy with this integrated Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ system! The innovative container features an air and water-tight secure seal, ideal for storing anything from soups, sauces to meats and vegetables. The state-of-the-art Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ and QR code system allows users to easily log their food and receive alerts when freshness is about to expire. Just store and scan; Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ does the rest.

CFS-TC-REC103G.name: Discontinued Rectangular 103oz
CFS-TC-REC103G.description: For decades, Cuisinart® has been helping you prepare delicious homemade meals. Now Cuisinart®'s superior storage containers let you vacuum seal food, locking out air and moisture, for longer freshness.

CFS-TC-REC32G.name: Discontinued Rectangular 32oz
CFS-TC-REC32G.description: For decades, Cuisinart® has been helping you prepare delicious homemade meals. Now Cuisinart®'s superior storage containers let you vacuum seal food, locking out air and moisture, for longer freshness.

CNP-800.name: Discontinued Rectangular Grilling Pan
CNP-800.description: The Cuisinart® Rectangular Grilling Pan helps any grilling enthusiast cook a variety of delicate foods on the grill without allowing them to fall through the grate. The roasting style pan is 18"x11"x1.5" and is great for seafood, vegetable, and also can hold larger items like a 5-pound chicken. The non-stick material features grill ribs that elevate food and collect cooking drippings and excess oil. The pour spouts make it easy and convenient to pour off excess oil and cooking juices. The raised stainless steel handles on the topper prevent your hands from coming in contact with the hot surface. Non-stick inside and out delivers great food release with quick cleanup; roasting pan style grill topper is safe up to 400°F.

CF-01-R20.name: Discontinued Rennes 20 Piece Flatware Set
CF-01-R20.description: With the introduction of Cuisinart® Flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. Finishes are artfully blended. Styles range from clean and modern to elaborate and refined. European in flavor yet universal in appeal, the new flatware adds grace and panache to any meal.

BA-1113.name: Discontinued Rectangular Prep Board™ Cutting Surface
BA-1113.description: The Rectangular Prep Board™ doubles as both a stylish serving tray and cutting board, with an embossed measuring guide for accurate slicing. Once you’ve sliced up crudités, add your favorite dips and then serve a party-ready appetizer right from the tray. Or heat up hot finger foods right on the tray, which is microwave safe and oven safe up to 180°F.

CTK-SS15.name: Discontinued Prodigy® 2 Quart Teakettle
CTK-SS15.description: The classic stainless steel tea kettle is given a contemporary twist from Cuisinart with a unique handle that makes the Prodigy™ 2 Quart Tea Kettle stand out in any kitchen. The industrial style tea kettle holds up to two quarts and whistles to alert you when the water has reached boiling point.

CDP01-S4WBK.name: Discontinued Reynes Collection
CDP01-S4WBK.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers a variety of beautiful patterns, each dish designed and crafted of the ?nest quality porcelain. From colorful geometrics to bold black on white to delicate pastels, Cuisinart® porcelain dinnerware can be classically elegant, totally trendy, and everything in between. Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CAHBR4SK.name: Discontinued Restaurant Style Steak Knives (Set of 4)

FRC-800.name: Discontinued Rice Plus™ Multi-Cooker with Fuzzy Logic Technology
FRC-800.description: Cuisinart® introduces a smarter way to cook rice…and a lot of other dishes, as well. Introducing the Rice Plus™ Multi-Cooker, the first product from Cuisinart® with advanced fuzzy logic technology. This built-in “brain” senses fluctuations in cooking and automatically adjusts operation to ensure perfect results. With pre-programmed settings for six types of rice, plus oatmeal, soup, steam, slow cooking, and more – and easy dishwasher cleanup – this is destined to become a favorite.

TOB-200.name: Discontinued Rotisserie Convection Toaster Oven
TOB-200.description: A dozen different ways to cook and room to rotisserie roast a 4 pound chicken makes Cuisinart® 's Rotisserie Convection Toaster Oven in demand for every kitchen. 1875 watts of power heats the unit quickly and ensures precise cooking. The easy clean nonstick interior boasts enough size to fit 6 slices of bread or a 12" pizza. The brushed stainless steel suits any kitchen countertop, making it easy for your family to hone their cooking skills at any time.

CTG-00-RG.name: Discontinued Rotary Grater
CTG-00-RG.description: The Cuisinart® Rotary Grater is made with an innovative design and stainless steel blades for fine grating. Rotary grater las reversible handles for left or right handed use with a soft grip handle. It has a large grating chamber, perfect for cheese  and chocolate!

CDP01-S4WR.name: Discontinued Rialle Collection
CDP01-S4WR.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers a variety of beautiful patterns, each dish designed and crafted of the ?nest quality porcelain. From colorful geometrics to bold black on white to delicate pastels, Cuisinart® porcelain dinnerware can be classically elegant, totally trendy, and everything in between. Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

A28805.name: Discontinued Roll Top Backpack Cooler
A28805.description: The all-new, lightweight insulated coolers come with many features to ensure your contents stay not only dry, but cold or warm too! Each cooler is thermal insulated and made of a durable shell. Keeping your contents dry is also easy with its water-resistant zipper and waterproof, wipeable liner.

WM-SW2.name: Discontinued Sandwich Grill
WM-SW2.description: The versatile Cuisinart® Sandwich Grill does more than just lunch; press sandwiches, grill omelets, and even crisp French toast in one product! Perfect for dorm rooms and cozy kitchens, the Sandwich Grill can make two items at once, with a lock-down lid guaranteeing both sides cook evenly while the nonstick plates seal in your favorite ingredients. Sizzling cheese sandwiches and fluffy omelets come out perfectly every time with dual indicator lights letting you know when the grill is ready to cook and your meal is ready to eat. The nonstick plates wipe clean after use and the lid lock and cord wrap make storage easy.

CBOOK-SAUCY.name: Discontinued Saucy Sisters Guide To Wine

CBB-055.name: Discontinued Sauce Bottle & Basting Brush
CBB-055.description: Whether basting some ribs or saucing a pizza, there is no easier tool than Cuisinart’s Sauce Bottle & Basting Brush. With a 13.5 oz bottle, there will be no shortage of sauce for whatever is being grilled, cooked, or baked. The cap is a basting brush in itself and it is resealable so it can go right from the refrigerator to saucing some meat without dirtying any other tools or containers. With an easily removable cap, the Sauce Bottle & Basting Brush can be thrown right in the dishwasher for quick and convenient cleaning. There is no limit to the number of sauces or fun concoctions that can be used with this bottle/basting brush combo. It is time to get creative and start slathering the best foods with some tasty sauces.

RTO-20.name: Discontinued Retro Toaster Oven Broiler
RTO-20.description: Cuisinart® streamlines its toaster oven to take up a little less space on the counter. This Retro Toaster Oven Broiler, in brushed stainless with smooth black panels and slide controls, has a roomy .3 cu ft. capacity - just the right size for most everyday tasks. Engineered to guarantee consistent temperatures for perfect results!

CCB-581.name: Discontinued Saw Tooth Grill Scraper
CCB-581.description: The Cuisinart® Sawtooth Grill Scraper has eliminated the fear of losing grill brush bristles when cleaning your grill. With this grill scraper, you won't have to worry about finding any metal bristles in your food. The Sawtooth Grill Scraper has five sizes of steel teeth that will scrape away grill grime on a number of different size grill grates. The thick durable stainless steel of the scraper will last a long time and the small size makes storage easy and convenient. So forget the bulky grill brush and make the switch to the uniquely designed Cuisinart® Sawtooth Grill Scraper!

CTG-00-SWW.name: Discontinued Shaker with Whisk
CTG-00-SWW.description: The Shaker with Whisk is great for making shakes, dressings, marinades, and more. The whisk is built into the shaker lid, making it easy to whisk or shake your mixes in the same prep jar.

CGG-049.name: Discontinued Searin' Sphere Portable Gas Grill
CGG-049.description: It’s time to get your grilling game rolling with the Cuisinart® Searin’ Sphere Portable Gas Grill. The design of this grill is perfect for portability, convenience, and making a great meal! This compact look has a hinged lid that rolls under the grill for smooth, compact use. The convenient and compact use of the grill is only rivaled by its convenient and compact portability. The locking lid, wooden handle, and tubular leg design make carrying and transporting the grill extremely easy. And cleanup has never been easier! With a dishwasher safe, porcelain enameled cooking grate, cut out the hassle of scrubbing down the grill after each use. Start grilling in style with the Cuisinart® Searin’ Sphere Portable Gas Grill and never look back!

CDST1-S4MG.name: Discontinued Saone Collection
CDST1-S4MG.description: Food matters, and so does what it's served on. Introducing Cuisinart® Stoneware Dinnerware, the perfect choice for breakfast, lunch or dinner! Available in a variety of irresistible styles, shapes and colors, Cuisinart® Stoneware is a perfect complement to any meal. Bright color glazes and dark and light matte finishes create the perfect looks for everything from cozy vintage-style kitchens to big, glamorous dining rooms. Celebrate meals in style, with Cuisinart®!

CDP01-S4WBL.name: Discontinued Renage Collection
CDP01-S4WBL.description: Porcelain dinnerware lends an instant elegance to any meal. Cuisinart® offers a variety of beautiful patterns, each dish designed and crafted of the ?nest quality porcelain. From colorful geometrics to bold black on white to delicate pastels, Cuisinart® porcelain dinnerware can be classically elegant, totally trendy, and everything in between. Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CTG-00-NC.name: Discontinued SharkBite™ Nut & Seafood Cracker
CTG-00-NC.description: Featuring large and small jaws, the SharkBite™ Nut & Seafood Cracker is perfect for a variety of nuts, lobster, and crab. It has comfortable, soft grip handles and is ergonomically designed to require less pressure when cracking.

CTG-00-SCO.name: Discontinued Safe Edge Can Opener
CTG-00-SCO.description: The Cuisinart® Safety Can Opener has no exposed blades and removes the lids from any size can without leaving behind a sharp edge. By cutting the lid around the outside edge, it also reduces the risk of food contamination. The soft-grip handle and sturdy construction make it easy and comfortable to use.

FCT22-911NS.name: Discontinued Set of 2 Nonstick Frying Pans French Classic Tri Ply Stainless
FCT22-911NS.description: Made in France to the highest standards of the world’s finest kitchens, this Set of 2 Nonstick Frying Pans will last a lifetime, providing you with classic elegance and modern technology.

CASH4.name: Discontinued Shears (Set of 4)
CASH4.description: Set of four stainless steel shears for use in the kitchen

CASHTK05-1.name: Discontinued Sheartoku- Santoku and Shear all in one

CST-152.name: Discontinued Side Shelves for CCG-100
CST-152.description: Bring the convenience of an indoor kitchen to the outside with the Cuisinart® GrateLifter Pair of Side Tables, made to attach to the Cuisinart® GrateLifter Charcoal Grill. The sturdy side shelves add 200 square inches of valuable counter space to your grilling area. Ideal for prep space, holding your tools and food, these durable shelves are easy to remove for grilling on the go.

CBB-106.name: Discontinued Silicone Basting Brush
CBB-106.description: Applying tasty sauces to foods on the grill can make ordinary cuisine extraordinary. However, using the wrong basting brush can make the process painful and messy. The Cuisinart®  Silicone Basting Brush is designed to help add those essential finishing touches to your grill creations without all the pains. The long, angled handle keeps hands away from the heat, and the drip cover and dishwasher-safe removable head makes clean-up simple.

CTG-00-ICS.name: Discontinued Silicone Ice Cube Trays (Pack of 2)
CTG-00-ICS.description: Each tray makes 15 ice cubes for your summer drinks and iced coffee.

CTG-12-SSP.name: Discontinued Silicone Scoop Spatula
CTG-12-SSP.description: You can always count on Cuisinart® for the next big idea, and this line of premium kitchen utensils and gadgets is no exception. With substantially-sized handles and generously proportioned heads, function and form unite to make quick work of any kitchen task whether stirring, scooping, flipping, grating or peeling.

CASHPS2.name: Discontinued Shears (Set of 2)
CASHPS2.description: Two stainless steel shears for use in the kitchen.

CTG-01-SP.name: Discontinued Silicone Spatula
CTG-01-SP.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Curve Handle Line, this kitchen gadget features a soft-grip nonslip handle. This silicone spatula is heat resistant up to 450°F. Dishwasher Safe.

DGB-1.name: Discontinued Single Cup Grind & Brew™ Coffee Maker
DGB-1.description: Savor every deliciously fresh cup with the Cuisinart® Single Cup Grind & Brew. Choose your favorite coffee beans and let the built-in grinder start the transformation into sixteen ounces of beautifully brewed, gourmet quality java every time. For caffeine on the go, drip tray is removable to accommodate a travel mug. And cleanup is easy because all the removable parts are dishwasher safe.

CTG-00-SSC.name: Discontinued Silicone Steam Case
CTG-00-SSC.description: Made of flexible, heavy-duty silicone, our Silicone Steam Case steam case is a healthy and simple new way to cook with steam! You can quickly steam vegetables, chicken, fish and more in the oven or microwave while retaining the fullest flavors, textures and nutrients. This 100% platinum silicone steam case is oven safe up to 425°F and steams up to 4.5 cups of vegetables, 1.5lbs of chicken or 1lb of fish. With a specially designed steam-release valve, wide easy-grip handles, and dishwasher-safe cleanup, it’s ideal for everyday use.

CNP-411.name: Discontinued Simply Grilling Nonstick Grilling Platter
CNP-411.description: The Cuisinart® Non-Stick 12-inch by 16-inch Grilling Platter helps any grilling enthusiast cook a variety of delicate foods on the grill without allowing them to fall through the grate.  Ideal for fish, seafood and vegetables, this smartly designed platter features a large 12-inch by 16-inch grilling surface, professional grade non-stick coating and a perforated grilling surface to enhance the natural grilled flavors created by the open flame.

CNW-428.name: Discontinued Simply Grilling Nonstick Grilling Wok
CNW-428.description: Step outside and spice up your grill with the new Cuisinart®  Simply Grilling Nonstick Grilling Wok. Start with the freshest vegetables in the generous 10"  diameter wok and add a helping of juicy meats or seafood. Just add a splash of your favorite sauce, a sprinkle of seasoning, and your sizzling creation is done! The wok's professional non-stick coating ensures food wont stick, making grilling easy and cleanup a breeze. The heat-resistant handle adds a comfortable grip and also folds for convenient storage.

SS-5.name: Discontinued Single Serve Brewer
SS-5.description: Brew your favorite coffee fast with the Cuisinart® Single Serve Brewer! Featuring a 40-ounce water reservoir and 3 serving sizes, the morning rush just got a little easier. Choose 6, 8, or 10 ounces and brew into a mug, cup, or even travel mug by removing the drip tray. The 30 minute auto shutoff turn your brewer off for you.

CSKR-105.name: Discontinued Skewer Rack with 5 skewers
CSKR-105.description: The Cuisinart® Skewer Rack with Set of 5 Skewers is the ultimate barbecue accessory for perfect kebabs. This professional stainless steel rack fits on your grill, raising your skewers 1.5 inches above the grill surface to reduce charring and flare ups. The skewers hold ten inches of food and nest securely on the rack without spinning because of the unique flat design, meaning an even grill every time. When cooked, use the Cuisinart® Grill Mitt or Cuisinart® Grill Gauntlet and bring the full rack right to your table for easy serving. Additional Set of 6 Stainless Steel Skewers sold separately.

CNHB-434.name: Discontinued Simply Grilling Nonstick Hamburger Basket
CNHB-434.description: The Cuisinart®  Nonstick Hamburger Basket makes entertaining easy! Just place up to six large burgers on the non-stick grid, slide the lock into place, and get grilling. Turn the basket once and all six burgers will be evenly grilled on both sides. The professional nonstick coating ensures your burgers will be easily removed - even if you grill lean foods like turkey burgers, salmon steaks, and chicken breasts. The long heat-resistant handle provides a safe and comfortable grip, the Hamburger Basket is certain to make your grilling experience easier and more enjoyable.

MCP22-1012PKN.name: Discontinued Skillet Set of 2 (10" Skillet & 12" Skillet)

SS-700.name: Discontinued Single Serve Brewing System
SS-700.description: Perfect for both personal use and entertaining, this single-serve home-brewing system offers consumers fresh gourmet coffee, tea, hot cocoa and more in under one minute. This brewer’s innovative one-touch technology makes it easier than ever for consumers to enjoy a wide array of hot beverages.

CNFB-432.name: Discontinued Simply Grilling Nonstick Fish Filet Basket
CNFB-432.description: The Cuisinart®  Nonstick Fish Basket is ideal for grilling delicate fish filets, preventing them from falling through traditional grill grates. Just place your seasoned or sautéed filet in the basket, lock the cover, and place the basket on the grate to start grilling! And there's no need to worry about the filet sticking to the grill or breaking apart during turning thanks to the nonstick coating and convenient elongated heat-resistant handle. And since your food won't stick, cleaning after grilling is a breeze.

CTG-16-SMS.name: Discontinued Small Strainer (4-inches)
CTG-16-SMS.description: Cuisinart® combines classic design and comfortable handling in the Primary line of tools and gadgets. Home chefs will love this selection of everyday tools for prepping and cooking! Nonslip ergonomic handles and textured thumb rests provide comfort as well as control. Durable stainless steel mesh is excellent for sifting and straining.

CSC-650.name: Discontinued Slow Cooker
CSC-650.description: Slow cook your favorite one-pot recipes for tender meats and delicious family meals with the Cuisinart™ Slow Cooker. The 8-hour timer allows you set the time and temperature – then walk away.  Use the cooking rack to make a perfect soufflé or dessert. The oval ceramic pot accommodates larger cuts of meat and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.

CSB-400CD.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® Cordless Hand Blender
CSB-400CD.description: Introducing a new hand blender that’s one of the most multifunctional food prep tools in any kitchen. The cordless design of the Smart Stick® makes it highly portable and provides exceptional versatility, along with the chef's whisk for merinque and whipped cream. The slim, stainless steel shaft is 8¾ inches long with a larger blade and guard for faster results. Five speeds and 20 minutes of runtime on each charge make this cordless stick blender any chef’s all-time favorite!

CSB-76.name: Discontinued Smart Stick Hand Blender
CSB-76.description: The versatile stick design of the Cuisinart® Smart Stick® Hand Blender lets users blend ingredients right in pots, pitchers, bowls, or the clear plastic beaker that’s included. A powerful 200-watt motor operates with an easy one-touch control. Blends drinks, purées soup, mixes pancake and crêpe batters in seconds! Both stainless steel blending shaft and beaker are dishwasher-safe.

CSB-78.name: Discontinued Smart Stick PLUS® Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender
CSB-78.description: The versatile Cuisinart®  Smart Stick PLUS® Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender makes you the master of your kitchen. With no cord to get in the way, you can take the Smart Stick PLUS® from its wall-mountable storage stand and whip cream, beat eggs, puree fruits, and blend soups whether prepping or cooking on the stovetop. Use the included chopper attachment to quickly prep ingredients. And with 20 minutes of cordless use at a time, you can blend a soup, chop vegetables for sides, and whip cream for dessert to create a delicious three-course meal on a single charge.

CSB-80.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® PowerTrio® Hand Blender with Food Processor
CSB-80.description: With 400 watts of power, the Smart Stick® PowerTrio®  High-Torque Hand Blender makes short work of processing vegetables, nuts, and hard cheeses right in pots, pitchers, and bowls. The versatile Smart Stick® can also whisk delicate meringues and fluffy creams to perfection - all with a touch of a button! Cleaning is just as easy, with a wipe clean handle and dishwasher safe attachments.

CSB-75.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® 2 Speed Hand Blender
CSB-75.description: This sleek Smart Stick® 2 Speed Hand Blender is available in five fab colors to complement any kitchen, from funky to sophisticated. With a 200-watt motor, two speeds, and deep reach, you can make quick work of puréeing soup in a pot or frothing a pitcher hot chocolate. Make healthy breakfast smoothies fast, blending soft fruits with yogurt in seconds.

CSB-300.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® Variable Speed Cordless Hand Blender with Electric Knife
CSB-300.description: Blend, whip, chop, whisk, and now carve with the powerful Cuisinart® Smart Stick® Variable Speed Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender with Electric Knife. The 2 cup chopper for nuts, cheese, and garlic or herbs will revolutionize your meal prep, giving your more time with your family or guests, while the electric knife attachment lets you carve meats or slice crusty bread and even tomatoes with ease right at the table, thanks to the cordless capability for 20 minutes of run time on a single charge. And with the 9.5 inch slim shaft, you can easily reach the bottom of any pot or pitcher, or whisk up a party-sized portion of whipped cream in no time at all.

N6122-810.name: Discontinued SmartNest® Hard Anodized 2-pk Skillet Set
N6122-810.description: Build a more organized future with a nesting set that satisfies all of your cooking needs. You can cook with confidence with this durable hard anodized set, while enjoying ultimate convenience in your kitchen. Fit, stack and store!

CSB-100.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® Variable Speed Hand Blender with Potato Masher
CSB-100.description: More than just a hand blender, this stainless steel Smart Stick® does it all. The variable speed knob gives you control of the 700 watts of power, using premium attachments to whisk egg whites, whip cream, chop nuts, shred cheese, and even mash potatoes with the push of a button! The 8.6” stainless steel shaft reaches into bowls, pots, and pitchers, while the 2 cup chopper, 4 cup mixing cup, help you blend and whisk your way through anything!

CSB-175.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® Two-Speed Hand Blender
CSB-175.description: Blending and mixing have never been smarter! The Cuisinart® Smart Stick™ Two-Speed Hand Blender has a new, higher 300-watt motor that blends smoothies and purées soups in seconds, easily powering through even heavy-duty tasks. The two-speed slide control is simple to operate – just one touch shifts from high to low – and the longer stainless-steel blending shaft reaches deep into pots, pitchers and bowls so there are fewer dishes to wash! The new, improved and easier to operate blade guard provides the ultimate in safety and convenience.

N6119-5.name: Discontinued SmartNest® Hard Anodized 5 Piece Saucepan Set
N6119-5.description: Build a more organized future with a nesting set that satisfies all of your cooking needs. Boil, simmer, Sauté or fry. You can cook with confidence with this durable hard anodized set, while enjoying ultimate convenience in your kitchen. Fit, stack and store! Specially designed lid organizer included.

N51-12BK.name: Discontinued SmartNest® Non-Stick Aluminum 12 Piece Set
N51-12BK.description: Save 30% more space and build a more organized future with a nesting set that satisfies all of your cooking needs. Choose from a variety of vessels while cooking your favorite meals – boil, simmer, steam with the first nesting stack or sauté, sear, fry with the second nesting stack!
