N9119-5.name: Discontinued SmartNest® Stainless Steel 5 Piece Saucepan Set
N9119-5.description: Build a more organized future with a nesting set that satisfies all of your cooking needs. HTM-3.name: Discontinued SmartPower™ 3 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
HTM-3.description: The Cuisinart®  Smart Power®  3 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer provides maximum performance with a minimum of effort.

CSB-79.name: Discontinued Smart Stick® 2 Speed Hand Blender with Chopper
CSB-79.description: Blend, purée, chop, grind, and whip up cream and meringues with ease thanks to the 2-speed control Cuisinart® Smart Stick®! The included chopper/grinder and chef’s whisk attachments are capable of handling nearly any sweet or savory task in your kitchen. The stylish brushed stainless steel blender has a one-touch operation making it easy for you to use one-handed, blending right into a pan, pitcher, or bowl.

N9122-810.name: Discontinued SmartNest® Stainless Steel 2-pk Skillet Set
N9122-810.description: Build a more organized future with a nesting set that satisfies all of your cooking needs. You can cook with confidence with this high performance stainless steel set, while enjoying ultimate convenience in your kitchen. Fit, stack and store!

SPB-7.name: Discontinued SmartPower™ 7 Speed Electronic Blender
SPB-7.description: Powerful motor crushes ice instantly with no liquid added. It blends, purées, chops, mixes, and liquefies all with the push of a button! This very smart and versatile SmartPower™ 7 Speed Electronic Blender has enough power and speeds to do it all.

CB-18R.name: Discontinued SmartPower Basics™ 18 Speed Blender
CB-18R.description: The Cuisinart®; SmartPower Basics®  18-Speed Blender operates a heavy-duty 500 watt motor to perform even the toughest tasks. An eighteen speed twist dial, easy On, Off, Pulse and Ice Crush buttons, and a generous 48-ounce heavy glass blender jar provide almost endless blending options. Easy to operate, easy to clean -- SmartPower®  products by Cuisinart® equal power plus versatility.

HTM-9LB.name: Discontinued SmartPower CountUp® 9 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
HTM-9LB.description: For the ultimate in control, CountUp®  has 9 speeds, including 3 extra-low speeds and a SmoothStart®  feature to prevent splatters. The digital clock, built into the handle, starts running as soon as you press the start button.

HTM-7L.name: Discontinued SmartPower™ 7 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
HTM-7L.description: The powerful 220 watt motor enables you to mix double batches of cookies without bogging down.

SPB-6.name: Discontinued SmartPower Classic™ Blender 500 Watt
SPB-6.description: Cuisinart® simplifies blending without sacrificing power or performance. This 500 Watt SmartPower Classic®  Blender features 6 preset speeds for the most popular blending functions and calls out the names on a single, easy-to-use rotary dial. Guarantees the right blend for any task. Includes Cuisinart®'s Instant Pulse, LED indicators, 50-ounce stainless steel jar, and, as always, dishwasher-safe parts for effortless cleanups.

SPB-600.name: Discontinued SmartPower® Deluxe™ Blender
SPB-600.description: Cuisinart® introduces the blender you’ve been waiting for! The new SmartPower® Deluxe™ has all the features – and all the blending power – serious cooks need. Our patented stainless steel blade, large borosilicate glass jar, and Pulse at High or Low speeds let you do it all – mince delicate herbs, whip up smoothies or chop ice for a crowd! With its sturdy die-cast base, this blender can handle anything you toss at it – or into it.

BFP-703BC.name: Discontinued SmartPower™ Duet 500 Watt Blender/Food Processor
BFP-703BC.description: Powerful motor crushes ice instantly with no liquid added. It blends, purées, chops, mixes, and liquefies all with the push of a button! This very smart and versatile SmartPower™ 500 Watt Blender/Food Processor has enough power and speeds to do it all.

CB-18BKSS.name: Discontinued SmartPower Bar Basics™ 18 Speed Electronic Blender
CB-18BKSS.description: The Cuisinart®  SmartPower Bar Basics®  is one of the smoothest moves in blending. Designed with a single 18-setting speed dial and a separate ice crush button, this powerful blender delivers the ease of use, power, and versatility you can always count on from Cuisinart.

CBT-500.name: Discontinued SmartPower Premier™ 600 Watt Blender
CBT-500.description: The SmartPower Premier®  600 Watt Blender can handle the toughest blending tasks with ease -- even ice crushing! The Count-Up Timer helps to keep track of recipe time for perfect results.You can double and triple your recipes in the large capacity 50-ounce (1.5-liter) glass blender jar. It even has top-of-the-line heavy cast metal and stainless construction that adds sophistication to any kitchen.

BFP-703.name: Discontinued SmartPower Duet® Blender/Food Processor
BFP-703.description: Enjoy a frozen drink, crush enough ice for a crowd, and prepare hors d'oeuvres for a party with the Cuisinart® SmartPower Duet™ Blender/Food Processor. Seven speeds, one just for ice crushing and one for food processing, make this Blender/Food Processor a powerful kitchen helper. The smart choice for everyday home cooks and chefs extraordinaire!

CSB-55N.name: Discontinued SmartStick® Extendable Shaft Hand Blender & Chopper/Grinder
CSB-55N.description: Now you can easily blend tall pots of hot soup and great sauces without getting messy hands or stained sleeves!

CSB-158.name: Discontinued Smoke and Humidity Grill Box
CSB-158.description: The Cuisinart® Smoke & Soak Grilling Box is the best way to turn your grill into a flavor infusing machine.  This new design combines the classic smoke chip box with a tandem humidifying section so you can maintain deliciously moist meats while grilling a smoky roast.  Try mixing beer in the humidifier and bourbon chips in the smoker.  Give wine a whirl alongside smoking some oak.  Any combination of smoke flavors and juicy foods is sure to be a hit.  The Smoke & Soak Grilling Box works perfectly on gas grills, charcoal and electric so go ahead and bring some new flavor to your food.

CSB-77.name: Discontinued SmartStick® Hand Blender
CSB-77.description: Cuisinart® makes it quick, clean, and easy to blend, prep and whip a variety of ingredients. Our SmartStick® Hand Blender includes Whisk and Chopper attachments to extend this blender's performance. Blends or whips right in the bowl, pitcher or pot, to eliminate extra dishes, and with the Chopper attached, it turns into a handy mini food prep tool. The look is commercial, the performance is professional, and the ease of use is pure Cuisinart®!

SCM-10.name: Discontinued Snow Cone Maker
SCM-10.description: All you need is ice, flavored syrup and a Cuisinart® Snow Cone maker to enjoy fun, icy treats at home, any time!

SMO-56.name: Discontinued Smooth Operator
SMO-56.description: The Cuisinart® Smooth Operator® is the perfect party blender, with a dispenser tap on the front to serve up to 56 ounces of exotic frozen drinks to delighted guests. With 1500 watts of pulse power, the Smooth Operator® blends faster and smoother, for the ultimate fresh fruit smoothies, protein shakes, and puréed soups. Simple to operate, easy to clean, and elegant in brushed chrome and stainless with our trademark embossed logo, this blender is a stunning addition to today's best-looking kitchens.

CNGS-333.name: Discontinued Smoker Mats
CNGS-333.description: Let the smoke reach every part of your dish with the Cuisinart® Reusable Non-Stick Smoker Mats! The fine mesh allows the smoke to penetrate food easily, while the non-stick material prevents meats from sticking and smaller items from falling through. The Reusable Non-Stick Smoker Mats fit all 30 inch smoker and larger! For an easy clean up, these mats are dishwasher safe! Ideal for smoking vegetables, fish and jerky.

CBT-500FP.name: Discontinued SmartPower Premier Duet™ Blender/Food Processor
CBT-500FP.description: Cool cast metal and commercial styling make the SmartPower Premier Duet ™ one of the most sophisticated appliances on the market. This phenomenal multitasker is two appliances in one, delivering twice the performance options and in half the counter space. The 50-oz. Blending jar can be replaced with the 3 cup work bowl to turn this 600-watt SmartPower® Blender into a genuine Cuisinart® Food Processor. Loaded with features to make quick work of crushing ice, blending, chopping, slicing and shredding, people are building entire kitchens around the SmartPower Premier Duet™.

CPT-7TR.name: Discontinued Soho™ 2 Slice Toaster
CPT-7TR.description: Form meets function in the new Cuisinart Soho™ 2-Slice Toaster. Whether optimizing a hectic morning or mindfully savoring breakfast, this versatile toaster is designed to fit into every morning routine. On top of toasting essentials like Bagel, Defrost and 1 - 7 shade settings, it also includes features like QuickView™ and Reheat to provide max control over the toast process. Keep countertops looking clear with easy front access crumb tray for convenient cleaning and rear cord storage to hide excess cord length. Morning rituals should be simple and minimal—nothing more, nothing less. That's Cuisinart Soho.

BL-9TR.name: Discontinued Soho™ Blender
BL-9TR.description: With the Cuisinart Soho BL-9 Blender, all you need to do is add your preferred ingredients to the 36 oz. jar, secure the lid and press "Blend" or "Pulse." Its user-friendly design makes it simple to operate, and the jar has enough capacity to create a variety of recipes. The integrated 2 oz. measuring cup on the lid ensures that adding ingredients is mess-free. Cleaning up is also quick and easy with the built-in "Clean" function and removable blade assembly. Plus, the integrated cord storage feature keeps your counters free of clutter.

SS-7.name: Discontinued Soho™ Single-Serve Coffee Maker
SS-7.description: Begin your day with the Cuisinart Soho™ Single-Serve Coffeemaker. With a slim and sophisticated profile, this coffee maker is designed to save countertop space, making it ideal for smaller living spaces. Brew one rich cup at a time to take on the go or sit down for work or relaxation. The unit is pod compatible with a brew intensity guide for cup sizes in 6-, 8-, 10-, and 12-ounces. The 2-stage drip tray reduces splashes and is removable to accommodate a 20-ounce travel mug. With easy settings, LED lighting, and fast, flavorful brewing, the first cup of the day has never tasted so good. Morning rituals should be simple and minimal—nothing more, nothing less. That's Cuisinart Soho.

CSS-131.name: Discontinued Spice Mill
CSS-131.description: Combining ultimate convenience with a unique/modern design has been the ultimate goal of the Cuisinart® Spice Mill. This combination pepper grinder/salt shaker/spice pen is as user friendly as it is sleek. Simply twist the chamber to open. Once open, you can pour your salt, pepper, or spice into the 40mL chamber. Then reconnect the chamber. Now, just press the soft, rubberized pump button to dispense your chosen spices on whatever you’re cooking or about to eat. This one-handed spice grinding and dispensing tool can be taken with you anywhere and stored in a drawer or with your spices.

CFS-TC-SQ32G.name: Discontinued Square 32oz
CFS-TC-SQ32G.description: For decades, Cuisinart® has been helping you prepare delicious homemade meals. Now Cuisinart®'s superior storage containers let you vacuum seal food, locking out air and moisture, for longer freshness.

CFS-TC-SQ16G.name: Discontinued Square 16oz
CFS-TC-SQ16G.description: For decades, Cuisinart® has been helping you prepare delicious homemade meals. Now Cuisinart®'s superior storage containers let you vacuum seal food, locking out air and moisture, for longer freshness.

SMS-201R.name: Discontinued Sparkling Beverage Maker
SMS-201R.description: Save money, save time, save space, save the planet! Do all that and more with the Cuisinart® Sparkling Beverage Maker. You control the level of carbonation; you control the sweetness. The CO2 cartridge easily snaps in to make liters of soda with the push of a lever! Get ready to enjoy the drinks you love!

HTM-5.name: Discontinued SmartPower™ 5 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer
HTM-5.description: With its powerful 220 watt motor and supersized beaters, the Cuisinart® Smart Power™ 5 Speed Electronic Hand Mixer makes fast work of heavy tasks.

CFS-QR-34S.name: Discontinued Square 34oz
CFS-QR-34S.description: Monitoring food-freshness is easy with this integrated Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ system! The state-of-the-art Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ and QR code system allows users to easily log their food and receive alerts when freshness is about to expire. Just store and scan; Cuisinart® SmarTrack™ does the rest.

A28802.name: Discontinued Square Cooler
A28802.description: The all-new, lightweight insulated coolers come with many features to ensure your contents stay not only dry, but cold or warm too! Each cooler is thermal insulated and made of a durable shell. Keeping your contents dry is also easy with its water-resistant zipper and waterproof, wipeable liner.

CPB-7TR.name: Discontinued Soho™ Personal Blender
CPB-7TR.description: Start fresh every morning with healthy juices and creamy smoothies made in a minute with the Cuisinart Soho™ Personal Blender. Top off the 24-ounce cup with your favorite fruits, vegetables, and mix-ins then press the Pulse or Blend button to effortlessly combine ingredients in seconds. A28809.name: Discontinued Square Lunch Tote Cooler

BA-1111.name: Discontinued Square Prep Board™ Cutting Surface

DTC-950.name: Discontinued Stainless Programmable Automatic Brew and Serve™ Coffee Maker
DTC-950.description: Our newest edition in thermal coffee makers, this model features a carafe that is made of brushed stainless steel and accented in either white or black. The Automatic Brew and Serve Coffee Maker brews coffee directly into the carafe by using our patented brew-through lid. Serving coffee is just as easy, since the lid also dispenses the brew without ever having to twist or turn the carafe lid. The carafe is so efficient that it keeps coffee hot for 12 hours and warm for 8. It preserves that great coffee flavor from the moment you brew it!

CTG-07-CS.name: Discontinued Stainless Steel Cheese Slicer
CTG-07-CS.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Elements Collection, this cheese slicer features a nonslip grip handle with an embossed stainless steel accent. Features a durable stainless steel head. Dishwasher Safe.

CGWM-012.name: Discontinued Stainless Steal Multi-Purpose BBQ Shears

CGB-120.name: Discontinued Stainless Steel Grilling Basket

CGWM-019.description: The Cuisinart® Stainless Steel Grill Wok is a simple way to bring stir fry and other fun dishes to the grill. This wok features raised sides to hold your food in while perforations let you get the real grilling experience.

CAAB4SK.name: Discontinued Steak Knives in Bamboo Box (Set of 4)

CGWM-077.name: Discontinued Steam Cleaner Grill Brush
CGWM-077.description: Give your grill the deep steam cleaning it needs with the Cuisinart® Steam Cleaner Grill Brush! Cleaning your grill grates with steam is an extremely effective way to break up tough grease and grime. Simply pop open the top of the handle and fill up the water reservoir. Use the flow control knob on the brush head to control the amount of water that is being released as you brush the grates. Simply turn the knob off to stop the flow of water. The stainless steel scraper on the brush head is a great tool for breaking up stubborn residue and providing a true deep clean.

DSA26-30.name: Discontinued Stir Fry Pan
DSA26-30.description: The sloped sides of this anodized Stir Fry Pan pan make it perfect for stir-fry, noodles or stock reduction recipes. The nonstick surface requires no oil, so meals are healthier. Dishwasher-safe design means effortless cleanup.

CG-S4W.name: Discontinued Stemless White Wine Glasses (Set of 4)
CG-S4W.description: Cheers to the new Cuisinart® Essentials Glassware Collection! Elegant and affordable, these glasses will bring style and grace to any home. Sip and savor favorite wines with quality glassware designed for daily use, and special enough for the fanciest celebration.

CIT-6012.name: Discontinued Stainless Steel Griddle Spatulas 2-Pack
CIT-6012.description: The Cuisinart® 2 Pack Griddle Spatulas is the perfect set for all your griddle needs. Both spatulas feature rounded ends to prevent scratching on griddle surface. Fats and liquids drain easily through the perforations featured on one of the spatulas. This set is great for Teppanyaki, Hibachi, camping, tailgating, and more!

CG-S4R.name: Discontinued Stemless Red Wine Glasses (Set of 4)
CG-S4R.description: Cheers to the new Cuisinart® Essentials Glassware Collection! Elegant and affordable, these glasses will bring style and grace to any home. Sip and savor favorite wines with quality glassware designed for daily use, and special enough for the fanciest celebration.

STOW-8.name: Discontinued Stowaway Cookware™ (Set of 8)
STOW-8.description: Eight essential pieces of cookware stack and store in a sturdy canvas bag. Ideal for dorms, apartments, boats and RVs.

CTG-00-STR.name: Discontinued Strainer
CTG-00-STR.description: The beautiful stainless steel Strainer from Cuisinart® makes it easy to strain your libations, crafting perfectly smooth cocktails time after time.

CFE-01-ST20.name: Discontinued Stream Seine 20 Piece Set
CFE-01-ST20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. Made to the renowned quality standards of Cuisinart®, these solid yet comfortable continental size pieces are hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel and finished with the utmost care. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

SB-5600.name: Discontinued Supreme Super 600™ 60oz Stainless Steel Blender
SB-5600.description: Cuisinart® presents more power and capacity in this Supreme Super 600™ 60-Ounce Stainless Steel Blender. A 600-watt high-torque motor and powerful cyclonic blending action deliver quick results that are thoroughly and consistently blended. Preprogrammed rubberized push button controls with LED indicators guarantee that everything from fruit smoothies to crushed ice is perfect. Detachable parts are dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup.

CSKS-166.name: Discontinued Stainless Steel Skewers (Set of 6)
CSKS-166.description: The Cuisinart® Set of Six Stainless Steel Grill Skewers will cook your kebabs to perfection without taking up your entire grilling space.  These 10-inch skewers can hold a lot of meat, shrimp and veggies but still fit on a typical plate so handling your food is easy when served.   The flat design prevents food from spinning on the skewer, allowing food to be grilled evenly when skewers are turned.

ICE-50BC.name: Discontinued Supreme™ Commercial Quality Ice Cream Maker
ICE-50BC.description: Cuisinart® makes it faster and easier than ever to treat friends and family to rich and creamy gourmet ice cream. The Cuisinart® Supreme™ Commercial Quality Ice Cream Maker has a built-in compressor-freezer, so there's no bowl to pre-freeze. That means frozen desserts are ready to enjoy sooner. Processes batch after batch of scrumptious ice cream, fruity sorbet, silky smooth frozen yogurt, and even your favorite ice summer drinks. Just add the ingredients and turn it on. It's as easy as 1, 2, 3!

CPR-100.name: Discontinued Stuffed Grilled Pepper Rack
CPR-100.description: Stuffed grilled peppers are the hottest food to hit grills!  Use this clever pepper shaped rack to grill up to 22 peppers at once.  The rack is non-stick for easy cleaning and the legs fold up for storage.  It has a convenient removable handle to move to and from the grill and even includes a pepper corer.  Add a little spice to your next grilling party with this handy accessory.

CGSS-552.name: Discontinued Sweet Chili Seasoning
CGSS-552.description: This blend has a sweet, savory and spicy taste to it. The subtle heat from the jalapenos and chili peppers harmonizes with the sweetness of the soy sauce flavor.

CGSS-776.name: Discontinued Sweet Paprika Seafood Seasoning
CGSS-776.description: Cuisinart®’s Sweet Paprika Seafood Seasoning is a flavorful blend that you and your guests will truly enjoy at your next barbecue. Paprika has a sweet, warm taste that will spice up grilled shrimp, fish, and even crab cakes. Add this blend to a mix of honey, soy sauce, and lemon juice for a savory glaze to go over grilled salmon, tuna or any seafood steak. Great for grilled and baked fish; use as a dry rub or blend together for a marinade or glaze, your taste buds will love the sweet taste of the paprika. The prestigious Cuisinart® brand is not limited to their famous food processors - plugged or unplugged, nobody covers the modern chef like Cuisinart®. Cuisinart® is a full-service culinary resource with a wide array of products, preferred by chefs and favored by consumers. And now you can take the world-famous Cuisinart® brand to your patio, lawn, tailgate, or campsite with their comprehensive line of Cuisinart® outdoor grilling products available now at Walmart.

CTK-SS1.name: Discontinued Swoop™ 1.75 Quart Teakettle
CTK-SS1.description: A gleaming stainless steel kettle is a classic that looks right in both traditional and today's popular industrial style home kitchens. All Cuisinart® kettles have convenient whistles to signal that water is boiling.

CTG-07-LDS.name: Discontinued Straining Ladle
CTG-07-LDS.description: Easily strain and pour your favorite comfort dishes with Cuisinart's Straining Ladle. The convenient kitchen tool also features nonslip grips, making it comfortable and reliable to use.

CCB-390.name: Discontinued Swivel Head Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-390.description: The Cuisinart® Swivel Head Grill Brush speeds up any grill cleaning chore.  This brush features a 6.5" x 2" brush head to swipe across grill grime.  Simple press and swivel the head to attack your mess the easiest way possible.  The  15" handle keeps your hands far from the mess while the brush cleans up fast.

CGS-6005.name: Discontinued Teppanyaki Set
CGS-6005.description: Bring the excitement of hibachi grilling to your backyard! The Cuisinart® Teppanyaki Set has the 7 essential tools for Hibachi grilling; all grilling tools are stainless steel and feature robust wooden handles. An elongated, multi-functional spatula with bottle openers. Stainless steel fork designed with a long handle that provides incredible reach while keeping your hands away from the heat and two sharp prongs can dig into just about any meat for slicing and serving. Griddle scrapper to dice up food or scrape the griddle clean. Protect the sharp Hibachi knife with the durable cover included in the set. Also includes, two squirt bottles for water, oil or sauces.

TOB-60N2NAS.name: Discontinued Toaster Oven Broiler with Convection
TOB-60N2NAS.description: Cuisinart® brings a classic approach to modern cooking with the Toaster Oven Broiler with Convection. The industrial stainless steel styling, and the 0.6 cu ft. capacity – large enough to fit a 12" pizza or 6 slices of toast – make this countertop oven a valuable addition to any kitchen. This multi-functional oven can bake, broil, toast, warm, convection bake and convection broil to perfection with a glass window allowing you to monitor the cooking progress without opening the door.

TOB-160.name: Discontinued Toaster Oven Broiler with Exact Heat™ Sensor
TOB-160.description: Cuisinart® brings a new standard of convenience and consistency to baking, broiling and toasting. The state-of-the-art Exact Heat™ Sensor and Your Choice™ Browning Memory ensure that everything is cooked to perfection. Program perfect toast on the sleek touchpad control panel ? separate Bagel, Defrost, Reheat and 4-Slice buttons make it easy. With a slide-out crumb tray, baking/broiling pan, automatic shutoff and the capacity to hold a 4-1/2 lb. chicken or a 9-inch pie, this compact toaster oven broiler will be a welcome addition to any kitchen

CPT-2400.name: Discontinued The Bakery™ Artisan Bread 2 Slice Toaster
CPT-2400.description: Toasting rustic artisan and thick homemade breads requires a special toaster, and Cuisinart® comes through once more! The Artisan Bread 2 Slice Toaster has two extra-long, extra-wide 10” x 1 ½” slots to hold healthy, fresh artisinal breads. Toasts big chunky hand-cut slices – and regular thick to thin breads or bagels – all to the shade selected. Controls are large and intuitive; everything about this toaster is easy!

TOB-155.name: Discontinued Toaster Oven
TOB-155.description: Today's busy lifestyles have made the multifunctional countertop oven more popular than ever. This Cuisinart®; Toaster Oven Broiler has a great sense of style, three versatile cooking options, state-of-the-art electronic touchpad controls, and a capacity large enough to let it double as a second oven. Cuisinart® makes baking a whole chicken, broiling fish, or toasting 6 slices of bread easy as pie!

A28803.name: Discontinued Tote Cooler
A28803.description: The all-new, lightweight insulated coolers come with many features to ensure your contents stay not only dry, but cold or warm too! Each cooler is thermal insulated and made of a durable shell. Keeping your contents dry is also easy with its water-resistant zipper and waterproof, wipeable liner.

CPT-440.name: Discontinued Touch to Toast™ Leverless 4 Slice Toaster
CPT-440.description: Cuisinart brings technological innovation to the toaster, with the Touch to Toast™ Leverless 4 Slice Toaster! The stylish brushed stainless steel houses a unique motorized control that lowers items into the 4 extra wide slots at the simple touch of a button. Use the dual control panels to toast combinations of bagels, English muffins, pastries, and bread to the exact shade you love, keeping track of progress with the blue backlit LCD displays and countdown timers for superior control.

CTG-00-LT.name: Discontinued Toss & Serve 2-in-1 Salad Tongs
CTG-00-LT.description: The Cuisinart® Toss & Serve 2-in-1 Salad Tongs are the ideal tool for making the perfect salad: use the two sides of the tongs separately to toss salad ingredients and dressing, then lock them together to use as tongs for serving. Once the salad is served, the tongs nest together for convenient storage.

RK-17.name: Discontinued Traditional Cordless Electric Kettle
RK-17.description: The Cuisinart® Traditional Cordless Electric Kettle combines all of the comforts of the kettle on the stove with the convenience of today?s newest technology.  The elegant stainless steel finish makes it a lovely addition to any table.

WAF-R.name: Discontinued Traditional Waffle Maker
WAF-R.description: Cuisinart® streamlines the traditional waffle iron to create a brand new look that's still classic Cuisinart®. Brushed stainless steel housing is slightly flared for an elegant shape that's practical too, catching drips before they hit the counter. With 6 shade settings, indicator lights, an audible "ready" tone, and a lid that locks to ensure even baking, it's hard to bake a waffle that isn't absolutely perfect. Come back to the traditional breakfast with the Traditional Waffle Iron, from Cuisinart®!

CPT-420.name: Discontinued Touch to Toast™ Leverless 2 Slice Toaster
CPT-420.description: A touch of a button is all it takes to lower items into the extra wide slots of the brushed stainless steel Cuisinart Touch to Toast™ Leverless 2 Slice Toaster. The motorized control and sleek new control panel with blue backlit LCD display with countdown combines the latest technology with the humble toaster. Use the premium features such as one-sided enhanced bagel toasting, reheat and defrost controls, audible alert signal, and 7 shade settings, to toast just how you like it.

CTG-15-GP.name: Discontinued Trentino Garlic Press
CTG-15-GP.description: Cuisinart's new Trentino collection of kitchen tools merges complete comfort and optimal performance. Durable yet lightweight, these ergonomically designed essentials feature soft grip handles for ease of use.

CTPP22-30H.description: Cuisinart® Copper Collection Tri-Ply Stainless 12" Skillet with Helper Handle

CDP01-S4T.name: Discontinued Tille Collection

Whether serving family or guests, dining at a table set with Cuisinart® makes every meal a special occasion!

CTPP22-24.name: Discontinued Tri-Ply Stainless 10" Skillet
CTPP22-24.description: Cuisinart® Copper Collection Tri-Ply Stainless 10" Skillet

FCT23-24NS.name: Discontinued Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 10" Nonstick Crepe Pan
