CTPP22-20.name: Discontinued Tri-Ply Stainless 8" Skillet
CTPP22-20.description: Cuisinart® Copper Collection Tri-Ply Stainless 8" Skillet

FCT22-30HF.name: Discontinued Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 12" French Skillet with Helper Handle
FCT22-30HF.description: Get cooking with Cuisinart! This Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 12" French Skillet with Helper Handle provides optimal cooking heat and is composed of induction-ready stainless steel.

842750112707.name: Discontinued The Tasty One Top
842750112707.description: The Tasty One Top is a smart induction cooktop. When following a recipe in the One Top app, the One Top automatically changes its temperature and power settings to precisely match the instructions. The One Top’s thermometer measures the internal heat of your meats and fish to cook to the perfectly desired temperature, with or without the app. The One Top can be utilized for almost any form of cooking including: Sous vide, deep frying, pan frying, stir frying, grilling, simmering, sautéing, slow cooking, searing, poaching, and more!

CCB-012.name: Discontinued Tri-Wire 12-Inch Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-012.description: Cleaning your grill is a necessity of every grill owner. It is also the least enjoyable part of the grilling process. The 12” Tri-Wire Grill Cleaning Brush offers a new take on traditional grill brushes. The unique design of this grill brush allows you to clean in between each bar on your grill grate with ease. You will be able to cover more surface area with each motion while easily being able to get to those hard to reach places. Unlike the average grill brush, you will now be able to use both sides of your grill brush. This will extend the life of your brush and keep the grill cleaner longer. Take a less traditional approach to cleaning your grill and enjoy the results.

CCB-939.name: Discontinued Triple Nylon Bristle Grill Brush
CCB-939.description: The Cuisinart® Triple Nylon Bristle Grill Brush cleans grills cold and cleans grills fast. It is 3 brushes in 1 & cleans faster than a traditional brush. It features nylon bristles designed to use once your grill has cooled. They will go to task cleaning up grill grime and are safe to use on all types of grill grates. The bristles are firmly rooted in the brush, but sometimes during normal grilling bristles can dislodge. In the event that occurs, our red bristles are easy to spot for added safety. The 90 Degree angles of each brush allow you to clean even the hardest to reach places and apply more cleaning leverage.

CCB-021.name: Discontinued Tri-Wire 21-inch Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-021.description: Cleaning your grill is a necessity of every grill owner. It is also the least enjoyable part of the grilling process. The 21” Tri-Wire Grill Cleaning Brush offers a new take on traditional grill brushes. The unique design of this grill brush allows you to clean in between each bar on your grill grate with ease. You will be able to cover more surface area with each motion while easily being able to get to those hard to reach places. Unlike the average grill brush, you will now be able to use both sides of your grill brush. This will extend the life of your brush and keep the grill cleaner longer. Take a less traditional approach to cleaning your grill and enjoy the results.

TOB-5.name: Discontinued Toaster Oven Broiler
TOB-5.description: From evenly toasting bread to cooking a roast with mouthwatering results, Cuisinart’s classic toaster oven offers today’s home cooks superior performance and versatility. Equipped with 1800 watts of power, this kitchen essential is large enough to accommodate 6 slices of toast, and Always Even™ technology ensures consistent results every time! A dedicated pizza function bakes an 11" pizza to perfection in minutes. The cool-touch handle, slide-out rack, and easy-clean nonstick interior add exceptional convenience. With its elegant stainless steel front, this toaster oven is trademark Cuisinart.

CGG-501G.name: Discontinued Two Burner Outdoor Griddler®
CGG-501G.description: If you're looking for easy and versatile cooking at home, look no further! From the basics to breakfast and beyond, you can cook just about anything on a griddle. Flat top cooking can be found in just about every cultural cuisine from Japan to Spain to the U.S. The Cuisinart® Gourmet Two Burner Gas Griddler is designed to look great on your patio while still offering the portability to take it to the tailgate, camp site, or anywhere your culinary creativity is needed. The Griddler comes with a cast iron cooking grate attachment that can be placed over half of the griddle surface for when you want the benefits of a griddle with the sear marks of a grill. Sear steaks on one side of the Griddler while cooking vegetables on the other. And when you’re not looking to sear food on the cast iron surface, remove the attachment and use the entire griddle surface for whatever you’re cooking. If you need an all-in-one outdoor cooking appliance or something to expand your culinary creativity at home or away, then this product is for you!

TCS-60.name: Discontinued Turbo Convection Steamer
TCS-60.description: The Turbo Convection Steamer is equipped with a convection fan that circulates the steam 33% faster and easier. With an extra-large 6-quart steaming tray and a removable water reservoir with cooking and time indicators, the Turbo Convection Steamer can cook family size meals. It can also cook up to 5 cups of rice at a time! With easy-to-use dial controls, an additional steaming tray, and an automatic turn-off, this new Cuisinart® steamer is not only high in performance and reliability, but high in safety too.

GAS2256AS.name: Discontinued Two Burner Duel Fuel Gas Grill
GAS2256AS.description: The Cuisinart Two Burner Gas Grill is designed with form and function and built with compact storage. Experience exceptional cooking with durable porcelain-coated cast iron cooking grates and a built-in appliance grade viewing window that allows for easily monitoring without losing heat. Adjust the Cuisinart Two Burner Gas Grill to fit your needs with dual fuel valves for propane or natural gas (Model#ACC1056AF Cuisinart Natural Gas Conversion Kit sold separately).

TTG-500.name: Discontinued Two to Go® Coffee Maker
TTG-500.description: The Cuisinart®  Two to Go® brews directly into two travel mugs that hold 14 ounces of coffee each. The attractive black housing and high quality stainless steel mugs look great in any kitchen. Convenient, travel-ready mugs have tight fitting lids and are ergonomically designed for a comfortable, slip-free grip. They fit most car cup holders, and their extra-deep sipping wells prevents spills.

GAS0356AS.name: Discontinued Twin Oaks Pellet & Gas Grill
GAS0356AS.description: The Cuisinart® Twin Oaks Pellet and Gas Grill delivers both flavor and convenience all in one. No matter your grilling aspirations the Twin Oaks is ready to griddle the finest breakfast hash, smoke for hours with a 30-pound pellet hopper, or grilling tonight's chicken dinner. Revel in the ease of cooking with 900 square inches of cooking space that includes heavy-duty cast-iron grates. Never be in the dark on what is happening under the lid, with an appliance grade viewing window and two ten-watt halogen lights, sit back and relax while mastering the grill. Smoke to perfection with two meat probes equipped with Bluetooth readouts on the LCD controller and the Cuisinart® Easy Connect®  BBQ app. Lock in the flavor you dream of in a pellet grill with the insulated lid designed with a gasket seal that prevents smoke from escaping. We took the hassle out of cleaning with the express clean-out system that removes ash as easy as one-two-three. Whether you are smoking a brisket, grilling up some burgers, or griddling your favorite recipes the Twin Oaks does it all. Exclusively sold at Walmart.

CAUSH.name: Discontinued Ultimate Kitchen Shears
CAUSH.description: One of the most resourceful kitchen tools you'll find, these shears make the cut... and much more! The multifunction design incorporates a screwdriver, can opener and screw-cap bottle opener, too!

CGWM-029.name: Discontinued Universal Grill Warming Rack
CGWM-029.description: The Cuisinart® Universal Grill Warming Rack provides you with extra space to keep food warm or toast buns, allowing you to use the full surface of the grill to cook your main meal. Easily extends from 15.5 inches to 21.75 inches. Also acts as a second grill grate, ideal for cooking items that don’t need to be on direct heat, like some vegetables. Whether you are keeping finished food warm or toasting buns, the Cuisinart® Universal Grill Warming Rack offers you that extra space you need!

CAUSHE.name: Discontinued Ultimate Shears with bottle opener

CGR-400.name: Discontinued Ultimate 4 Piece Griddle Ring Set
CGR-400.description: Create Perfectly Shaped Omelets, 4” Eggs for Sandwiches, and 6” Pancakes. The Cuisinart® Ultimate Egg Ring Set will not only make perfectly shaped eggs, omelets, and pancakes, it will also simplify breakfast! This set includes 2 Egg Rings, 1 Pancake Ring, and 1 Omelet Ring. Evenly space out your rings on your griddle surface and get cooking! The 2 Egg Rings make 4” eggs that fit perfectly on English muffins making homemade breakfast sandwiches look just as good as they taste! The Egg Rings are also great for smaller pancakes, but when you want that restaurant-style 6” pancake use the Pancake Ring. Add blueberries, chocolate chips, or sliced apples, the ring will hold the shape of the pancake and make it easier to flip and serve! Easily create thick, perfectly shaped omelets! Make almost 8” wide pancakes and .87” thick! This ring will make it easy to add all your yummy veggies and meat without getting too messy on your griddle top. When done, add cheese and fold in half! Your family and friends will love the restaurant-style omelet! Also great for making fritters and more!

SPB-8.name: Discontinued VELOCITY 600 Watt Blender
SPB-8.description: Blend smoothies, sauces, and soups with the Cuisinart®  VELOCITY 600 Watt Blender. Our premium power blender features patented stainless steel blades and a large BPA-free plastic jar with an Ice Crush control to make entertaining easy. Take control of your cooking with electronic touchpad options to Blend or Pulse at Low and High speeds!

CTK-SSTR.name: Discontinued Valor™ 2 Quart Teakettle
CTK-SSTR.description: Make up to two quarts of hot beverages in the gleaming stainless steel of the Valor™ 2 Quart Tea Kettle. This timeless tea kettle from Cuisinart® features a traditional whistle to signal that water is boiling.

CTG-00-VWS.name: Discontinued Vacuum Wine Saver
CTG-00-VWS.description: The Cuisinart® Vacuum Wine Saver helps extend the life of your leftover wine. Attach the Vacuum Wine Saver to the top of an opened bottle and push the center down to extract the air from the bottle, prevnting the wine from oxidizing and spoiling.

HB400GF.name: Discontinued Variable Speed Hand Blender with Hand Mixer Attachment
HB400GF.description: Make quick work of blending tasks with the power and performance of the Goodful by Cuisinart® variable speed stick blender. It comes with a measurement beaker and a double-beater attachment for hand mixing.

CTG-00-VC2.name: Discontinued Vegetable and Fruit Chopper
CTG-00-VC2.description: The Cuisinart® Vegetable and Fruit Chopper allows the home chef to easily dice fruits and vegetables to perfection with this multipurpose must-have kitchen tool. Large dice and small dice blades allow for uniform cuts of onions, tomatoes, cucumbers, apples, cheese and much more. You can operate this chopper with one-hand and the blades store safely in the unit.

CBT-600GRY.name: Discontinued Velocity Blender
CBT-600GRY.description: The Velocity Blender features a 600-watt motor to power through any blending task in seconds, from mixing up a daiquiri to crushing ice. All-in-one speed control dial makes it easy to shift from Low to High to Pulse, while the premium stainless steel blades ensure smooth results. The BPA-free, 48-ounce Tritan™ blending jar offers the capacity to spare, and the wipe-clean base and dishwasher-safe, removable parts make cleanups easy. Tight-seal lid prevents spills when the blender’s in use and a 2-ounce measuring pour lid insert provides additional precision measurements.

CGS-311.name: Discontinued TriTip Grill Tool Set
CGS-311.description: The Cuisinart® TriTip Grill Tool Set does more than you’d ever expect two tools to do. These tools are constructed of durable stainless steel that goes all the way through the ergonomic plastic handles. The TriTip Spatula has a large surface with a bottle opener and a clever cutting edge. The TriTip Locking Tongs feature a precision point grip, perforations for straining, and a scalloped/firm toothed edge. Why waste space with more tools than you need? This TriTip tool set was built for a variety of uses and it was built to last.

SPB-650GM.name: Discontinued VELOCITY Ultra 7.5 1 HP Blender
SPB-650GM.description: This sleek and powerful blender features Ice Crush and Smoothie controls, Low and High blending speeds, and a convenient Pulse function. Its generous 56-ounce durable BPA-free plastic jar features a tight-seal lid, soft-touch handle, and a 2-oz. measuring cap for precise measuring. The blender’s electronic touchpad provides easy selection for all your blending needs.

WAF-V100Y.name: Discontinued Vertical Waffle Maker
WAF-V100Y.description: The brushed stainless steel on the Cuisinart® Vertical Waffle Maker takes up less room on the counter while making foolproof perfect Belgian waffles. Just add your favorite batter through the spout up to the fill line for consistent waffle thickness, top to bottom and side to side, that won’t spill over the edges. Indicator lights and an audible alert, plus five browning levels, guarantee crowd-pleasing waffles are perfectly baked for all your family and friends.

CPT-3000.name: Discontinued ViewPro™ Glass 2 Slice Toaster
CPT-3000.description: See toast in a whole new light with the Cuisinart® ViewPro® Glass 2 Slice Toaster. With both front and back windows, you can quickly and easily monitor your toast for the perfect shade every time. Helpful touchscreen controls offer 6 shade levels and presets for defrosting items or toasting bagels to help you make breakfast delicious. Glass windows are removable for easy cleanup.

CFE-01-V20.name: Discontinued Valloire 20 Piece Flatware Set
CFE-01-V20.description: European in flavor yet universal in appeal, Cuisinart® Elite™ Flatware adds grace and style to any meal. Made to the renowned quality standards of Cuisinart®, these solid yet comfortable continental size pieces are hand-crafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel and finished with the utmost care. In a multitude of precisely realized designs, reflecting a wide array of sophisticated style preferences, each piece bears a distinctive hallmark “C” for Cuisinart®.

DIP-8.name: Discontinued Waffle Dippers™
DIP-8.description: Cuisinart® Waffle Dipper™ makes breakfast fun--and easy!  Bakes eight Belgian waffle sticks just the way you like them, with 6 shade settings and indicator lights backed up by an audible signal to guarantee perfect results.  The lid locks to ensure that waffles bake evenly, top to bottom and side to side, and a handy Dipping Station with 3 dipping cups is microwaveable to warm up favorite syrups and sauces.   Housing stays cool, so waffles can be cooked right at the table.  Perfect for "kids" of all ages!

KS-55.name: Discontinued WeighMate™ Digital Kitchen Scale
KS-55.description: The efficient WeighMate™ Digital Kitchen Scale makes it easy to control portions and bake with maximum consistency. The easy-to-read digital screens displays accurate weights in imperial and metric, as well as easy cleaning. Modern, sleek designs look great on the countertop and are easy to store.

CWT-100.name: Discontinued Warming Tray
CWT-100.description: Essential for anyone who likes to entertain with style, the Cuisinart® Warming Tray is both beautiful and practical. Brushed stainless steel makes it an especially attractive enhancement to any table or buffet. With 400 watts of power, it heats up fast and maintains a temperature of up to 200°F. The temperature control knob makes it easy to regulate how hot the tray gets with a choice of low, medium or high. A large, 21" x 14" surface easily holds two or more dishes at just the right serving temperature – eliminates back-and-forth trips from the kitchen and accommodates family meals and get-togethers with friends.

CTG-00-WAC.name: Discontinued Waiter's Corkscrew
CTG-00-WAC.description: The Cuisinart® Waiter’s Corkscrew easily removes corks and works on all standard wine bottles. Made from durable stainless steel. Hand Wash Only.

A28806.name: Discontinued Wine Bottle Cooler
A28806.description: The all-new, lightweight insulated coolers come with many features to ensure your contents stay not only dry, but cold or warm too! Each cooler is thermal insulated and made of a durable shell. Keeping your contents dry is also easy with its water-resistant zipper and waterproof, wipeable liner.

CTG-09-W2.name: Discontinued Whisk
CTG-09-W2.description: This collection of gourmet tools features soft-grip, nonslip, bubble textured handles for a fun form as well as a steady hold. Available in red and black nylon and stainless steel.

C77MB-3PRW.name: Discontinued White Marble 3.5" Parer
C77MB-3PRW.description: Take on any kitchen task in style with our Cuisinart® Marble-Style collection. Designed with superior stainless steel blades for precision and accuracy, and an ergonomic handle for comfortable control. Marble-style design complements any kitchen décor.

C77MB-8CFW.name: Discontinued White Marble 8" Chef
C77MB-8CFW.description: Take on any kitchen task in style with our Cuisinart® Marble-Style collection. Designed with superior stainless steel blades for precision and accuracy, and an ergonomic handle for comfortable control. Marble-style design complements any kitchen décor.

CWO-400.name: Discontinued Wine Center - Opener/Preserver
CWO-400.description: The Cuisinart® Wine Center includes an electric wine opener and wine preserver on a handsome charging base. All feature elegant brushed stainless accents. The unit also comes with two wine stoppers and a foil cutter.

CSG-900.name: Discontinued Wireless Dual Probe Grilling Thermometer
CSG-900.description: Convenience isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when thinking about monitoring meat and grill temperatures. But, with Cuisinart’s Wireless Dual Probe Grilling Thermometer, convenience is a main priority. Monitor grill and meat temperature from up to 300 feet away with the two included temperature probes. The food probe can be inserted 6” into meat and the thermometer’s backlight will allow for productive nighttime grilling. The timer settings allow you to have multiple options when it comes to tracking grill and meat temperatures. Either use the thermometer to set personalized times or let it tell you when your grill and meat are at the desired temperatures. It’s time to relax, step away from the grill, and let the thermometer remind you when it’s time to eat.

CTG-00-WS.name: Discontinued Wine Stopper
CTG-00-WS.description: The Cuisinart® Wine Stopper seals bottles for storage. Hand Wash Only.

CG-01-S4WW.name: Discontinued White Wine Glasses (Set of 4)
CG-01-S4WW.description: Make any occasion a celebration with Cuisinart®’s The Star’s the Limit® White Wine Glasses. With a star on each glass to indicate the optimum fill level, the shape of these White Wine Glasses is designed to bring out the complex flavors and aromas of all your favorites. Each piece of stemware is hand crafted from soda lime glass for durability and clarity.

CSB-156.name: Discontinued Wood Chip Smoker Box
CSB-156.description: The Cuisinart® Wood Chip Smoker Box  infuses your barbecue with delicious smoky flavors just like the pros.  Simply place a handful of pre-soaked cedar, hickory, mesquite or other wood chips in the stainless steel smoker box and place the box on your gas or charcoal grill while cooking.  In no time, your grill comes to life with aromas you thought only the professionals could create.  Your meat, fish and poultry capture the smoky flavor, turning your basic barbecue into delicious gourmet meals.  What's best is that the compact size takes up very little space on your grill, so the smoker box works great with any grill size.

CVR-1000.name: Discontinued Vertical Rotisserie
CVR-1000.description: The Cuisinart®; Vertical Rotisserie seals in nutritious juices and drains away unwanted fat for healthier meals. To keep the temperature consistent, removable chrome insert reflects heat as the rotisserie turns, and a 3-hour countdown timer with auto-shutoff ensures perfect timing. Cuisinart® includes accessories to cook poultry, fish, vegetables, roasts and shish kebabs, as well as a recipe book with even more options!

CSG-700.name: Discontinued Wireless Meat Thermometer
CSG-700.description: The Cuisinart® Wireless Grill Thermometer is the perfect BBQ Companion for a busy griller.  We've thought of everything with this one.  You can monitor the grilling temperature of 6 different types of meat (Beef, Veal, Lamb, Pork, Chicken & Turkey) from up to 100 feet wirelessly.  Simply select your meat and desired taste, insert the probe and grill away.  The handheld unit will monitor the meat temperature and even alert you when it's done. That's not all though.  This thermometer also features a convenient timer option and built in flashlight for grilling at night.  The handheld unit is small enough for your pocket and also has a belt clip for easy transport. The Cuisinart® Wireless Grill Thermometer packs in all of the features you'll ever need to take the guess work out of perfect grilling!

C77RB-11P.name: Discontinued Vetrano 11 Piece Cutlery Block Set
C77RB-11P.description: The Vetrano collectino from Cuisinart® adds innovative lines, looks, and textures to its expanding collection of cutlery block sets. New blade surfaces, unique textured handles, and a selection of both knife styles and block styles let consumers choose you cutting tools that fit their kitchen decor as well as your personal cooking styles.

CCB-W2.name: Discontinued Wood Grill Cleaning Brush
CCB-W2.description: The Cuisinart® Wood Cleaning Brush is the largest in our selection.  This tool features 14 square inches of stainless steel bristles to clean your grill as fast as possible.  This brush also has a great carved wooden handle that has a classic look and a great hand feel to help make the chore of cleaning a little less painful.

CPG-4000.name: Discontinued Wood Pellet BBQ Grill & Smoker
CPG-4000.description: Get that smoky barbecue flavor right in your backyard! With the Cuisinart® Wood Pellet BBQ Grill & Smoker, enjoy a convenient way to smoke your favorite meats! Increasing in popularity, Pellet Grills are an easy and fun way to smoke meat and start barbecuing. The Wood Pellet BBQ Grill & Smoker is super versatile, giving you the ability to grill, smoke, roast, braise, barbecue and even bake with it. Add pellets to the hopper and set your desired temperature; that’s it. Pellets come in a variety of flavors and can be mixed to create your own personal smoky-flavor.

CTG-00-XCS.name: Discontinued X-Cold™ Cocktail Set
CTG-00-XCS.description: Finally, a cocktail set that keeps drinks ice-cold for hours without getting watered down! With our X-Cold™ Cocktail Set, cocktails always taste freshly made. A stainless steel chamber encased in a freezing shaker preserves cocktails in a deep freeze without letting ice touch the liquid. The result is pure, perfectly ice-cold drinking pleasure, whether enjoying a martini, limoncello, or any specialty drink in the the recipe book included.How it works: Freeze water in the shaker. Measure drink ingredients and pour them through the wide-mouth funnel into the drink chamber. Use the included stirrer to mix the drink, or place the stainless steel cap on and shake. Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy your ice-cold, full-flavored cocktail!

SMK0036AS.name: Discontinued Woodcreek 4-in-1 Pellet Grill
SMK0036AS.description: Surpass expectations with the Cuisinart® Woodcreek 4-in-1 Pellet Grill. Set the bar above all others with a pellet grill that is loaded with features. Sear any steak to perfection with the ceramic briquette insert that allows for high temperatures. Perfect the flavor of charcoal without the hassle, simply insert charcoal tray and light with the turn of a knob. With no shortage of space, the enormous 862 square inches allows you to griddle your favorite dishes while smoking or searing the main course simultaneously. Monitor food easily with the large LCD Bluetooth enabled controller with two meat probes and cooking readouts, the Cuisinart® Easy Connect®  BBQ app, an appliance grade viewing window, as well as two ten-watt halogen lights making seeing inside a breeze. Achieve the perfect smoke ring on any cut of meat with our insulated lid featuring a gasket seal that locks in the flavor. After indulging in your meal cleaning up is as easy as one-two-three with the express ash clean-out system. The Cuisinart® Woodcreek is built for endless possibilities. What will you cook? Exclusively sold at Walmart.

CTG-07-LZ.name: Discontinued Zester
CTG-07-LZ.description: This Zester has nonslip grips that offer a firm and comfortable hold, making it easy to obtain zest from lemons and other citrus fruits.

CTG-00-XS.name: Discontinued X-Cold® Ultimate Cocktail Shaker
CTG-00-XS.description: Finally, a cocktail set that keeps drinks ice-cold for hours without getting watered down! With our X-Cold® Cocktail Shaker, cocktails always taste freshly made. A stainless steel chamber encased in a freezing shaker preserves cocktails in a deep freeze without letting ice touch the liquid. The result is pure, perfectly ice-cold drinking pleasure, whether enjoying a martini, limoncello, or any specialty drink in the the recipe book included.How it works: Freeze water in the shaker. Pour drink ingredients into the drink chamber. Place the stainless steel cap on and shake. Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy your ice-cold, full-flavored cocktail!

DSA22-24.name: Dishwasher Safe Anodized Cookware 10" Open Skillet
DSA22-24.description: Cuisinart's® DS Anodized cookware features Cuisinart’s exclusive ArmorGuard™ protective coating technology, allowing the hard anodized construction to not only offer durability and professional performance, but now the convenience of easy cleanup in the dishwasher. The evolutionary design also features Eterna™, “The World’s Longest Lasting, and Metal Utensil-safe, Non-stick” interior.

CCB-3DLDN.name: Discontinued
CCB-3DLDN.description: Let Cuisinart® transport you across the Atlantic with the sights of the 3D London Cutting Board. Be inspired by the United Kingdom as you prepare your fruits, vegetables, and meats on the cutting 3D images of London for an international delight.

MCP111-20N.name: Double Boiler
MCP111-20N.description: Professional chefs and home cooks recognize the necessity of the double boiler. It rests above water to gently cook foods without scorching them. The rounded design of the stainless steel universal double boiler facilitates easy whisking while slowly cooking a delicate chocolate sauce or a creamy sabayon. Uniquely shaped to fit 2, 3, and 4 quart saucepans, it's a versatile piece in any cookware collection. This Cuisinart® MultiClad Pro Stainless Cookware piece is composed of stainless steel for unsurpassed durability and performance. We guarantee it with a lifetime warranty.

WAF-F40NAS.name: Double Flip Belgian Waffle Maker
WAF-F40NAS.description: Cooking two Belgian waffles at a time to perfection is easy with Cuisinart®'s Double Belgian Waffle Maker. The distinctive rotary feature flips 180 degrees to evenly cook them inside and out. Powered by 1400 watts, this innovative kitchen essential cooks Belgian waffles in minutes, with 5 shade settings to bake them according to preference, from light and fluffy to brown and crispy. To prevent over- or under-cooking, a ready indicator light and beeping alert announce when waffles are ready. Nonstick plates ensure flawlessly formed, deep pocketed Belgian waffles release easily onto the plate, ready for a wide variety of toppings, from fruits and meats to jams and whipped cream. Durable, brushed stainless steel housing adds a sleek, modern touch to any kitchen and wipes clean in seconds.

CTG-00-DB.name: Dough Blender
CTG-00-DB.description: These specialty tools are designed for bakers. Whether making dough or cookies, or cleaning up, these gadgets make it all easier.

CDH-444.name: Drink Stakes Party Pack
CDH-444.description: I think we’ve all encountered the problem of being out on the grass or sand somewhere with a drink and no good place to put it down when playing a game or just hanging out with friends or family. It’s time to stop looking for a nice patch of grass to put your drink down on and allow these drink stakes to keep your beverages in reach! This party pack of drink stakes includes 4 drink holder ground stakes. These can hold wine bottles, soda cans, cups & more. The stakes are built of durable ¼” thick wire construction. The foot-pegs on each stake add leverage to anchor each one securely to the ground. With no tools required for assembly, these stakes are simple and easy to setup at home and then pack up and take with you to the park, beach, or wherever! And the threaded 2 piece design allows them to be stored in a way that takes up half the space.

SS-16DT.name: Drip Tray for Coffee Center® 2-in-1 Coffee Maker

CSO-300DT.name: Drip Tray for Convection Steam Oven

WAF-F40DT.name: Drip Tray for Double Flip Belgian Waffle Maker

EM-200NTRAY.name: Drip Tray for Programmable Espresso Maker

WAF-F30DT.name: Drip Tray for Round Flip Belgian Waffle Maker

EM-15DTGN.name: Drip Tray Grate for Espresso Defined™ Espresso Machine

ICE-48TRAY.name: Drip Tray for Mix It In™ Soft Serve Ice Cream Maker by Cuisinart®

CTG-00-DPW.name: Dual Head Pastry Wheel
CTG-00-DPW.description: Designed for precision cutting, the Cuisinart® Dual Head Pastry Wheel glides through pasta dough, pastry dough, and fondant with ease. The two wheels roll and cut through dough effortlessly, creating perfect hand-cut pasta and pastry, pierogis, and lattice-top pie crust. Crafted from durable stainless steel, the wheels are positioned to provide a clear view of the dough, so every cut is exact. Cut and clean up in minutes with the must-have tool that’s dishwasher safe!

DSA-11.name: Dishwasher Safe Anodized Cookware 11 Piece Set
DSA-11.description: Evolutionary Design - Our exclusive ArmorGuard™ technology offers a rich hard-anodized exterior with the convenience of dishwasher cleanup

DSA22-20.name: Dishwasher Safe Anodized Cookware 8" Open Skillet
DSA22-20.description: Cuisinart's® DS Anodized cookware features Cuisinart’s exclusive ArmorGuard™ protective coating technology, allowing the hard anodized construction to not only offer durability and professional performance, but now the convenience of easy cleanup in the dishwasher. The evolutionary design also features Eterna™, “The World’s Longest Lasting, and Metal Utensil-safe, Nonstick” interior.

CPM-150.name: EasyPop Hot Air Popcorn Maker
CPM-150.description: The Cuisinart® EasyPop® Hot Air Popcorn Maker offers a healthier take on snacking by eliminating fatty oils and using forced hot air to make light, delicious popcorn for snacks or recipes. Simply add kernels to the chamber, turn on the popper and watch as hot and fluffy popcorn pours out of the chute and into a bowl. The Cool Air function chills the chamber making cleanup faster and easier than ever. Flavor the popcorn to taste with sweet or savory sprinklings. Pop 15 cups of corn—enough to treat a crowd—in less than 3 minutes, clean up quickly, and dig into handfuls of hot, healthier, flavorful popcorn.

CTG-00-YS.name: Egg Separator
CTG-00-YS.description: The Cuisinart® yoke separator is great for all your cooking and baking needs, from egg white omelets to meringues. The nonslip bowl grip conveniently rests on the side of your bowls and pans. The raised ridge is great for cracking eggs right over the bowl to eliminate any mess.

CFO-3SSNAS.name: Electric Fondue Pot
CFO-3SSNAS.description:
Dip and dine with the Electric Fondue Set by Cuisinart®.
This custom-heat fondue pot is the fun and modern way
to enjoy savory meat dishes cooked in oil or broth, crusty breads
dipped in gooey melted cheese blends, or decadent desserts dunked
in melted chocolate. Eight extra-long fondue forks let you share
the melting pot with family and friends for memorable meals made
any night of the week. And the nonstick, dishwasher-safe surface
means cleanup is fast and easy!

CEK-41.name: Electric Knife Set with Cutting Board
CEK-41.description: The knife set includes a carving/serving fork and a bamboo cutting board. The power handle, blade and fork ﬁ t into their own tray when not in use, and the cutting board slips underneath to store. Convenient, start to ﬁnish! The ultra-sharp blade on the Cuisinart® Electric Knife carves meats and poultry as quickly and smoothly as it slices bread. The ergonomic handle is comfortable, even with extended use, letting users cut uniformly consistent slices, one after another.  A simple trigger on/off switch turns the knife off the instant the trigger is released.

CEC-10.name: Egg Cooker
CEC-10.description: The Cuisinart® Egg Central appliance has a new two-tiered cooking system that allows ten eggs to be cooked at once. Eggs can be cooked to a hard, medium or soft consistency. The egg cooker also comes with removable trays that can be used to poach eggs and make omelets. Cooking time is controlled precisely by the amount of water added. Fill included measuring beaker to the appropriate range and pour water into cooking plate. The built-in LED light, audible alert, and standby mode help guard against overcooking. All egg favorites can be made in one compact unit.

CTG-07-PC.name: Elements Pizza Cutter
CTG-07-PC.description: This line of gourmet tools has Cuisinart’s trademark logo, elegantly embossed in stainless steel, right on every handle. The black nonslip grips have a firm and comfortable hold to make any task, from stirring to mixing to serving, easy. The Nylon tool heads are safe for nonstick cookware and are heat resistant to 400⁰F. Dishwasher Safe.

MG-100.name: Electric Meat Grinder
MG-100.description: The Cuisinart® Electric Meat Grinder effortlessly grinds a wide variety of meats, guaranteeing freshness and quality when making family favorites like burgers, meatloaf, meatballs, sausages, chili, and pâtés. The powerful 300-watt motor quickly grinds up to 3 pounds per minute, for professional grinding results. The grinder offers plenty of options with 2 cutting plates for medium and coarse thickness, as well as 2 sausage attachments for breakfast links and regular sausages. The single on/off switch, along with a reverse feature make operation as simple as can be.

CFE-V20.name: Elite Valloire Collection
CFE-V20.description: With Cuisinart® Flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® Flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience.

CFE-20PF.name: Elite Jolie Collection 20 piece Flatware Set
CFE-20PF.description: With Cuisinart® Flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® Flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience.

CFE-MA20.name: Elite Maree Collection
CFE-MA20.description: With Cuisinart® Flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® Flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience.

EM-640.name: Espresso Bar™ Grind & Brew Espresso Machine
EM-640.description: Craft café-quality espresso beverages with ease, right on your countertop with the Cuisinart® Espresso Bar™ Grind & Brew Espresso Machine. Customize your espresso experience with 16 grind settings that let you choose the perfect texture—from fine for espresso to coarse for a French press. Witness the artistry of espresso extraction with the stainless steel bottomless portafilter that ensures consistency with every shot. Top it off with rich, creamy froth from the easy-to-use frothing wand, creating a delightful finish for your favorite drinks. Plus, the cold extraction feature means you can enjoy refreshing iced beverages anytime. With an integrated accessory tray and a 75-ounce removable water reservoir, every detail has been designed for your convenience.

EM-320.name: Espresso Bar™ Espresso Machine
EM-320.description: Be your own barista and indulge in the café experience from the comfort of home with the Cuisinart® Espresso Bar™ Espresso Machine. Make espresso shots that burst with robust flavor and enticing aroma with 20 bars of pressure and a stainless steel bottomless portafilter for consistency every time you brew. Whether you’re in the mood for a frothy cappuccino or a refreshing iced drink, the easy-to-use frothing wand and cold extraction feature make it effortless. Create drinks that are uniquely yours—accommodating up to 20 oz. travel size for taking your favorite brews on the go. With a removable water reservoir and an integrated accessory tray for all the essentials, crafting the perfect beverage has never been more convenient.

EM-160.name: Espresso Bar™ Slim Espresso Machine
EM-160.description: Experience the art of espresso with the Cuisinart® Espresso Bar™ Slim Espresso Machine. Effortlessly create refreshing iced drinks with the cold extraction feature, while the stainless steel bottomless portafilter lets you witness the magic of perfectly crafted espresso. Customize each sip with our easy-to-use frothing wand, adding luscious, creamy froth to your cappuccinos and lattes. Designed for convenience, it accommodates up to 20 oz. travel mugs, so you can take your creations on the go. Be your own barista and indulge in endless espresso possibilities—every sip is a delightful escape!

ECH-4GM.name: Elemental 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder
ECH-4GM.description: More convenient than ever, the Cuisinart® Elemental CollectionTM 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder effortlessly handles a variety of food preparation tasks such as chopping, grinding, and puréeing. The SmartPower® blade has a patented auto-reversing ability with a sharp edge for delicate chopping and pureeing soft foods, while the blunt edge grinds through spices and harder foods. Additionally, the revolutionary BladeLock System keeps the blade secure during processing and pouring. It’s cutting-edge food prep from Cuisinart!

RPB-100.name: EvolutionX Cordless Compact Blender
RPB-100.description: Compact, cordless convenience meets full-size professional performance. Powered by 7.4 volts of lithium ion efficiency and easily rechargeable with a USB cord, the EvolutionX Cordless Rechargeable Personal Blender does it all, from blending smoothies and shakes to crushing ice and pureeing soups. Portable. Powerful. Perfect for use at home or on the go!

CH-4DC.name: Elite Collection 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder
CH-4DC.description: The Cuisinart® Elite Collection™ 4 Cup Chopper/Grinder handles food preparation such as chopping, grinding, and puréeing effortlessly, making your kitchen tasks easier. The unique SmartPower™ blade has a patented auto-reversing ability with a sharp edge so you can chop delicate ingredients and purée soft foods, while the blunt edge can grind through your favorite spices and harder foods. The superior BladeLock™ System feature keeps you safe by securing the blade in place during processing and pouring.

CWO-25.name: Electric Wine Opener
CWO-25.description: This automatic corkscrew packs the power to open up to 50 bottles of wine on just one full charge. A stainless steel exterior makes it attractive, durable and easy to clean. It’s the perfect electric wine opener!

CBM-22.name: Espresso & Coffee Conical Burr Grinder
CBM-22.description: Enjoy the perfect grind made easy with the Cuisinart Espresso & Coffee Conical Burr Grinder. This professional-quality essential for any espresso lover grinds evenly and reduces heat to release the most robust flavor and aroma. Customize your grind with 35 grind settings from extra-fine for espresso to coarse for French Press and adjust the amount from 1-14 cups. Anti-static prevents buildup, minimizing mess waste and maximizing fresh-ground coffee. The removable 8-oz. bean hopper features a silicone-sealed lid to keep beans fresh.

RWO-100.name: EvolutionX Cordless 4-in-1 Wine Opener
RWO-100.description: Everything you need to maximize your wine enjoyment is right here. Complete cordless convenience makes opening bottles easier than ever. Open up to 50 bottles on a single charge. The foil cutter neatly removes foil seals. Use the aerator to bring out wine's full flavor, and the preserver to retain freshness. To recharge, simply plug the USB cable into the port. Quick. Easy. Exceptional.

RHM-100.name: EvolutionX Cordless Hand Mixer
RHM-100.description: Introducing mixing taken to a new level of professional performance and cordless convenience. Powered by 7.4 volts of lithium ion efficiency and easily rechargeable with a USB cord, the EvolutionX Cordless Rechargeable Hand Mixer features removable beaters for whipping cream, beating eggs, mixing batter, and more. Compact yet mighty, it powers through any mixing task.

CTG-00-ICL.name: Extra Large Silicone Ice Cube Tray
CTG-00-ICL.description: Makes six jumbo square ice cubes.

RHB-100TG.name: EvolutionX Cordless Hand Blender
RHB-100TG.description: Introducing blending taken to a new level of professional performance and cordless convenience. Powered by 7.4 volts of lithium ion efficiency and easily rechargeable with a USB cord, the EvolutionX Cordless Rechargeable Hand Blender does it all, from blending smoothies to whipping cream, mixing sauces and more. Includes 30 oz. beaker and chef's whisk.

RMC-100.name: EvolutionX Cordless Mini Chopper
RMC-100.description: Introducing the cord-free compact chopper that maximizes powerful performance and portable convenience. Equipped with a 4 cup capacity work bowl and precision stainless steel blade, this mini yet mighty kitchen essential makes quick work of any chopping task. 7.4 volts of lithium ion power—easily recharged with a USB cord—provide peak efficiency.

CFE-FP20.name: Fampoux 20 Piece Set
CFE-FP20.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience.

ICE-FD50.name: FastFreeze™ Max Ice Cream Maker
ICE-FD50.description:
With the Cuisinart® FastFreeze™ Max Ice Cream Maker, creating homemade frozen treats is as easy as 1-2-3—Pre-Freeze, Blend & Enjoy. This powerful electric ice cream maker works as a versatile ice cream machine for home, transforming frozen ingredients into smooth, creamy desserts in minutes. Simply prepare your ingredients and freeze them for 24 hours. Then select a preset, push down the wand, and enjoy fresh, flavorful creations from your own countertop ice cream maker.
Designed for customizable convenience, the Cuisinart® FastFreeze™ Max Ice Cream Maker is more than an ice cream machine—it’s also one of the most versatile frozen drink makers. Create everything from classic ice cream and dairy-free treats to protein milkshakes, fruit-forward sorbets, smoothies, and slush-style beverages with total control. With five preset functions for ice cream, sorbet, milkshakes, slushies, and mix-ins, it works beautifully as the ideal ice cream machine for home. But it doubles as a compact slushie machine for home, making it easy to craft icy favorites whenever the craving strikes. 
Count on this combination frozen dessert maker and slushy machine   to deliver smooth, consistent results every time, with two included 1-pint dessert cups that make treats easy to share. Compact and quiet, it’s the sleek countertop ice cream maker with a detachable design that’s easy to store in a pantry or cabinet. And with dishwasher-safe cups, cleanup is just as easy as dessert itself.
Fast, fun, and endlessly customizable, the Cuisinart® FastFreeze™ Max Ice Cream Maker turns frozen ingredients into moments worth sharing.

ICE-FD10.name: FastFreeze™ Ice Cream Maker
ICE-FD10.description: With the Cuisinart® FastFreeze™ Ice Cream Maker, you can prepare half a pint of flavorful ice cream in just 3 minutes at the touch of a button! The ice cream machine features five preset settings, making it so easy to create ice cream, milkshakes, slushies, sorbet, and mix-ins from pre-frozen ingredients. This ice cream machine is small enough to store away, and cleanup is a breeze.

DLC-6FD.name: Fine Disc for 8 Cup Food Processor

CGG-8500.name: Five Burner Gas Grill
CGG-8500.description: The Cuisinart® 5-Burner Gas Grill is the perfect BBQ for any level of griller! The 5 independently controlled burners produce a total of 50,000 BTUs of cooking power spread evenly across the 460 square inch cast iron cooking surface. The grill is also equipped with an additional side burner that provides 12,000 BTUs and is great for stews, corn, clams and more. And if you’re looking for additional space, the warming rack above the cooking surface provides an additional 202 square inches. With a reliable and easy twist-to-start ignition your grill will start up time after time. And no grill is complete without side tables. The Cuisinart® 5-Burner Gas Grill has two 18-inch x 13-inch stainless steel side tables that allow for extra room while prepping and grilling. Unlock your inner griller with the Cuisinart® 5-Burner Gas Grill!

CTG-00-SIF.name: Flour Sifter
CTG-00-SIF.description: Banish clumps from your flour with perfectly sifted ingredients thanks to our stainless steel Flour Sifter!

CEG-1302.name: Flavorboost™ 8-in-1 Outdoor Electric Grill
CEG-1302.description:
Plug into bold, open-flame flavors you’ve always missed with the FlavorBoost™ 8-in-1 Outdoor Electric Grill.

Unlike ordinary electric grills, FlavorBoost™ delivers the caramelization and authentic BBQ flavor electric grills typically lack. Our dedicated Smoke Drawer infuses smoky taste into any cook, while the built-in moisture cup subtly enhances unique flavors and ensures your food stays juicy and tender. 

The FlavorBoost™ is more than an outdoor electric grill—it’s your complete outdoor electric cooking station. With eight cooking functions—grill, smoke, air fry, broil, roast, bake, dehydrate, and keep warm—you can explore endless recipes. Intuitive controls and a smart temperature probe make cooking effortless, auto-switching to keep warm mode when your food is ready. 

The spacious cooking area handles family-sized meals, while its compact footprint makes it ideal for apartments, patios, and tailgates. 

No propane, no charcoal—just plug into the outdoors and unleash your culinary creative freedom.

CTG-00-FPSP.name: Food Processor Spatula
CTG-00-FPSP.description: Get the most out of your food processing while minimizing mess and waste! Crafted to fit any 7+ cup work bowl, this custom spatula is perfect for mixing, scraping, folding, spreading, and more.

CPT-2110P.name: Fold 'n Go Prep Table & Grill Stand
CPT-2110P.description: Upgrade your outdoor cooking experience with the Cuisinart Fold 'n Go Prep Table & Grill Stand—the ultimate folding table for camping, tailgating, and backyard barbecues! This versatile table features a durable 24" x 20" steel work surface that doubles as a food prep station and grill stand, supporting up to 50 lbs. Its easy-to-use X-frame design sets up in seconds and folds flat for compact storage and transport. Utility additions like a built-in trash bag holder, paper towel rack, and 4 tool hooks keep your cooking essentials organized and within reach. Lightweight, portable, and built for convenience, the Fold ‘n Go Prep Table & Grill Stand is the perfect companion for any outdoor adventure.

CTG-00-FS2.name: Food Scraper
CTG-00-FS2.description: The Cuisinart® Food Scraper is perfect to use for dough and chopping, as well as scraping food particles from flat surfaces. The food scraper has a soft-grip handle and stainless steel blade. Food scraper also has easy-to-read measure marks to ease of use.

FCT22-24NS.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless 10” Nonstick Frying Pan
FCT22-24NS.description: Cuisinart's Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 10" Non-Stick Frying Pan is made in France to the highest standards of the world’s finest kitchens.

CTG-00-SPI4.name: Food Spiralizer
CTG-00-SPI4.description: This multifunctional Food Spiralizer is equipped with Cuisinart’s exclusive food processor blade technology, which offers home cooks three cutting options: thin or thick julienne, and ribbon slice. The unit’s vertical design makes for easy spiralizing, and is ideal for making zoodles, onion straws, potato chips, fruit chips, and more. Additionally, its BladeLock design eliminates the need to touch or handle sharp blades, and the entire unit is dishwasher safe.

CF3-RING.name: Fork Ring Holder For Fondue Set

FCT22-30H.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 12" Frying Pan with Helper Handle
FCT22-30H.description: Our French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware is made in France to the highest standards, bringing world class cookware to your kitchen. The 12" Frying Pan with Helper Handle is perfect for omelets, burgers, crepes, and Sautéing vegetables, with a useful handle to make transporting the pan when filled.

FCT22-20NS.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 8" Non-Stick Frying Pan
FCT22-20NS.description: Made in France to the highest standards of the world’s finest kitchens, the 8" Nonstick Frying Pan will be your go-to pan.

FCT22-30HNS.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 12" Nonstick Frying Pan with Helper Handle
FCT22-30HNS.description: From entertaining guests to dinners at home, Cuisinart's® Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 12" Non-Stick Frying Pan with Helper Handle is made in France to the highest standards of the world’s finest kitchens. It's superior Triple-Ply construction eliminates hot spots and allows for even heat distribution. This Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware can be ued on the stovetop, broiler, and is even freezer safe.

FCT-13.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 13 Piece Set
FCT-13.description: This 13 piece set is the home chef’s dream of stainless cookware. These multifunctional and elegant pieces go anywhere a cook desires — on the stove, under the broiler or right into the oven. The set offers everything food lovers need to create world-class meals at home! Made in France.

FCT-10.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 10 Piece Set
FCT-10.description: This 10 Piece French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Set is the perfect choice for home cooks! The set is conveniently equipped with essential pieces for creating multi-course gourmet feasts to everyday family meals. Cook with ease and elegance!

FCT22-20.name: French Classic Tri-Ply Stainless Cookware 8" Frying Pan
FCT22-20.description: This first class 8" Frying Pan is perfect for omelets, burgers, crepes, and Sautéing vegetables in timeless style.

CTG-00-FEL.name: Fresh Edge Lemon
CTG-00-FEL.description: Keep food fresher longer with these handy food holders! The airtight design keeps cut vegetables fresher and helps contains odors. The fun designs make them easy to spot in the refrigerator and they are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup!

CTG-00-FET.name: Fresh Edge Tomato

CTG-00-DG.name: Fresh Slice® Drum Grater
CTG-00-DG.description: The Cuisinart® Freshslice Drum grater lets you create fine or coarse shreds or slices of a variety of cheeses, nuts, veggies, and fruits. Three cutting drums and a food pusher lets you prep food in less time! The pusher keeps fingers safely away from the blade and lets you grate or slice them right down to the ends to reduce waste. Easy to put together, take apart and removable parts are dishwasher safe!

CCF-31FS.name: Fridge Shelf for 3.1 Cu. Ft. Compact Fridge

CTG-00-FEA.name: Fresh Edge Avocado
CTG-00-FEA.description: Keep food fresher longer with these handy food holders! The airtight design keeps cut vegetables fresher and helps contains odors. The fun designs make them easy to spot in the refrigerator and they are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup!

CTG-16-GP.name: Primary Garlic Press
CTG-16-GP.description: Cuisinart® combines classic design and comfortable handling in the Primary line of tools and gadgets. Home chefs will love this selection of everyday tools for prepping and cooking! Nonslip ergonomic handles and textured thumb rests provide comfort as well as control. Nylon heads on tools are heat resistant to 420°F and are safe for use with nonstick cookware.

CTG-14-GP.name: FusionPro Garlic Press
CTG-14-GP.description: The FusionPro collection features sleek, stainless steel with a red accent ring. Easily presses garlic for quick meal prep.

CTG-00-GS.name: Garlic Slicer and Grater
CTG-00-GS.description: Create flavorful variety with ingredients safely and precisely sliced and grated using the Cuisinart® Garlic Slicer. This mini mandolin makes quick work of cutting garlic cloves, ginger root, whole nutmeg, cheese, citrus peels and more. Built-in safety features protect hands and fingers from nasty nicks and cuts. Fingers never get close to the blades as small foods are pushed and prepared right into the chamber. Hold the slicer by the non-slip handle directly over a mixing bowl or pan to conveniently add ingredients or set the tool down and grate onto a cutting board. The non-slip base keeps the cutter from slipping and the arched design provides plenty of space for sliced foods to collect. Compact and dishwasher safe, this 2-in-1 kitchen essential with stainless steel slicing and grater blades comes with a protective blade cover and lifetime warranty.

CTG-24-GP.name: Profile Garlic Press
CTG-24-GP.description: The 7-piece Profile Collection includes essential utensils with nonslip, ergonomic handles, featuring durable stainless steel gadget heads.

IC-50.name: Fruit Scoop™ Frozen Dessert Maker Attachment
IC-50.description: Make fresh fruit desserts and ice cream in just 10-25 minutes in the 1.5 Quart Fruit Scoop™ Frozen Dessert Maker Attachment! Once the bowl has frozen fully (may take up to 24 hours), remove from your freezer and lock into place on the stand mixer. Attach the fresh fruit or ice cream paddle, and get creative! Only for use with SM-50 and SMD-50 series stand mixer. Does not fit SM-35 series.

AMW-90GT.name: Glass Tray for 3-in-1 Microwave Air Fryer Plus

CMW-110GT.name: Glass Tray for Microwave with Sensor Cook & Inverter Technology

53G-13SG.name: GreenChef Ceramica XT Nonstick Cookware
53G-13SG.description: Our exclusive Cuisinart Ceramica® XT ceramic nonstick technology is reinforced with titanium for superior release and petroleum, PTFE, PFOA and PFOS free to deliver exceptional performance that all chefs will love! Aluminum core provides even heat and best heat retention. Clear glass covers let you monitor results while cooking. Recycled stainless steel handles allow for a secure, comfortable grip. Packaging is made from recycled cardboard and printed in soy ink. Set consists of : 1.5 Qt. Saucepan w/ Cover, 2.5 Qt. Saucepan w/ Cover, 3 Qt. Sauté Pan w/ Cover, 8″ Skillet, 10″ Skillet, 6 Qt. Stockpot, Bamboo Solid Spoon, Bamboo Slotted Turner, Bamboo Slotted Spoon.

C77SS-13P.name: Graphix Collection 13 Piece Stainless Steel Knife Block Set
C77SS-13P.description: This Graphix Collection 13 piece Stainless Steel Cutlery Block Set features superior stainless steel blades for precision cutting. Ergonomically designed handles are textured for comfortable control, and add a sleek look to any kitchen.

GGI22-24.name: GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized Induction-Ready 10" Skillet
GGI22-24.description: Cuisinart® is leading the way in eco-friendly branded cookware with our new GreenGourmet™ line. Exclusive Cuisinart® Ceramica™ nonstick technology is ceramic based instead of petroleum based, helping to conserve existing oil supplies and the coating is applied at a temperature one half that of conventional nonsticks. And it’s completely free of PTFE and PFOA. The cookware’s hard anodized construction provides high heat conductivity, which requires less energy to reach desired cooking temperatures. Riveted stainless handles stay cool on the stovetop and are made from 70% recycled stainless steel. Equipped with an induction base-safe for all stovetops. Today, more and more home cooks are going green… and so is Cuisinart® cookware!

GG-12.name: GreenGourmet Hard Anodized 12 Piece Set
GG-12.description: Cuisinart® is leading the way in eco-friendly branded cookware with our new GreenGourmet™ line. Exclusive Cuisinart® Ceramica™ nonstick technology is ceramic based instead of petroleum based, helping to conserve existing oil supplies and the coating is applied at a temperature one half that of conventional nonsticks. And it’s completely free of PTFE and PFOA. The cookware’s hard anodized construction provides high heat conductivity, which requires less energy to reach desired cooking temperatures. Riveted stainless handles stay cool on the stovetop and are made from 70% recycled stainless steel. Today, more and more home cooks are going green… and so is Cuisinart® cookware!

CSS-2424Z.name: Gravity Salt and Pepper Mill
CSS-2424Z.description: Season to your liking with the Cuisinart Gravity Salt and Pepper Mill Set. This grinder set is easy to use with one hand, simply turn upside down to activate and get fresh ground salt or pepper. Easily adjust the grinder knob to choose the coarseness of your liking. Rotate clockwise for fine particles and rotate counterclockwise to grind coarse. The auto-on light helps see what you are seasoning while grilling at night. Takes 6 x AAA batteries (not included). Each shaker holds 2/3 cups of spices so you won't need to frequently refill.

C77SS-15P.name: Graphix 15 Piece Knife Block Set
C77SS-15P.description: The Graphix Collection 15 Piece Cutlery Block Set turns heads with its textured handles for easy grip, sharp fine blades, and effortless efficiency.

GGI22-20.name: Greengourmet® Hard Anodized Induction-Ready 8" Skillet
GGI22-20.description: Cuisinart® is leading the way in eco-friendly branded cookware with our new GreenGourmet™ line. Riveted stainless handles stay cool on the stovetop and are made from 70% recycled stainless steel. Equipped with an induction base-safe for all stovetops. Today, more and more home cooks are going green… and so is Cuisinart® cookware!

CSGS-001.name: Griddle Food Mover
CSGS-001.description: Make griddle cooking faster and easier with the Cuisinart Griddle Food Mover! This extra-large stainless steel spatula acts as a shovel-like scoop, letting you transfer up to 5 cups of cooked food in one go. Perfect for griddles and barbecues, it’s a must-have for flipping, turning, and scooping scrambled eggs, rice, stir-fry, home fries, or even scallops. Designed for efficiency and durability, this tool ensures a quick transition between batches so you can keep the food coming at your next cookout or barbecue.

GR-6SNAS.name: Griddler® with Smoke-Less Mode
GR-6SNAS.description: Introducing the Griddler® with Smoke-Less Mode, an innovative kitchen essential that makes it easy to cook delicious grilled meals indoors—without all the smoke. Specially designed plates reduce grease while precision temperature control maintains just the right heat for grilling beef, poultry, fish, and pork to perfection, with maximum flavor and minimal smoke. Engineered especially for smoke-less indoor cooking of grilled favorites all year round, this one-of-a-kind appliance also includes all the Griddler® features home chefs love. And because there's a removable drip tray and the plates are nonstick and dishwasher safe, cleanups are a breeze.

GR-4NNAS.name: Griddler® Indoor Grill - Griddle and Panini Press
GR-4NNAS.description: With five separate cooking options, the Cuisinart® Griddler® can handle everything from pancakes and sausages to grilled cheese to steaks, hamburgers, and panini. A floating cover and one set of reversible plates turn the Griddler® into a contact grill, panini press, full grill, full griddle, or half grill/half griddle. Dual temperature controls ensure everything is perfectly cooked every time on the removable dishwasher safe nonstick cooking plates for easy meals and clean up.

CCB-1000A.name: Grill Renew Steam Cleaner Brush
CCB-1000A.description: Give your grill the deep steam cleaning it needs with the Cuisinart® Grill Renew Steam Cleaner Brush! Cleaning with steam is the quickest and most effective way to clean your dirty grill grates. The cleaning head is constructed of silicone and wrapped in a super durable, heat resistant aramid fiber fabric. Dunk the cleaning head into water, ensuring it is completely soaked, and begin scrubbing your pre-heated grill surface. The heat from the grill will combine with the water on the brush head to create steam and give your grill grates a true deep cleaning. The hard silicone head, along with the arched handle design and center knob grip, allow for maximum leverage while cleaning tough messes. The square shape of the cleaning head makes the sides of the head ideal for cleaning in between grill grates. The cleaning head is detachable from the handle and can be placed in the top rack of your dishwasher for easy cleaning. The Grill Renew Brush is a safe and effective alternative to steel wire bristle brushes. Patent Pending.

GGI22-30.name: GreenGourmet® Hard Anodized Induction-Ready 12" Skillet
GGI22-30.description: Cuisinart® is leading the way in eco-friendly branded cookware with our new GreenGourmet™ line. Exclusive Cuisinart® Ceramica™ nonstick technology is ceramic based instead of petroleum based, helping to conserve existing oil supplies and the coating is applied at a temperature one half that of conventional nonsticks. Today, more and more home cooks are going green… and so is Cuisinart® cookware!

CGG-059.name: Grillster Portable Gas Grill
CGG-059.description: The Cuisinart Grillster Portable Gas Grill delivers sleek design, high performance, and ultimate convenience—all in one compact package! With a powerful 8,000 BTU burner and a spacious 146-square-inch enameled steel cooking grate, this grill reaches searing temperatures of over 600°F, ensuring every meal is cooked to perfection. Its lightweight, portable design is perfect for camping, tailgating, or grilling at home, and the locking lid ensures hassle-free transport. Cleanup is a breeze with the dishwasher-safe cooking grate, while the tool-free, 5-minute assembly gets you grilling faster. The Grillster combines style, performance, and ease, making it the ultimate choice for on-the-go grilling.

CPO-700.name: Grill Top Pizza Oven Kit
CPO-700.description: Turn your grill into a pizza-making machine with the Cuisinart® Grill Top Pizza Oven Kit! The kit includes the Grill Top Pizza Oven Box and a 12" Aluminum Pizza Peel. The Grill Top Pizza Oven Box is powered solely by your grill. The oven sits directly on the cooking surface of your grill and is powered by the heat source of your grill. The oven features a cordierite baking stone that is ideal for retaining heat to produce a perfectly cooked crust. The inside of the oven features stainless steel sides that provide reflective heat to the top of your pizza for evenly cooked toppings. The oven is equipped with a temperature gauge that allows you to easily track the oven's temperature while in use. The oven can be used for much more than just pizza. It is perfect for baking and roasting a variety of foods like breads, fish, chicken, macaroni and cheese and so much more. The 12" Aluminum Pizza Peel is the perfect tool for easily transferring pizza to and from the oven. The peel features a stylish wooden handle that folds down to allow for compact storage. The Cuisinart® Grill Top Pizza Oven Kit work with gas, charcoal, or pellet grills and will fit most 2-6+ burner gas grills. Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CPK-180P.name: Grilling Prep and Serve Melamine Trays -Small
CPK-180P.description: Streamline your grilling process and ensure food safety with the Small Cuisinart Grilling Prep and Serve Melamine Trays. These trays take the hassle out of grilling with a two-tray system designed for safety and convenience. Use the red tray to prep and transport raw meat, then switch to the black tray for serving cooked food—keeping cross-contamination off your menu. Made from durable, shatter-resistant melamine, these lightweight trays are perfect for handling up to 20 lbs., whether it's a whole chicken or a platter of barbecue favorites. The trays nest together for compact storage, are dishwasher safe for quick cleanup, and remain cool to the touch, ensuring a smooth transition from grill to table. Sleek, functional, and tailored for solo or small-group grilling, these trays are a must-have for barbecue enthusiasts.

COM-099.name: Grilling Oil Mister
COM-099.description: The Grilling Oil Mister is a fast and easy way to get a nice misted coating of olive oil on your grill or food. The speed at which you spray the mister will allow you to get a direct spray or an even mist. Not only is the mister great for giving flavor to food, but it also allows you to prevent the sticking of food to your cooking surface. The Grilling Oil Mister is easy to clean and dishwasher safe, so it is one less thing to worry about when you've finished your meal.

CPK-210.name: Grilling Prep and Serve Melamine Trays -Large
CPK-210.description: Streamline your grilling process and ensure food safety with the Large Cuisinart Grilling Prep and Serve Melamine Trays. These trays take the hassle out of grilling with a two-tray system designed for safety and convenience. Use the red tray to prep and transport raw meat, then switch to the black tray for serving cooked food—keeping cross-contamination off your menu. Made from durable, shatter-resistant melamine, these lightweight trays are perfect for handling up to 20 lbs., whether it's a whole chicken or a platter of barbecue favorites. The trays nest together for compact storage, are dishwasher safe for quick cleanup, and remain cool to the touch, ensuring a smooth transition from grill to table. Sleek, functional, and tailored large-group grilling, these trays are a must-have for barbecue enthusiasts. Fits up to 9 burgers.

CGL-330.name: Grilluminate Expanding LED Grill Light
CGL-330.description: The Grilluminate Extending Grill Light is designed to keep you grilling long into those summer nights.  It attaches to your grill in seconds and with the touch of a button 9 bright LEDs light your entire grill surface.  Our unique extending sides increase your light spread allowing you to see more and cook with ease.  This light is made of durable glass reinforced nylon to handle the rigors of grilling and its sleek design will look great with any grill.

CPK-200.name: Grilling Prep and Serve Trays
CPK-200.description: Streamline your grilling process and ensure food safety with the Medium Cuisinart Grilling Prep and Serve Melamine Trays. DCG-12BC.name: Grind Central Coffee Grinder
DCG-12BC.description: With the Grind Central® Coffee Grinder, you can easily process up to 90g/3.2oz of beans at once, enough to make up to 18 cups of fresh coffee! With useful measurement markings inside the removal stainless steel bowl, you can grind the exact quantity of beans you need for your next cup or pot of coffee at the touch of a button.

CRHC-22B.name: Half Circle Wall Rack
CRHC-22B.description: Bring your cookware out from the cupboards and into the heart of the home with the Cuisinart® Half Circle Wall Rack. Designed to complement any kitchen, the wall rack is available in brushed stainless steel, oil brushed bronze, and matte black.

98-11TR.name: Heritage™ Stainless Collection
98-11TR.description: Introducing Cuisinart’s newest stainless assortment, Cuisinart Heritage™ Stainless Collection! Inspired by our beginnings, we combined the traditional triple rivet handle design with our bestselling material, stainless. The stunning new handle, is beautifully crafted with a matte black finish and brilliant stainless steel rivets. The pieces in this collection are versatile enough to bring from oven to table and are dishwasher safe for quick and easy cleanup. Set includes 1.5 qt. saucepan with cover, 3 qt. saucepan with cover, 3.5 qt. sauté pan with helper handle and cover, 6 qt. stockpot with cover, 8″ nonstick skillet, 10″ skillet and steamer insert.

CGM-520.name: Heat Resistant Silicone Gloves (2-Pack)
CGM-520.description: The Cuisinart® Heat Resistant Silicone Gloves are perfect for working with a grill or smoker. Since the gloves are heat resistant up to 425⁰F, you won’t have any issue making adjustments to air vents, cooking racks, or removing anything from a hot surface. This two-pack includes two ambidextrous gloves so you can easily share the gloves with a friend or use them both at the same time. And don’t worry about getting these gloves dirty because you can toss them in the dishwasher and they’ll look as good as new!

CCB-500.name: Heavy Duty Griddle Scraper
CCB-500.description: Easily remove burnt, caked-on residue from your griddle with the Cuisinart® Heavy Duty Griddle Scraper! The ergonomic design has an easy grip handle allowing you to place more pressure on the stainless steel blade for a better clean.

FR-16.name: Hot/Cold Foam Milk Frother
FR-16.description: Top off lattes, cappuccinos, macchiatos, and more with rich, creamy foam made with the Cuisinart Hot/Cold Foam Milk Frother. At the touch of a button, it makes up to 4 oz. of hot or cold froth for all your specialty beverages or heats up to 8 oz. of hot milk. Whip up thick foam with the frothing whisk or use the milk-warming stirrer when heating up milk. Designed with an easy-grip handle and spout, this innovative frother makes it easy to make barista-worthy latte art. And the nonstick milk tank, wipe-off exterior, and dishwasher-safe lid make it easy to clean.

CGSS-118.name: Honey Sriracha Seasoning
CGSS-118.description: Cuisinart’s Honey Sriracha seasoning comes from the classic Thai chili sauce transformed into a seasoning! Sriracha is the perfect blend of heat, salt, and spice. Honey and bright chilis to sweeten and punch up the flavor. Perfect as a rub on meats or poultry or as a seasoning on your sauces, soups, and dressings. Use as a dry rub for grilling by rubbing or sprinkling 1-3 teaspoons of seasoning per pound of meat; adjust to taste. Use as a paste by adding 1 Tablespoon of olive oil for every 1 teaspoon of seasoning and brush on just before cooking.
