CNTB-555.description: The Cuisinart® Non-Stick Grilling Basket is a great substitute for a typical kabob, keeps foods from fall through the cooking grate without the need for skewers. Fill the basket with veggies, shrimp, cubed meats, or for any small foods that you want to grill and lock it in place. As foods cook they will absorb the delicious smoky flavor that only comes from grilling. The elongated handle makes turning easy and safe, it folds for convenient storage. The non-stick wires ensure your food won't stick - making clean-up is a breeze.

CNW-328.name: Non Stick Grill Wok
CNW-328.description: The Cuisinart® 11 x 11 Non-Stick Grill Wok is a simple way to bring stir fry and other fun dishes to the grill. This wok features raised sides to hold your food in while perforations let you get the real grilling experience. The non-stick surface keeps your food from sticking to the grill surface and makes clean up simple. This grill wok is the perfect addition to any gas or charcoal grill to provide you with an easy to cook and easy to clean surface for all those difficult foods. NOTE: This wok is not dishwasher safe and as with other non-stick we recommend using nylon, wood or bamboo tools to prevent chipping and scratching the surface.

CGSS-777.name: Nashville Hot Seasoning
CGSS-777.description: Although the backstory of Nashville Hot Chicken is pretty funny, this seasoning is no joke! The Cuisinart Nashville Hot Seasoning features a combination of a bold blend of spices with hints of chili powder to create a spicy, peppery, savory infusion of flavor. This seasoning is great for grilling and will take any meal to the next level; it can be used as a dry rub, seasoning, paste, or topical seasoning. From the assurance of quality ingredients and creation to the spicy and savory flavoring, The Nashville Hot Seasoning is sure to become a staple seasoning next to your grill!

P57-11BK.name: Nonstick 11 Piece Set
P57-11BK.description: Nonstick construction heats quickly and distributes heat evenly, eliminating hot spots. Durable 3-layer nonstick cooking surface for healthier cooking. Lasting food release and easy cleaning. Handles are designed to provide a secure and comfortable grip. Riveted stick handles stay cool on the stovetop. Glass lids fit tight to lock in flavor, moisture and nutrients. Covers are made from tempered glass for superior durability. Glass lids are oven safe to 350°. Rims of cookware are tapered for convenient, drip-free pouring. Cookware is oven safe to 350°F and freezer safe for easy storage. Kitchen tools feature ergonomic handles and are dishwasher safe.

C77SS-19P.name: Normandy 19 Piece Knife Block Set
C77SS-19P.description: The Normandy Collection 19 Piece Cutlery Block Set is a beautiful range that brings style to any kitchen. Cuisinart® adds innovative lines, looks, and textures to its expanding collection of cutlery block sets. New blade surfaces, unique textured handles, and a selection of both knife styles and block styles let consumers choose you cutting tools that fit their kitchen décor as well as your personal cooking styles.

CTG-01-LD.name: Nylon Ladle
CTG-01-LD.description: Cuisinart® has even more of what it takes to cook, including colors to match any kitchen! This line of kitchen tools and gadgets features soft-grip ergonomic handles and is designed to lie flat, so they never tip or roll. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 400°F and safe for all non-stick cookware.

C77NS-7P.name: Nonstick Edge 7 Piece Knife Block Set
C77NS-7P.description: The Cuisinart® Nonstick Edge Collection offers blades with grooves to keep food from adhering to the blade and make slicing easier. These finely honed and tapered blades are made of premium high-carbon stainless steel. Their easy handling, comfortable soft grip, and handsome professional look make them a perfect addition to any kitchen. Protective nonstick coating for long-lasting use.

CTG-07-FT.name: Nylon Flexible Turner (Square)
CTG-07-FT.description: This line of gourmet tools has Cuisinart’s trademark logo, elegantly embossed in stainless steel, right on every handle. The black nonslip grips have a firm and comfortable hold to make any task, from stirring to mixing to serving, easy. The Nylon tool heads are safe for nonstick cookware and are heat resistant to 400⁰F. Dishwasher Safe.

CTG-01-PS.name: Nylon Pasta Server
CTG-01-PS.description: Cuisinart® has even more of what it takes to cook, including colors to match any kitchen! This line of kitchen tools and gadgets features soft-grip ergonomic handles and is designed to lie flat, so they never tip or roll. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 400°F and safe for all non-stick cookware.

CTG-01-SK.name: Nylon Skimmer
CTG-01-SK.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Curve Handle Line, this kitchen tool features a soft-grip ergonomic handle that is designed to lie flat so it will not tip or roll. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 400F, and are safe on non-stick cookware. Dishwasher Safe.

C55CB-9PR.name: Nonstick Color 9 Piece Cutlery and Cutting Board Set
C55CB-9PR.description:
Cuisinart Advantage 9-piece non-stick coated knife and cutting board set includes: 
Red trim nonslip cutting board
8"" Chef Knife
7"" Santoku Knife
6.5"" Serrated Utility Knife 
3.5"" Paring Knife 
All knives include matching blade guards for safe and easy storage

CTG-01-LT.name: Nylon Slotted Turner
CTG-01-LT.description: Cuisinart® has even more of what it takes to cook, including colors to match any kitchen! This line of kitchen tools and gadgets features soft-grip ergonomic handles and is designed to lie flat, so they never tip or roll. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 400°F and safe for all non-stick cookware.

CTG-01-LS.name: Nylon Slotted Spoon
CTG-01-LS.description: Cuisinart® has even more of what it takes to cook, including colors to match any kitchen! This line of kitchen tools and gadgets features soft-grip ergonomic handles and is designed to lie flat, so they never tip or roll. Nylon heads are heat resistant up to 400°F and safe for all non-stick cookware.

CTG-22-GPB.name: Oceanware Garlic Press
CTG-22-GPB.description: The Oceanware Collection is making waves as the new eco-friendly kitchen tool line. Crafted from recycled fishnets pulled from the ocean, the handles capture the essence of the seashore with deep blue and aqua tones.

CTG-22-P1B.name: Oceanware Peeler
CTG-22-P1B.description: The Oceanware Collection is making waves as the new eco-friendly kitchen tool line. Crafted from recycled fishnets pulled from the ocean, the handles capture the essence of the seashore with deep blue and aqua tones.

CTG-22-LTB.name: Oceanware Slotted Turner
CTG-22-LTB.description: The Oceanware Collection is making waves as the new eco-friendly kitchen tool line. Crafted from recycled fishnets pulled from the ocean, the handles capture the essence of the seashore with deep blue and aqua tones. These durable, eco-friendly tools have nylon heads that resist heat up to 420 ̊F. Safe to use on non-stick cookware, they go in the dishwasher for easy cleaning.

CTG-22-LSB.name: Oceanware Slotted Spoon
CTG-22-LSB.description: The Oceanware Collection is making waves as the new eco-friendly kitchen tool line. Crafted from recycled fishnets pulled from the ocean, the handles capture the essence of the seashore with deep blue and aqua tones. These durable, eco-friendly tools have nylon heads that resist heat up to 420 ̊F.  Safe to use on non-stick cookware, they go in the dishwasher for easy cleaning.

CTG-22-PCB.name: Oceanware Pizza Cutter
CTG-22-PCB.description: The Oceanware Collection is making waves as the new eco-friendly kitchen tool line. Crafted from recycled fishnets pulled from the ocean, the handles capture the essence of the seashore with deep blue and aqua tones.

MCP55-24N.name: MultiClad Pro Triple Ply Stainless Cookware

CTG-00-EWAC.name: One-Step Corkscrew
CTG-00-EWAC.description: The Cuisinart® One Step Corkscrew makes opening wine bottles and bottle caps easy! For corktop bottles, simply twist the corkscrew into the cork and open the lever to automatically raise the spiral! The double hinged corkscrew provides superior leverage and features a serrated foil cutter and bottle cap opener.

CPT-200.name: Outdoor BBQ Prep Cart
CPT-200.description:
Expand your outdoor grill prep space with the Cuisinart Outdoor BBQ Prep Cart! Cut down on the trips to and from the kitchen by keeping all your BBQ essentials out by your grill or smoker. The prep table features a spacious 36" x 18" stainless steel work surface that offers plenty of space for prepping meats, fish, chicken, veggies, and so much more. Easily remove food scraps from the work surface by brushing them directly in to the garbage bag holder, which can accommodate up to 30 gallon size trash bags. The prep cart also come equipped with a paper towel holder that can fit up to a jumbo roll of paper towels. The height adjustable shelf sits between 18-24" inches off the ground, allowing you to position exactly where you need it. The shelf is perfect for holding plates, utensils, grill fuel like charcoal and wood pellets, as well as any other BBQ essentials you need by your grill or smoker. Keep up to 6 BBQ tools within quick reach by utilizing the tool hooks on the front of the work surface.

Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CPT-194.name: Outdoor Prep Table
CPT-194.description: Expand your outdoor grilling prep space with the Cuisinart® Outdoor Prep Table. This stylish prep table features a 36" x 22" stainless steel work surface which provides plenty of space for prepping and seasoning meats, vegetables, fish and more. The integrated trash bag holder allows for easy disposable of trash and food waste from the work surface. Paper towels are always necessary when prepping and cooking outdoors, that's why the Prep Table comes equipped with a paper towel holder, to make sure you always have some handy. The 4 swiveling casters make moving the table effortless, allowing you to easily situate it in the perfect spot in your yard. The storage shelf allows you to keep all of your grilling essentials handy while outside, cutting down on time back and forth to the kitchen.

CGG-1265.name: Outdoor Wok Station
CGG-1265.description: Wok This Way! Create fast, fresh and fabulous meals in minutes with the new Cuisinart Outdoor Wok Station. Premium features and unparalleled performance, it’s time to take your outdoor culinary skills to new heights. The first and only cooking solution bringing indoor wok cooking outside. Complete with premium 14” hand-hammered carbon steel wok, powerful 50,000 BTU burner system and precision haptic knob sensory control. Designed for ease of use, the Outdoor Wok Station features large rear wheels for mobility, an integrated 20 lb. propane tank holder, a convenient paper towel holder, generous prep area, and easy-clean stainless-steel top. Don’t just cook it…Wok it!

CROW-25B.name: Oval Wall Rack
CROW-25B.description: Turn your kitchen into a showstopper with the Cuisinart® Oval Wall Rack! The stunning brushed stainless steel is the perfect statement piece to hang above a kitchen island, bringing your Cuisinart® Cookware within arms reach as you cook for minimal fuss during the creative process. With ample space to hang your pans, the Oval Wall Rack is a practical and beautiful way to organize your kitchen.

ICE-70PDL.name: Paddle for Cool Creations™ Ice Cream Maker

CTG-00-OSC.name: Over the Sink Colander
CTG-00-OSC.description: The Cuisinart® Over the Sink Colander is perfect for rinsing fruits, vegetables or draining pasta. Nonslip handles extend to rest on top of sink. Sturdy stainless steel mesh. Dishwasher Safe.

CBK-110RH.name: Pan Hook for Compact Automatic Bread Maker

CPO-401.name: Outdoor Pizza Oven
CPO-401.description: The Cuisinart Outdoor Pizza Oven can turn anyone into a pizza-making master! This thoughtfully-designed and easy-to-use pizza oven takes all of the guess work out of cooking pizzas. The Pizza Pre-Set Temperature Zone allows you to easily dial in the perfect cooking temperature. Simply pre-heat the oven on high and once the thermometer reaches the "PIZZA" zone, turn the knob to the corresponding setting on the dial and you're ready to cook. This helps to match the oven temperature with the stone temperature, ensuring your pizza cooks evenly on the top and bottom. The Dual-Hinged Lid is a Patent Pending design that features a front-access pizza door to easily add and remove pizza with minimal heat loss. When you're done cooking pizzas, flip the lid open to easily clean inside the oven. The lid is also double-wall insulated allowing for faster pre-heat, temps over 800° F, and a cook time of under 5 minutes. To create perfectly cooked crusts, the oven features a 13" round cordierite pizza stone to retain and distribute heat evenly across the surface. Our Thermo-Flo Technology utilizes a 15,000 BTU burner that heats the stone from the bottom, allowing for natural convection around the pizza, preventing hot spots that can burn and ruin your pizza.

ICE-30BCPDL.name: Paddle for Pure Indulgence™ 2 Quart Frozen Yogurt-Sorbet & Ice Cream Maker

PE-50.name: Pasta Extruder Attachment
PE-50.description: Our Pasta Extruder Attachment lets you turn your Precision Master Stand Mixer into a kitchen workhorse, whipping up fresh batches of pasta for family and friends. Makes macaroni, spaghetti, rigatoni, fusilli, and more. Bellissimo! For use with SM-50 Series, SMD-50 Series and SM-35 Series Stand mixers.

CBK-210PH.name: Pan Hook for Custom Convection Bread Maker

CTG-15-P1R.name: Trentino Peeler
CTG-15-P1R.description: Cuisinart's new collection of kitchen tools merges complete comfort and optimal performance. Durable yet lightweight, these ergonomically designed essentials feature soft grip handles for ease of use. Each tool is safe for nonstick cookware and has a built-in couter-rest feature that elevates the tool head, eliminating mess and cross contamination.

PRS-50.name: Pasta Roller and Cutter Attachment
PRS-50.description: The Cuisinart® Pasta Roller and Cutter Attachment connects to your Precision Master™ Stand Mixer to make a variety of homemade pastas. Pasta Sheet Roller lets you make fresh lasagne or hand-cut pasta of differing thicknesses, while the other two cutters make Fettuccine or spaghetti. Homemade pasta will become an everyday affair! For use with SM-50 Series, SMD-50 Series and SM-35 Series stand mixers. NOTE: Pasta roller and cutters must be kept dry. Do not immerse in water, or spray with water, on any part of the attachments.

PM-1.name: Pastafecto Pasta / Bread Dough Maker
PM-1.description: Making mouthwatering meals is simple and satisfying with the Cuisinart® Pastafecto Pasta/Bread Dough Maker. Mix together eggs, flour, oil, and salt and choose from 6 discs to make classic pasta varieties, including spaghetti, rigatoni, fusilli, small macaroni, fettuccine, and bucatini, in only 20 minutes. Get inspired and add ingredients for a pasta recipe of your own creation or put the mixer to use kneading small-batch bread dough to perfect, ready-to-rise consistency. Delight family, friends, and yourself with healthier homemade pastas and breads made fresh at home.

CTG-00-TIL.name: Perfect Steep™ Tea Bag Shape Infuser - Large
CTG-00-TIL.description: The Perfect Steep™ Tea Bag Infuser holds up to two tablespoons of loose tea, ideal for making a pot of tea or mulling spices, and comes with a stainless steel coaster to prevent drips.

CTG-00-TIS.name: Perfect Steep™ Tea Ball Infuser
CTG-00-TIS.description: The Perfect Steep™ Tea Ball Infuser holds up to one and one-half teaspoons for individual servings, with perforated and fine mesh construction for steeping efficiently.

COH-400.name: Perfect Position Propane Patio Heater
COH-400.description: The Cuisinart® Perfect Position Propane Patio Heater is an overhead heater like no other! Unlike standard upright heaters, it has a swivel design that directs the heat where you need it most; from left to right, it has your patio covered. The extra-large 33” heat shield and cone-shaped burner unit helps direct the heat downward and outward, maximizing the 38,200 BTUs. This heater comes ready to use right out of the box with a 50 lb. sand-filled wheeled base. The enclosed base hides a 20 lb. propane tank, and has easy access to turn the gas on and off. A built-in drink table adds even more functionality and style to the unit. Your guests will love coming over for dinner parties knowing that they won’t have to huddle under the heater, they will enjoy the warmth wherever you rotate the Perfect Position Propane Patio Heater.

CPK-17P1W.name: PerfecTemp® Cordless Electric Kettle
CPK-17P1W.description: Protect your tea from over brewing with the PerfecTemp® Cordless Electric Kettle and its six preset temperatures optimized for every variety of tea. The 1500-watt cordless kettle quickly brings water to the exact heat and keep it at temperature for 30 minutes, so you don’t have to wait for your second cup! And for those who enjoy coffee, this Cuisinart teakettle also features a French Press preset to bring out the full flavors of your coffee grinds every time.

CGG-180T.name: Petite Gourmet Portable Tabletop Gas Grill
CGG-180T.description: Get great grilled flavor every day from the compact, high-performance Cuisinart Petite Gourmet Gas Grill. Its small format can be put almost anywhere for ultimate convenience. And although the grill is compact, its ample cooking grate is large enough to cook most family meals - 8 steaks, 8 hamburgers, 6 - 10 chicken breasts, or over 4 lbs. of fish! The grill heats up very quickly and uses far less gas than a full-sized grill. Best of all, with its great portability features this grill can cook your meals wherever you go - the beach, the game, the campsite - anywhere! Folding legs, grill lid latch, generous carry handle, and the spill resistant drip tray all enhance portability.

PBL-100.name: Personal Portable Blender
PBL-100.description: Make smoothies, protein drinks, and other nutritious beverages in seconds with this innovative portable blender for active lifestyles. Ideal for blending fresh drinks at home or while traveling, it’s the mini blender that combines powerful performance with portable convenience. Designed with a snap spout lid and carrying loop, this cordless single-serve blender lets you blend up to 18 oz directly into the travel cup for beverages to go. It even comes with a charging cable and produces up to 20 blends on a single charge. Blend anywhere, anytime, with the power to turn ice and frozen fruit into quick, refreshing drinks. The lid and travel cup are top-rack dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning.

CGG-180.name: Petite Gourmet Portable Gas Grill with VersaStand
CGG-180.description: The Cuisinart Petite Gourmet Portable Gas Grill with VersaStand™ delivers exceptional grilling performance in a compact, portable design. With 150 sq. in. of dishwasher-safe porcelain-enameled cooking space, it accommodates up to 8 burgers, steaks, chicken breasts, or over 4 lbs. of fish. The 5,500 BTU burner and twist-to-start ignition ensure quick, consistent heat. The innovative VersaStand™ features an integrated telescoping base, transitioning effortlessly between tabletop and freestanding grill use. Compact and lightweight, it folds down for easy transport. Ideal for camping, tailgating, beach outings, or everyday grilling, this small grill combines convenience, versatility, and performance wherever you go.

CPS-445P.name: Pizza Grilling Pack 3 piece
CPS-445P.description: Who can resist a fresh, grill fired pizza? Now you can fire one up with ease using the Cuisinart® Grilled Pizza Pack.  This 3 Piece set provides everything you need to grill a pizza – Pizza Stone, Pizza Peel and Pizza Cutter.   Toss the stone on your grill and in about 15 minutes you'll be ready to turn professional looking grilled pizzas out at home.  The large stainless peel makes it easy to remove and maneuver your pizzas and our cutter will have you enjoying slices in a flash.

CTG-00-PSS.name: Pizza Sauce Spoon
CTG-00-PSS.description: Crafted from durable stainless steel, the Cuisinart Pizza Sauce Spoon is 12” long and holds 4 ounces of sauce—the perfect length and amount for pizza-making. Measurement marks inside the spoon head ensure you always get the amount just right. The flat-bottom of the head evenly spreads sauce while the angled handle gives you mess-free control.

CPS-013.name: Pizza Grilling Stone
CPS-013.description: Grill pizza evenly and easily with The Cuisinart® Pizza Grilling Stone. You will be able to cook your pizzas evenly on the grill with this 3/8" thick cordierite stone. At 13", this pizza stone will allow you to make a variety of different size pizzas. You can use this stone whether you want to make a pizza for the whole family or your own personal pie. Cordierite is the perfect material for the grill because it withstands the high temperatures of an open flame and resists thermal shock better than ceramic.  Be the hit at your next tailgate with this pizza stone as you grill perfect pizzas for all your friends and family.

WM-PZ10.name: Pizzelle Press
WM-PZ10.description: Cuisinart simplifies the art of making the perfect pizzelle. Our Pizzelle Press bakes two, thin, 4-inch Italian waffle cookies at once. Five browning shades let users make pizzelle dark or light, hard and crisp, or soft and chewy. Indicator lights guarantee perfect timing, and non-stick plates let pizzelle be removed without breaking. Warm pizzelle can be rolled for cannoli or cones to fill with custard or cream. It's easy start to finish, and delicious, first bite to last!

CGG-1050.name: Portable Butane Camping Stove
CGG-1050.description: The Cuisinart Portable Butane Camping Stove is an essential accessory to any good camping trip or tailgating event. The butane stove accommodates pots and pans ranging from 5" to 10" in diameter, allowing you to prepare a variety of meals wherever your adventure takes you. The rust-proof aluminum burner provides up to 8,000 BTUs of cooking power, giving you a continuous run time of 1.25 hours with one 8oz. butane canister. The butane canisters nest neatly in to the integrated fuel compartment when in use and lock in place for added safety.

COH-514.name: Portable Tabletop Patio Heater-Dark Grey
COH-514.description: Bring warmth and style to your outdoor space with the Cuisinart Tabletop Patio Heater, a compact yet powerful propane heater that enhances any patio, yard, or outdoor setup. Perfectly sized for tabletops, this 11,000 BTU heater evenly warms up to 100 sq. ft., making it ideal for gatherings on chilly nights. Its portable design means you can easily bring it to camping trips or tailgating events. Equipped with an anti-tilt safety switch and burner screen guard, this heater ensures safety while providing steady warmth. Easily control the temperature with the rotary dial, and enjoy extended warmth by connecting it to a 20-lb. propane tank for longer-lasting comfort. Whether you’re dining outdoors or hosting a gathering, this stylish and versatile tabletop heater keeps everyone warm and comfortable.

CTG-04-PC.name: Pizza Cutter
CTG-04-PC.description: As part of the Cuisinart® Barrel Handle Line, this pizza cutter features a sophisticated design with a professional look and feel. The black soft-grip handle with stainless steel is rounded for universal comfort. Pizza cutter has a 4.25" stainless steel blade. Dishwasher Safe.

CTG-00-MPM.name: Pop and Serve Popcorn Maker
CTG-00-MPM.description: Cuisinart® has an easier, healthier way to make fresh crisp popcorn in the microwave. Our Pop and Serve Popcorn Maker silicone bowl pops kernels without needing any oil for a lighter healthier snack. Add your own flavorings like butter, salt, or spices, or leave as is for a healthy snack that’s ready to serve right from the bowl! The silicone bowl is easy to clean and collapses for convenient storage. Fun to use and easy to clean.

CPG-256.name: Portable Wood Pellet Grill and Smoker
CPG-256.description: Take your outdoor cooking to the next level with the Cuisinart Outdoors Portable Wood Pellet Grill and Smoker. Compact yet powerful, this versatile pellet smoker offers 256 sq. in. of cooking space (188 sq. in. main rack + 68 sq. in. warming rack) and features an integrated sear zone for direct or indirect grilling. Whether you're smoking, barbecuing, grilling, roasting, or even baking, this 8-in-1 pellet grill has you covered with precise temperature control ranging from 180°F to 500°F. The Precision Pellet Delivery System automatically adds wood pellets to maintain the perfect temperature, making it easier than ever to get that authentic wood-fired flavor. With a 4 lb. pellet hopper, you can enjoy hours of uninterrupted smoking. Plus, the included meat probe lets you monitor food temperatures effortlessly. Ideal for backyard gatherings, RV camping trips & tailgating, and more, this portable pellet grill is your go-to for on-the-go grilling with smokey flavor.

COH-513.name: Portable Tabletop Patio Heater-Red
COH-513.description: Bring warmth and style to your outdoor space with the Cuisinart Tabletop Patio Heater, a compact yet powerful propane heater that enhances any patio, yard, or outdoor setup. Perfectly sized for tabletops, this 11,000 BTU heater evenly warms up to 100 sq. ft., making it ideal for gatherings on chilly nights. Its portable design means you can easily bring it to camping trips or tailgating events. Equipped with an anti-tilt safety switch and burner screen guard, this heater ensures safety while providing steady warmth. Easily control the temperature with the rotary dial, and enjoy extended warmth by connecting it to a 20-lb. propane tank for longer-lasting comfort. Whether you’re dining outdoors or hosting a gathering, this stylish and versatile tabletop heater keeps everyone warm and comfortable.

DLC-XPN.name: Plus™ 20 Cup Food Processor
DLC-XPN.description: Designed for professional chefs, the Cuisinart Plus™ 20 Cup Food Processor provides unmatched performance and durability. The extra large 20 cup work bowl is perfect for catering and restaurant use. The powerful motor can knead dough with ease, shred cheese, and chop without burning out over tough whole root vegetables. UL listed for household and commercial use, the Plus™ 20 Cup unites the ease of home cooking with professional power for the ultimate food processor.

COH-512.name: Portable Tabletop Patio Heater-Navy
COH-512.description: Bring warmth and style to your outdoor space with the Cuisinart Tabletop Patio Heater, a compact yet powerful propane heater that enhances any patio, yard, or outdoor setup. Perfectly sized for tabletops, this 11,000 BTU heater evenly warms up to 100 sq. ft., making it ideal for gatherings on chilly nights. Its portable design means you can easily bring it to camping trips or tailgating events. Equipped with an anti-tilt safety switch and burner screen guard, this heater ensures safety while providing steady warmth. Easily control the temperature with the rotary dial, and enjoy extended warmth by connecting it to a 20-lb. propane tank for longer-lasting comfort. Whether you’re dining outdoors or hosting a gathering, this stylish and versatile tabletop heater keeps everyone warm and comfortable.

CSB-750HPM.name: Potato Masher for Hurricane® Hand Blender

HM-50.name: Power Advantage® 5 Speed Hand Mixer
HM-50.description: The Cuisinart® Power Advantage® 5 Speed Hand Mixer easily mixes even the heaviest ingredients with ease. Switch from dense cookie dough to whipped cream with just one touch thanks to the slide control. This powerful motor with automatic feedback can perform any mixing task your recipes require.

HM-C.name: Power Advantage Deluxe 2 Cup Chopper/Grinder Attachment
HM-C.description: Custom-designed for use with the Cuisinart® 8-Speed Hand Mixer HM-8GR, this versatile attachment adds variety to family meals and desserts. Equipped with an ultra-sharp, stainless-steel reversible blade, it quickly and easily chops, grinds, and minces to maximize the mixer's value and performance. From chopping carrots to mincing onions to grinding nuts and much more, this kitchen essential is a must for making delicious hor d'oeuvres, side dishes, soups, salads, and garnishes. Simple to assemble and clean, it's the attachment home chefs turn to for endless menu options.

HM-3.name: Power Advantage 3-Speed Hand Mixer
HM-3.description: The Cuisinart® Power Advantage 3-Speed Hand Mixer puts 200 watts into the palm of your hand for mixing, blending, whipping, folding, and beating ingredients into mealtime masterpieces. Three ideal speed settings mix light to heavy, starting up slow and splatter-free with the SmoothStart feature, while the center-mounted cord moves with you, keeping tangles at bay and the cord out of the way so you can mix without worry. And when you need to put the mixer down, there is a convenient heel that lets you rest it upright on the countertop.

PRC-12NPC.name: Power Cord for Classic 12-Cup Stainless Percolator

HM-90S.name: Power Advantage PLUS 9 Speed Hand Mixer with Storage Case
HM-90S.description: Our premium Cuisinart® Power Advantage® PLUS 9-Speed Hand Mixer is as easy to stow away as it is to use! Whiz through any task with the automatic feedback SmoothStart™ feature to eliminate splatters. Once you’ve beaten batters, whipped egg whites, and kneaded homemade bread dough, just clean it up and fit the extra-long beaters, chef’s whisk, and dough hooks into the clear case, and snap the mixer on top. Perfect control, plenty of power, and compact storage. That’s a mixer anyone can love! All removable parts are dishwasher safe.

HM-70.name: Power Advantage® 7 Speed Hand Mixer
HM-70.description: Flawlessly mix even the densest ingredients with the Cuisinart® Power Advantage® 7 Speed Hand Mixer. Make fast work of any cookie dough or meringue with its powerful motor featuring automatic feedback delivering just the right amount of power for your cooking task. Boasting a precision touchpad with digital display, you can shifts speeds with just one touch to tackle whipping cream perfectly!

CAP-500CORD.name: Power Cord for Select Cuisinart HEPA Air Purifiers

SMD-50CRMNAS.name: Precision Pro 5.5-Quart Digital Stand Mixer
SMD-50CRMNAS.description: Introducing the digital stand mixer with the perfect blend of power, precision, and speed! Equipped with a high-performance 500-watt motor, the Cuisinart® Precision Pro Digital Stand Mixer powers through even the heaviest mixing jobs in a 5.5-quart large capacity bowl. A turn of the digital LED dial is all it takes to select from 12 speed options, including 3 preprogrammed food prep settings and 7 recipe tasks to be performed in each food prep setting. Premium attachments include chef's whisk, flat mixing paddle, dough hook, and splash guard with pour spout for maximum versatility with minimal mess. Die-cast housing provides superior durability, and commercial mixing for today's kitchen ensures precise, thorough mixing. Leave it to Cuisinart® to combine digital convenience with powerful performance in the must-have stand mixer for today's home chef.

HM-7BCS.name: Power Advantage® 7-Speed Hand Mixer with Storage Case
HM-7BCS.description: Equipped with a 200-watt motor to power through any mixing task, the Cuisinart Power Advantage 7-Speed Hand Mixer combines compact convenience with professional performance. From beating eggs and mixing batter to whipping cream and kneading dough, this kitchen essential makes it easy for home chefs to add endless variety to family desserts and meals. The simple slide control shifts seamlessly from speed to speed, and the professional-grade attachments—dough hooks, chef’s whisk, and self-cleaning beaters—make the mixer especially versatile.  A clear, snap-on storage case keeps the mixer and attachments together.

CCB-505.name: Power Scour Grill Brush
CCB-505.description: If you haven't been using stainless steel scouring pads or brushes up to this point, you truly have been missing out. The food and grease that gets caked onto your grill grate no longer stands a chance. This multi-use scour grill brush allows you to do some heavy duty cleaning on a dailly basis. There is nothing like stainless steel to eliminate any lasting residue from your delicious meal. And unlike a normal grill brush, there is no need to worry about any pieces of the grill brush head falling off. The circular design of this grill brush allows you to do all the scrubbing that the dirties of messes requires while keeping all of the stainless steel links intact.

CTG-00-PMAN2.name: PrecisionSlice™ Upright Mandoline
CTG-00-PMAN2.description: The Cuisinart PrecisionSlice™ Upright Mandoline combines ease and versatility with an upright design that ensures hands are kept away from the blades. Equipped with Cuisinart’s exclusive food processor blade technology, this innovative kitchen essential transforms fruits and vegetables into perfectly uniform slices, dices and thin and thick julienne strips. Adjust the sliders to change between cutting options and simply turn the control knob for 40 adjustable thickness options, from 1 mm to 8 mm. The extra-wide feed tube easily accommodates larger cuts of food to minimize trimming, and the slanted, gravity-fed design ensures smooth, effortless slicing. Compact and foldable, with a custom attachable collection container and cleaning brush, this mandoline set is constructed for convenient self-storage.

CPT-2150.name: Prep 'n Cook Outdoor Table & Grill Stand
CPT-2150.description: The Cuisinart Prep 'n Cook Outdoor Table & Grill Stand allows you to seamlessly move from food prep to cooking while using your portable grill. The Prep 'n Cook stainless steel table top measures 48" x 24". One half of the table will fit most portable grills, griddles, and pizza ovens. The other half offers a spacious area for food prepping and serving. The front of the table features a hide-away condiment caddy, giving you extra room to store all of your sauces and spices. To keep your work surface clean, the garbage bag holder allows you to easily dispose of foods scraps as you go. When you're finished cooking, wipe the surface clean for next time with the integrated paper towel holder. The prep half of the table folds down and the unit can be easily rolled away for storage.

PP4-26CR.name: Preferred Pan 4-Pc Set
PP4-26CR.description: Meet the Preferred Pan – your ultimate culinary sidekick! Enhance your cooking with this versatile 4.5 Qt. capacity multi-purpose pan designed to perform at least 14 cooking tasks - poach, steam, strain, sauté, sear, fry, boil, simmer, sauce, braise, deglaze, brown, bake, roast. This pan features Cuisinart’s exclusive PURELYCERAMIC™ nonstick interior - manufactured without PFAS, ensuring it is free of PFOS, PFOA, and petroleum - for easy cleanup and is dishwasher safe. Lifetime warranty.

PPS4-26.name: Preferred Pan 4-Pc Set Stainless Steel
PPS4-26.description: Meet the Preferred Pan – your ultimate culinary sidekick! Enhance your cooking with this versatile 4.5 Qt. capacity multi-purpose pan designed to perform at least 14 cooking tasks - poach, steam, strain, sauté, sear, fry, boil, simmer, sauce, braise, deglaze, brown, bake, roast. This pan features Cuisinart’s exclusive PURELYCERAMIC nonstick interior - manufactured without PFAS, ensuring it is free of PFOS, PFOA, and petroleum - for easy cleanup and is dishwasher safe. Lifetime warranty.

SPI-50.name: PrepExpress™ Spiralizer/Slicer Attachment
SPI-50.description: The PrepExpress™ Spiralizer/Slicer Attachment turns the Cuisinart® SM-50 Stand Mixer into one of the most versatile appliances in any kitchen! Ideal for creative cooks, with four cutting cones with ultra sharp stainless steel blades that produce 8 different types of cuts. Cones and two feed tubes – one straight and one angled – make it easy to create Slices and Ribbon Slices, Crinkles and Ribbon Crinkles, Shreds and Thin Shreds, Spaghetti and Thin Spaghetti. Great for butternut squash pasta, nutritious spirals of zucchini and apples, shredded veggies for homemade fajitas, and so much more! Cuisinart® continues to make it easier than ever to eat healthy! For use with SM-50 Series, SMD-50 Series and SM-35 Series stand mixers.

SM-50.name: Precision Master 5.5-Quart Stand Mixer
SM-50.description: Delivering power, precision and performance, our stand mixer features a 500-watt motor, die-cast metal construction, and 12 speeds that allow for nuance and excellence in performing a variety of preparation tasks. The unit's tilt-back head allows for easy access to its 5.5-quart mixing bowl, while the included splash guard prevents messy countertops. Also included are a chef's whisk, dough hook, and flat mixing paddle. The mixing bowl and all accessories are dishwasher safe. Additionally, you can purchase a variety of attachments for the unit: a pasta roller and cutter, pasta extruder, meat grinder, frozen dessert maker, and spiralizer.

CGS-2010Z.name: Premium Grilling Set (10 Piece)
CGS-2010Z.description: The Cuisinart® 10 Piece Premium Grilling Set features all the tools any grill master needs to manage your savory steaks, juicy burgers, succulent fish and fresh vegetables.  These durable stainless steel tools with wooden handles fit comfortably in your hands and bring a touch of style to your grilling area.  Set includes Chef's Spatula, Grill Tongs, Grill Fork, Set of 4 Skewers, Grill Brush and 2 Replacement Grill Brush Heads.  The durable leather case make storing and traveling with your set a breeze.

CGG-288.name: Prep 'N Go Folding Gas Grill
CGG-288.description: The Cuisinart Prep 'n Go Folding Gas Grill is designed for ultimate portability, food prep, storage, and cooking all in one. When folded, the grill measures 27.8" L x 22.3" D x 15.1" H, making it the most compact tri-fold grill available—saving valuable trunk space for other essentials . Cook up to 17 burgers at once with 285 sq. in. of cooking space on durable cast iron grates. With 18,000 BTUs of cooking power, this grill is perfect for camping, tailgating, or any on-the-go grilling. The large 24" x 12" prep table eliminates the need for a separate table, giving you plenty of room for food prep and staging. A removable storage tote underneath the prep area keeps your party essentials like plates, bowls, and utensils organized, and folds away with the grill when you’re done. The wheels and built-in handle allow for easy mobility, so you can easily wheel the grill to your campsite, tailgate, or backyard gathering.

CTG-16-MC.name: Primary Meat Chopper
CTG-16-MC.description: Make mealtime prep easier with this versatile meat chopper. Effortlessly break apart ground meat, sausage, tofu and more. The durable tool head is safe for nonstick cookware and works great for browning ground meats, mashing potatoes, and mixing ingredients together. A soft-grip, nonslip handle with a textured thumb rest provides added comfort and control while you cook.

CTG-00-PCH4.name: PrepExpress® Manual Food Processor
CTG-00-PCH4.description: Chop and mince! Five stainless steel blades for easy chopping, mincing, and puréeing of fruits, vegetables, nuts and more! The Blend and Mix Blending Paddle is ideal for omelets, salad dressings, sauces and more!

CWC-60CU.name: Private Reserve® 30-Bottle Wine Cellar with Compressor
CWC-60CU.description: This powerful, consistent, cooling compressor wine cellar holds up to 30 bottles of your favorite red, whites and champagnes! It's cooling compressor technology keeps the interior perfectly cool despite room temperature fluctuations. Complete with touchscreen temperature and light controls on the outer door to select your preferred temperature 43°F to 64°F and to turn the wine cellar light on/off. Store your wine in style in this elegant wine cellar with black rubber-coated shelves complete with solid wood trim that will give your collection the showcase it deserves.

CWC-1500CU.name: Private Reserve 15-Bottle Wine Cellar with Compressor
CWC-1500CU.description: This powerful, consistent, cooling compressor wine cellar holds up to 15 bottles of your favorite red, whites and champagnes! It's cooling compressor technology keeps the interior perfectly cool despite room temperature fluctuations. Complete with touchscreen temperature and light controls on the outer door to select your preferred temperature 43°F to 64°F and to turn the wine cellar light on/off. Store your wine in style in this elegant wine cellar with black rubber-coated shelves complete with solid wood trim that will give your collection the showcase it deserves.

CWC-800CEN.name: Private Reserve 8-Bottle Wine Cellar
CWC-800CEN.description: Preserve wines flavor, bouquet, and body in style! The Cuisinart® 8 Bottle Private Reserve Wine Cellar combines technological sophistication with ease and convenience. Engineered for optimal efficiency, this compact wine showcase stores up to 8 reds, whites, and Champagnes at their ideal temperature. At the touch of a button, the desired temperature is set between 39°F to 68°F and is quietly maintained by a thermoelectric cooling system that conserves energy without sacrificing performance. Sleek black housing with soft interior lighting and contoured chrome racks make this wine cellar a handsome, on-trend addition to any home.

CWC-36CU.name: Private Reserve® Compressor Wine Cellar
CWC-36CU.description: Keep your wine tasting its best with 2-zone temperature control that ensures both reds and whites are stored under optimal conditions. Engineered with compression-free technology, the Cuisinart Private Reserve® Dual Zone Wine Cellar maintains ideal temperatures with less noise and energy consumption. Touchscreen controls right on the door make it easy to select preferred temperatures from 39°F to 68°F. The “slim line” design fits in narrow spaces while storing up to 18 bottles of wine and champagne. Crafted with stainless steel exterior trim and sturdy racks with natural wood and chrome accents, this sleek, modern wine cellar is worthy of the finest vintages.

CTG-00-VFC.name: PrepExpress® Vegetable & Fruit Chopper
CTG-00-VFC.description:
The multipurpose PrepExpress(R) Vegetable & Fruit Chopper makes customized chopping and dicing effortless. Create uniform dices and long cuts of vegetables and fruits  with interchangeable large and small stainless steel blade grids. This kitchen essential has an angled precision chopping platform for effortless chopping and less trimming. The large 4-cup collection container has a non-slip base that can safely store blade grids and the cleaning tool after use. This set is ideal for fries, salads, soup starters and so much more. 

The set includes a small & large blade grid, chopping cover, collection container, and cleaning tool.

CWC-800CENS.name: Private Reserve® Dual 16-Bottle Wine Cellar
CWC-800CENS.description: The Cuisinart® 16-Bottle Private Reserve Wine Cellar combines technological sophistication with ease and convenience. Designed to fit on the countertop, this compact, slim-line wine cellar cradles up to 16 bottles of wine or Champagne on contoured chrome racks. The two thermoelectric, compressor-free cooling systems chill quietly and efficiently. Touchscreen controls on each outer door let you select settings from 39°F to 68°F for dual-zone cooling at two different temperatures.

89-13.name: Professional Series Cookware 13 Piece Set
89-13.description: One of the most versatile tools in any kitchen, the 13 Piece set is ideal for browning meats, sautéing vegetables and even simmering hearty sauces for pasta. And it’s beautiful enough to bring to the table.

8922-24.name: Professional Series™ Cookware 10" Skillet
8922-24.description: Elegant style meets multitasking practicality in these professional quality stainless skillets. Cooks can pan-fry, sauté, simmer and braise everything a recipe requires.

DLC-8S.name: Pro Custom 11-Cup Food Processor
DLC-8S.description: From the Cuisinart Pro Custom 11™ 11 Cup Food Processor's cover with large feed tube and unique compact chopping/kneading cover, to its industrial quality motor, this kitchen powerhouse is built to deliver professional results year after year. With two different slicing discs, a shredding disc, a chopping/mixing blade, and two sizes of pushers, you can make fast work of any recipe prep without breaking a sweat.

8922-810NS.name: Professional Series Stainless Steel 2pk Non-Stick Skillet Set (8” & 10”)
8922-810NS.description: Professional Stainless Steel Construction PowerBond Impact Bonded Aluminum Encapsulated Base Premium Non-Stick Interior Riveted Stainless Handles Induction Ready Dishwasher Safe

CBM-18N.name: Programmable Conical Burr Mill
CBM-18N.description: The elegant brushed stainless steel Cuisinart® Programmable Conical Burr Mill produces perfect results every time for all your coffee needs with 18 settings, from extra coarse for your French Press to extra fine for rich espresso. The conical burr grinder produces a uniform grind without sacrificing the natural oils of your coffee beans for rich, flavorful results. With an easy-to-read LCD display showing the time, fineness, and number of cups, coffee is easy and fresher than ever.

DCC-3400NAS.name: Programmable Thermal Coffeemaker (12 Cup)
DCC-3400NAS.description: Hotter coffee and brew strength options – the best of both worlds! The Cuisinart® 12 Cup Programmable Thermal Coffeemaker is equipped with cutting edge coffee technology to give you hotter coffee without sacrificing taste. Choose a flavor profile with regular or bold strength control, and set brew-time up to 24-hours ahead. Our backlit LCD is easy-to-read, a ready tone can be turned on or off, and an indicator light signals when it’s time to decalcify.

8922-20.name: Professional Series™ Cookware 8" Skillet
8922-20.description: Cook like a pro with this professional stainless steel 8" Skillet from Cuisinart. The exclusive PowerBond high impact bonded base heats fast, distributes heat evenly and is induction-cooktop ready. Riveted stainless handles provide strength and durability for ultimate control. Oven and broiler safe up to 500°F for superior versatility.

CGS-333.name: Professional Grill Tool Set (3 Piece)
CGS-333.description: The Cuisinart® 3 Piece Professional Tool Set turns any griller into a pro with high quality good looking tools.  This set is constructed of durable stainless steel and rubber ergonomic grips.  The Cuisinart® logo is embossed proudly across the tools as a signature of quality and each tool is comfortably long enough to use safely at the grill without being bulky.  This set includes a grill spatula, silicone tipped grill tongs and a grill spatula.

CTG-00-FFC2.name: PrepExpress French Fry Cutter
CTG-00-FFC2.description: Cutting-edge fries! Make slicing potatoes, carrots, zucchini, eggplant and more, fast, fun, and easy. Two durable, stainless steel grid blades cut both regular and steak fries. The handy food pusher keeps fingers safe as you press food down. No part of the vegetable goes to waste! With setup and clean up so fast and simple, prepping the perfect fries has never been easier!

CTG-24-CO.name: Profile Can Opener
CTG-24-CO.description: The 7-piece Profile Collection includes essential utensils with nonslip, ergonomic handles, featuring durable stainless steel gadget blade.

C99SS-15P.name: Professional Series 15 Piece Knife Block Set
C99SS-15P.description:
THE SHARPEST BLADE IN CUISINART CUTLERY. With an emphasis on technique, craftsmanship, and German steel, Cuisinart introduces the sharpest knives in their class. These Professional Series knives use an innovative grinding process to create a more durable, finer-edged blade. The result is a knife fit for a chef and made for the everyday cook that give you the unprecedented advantage of high performance cutlery at tremendous value.
 
- Designed for exceptional performance
- Expertly crafted to give the home chef professional results
- Innovative technique produces a flawless “V” edge for finer more precise cutting, verses a traditional honed edge.
- Crafted from high quality German Stainless Steel
- Sleek design fits perfectly into any kitchen

QG-2186.name: Propel+ Series Natural Gas Conversion Kit
QG-2186.description: Never let your grilling plans be interrupted by an empty propane tank. The Cuisinart Natural Gas Conversion Kit is specifically designed for the Propel+ 4-Burner 3-in-1 Gas Grill, allowing you to seamlessly switch from liquid propane to natural gas for uninterrupted backyard BBQs. This complete kit includes a 10-foot natural gas hose and five precision-engineered orifices to ensure a perfect fit for all burners. All parts and instructions are included, so the conversion process is easy, allowing you to enjoy consistent, efficient grilling without the worry of running out of fuel. Built with durability and convenience in mind, this kit is the ideal solution for grilling enthusiasts who want the reliability of a direct natural gas connection. Designed exclusively for the (Models: CGG-6331 & CGG-63311).

CGG-6331.name: Propel+ Four Burner 3-in-1 Gas Grill (Grill, Griddle, Pizza Oven)
CGG-6331.description: The Cuisinart Propel+ 4 Burner 3-in-1 Gas Grill delivers powerful performance with endless possibilities. Our Thermo-Flo™ Technology ensures even, natural convection heating, while the electronic ignition gets you cooking fast. The grill features 477 sq. in. of main cooking space plus a 138 sq. in. warming rack, with 44,000 BTUs across four burners—rivaling full-size five-burner grills. The side table offers 176 sq. in. of griddle space with an 11,000 BTU XL burner. The cast iron griddle plate retains heat, reaching 600°F for restaurant-quality sears. Dual-functionality lets you use the grill and griddle simultaneously. The pizza oven includes a 15" cordierite stone for even heat and perfect crusts. Pizza rack’s slightly raised design ensures 360° heat circulation. The dual-hinged EZ-Lift lid features a drop-down tempered glass pizza door for minimal heat loss and easy access. Integrated storage keeps accessories organized. The grill is also dual-fuel capable with a natural gas conversion kit (sold separately).

CTG-120.name: Propane Tank Gauge
CTG-120.description: The Cuisinart® Propane Tank Gauge is a simple and quick way to check how much propane is left in your grill's tank. All you have to do is hook life and look. Innovative culinary tools are the Cuisinart® signature. The prestigious Cuisinart® brand is not limited to their famous food processors - plugged or unplugged, nobody covers the modern chef like Cuisinart®. Cuisinart® is a full-service culinary resource with a wide array of products, preferred by chefs and favored by consumers. And now you can take the world famous Cuisinart® brand to your patio, lawn, tailgate, or campsite with their comprehensive line of Cuisinart® outdoor grilling products available now on Amazon.

CSJ-300P.name: Pusher for Easy Clean Slow Juicer

CTG-00-SCHP.name: Push Chopper
CTG-00-SCHP.description: The Cuisinart® Stainless Steel Food Chopper is great for chopping vegetables, hard cheeses, nuts, herbs, garlic and more. The base allows you to chop with or without a cutting board. Stainless Steel housing and blade. Dishwasher Safe.

CJE-500PSR.name: Pusher for Cuisinart Compact Juice Extractor

CWC-800CERK.name: Rack for Private Reserve Wine Cellars

CPS-050P.name: Quick Cut Pizza Cutter
CPS-050P.description: The Quick Pizza Cutter is designed for cutting your pizzas with quick, easy, and simple motions. Its sharp, stainless steel blade allows you to portion your dough as you prepare to make your delicious pizzas. Make your pizzas ready to serve seconds after they are finished cooking. This pre-sharpened blade comes ready to cut and the long rubber grip allows for comfortable and controlled cutting.

CWC-1800CURK.name: Rack for Private Reserve® Compressor Wine Cellar

EM-100RP.name: Removable Drip Tray for Espresso Maker

EM-200RP.name: Removable Drip Tray for Programmable Espresso Maker

EM-200NGRATE.name: Removable Grate for Programmable Espresso Maker

CCP-2747Z.name: Reversable 2-in-1 Cast Iron Grill/Griddle Plate
CCP-2747Z.description: Expand your outdoor and indoor cooking capabilities with the Cuisinart 2-in-1 Reversible Cast Iron Grill/Griddle Plate. This heavy-duty cast iron plate features a ribbed grill side for perfect sear marks and a flat griddle side for even cooking. Whether you’re grilling juicy steaks or making fluffy pancakes, this plate delivers exceptional heat retention and even cooking. The large cooking surface fits over campfires, grills, two stovetop burners, or even in the oven, offering unmatched versatility. From breakfast classics to your grilled favorites, this grill/griddle plate is a must-have for every home chef.

CCP-2000.name: Reversible Cast Iron Grill/Griddle Plate
CCP-2000.description: Unlock greater cooking versatility with the Cuisinart Reversible Cast Iron Grill/Griddle Plate! This heavy duty, cast iron plate features a ribbed grill on one side and a smooth flat top on the other. Use the grill side to get a restaurant-quality sear with the beautiful grill marks to match. Use the griddle side to cook up some bacon and eggs in the morning, paninis in the afternoon, and flip it over to sear steaks for dinner. The cast iron construction provides maximum heat retention with even heating across the surface. The plate fits perfectly on your grill to sear more delicate foods like fish and veggies and can also be used indoors on your stove top over 2 burners.

FP-130RSD.name: Reversible Shredding Disc for Core Custom® 13 Cup Food Processor

FP-110RSD.name: Reversible Shredding Disc for Core Custom 10 Cup Food Processor

MG-50RN.name: Ring Nut for Meat Grinder Attachment

CGSS-556.name: Roasted Chipotle Garlic Seasoning
CGSS-556.description: Cuisinart’s Roasted Chipotle Garlic Seasoning is a fan favorite! Your guests will love the smoky flavor that emerges from this sweet and spicy seasoning. The heat from the chipotle compliments the sweetness from the garlic perfectly, leaving your tastes buds excited for the next bite! Use as a dry rub for grilling by rubbing or sprinkling 1-3 teaspoons of seasoning per pound of meat; adjust to taste. Use as a paste by adding 1 Tablespoon of olive oil for every 1 teaspoon of seasoning and brush on just before cooking. Use as a topical seasoning by shaking on top of your grilled meats and vegetables; adjust to taste.

PE-50RN.name: Ring Nut for Pasta Extruder Attachment

ASR-1713V.name: Roasting And Lasagna Pans 17" x 13" Nonstick Roaster with V-Rack
ASR-1713V.description: Ideal for turkey dinners or large roasts, this collection provides the perfect solution for everyday family meals, parties and holiday celebrations. Lifting is made safe and easy with sturdy construction and wide-grip handles on each roaster pan. Each fully non-stick design makes cleanup convenient. Make and bake holiday classics or prepare family favorites any time of year with these versatile must-haves.

CTG-00-RPC.name: Rocking Pizza Cutter
CTG-00-RPC.description: Quickly and easily cut a full pizza pie into perfect slices with the Cuisinart Rocking Pizza Cutter. The soft-grip, nonslip handles provide a comfortable grip, while the durable 14” stainless-steel blade easily cuts through the pizza. A simple two-handed rocking motion ensures precise portions, so you can spend less time cutting pizza and more time enjoying it. The Cuisinart Rocking Pizza Cutter comes with a blade guard for safe storage.

WAF-F30NAS.name: Round Flip Belgian Waffle Maker
WAF-F30NAS.description: Fast, flavorful and fluffy—every Belgian waffle baked in Cuisinart’s Flip Belgian Waffle Maker is cooked to perfection in minutes. Designed with a rotary feature that flips 180° to evenly cook waffles inside and out, this kitchen essential bakes according to preference with a turn of the dial, from light to dark. Nonstick plates easily release a flawlessly formed Belgian waffle with deep pockets perfect for filling with fruit, meat, jams, whipped cream, and other toppings. A ready indicator light advises when the waffle is ready and prevents over- and under-cooking. Durable, brushed stainless steel housing complements any kitchen and wipes clean in seconds.

CTG-00-SAS1.name: Salad Spinner
CTG-00-SAS1.description: The Cuisinart® Salad spinner allows you to wash and dry salad greens, fruits, and vegetables without removing the spinner lid. Add and drain water through the opening on top. Turn the handle to spin the basket and press the brake button to instantly stop the spinning action. Quick, easy, dishwasher safe, and countertops stay dry!

CBP-116.name: Sauce Pot and Basting Brush Set
CBP-116.description: The Cuisinart® Sauce Pot and Basting Brush Set makes it easy to serve up delicious barbecued meat, poultry and seafood every time you grill.  This heavy-duty stainless steel pot comes with a secure lid with an integrated basting brush and holds an ample amount of sauce to cover all the food on your grill.  The silicone brush head distributes sauces smoothly and evenly and detaches from the lid for convenient dishwasher-safe cleaning.

WMR-CANAS.name: Round Classic Waffle Maker
WMR-CANAS.description: Make delicious waffles fast and easy with the gleaming stainless steel Cuisinart® Round Classic Waffle Maker. Take control of your breakfast with five browning settings and red and green indicator lights to let you know when it’s ready to bake, and ready to eat for wonderful waffles every time.

CGSS-787.name: Roasted Chipotle Garlic Seasoning 14.6 oz
CGSS-787.description: Cuisinart® Roasted Chipotle Garlic Seasoning - Smoky, Sweet and Spicy is a fan favorite! Your guests will love the smoky flavor that emerges from this sweet and spicy seasoning. The heat from the chipotle compliments the sweetness from the garlic perfectly, leaving your tastes buds excited for the next bite! Use as a dry rub for grilling by rubbing or sprinkling 1-3 teaspoons of seasoning per pound of meat; adjust to taste. Use as a paste by adding 1 Tablespoon of olive oil for every 1 teaspoon of seasoning and brush on just before cooking. Use as a topical seasoning by shaking on top of your grilled meats and vegetables; adjust to taste.

SP-4.name: Salt & Pepper Mills
SP-4.description: Add elegance and convenience to your kitchen. Cuisinart Rechargeable Salt & Pepper Mills make it easy to serve freshly ground salt and pepper. Mills sit in a stainless steel power base with charge and ready indicator lights and are always fully charged for 15~20 minutes of continuous use. LED base lighting helps you get the amount of seasoning you want, where you want it! Mills adjust settings from fine to coarse. Clear spice-holder containers make it easy to check salt and pepper levels at a glance.

CTG-00-RTNG.name: Scoop & Strain Tongs
CTG-00-RTNG.description: Get the perfect grip every time with the Scoop & Strain Tongs! Let water and other liquids drain back into the pan thanks to the carefully placed slots. Squeeze out excess fat for healthier meats with one hand.

WM-SW2N1.name: Sandwich Maker
WM-SW2N1.description: The versatile Cuisinart® Sandwich Maker does more than just lunch; press sandwiches, grill omelets, and even crisp French toast in one product! Perfect for dorm rooms and cozy kitchens, the Sandwich Grill can make two items at once, with a lock-down lid guaranteeing both sides cook evenly while the nonstick plates seal in your favorite ingredients. Sizzling cheese sandwiches and fluffy omelets come out perfectly every time with dual indicator lights letting you know when the grill is ready to cook and your meal is ready to eat. The nonstick plates wipe clean after use and the lid lock and cord wrap make storage easy.

CTG-00-3MPT.name: Set of 3 Mini Prep-and-Serve Tools
CTG-00-3MPT.description: Our Set of 3 Mini Prep-and-Serve Tools is perfect for preparing and serving a wide range of dishes. From hot appetizers, mixing and serving dips, and serving bread, cookies, desserts, and more.

CTG-00-3SP.name: Set of 3 Silicone Spatulas
CTG-00-3SP.description: Designed with durable silicone heads and nylon easy-grip handles, the 3 spatulas in this essential set are heat-resistant up to 525˚F and perfect for mixing, scraping, and folding ingredients. The flexible heads are safe for non-stick cookware and easy to clean, while the tapered handles ensure a comfortable grip. Complete with 9" mini scoop spatula, 11" standard spatula, and 11" scoop spatula, this dishwasher-safe set combines versatility and convenience. Backed by a lifetime warranty, these spatulas are sure to be go-to kitchen tools for years to come.

CTG-00-6CC.name: Set of 6 Chip Clips
CTG-00-6CC.description: The Cuisinart® Set of 6 Chip Clips keeps air out of open bags of chips, pasta, rice, and more. Magnetic backs make clips great for posting notes or hanging kid’s artwork. Clean with a dampened cloth.

CTG-00-5SP.name: Set of 5 High Heat Resistant Spatulas
CTG-00-5SP.description: Brighten your kitchen with this colorful 5-piece spatula set, featuring both mini and full-size tools perfect for stirring, scraping, folding, decorating, and more. Each spatula comes in a distinct color to help you stay organized, prevent cross-contamination, and add a stylish touch to your kitchen. Made from premium LFGB-grade silicone, these full-silicone spatulas offer superior heat resistance, flexibility, and long-lasting durability.

CCO-75.name: Side-Cut Can Opener
CCO-75.description: Now you can safely and smoothly remove lids from most pop-top or regular cans of all sizes. The Cuisinart® Side-Cut Electric Can Opener features a precision cutting mechanism that opens cans along the side of the lid, leaving edges smooth and minimizing contact with food.  Simply press the large push-down lever to activate the blade for effortless lid removal. With an extra-wide base that won’t tip or slip, this durable and dependable can opener is the fuss-free way to remove lids for all your cooking needs.

CTG-00-6MSP.name: Set of 6 Magnetic Measuring Spoons
CTG-00-6MSP.description: Measure out ingredients to perfection with this 6 piece magnetic measuring spoon set. Designed of stylish and durable stainless steel in an array of sizes, including a tablespoon, 1/2 tablespoon, 1 teaspoon, 3/4 teaspoon, 1/2 teaspoon, and 1/4; teaspoon, the set is a must-have for home chefs who want to measure ingredients with precision. Measurements markings conveniently placed for both right or left handed chef's. Each spoon features a slim head that reaches effortlessly into jars and a magnetic strip that keeps the set nested together for convenient storage.

CFE-20PSN.name: Sienna Collection
CFE-20PSN.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience. CFE-T20N.name: Trevoux 20 Piece Set
CFE-T20N.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience.

CTK-EOSTRR.name: Valor™ 2 Quart Teakettle
CTK-EOSTRR.description: Make up to two quarts of hot beverages in the gleaming stainless steel of the Valor™ 2 Quart Teakettle. This timeless teakettle from Cuisinart® features a traditional whistle to signal that water is boiling.

FRC-1000SR.name: Vent and Vent Pipe Steam Release Set

CGG-750P.name: Venture Portable Gas Grill
CGG-750P.description:
Calling all adventure seekers! The Cuisinart® Venture Portable Gas Grill is a versatile and compact grilling system that makes the perfect outdoor companion. The stack'n'go design allows the grill to go virtually anywhere; from the beach to a picnic, or on a boat delivering the ultimate social grilling experience. Venture is your all-in-one portable gas grill that comes with a comfort grip handle for carrying. The wooden lid doubles as a chopping board; simple remove the cutting board from the top to prepare your meal or use it for cheese and crackers to enjoy while sipping a glass of wine. The grill grates are porcelain enameled cast iron, giving off more heat and holds heat longer than steel. The base includes a flip-out rack that will hold your propane tank upright and secure. When packing up, you will find clips next to the grill legs that safely store the propane hose. Simple, Complete, and Compact Portable Grilling System; Venture is the perfect travel accessory for picnics, tailgating, and camping!
Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CTG-00-VB.name: Vegetable Cleaning Brush
CTG-00-VB.description: Clean produce with the Dual Bristle Brush that has soft bristles for soft-surface foods, stiff bristles for tough-skinned foods, and a handy potato eye remover. Easy-to-clean bristles and soft-grip ergonomic handle

COS-118.name: Vertical 18" Charcoal Smoker
COS-118.description: The Cuisinart® Vertical 18” Charcoal Smoker was built to last. The three year warranty adds confidence to the durable framework and porcelain enamel water bowl. With two 18” solid steel cooking grates, this smoker can accommodate just about any food you’re looking to smoke at the house. Working a charcoal smoker is as simple as lighting the charcoal, filling up the water bowl, and then casually adjusting the air vents to control the temperature. This vertical barrel design makes it easy to keep a consistent temperature with minimal adjustments and accessing the water bowl and charcoal grate doesn’t get much easier with this vertically hinged door. When all you need to setup the Cuisinart® Vertical 18” Charcoal smoker is 15 minutes and a screwdriver, you’ll be smoking your favorite foods in no time! Please Note: Outdoor grilling products do not ship to Alaska & Hawaii. International shipping is not offered.

CFE-20PVR.name: Verona Collection
CFE-20PVR.description: With our flatware, Cuisinart® brings its distinguished reputation for quality and design leadership to the dining room. Handcrafted of the finest heavy-gauge stainless steel, these generously sized pieces are created with the utmost attention to detail. The finish is artfully blended. The craftsmanship is impeccable. And the styling evokes the same French spirit that infuses Cuisinart® Cookware, which we began making in France more than 35 years ago. Set your table with Cuisinart® flatware and transform an ordinary meal into an extraordinary experience. Set includes: 4 Dinner Forks, 4 Dinner Knives, 4 Dinner Spoons, 4 Salad Forks, and 4 Teaspoons.

COS-244.name: Vertical 36" Propane Smoker
COS-244.description: Elevate your outdoor cooking game with the Cuisinart Vertical 36” Propane Smoker, the ultimate tool for creating mouthwatering barbecue. With a spacious 785 square inches of cooking space across four chrome-steel racks, this smoker is perfect for smoking meats, fish, and vegetables. The powerful 15,000 BTU propane heating element makes it easy to achieve the ideal smoking temperature, while the rear vent allows precise control of heat and smoke levels. Whether you're smoking brisket for a weekend cookout or preparing jerky for a snack, this propane smoker delivers unmatched versatility and flavor. Easy to use and clean, it’s the perfect companion for barbecue lovers of any skill level.

GK-17N.name: ViewPro Cordless Electric Kettle
GK-17N.description: Powered by 1500 watts, the ViewPro Cordless Electric Tea Kettle brings water to a boil in minutes. Whether heating water to steep the perfect cup of tea, make a cup of hot cocoa, or fill a French Press Coffeemaker, the 1.7-liter capacity holds enough water to please every member of the family at once! The glass jug lets you see at a glance when your water is ready-just pour, enjoy, and repeat. More Enjoying, Less Waiting!

C55W-14PCB.name: Walnut Triple Rivet 14 Piece Knife Block Set
C55W-14PCB.description: The professional Walnut Triple Rivet 14 Piece Cutlery Block Set includes knives that are essential for food prep, kitchen shears, and complimentary steak knives, all stored safely in a solid block. Tapered blades boast exceptionally sharp edges for precise cutting of cooked and raw meats. Made from superior high carbon stainless steel, we use three rivets to create durable cutlery that looks as good as it works.

WAF-ST6.name: Waffle Stick Maker
WAF-ST6.description: Make six 4.5-inch waffle sticks for breakfast, snacks, or savory meals. The Cuisinart® Belgian Waffle Stick Maker bakes delicious, perfectly portioned Belgian waffle sticks cooked to custom golden-brown crispiness with 5 shade settings and deep nonstick plates that wipe clean. Snack on waffle sticks topped with sweet syrups, fruit preserves, or ice cream, or make them a meal with eggs, bacon, and sausage or fried chicken and gravy.

SM-35W.name: Whisk Attachment for Precision Master™ 3.5-Quart Stand Mixer

CWO-50.name: Wine Opener
CWO-50.description: The Cuisinart Wine Opener easily removes up to 80 natural or synthetic corks on one full charge. We’ve included a foil cutter and vacuum sealer too!

CTG-00-WIC.name: Winged Corkscrew
CTG-00-WIC.description: The Cuisinart® Winged Corkscrew easily removes corks and more on all standard wine bottles. Made for Durable Stainless Steel. Hand Wash Only.

TOA-26WR.name: Wire Rack for Compact Air Fryer Toaster Oven

CTG-12-WT.name: Wide Turner
CTG-12-WT.description: You can always count on Cuisinart® for the next big idea, and this line of premium kitchen utensils and gadgets is no exception. With substantially-sized handles and generously proportioned heads, function and form unite to make quick work of any kitchen task whether stirring, scooping, flipping, grating or peeling.

CTG-00-WPS.name: Wine Pourer with Stopper
CTG-00-WPS.description: The Cuisinart® Wine Pourer with Stopper allows you to easily pour wine and store a bottle when finished. Hand Wash Only.

CTG-19-FTW.name: Wide Flex Turner
CTG-19-FTW.description: Cuisinart's New Collection of Flexible turners are great for any home chef. These flexible Stainless steel, silicone wrapped turners are perfect for flipping omelets, burgers, cookies and more! The tapered edge helps move easily underneath delicate foods without tears or a mess. These are a great addition to any kitchen!

TOA-95WR.name: Wire Rack for Large Air Fryer Toaster Oven

CPZ-120WR.name: Wire Rack for Indoor Pizza Oven

TOB-60WR.name: Wire Rack for Toaster Oven Broiler with Convection

TOB-1010WR.name: Wire Rack for Toaster Oven Broiler

TOB-40WR.name: Wire Rack for Custom Classic™ Toaster Oven Broiler

CWA-198.name: Wok Resting Rack
CWA-198.description: Cook, rest, repeat with the Cuisinart Wok Resting Rack. Crafted with premium 7 mm thick stainless steel, the resting rack provides a balanced surface to hold and serve; The 9.5” ring fits woks up to 16” and is reversable with a larger 11” ring that holds woks 18” and larger; The simplistic design creates a protective platform for support and limits transfer of heat from the wok to the table. A must have for wok stability and storage; Cuisinart Outdoors, don’t cook it…Wok it!

CWA-479.name: Wok Cleaning Set
CWA-479.description: Keep wok and wok tools sparkling clean with Cuisinart Wok Cleaning Set; the Cuisinart Outdoors 8" Palmyra Cleaning Brush with 2” bristles and comfort-shaped handle ensures a firm grip, clean directly inside the wok without damaging the natural non-stick patina; 14 oz. water dispenser with an adjustable nozzle dispenses water as needed to effectively clean wok and wok tools, while the semi-clear design allows the user to monitor water level; Clean quickly and easily, wok this way!

TOB-135WR.name: Wire Rack for Deluxe Convection Toaster Oven Broiler

TOA-70WR.name: Wire Rack for Air Fryer Toaster Oven with Grill

CGS-W13Z.name: Wooden Handle Tool Set (13 Piece)
CGS-W13Z.description: The Cuisinart 13 Piece Wooden Grill Tool Set is a simple and effective way to equip any griller for the season. The set consists of 12 individual grill tools inside a recycled plastic case. Each tool is cut from durable stainless steel and set in robust wooden handles emblazoned with the Cuisinart brand. The set includes an 18.5” Spatula, 17.5" Grill Fork, 17.5” Cleaning Brush, 18” Tongs, Four 13.5” All Stainless Skewers, and 4 corn cob holders. The tongs, brush and spatula also have convenient leather straps to easily hang them on your grill hooks. This set can handle anything you throw on your grill and it makes a great gift.

CIT-702.name: XL BBQ Spatula
CIT-702.description: Get the spatula that can handle any job; the Cuisinart® XL BBQ Spatula. This spatula is ideal for lifting small or large items on the grill or griddle. Lift multiple burgers at a time, two sirloin steaks, or larger cuts of meat like brisket or pork shoulder all with one spatula. The beveled edges are perfect for quick chopping while cooking and the stainless steel construction will ensure this spatula will be by your grill for years to come. When you're finished cooking, hand wash the spatula with regular dish soap.

CGPR-223.name: XL Cast Iron Grill Press
CGPR-223.description: Smash the grilling competition with the Cuisinart XL Cast Iron Grill Press—the ultimate tool for creating delicious steaks, gourmet paninis, grilled cheese and bacon. Crafted from durable cast iron and weighing 5.1 pounds, this press evenly flattens food to reduce cooking times while creating sear marks and enhancing flavors. Preheat the press to achieve professional-grade grill marks on burgers, steaks, and more. Its stylish wooden handle stays cool, providing a comfortable and secure grip. Ideal for cookouts, barbecues, or even indoor griddles, this tool is your key to restaurant-quality results at home.
